lowkey best base i've raided so far...





100 Days Hidden in a Minecraft Chunk Base
 is the 37th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Spoke shows the base he is about to infiltrate and hide in for the next 100 days which is owned by 
Reddoons
 and 
Yeah Jaron
. Out of the 1000 players online, it is considered to be the #1 base. 

Spoke follows Jaron inside the base but as he was about to go inside the door closed. Spoke tries placing a block on the observer but the door kept closing before he could make it inside. Spoke decides to use an elytra and firework rockets. Spoke cannot make too much noise because Reddoons was inside the base.

The goals of the base were 'Build An Empire, Get Rich and Get More Rich'. Spoke was snooping around but then Reddoons came down he hid behind the bookshelves that were used for the enchanting table setup. Consequently, the book on the enchanting table opened and faced towards 
Spoke
. Luckily, Reddoons didn't spot it.

Spoke tried hopping downbut he took fall damage that makes noise that could alert Reddoons about his whereabouts. 

On day 3, Spoke went to his stash to get some potion materials, ender pearls and even a chorous fruit. Spoke went back inside the base but when he tried hopping up using a boat, he almost immediately got spotted. Once Reddoons left, Spoke went up and block his cobblestone to hide his tracks. Spoke noticed Jaron's nametag in a  contraption below. Spoke noticed some automatic farms. One produced beeswax, another produced pumpkins. Spoke tried going up the stairs but Reddoons was blocking  him, Spoke waited for Reddoons to pass and he went up and even saw a cactus farm, a wheat farm, a carrot farm, a wheat farm, a potato farm and a sweetberry farm. 

Spoke decides  to mine out his secret bunker but Reddoons came back up and before Spoke could block it Reddoons saw it. Spoke wasn't sure if his cover was blown, but Reddoons simply just covered it up probably thinking it was his basemate's tunnel. 

On Day 5, Spoke goes up another layer and finds an automatic sugarcane farm; but then Spoke heard a chest open. It was Jaron. 

On Day 6, Spoke decides to build his secret base near the automatic cactus farm. 

On Day 7, He mined out the area for his base, and placed down his brewing stand, a crafting table and four furnaces. He also mined out the floor and stored  the loot he stole from the last base he raided in 
I Survived 100 Days Inside a Hidden Base
 and 
I Spent 100 Days Hidden in a Secret Minecraft Base...
. 

On Day 8, he made a room to make a map of the base. Spoke realises his invisibility ran out and reinvis. 

On Day 9, Spoke explores the base and he finds their storage. Spoke doesn't steal Reddoons opens the chest so he doesn't make sound, Spoke saw a board for their upcoming trades and in how many days that trade would take in. On the opposite board it was the enemies list with Spoke, 
Mapicc
, EvilMaster and 
PlanetLord
 included on it. Finally Reddoons dropped down. Spoke decides this is his chance to find some crazy farms.

On Day 10, Spoke finds the chests of Pumpkins, Melons and Honey Bottles and some ominous potions. 

On Day 11, Spoke heard someone climbing up the ladder which was Reddoons. Spoke thought he was fine until his invisibility ran out. Spoke hid behind the wall of their storage room. Spoke needed to stay crouched or he'll be exposed. Spoke jumps down leaving him barely alive with 2 hearts. Somehow his damage noise was just out of range  and Reddooons didn't notice; when he was out of sight, Spoke quickly drank another potion of invisibility. 

On Day 12, Spoke goes back to his secret base and replaced his walls with melons and pumpkins.

On Day 13, he finished renovating his base. 

On Day 14,  Spoke crafted some hoppers, and created a model of how Spoke would leech off their farms and take it's resources. 

On Day 15, he put his plan in action. and implemented it on the automatic sugarcane farm. 

He was practically finished on Day 16, but then he saw Reddoons right through the walls. Reddoons opened some chests but he didn't spot Spoke's hoppers. 

On Day 17, Spoke was able to start mining. 

On Day 18, Spoke connected the tunnel to his secret base.

On Day 19,  Spoke made the bunker even prettier. 

On Day 20, Spoke lit the tunnels with torches and checked how much profit he made from the farms. 

On Day 21, He went back out to search out for better farms. 

On Day 22, Spoke spotted a new chest that was added to the storage room which was filled with cobwebs. 

On Day 23, Spoke went all the way up to see whats at the top of the secret base. Spoke saw Jaron's nametag but somehow he was above the roof. So, Spoke found a spot in the wall and dug up. However, instead of seeing a secret room he saw the night sky. Since Spoke was curious why Jaron was standing on the top of the mountain he sticked around. 

On Day 24, Spoke was replenishing his invisibility when 2 players showed up. The players demanded Jaron to drop the items but in return Jaron asked them to show him their items. Jaron realised they weren't here to trade but they were here to rob him. Jaron tried running but Spoke, and the players chased after him incase someone died. Spoke realized he needed Jaron alive if he wanted to gain more profit so Spoke places cobwebs on them trying to slow them down just so Jaron could escape. They then tried to escape once Spoke equipped his armor. Spoke then stroke a deal with them that would come in handy later.

On Day 25, Spoke checked when Jaron's next trade would occur. (17 days from now). 

On Day 26, Spoke checked how much the farms had made. 

On Day 27, Spoke got distracted.

On Day 28, Spoke made an ender pearl stasis to get out of trouble. 

On Day 29, Spoke was going to find more farms to raid but he almost broke the block right infront of Reddoons. Spoke eventually found what seemed to be a lava farm and also a cobblestone farm. 

On Day 30, Spoke discovered a chorous fruit farm but it didn't seem like it was working; so, Spoke began to fix their farm for them. Although Reddoons was right behind Spoke, Reddoons didn't notice Spoke and neither did Spoke. 

On Day 31, Spoke remembered his goal of rigging a farm. Eventually, Spoke found something useful; a mushroom farm which is a key ingredient in making fermented spider eyes which are used to brew invisibility potions. 

On Day 32, Spoke finished rigging the mushroom farm and connected it to his secret base. 

On Day 33, Spoke was staying productive and kept searching. Until Spoke noticed Reddoons returning on a flying machine with a minecart with a chest. Spoke waited for Reddoons to leave and checked and in the chest there was 192 torches, 36 diamonds, and 256 golden carrots. 

On Day 34. Spoke was back at the secret base and he added the new rooms he found to his map.

On Day 35, Spoke used his stolen lava buckets to add some "new features". 

On Day 36, Spoke finished adding his new features. 

On Day 37, Spoke was about to leave but then he noticed Reddoons was coming towards his direction. Spoke quickly got on the stairs to avoid Reddoons as Spoke was running out of invisibility. Spoke hid in the wall. 

On Day 38, Spoke drank a potion of invisibility to reinvis. 

On Day 39, Spoke expanded his bunker even more.

On Day 40, Spoke was back to exploring and he found an automatic potion brewer. Spoke takes a bunch of Harming and Poison potions. 

On Day 41, Spoke spotted Jaron which reminded Spoke tomorrow was the day of the trade. 

On Days 42 and 43, The player had arrived. Spoke had the bandits set up stasises and the bandits reappeared and killed the player. Spoke had rigged their stasises because Spoke knew the bandits would kill him; so Spoke threw poison and harming on them which killed them. 

On Day 44, Spoke went back inside the base like nothing happened. 

On Day 45, Spoke saw some new trades added to the board despite recent events. 

On Day 46, Spoke made his bunker even prettier. 

On Day 47, Spoke made some hoppers, and chests. 

On Day 48, Spoke rigged a bunch of farms; secretly taking items from the farms.

On Days 49 and 50, Spoke finished connecting all the tunnels. 

On Day 51, Spoke noticed he stole 0 items so he decided to check but he saw Reddoons at the farm. Spoke watched Reddoons place a new sign on the trading board.

On Day 52, Spoke finally fixed the problem. 

On Day 53, Spoke remembered another trade was coming up. 

On Day 54, Jaron seemed to be grabbing some items.

On Day 55, Spoke was waiting for Jaron to go to the top but instead Jaron started running down one of the tunnels. 

On Day 56, They finally made it to the top where another player was waiting. Spoke tried to troll them.

On Day 57, FartSteve08 tried to kill Spoke for trying to interrupt their trade. Spoke elytra'd away from FartSteve. 

On Day 58, To make up for not getting items Spoke decided to search for valuables inside the base.

On Day 59, Spoke renovated his bunker.

On Day 60 and 61, Spoke checked all his rigged farms to see if they were getting him items. 

On Day 62, Spoke decides to rig the Chicken egg farm. 

On Day 63, Spoke had the hoppers completely set out.

On Day 64, Spoke connected everything.

On Day 65, Spoke made his system more time efficient because he came up with a design to lead all the hoppers of the rigged farms into one singular chest.

On Days 66 and 67, Spoke mined out all the area.

On Day 68, Spoke set out with a mission of finding the best farm. Spoke found out that trades were coming up in 4 and 15 days respectively. Spoke changed the coordinates of the trades coming up in 4 days from 9000 ~ -7200 to 45000 ~ -600

On Day 69, Spoke watched Reddoons do his normal routine and when he looked at the board he didn't suspect a thing. Reddoons went on the flying machine and Spoke followed it from  the ground.

On Day 70, Spoke kept following the flying machine. 

On Day 71, Reddoons finally stopped the machine. 

On Day 72, Under the snow was Hopper Minecarts that would pick up any items dropped. The player Spoke asked to be bait was 
Jepexx
. Unfortunately Jepexx was AFK which hampered Spoke's plan. 

On Day 73, Jepexx was nowhere near his computer. So, Reddoons left.

On Day 74, Spoke followed Reddoons back. 

On Day 75, Spoke was back on the mission of finding the best farm. 

On Day 76, Spoke found a pitcher pod and torchflower seeds farm using sniffers.

On Day 77, Spoke decides to rig this farm anyways. 

On Day 78, Spoke finished connecting it all. 

On Day 79,  Spoke noticed Jaron's next trade was in 2 days.

On Day 80, Spoke went on top of the mountain ready to fish the items towards him.

On Day 81, The trade had begun. 

On Day 82, Spoke did nothing.

On Day 83, Spoke cleared his mind by doing some therapeutic building. Spoke also threw eggs everywhere; even in the lava. 

On Day 84, Spoke realised he is a failure.

On Day 85, Spoke realised some pumpkins aren't going to save him from his bad decisions.

On Day 86, Spoke decided to get some fresh air which meant going out into the base. 

On Day 87, Spoke decided to rig the chorous fruit farm but he ran out of hoppers.

On Day 88, Spoke just stole from the chorous fruit chest.

On Day 89, Spoke had a blast in the base.

On Day 90, Spoke decided to check on what Jaron's been doing at the bottom of the base.

On Day 91, Spoke saw the raid bar and freaked out because a team on the server called 
The Invisible Mafia
 killed all the villagers and mobs don't spawn for unknown reasons and raids need at least a minimum of one villager. Therefore, the base somehow had a villager. 

On Day 92, Spoke decided to try and steal the villager.

On Day 93, Spoke went down a water chute but found nothing.

On Day 94, Spoke went back up but he got stuck. He couldn't mine up because Jaron was right there. Spoke managed to swim down and break a glass to escape.

On Day 95, Spoke did nothing.

On Day 96, Spoke cleared out room for the materials to steal the villager.

On Day 97, Spoke had his closest moment with death and he descended into the farm. 

On Days 98 and 99, Raiders had placed TNT inside the base and found Spoke's secret base. Spoke crafted diamond armour and enchanted it. Spoke also equipps his 
netherite chestplate.
 Spoke makes a trap to kill all of them. The bandits say Spoke killed Jimmy. Spoke accidentally blows up the whole base with his trap. 

On Day 100, Jaron and Reddoons come back to their destroyed base and confront Spoke. Spoke escapes.

title: 100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
content:
100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP














Episode


118






Upload date


Feb 28, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
Fymada
Horace_Altman
DragonMC__
Lezy
4CVIT
LettuceK
















People of the Unstable SMP. Thank you for coming today and thank you for voting for me and crowning me as the king of this server.



ParrotX2
's opening speech as King of Unstable


100 Days as King of the Unstable SMP
 is the 118th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


On the Unstable SMP, every one in ten players make it out of spawn alive, but even those who get to escape do not live for long. The players have accepted this as how Unstable is, but in the first time in history, they had voted for a king of the server, and that person is 
Parrot
.

The episode begins with Parrot standing on top of the Northern Council and giving a speech to the entire server, he tells everybody that he has seen power be in the wrong hands and ensures that it wouldn't happen again. He promises to take responsibility and make sure that everyone can live peacefully. The crowd boos and shouts that they wanted 
LettuceK
 to be king. Parrot hears the backlash and says if players can not spawn onto the server safely within a hundred Minecraft days, or thirty three hours, he'd resign from king. Parrot knew Lettuce was unable to save spawn even with his powers, and if Parrot managed to do so, he'd prove everyone that he was worthy of being king.

Parrot has a meeting with his friends, 
Theo
, 
Fymada
, and 
Horace
. Theo thinks Parrot is crazy for attempting to make spawn a safe place in such a short amount of them when Lettuce was unable to during his regime. Fymada and Horace has their own plans on how they could improve the server and Theo says he'd be Parrot's royal guard. Theo asks what their first decree is, Parrot says they'll have to take back spawn. The two go to spawn and start their mission of killing off all the withers. As they get closer up to the top of spawn, the withers start focusing on them, which prevents more deaths from happening. At the same time, Parrot helps out players and gives them protection and food to make sure they get to a safe place. They kill off the withers at the top, but the rest of the withers are down under and they've been slowly drained of their armor and resources. Luckily, Fymada and Horace come to assist killing off all the withers and regear. On the fifth day, players no longer die from withers and the new players joining the server walk up to Parrot and praise him for saving them. However, players may still die from fall damage, so he asks Horace to rebuild the entirety of spawn.

The next step of Parrot's journey of being king, he needs to give people a safe place to go, and players usually head to 
Capital City
 for that. However, Capital City is ran by a corrupt mayor and Parrot goes to declare Fymada the new mayor. When Parrot, Theo, and Fymada step foot into the city, 
SirPig
 tells Parrot that the three of them have taxes to be paid or else they'd be escorted out. Parrot tells him that's going to be a problem since he's king now and grants Fymada the title of the mayor of Capital City. They hold a meeting with the players there, Fymada starts up by saying there will be an expansion to the city and reduce the percentages of taxes so players can keep what they earn. After Fymada has her speech, Parrot and Theo go back to their old potion shop and reminisces of the past. As they're about to head out, 
DragonMC
 comes to visit and tells them before they go, on behalf of Capital City, they're given horses for being king. Dragon says the first horse Parrot chooses is destined to be fate and will be the horse for the entirety of his kingship. Parrot looks through all of the horses and sees a lone white horse out of all of the horses there. He sits on the horse and tames it first try. This horse was truly fate, as it was extremely fast and could jump very high. As for Theo, he tamed a donkey and Parrot forces him to keep it.

After making room for more players, Parrot's next step is to supply players with food so they don't starve. Parrot and Theo visit the train station and meet up with an old friend, 
lezy
, and asks for two tickets to 
Redstone Town
. Lezy gives the tickets for free and says the king doesn't need to pay. Parrot, still with the mindset that they're still players, decides to pay it either way. Parrot and Theo spend the next few days on the railway on their horses and ironically runs out of food, so they make a pitstop at a village to buy food. As they walk into the tavern, Parrot says what's up and the entire place goes quiet. One person speaks up and asks what they're doing there. Parrot goes up to the owners and asks if they can buy food, the owners say yes and says they can get twenty steaks for a few diamonds, Theo pays and they only give two steak. Parrot says they need food to get to Redstone Town, but the owners say he's ruining the server and that nobody likes him. The players in the tavern all start booing and pushing them out. They make it to Redstone Town and visits 
4CVIT
, Parrot asks 4CVIT to help them out with an automatic chicken farm, but 4CVIT refuses to help since the members of the town would be upset with him. This forces Parrot and Theo to build it on their own, and they spend several Minecraft days attempting it, with 4CVIT watching in the distance. 4CVIT feels bad seeing Parrot build so many chicken farms when he could've been finished way earlier, but 4CVIT is not able to provide them with a chicken and tells them that they can get one through an auction over at 
Merchant City
. 

They head over to Merchant City and asks the auctioneer what the average price of a chicken is, the auctioneer tells them a thousand diamonds, but the two of them only have a total of 400 diamonds, so they decide to play games around the city to earn diamonds. The first game they head to is an archery game, one shot is three diamonds, each target is worth one to three diamonds depending on the distance respectively, and the minecart at the back is worth ten diamonds. Parrot shoots the minecart and uses the prize to buy more shots and hits the minecart over and over again. The owner of the game gets angry and accuses Parrot of cheating, so he makes Parrot stand back further to make the shot harder, but it doesn't change anything and Parrot makes the shots still. The owner makes Parrot stand even further back on top of a house that's fifty blocks away, Parrot charges his bow and times it, he hits the shot and asks to buy more shots, but the owner gets frustrated and refuses to sell anymore and says he's went into debt from the game and storms off. They had garnered over 900 diamonds, which may be enough to buy the chicken, so they head over to the auction. During the auction, Theo bids for a Law-owned spear and an enchanted golden apple, but Parrot tells Theo to stop bidding on anything besides the chicken. Parrot notices the person sitting right next to Theo may be a problem, since he bid over 800 on an enchanted book. The last item is the chicken, Parrot and the other person bidding goes back and forth, when the price goes up too high, Parrot tells him that without the chicken, his kingdom will fall and bids everything they have. The other player bids more than what they have, as Parrot thinks they're going to lose the bet, Theo steps up and bids over a hundred thousand diamonds, thinking that it was a hundred more than what the previous bid was, winning the auction immediately. Parrot quietly leaves with the chicken and tells the auctioneer they'll have the payment in the future. 

Back at Redstone Town, 4CVIT and the other members of the city had built farms that can produce more food than necessary. They spend the next few Minecraft days breeding the chicken and storing chickens into the farms to their fullest limit. After their hard work, they stand on top of a hill and look at the farm. Parrot says they may be able to win people over, Theo asks if it bothers Parrot that people still hate him even with all the effort he's been putting, and that people still want Lettuce to be king. Parrot says it did bother him a little, but it's not to make people like him and only wants to do what's right. They wait several more Minecraft days for the farm to work its magic, they now have a new problem; transporting all of the chicken would take a long time using railroads. Parrot follows the minecarts full of chicken while Theo goes ahead and deals with whatever players or situation may be waiting for them. On the second wave of players, a group of lawmen try to attack Theo, but he kills them off and one runs away, Theo chases them. Theo's horn is blown, signaling to Parrot that it's safe to continue, but Parrot notices 
SargeLAW
, who says he's going to stop Parrot from being king. Parrot tells him if he destroys the chicken supplies, he won't be able to become king and will cause players to die. SargeLAW says if Parrot succeeds on becoming king, they wouldn't have a server to play on, especially with a king like Parrot. SargeLAW and his group of lawmen begin looking through the minecart chests, which were all empty. Parrot slowly backs up away from 
The Law
 and had managed to juke them. The truth was he had 4CVIT transport all the chicken using a happy ghast and that they'd buy him as much time as possible. 

On the 94th day, Parrot made it back to spawn, which had been fully reconstructed. Parrot is astonished at how quickly Horace rebuilt spawn. Horace brings Parrot to the designated food giver and shows them where players spawn now. Afterwards, he rides through the obsidian highway and greets the players that he stumbles across, but every time he stops to talk to them, they tell him how he had ruined the server. Parrot goes back to the Northern Council and down to the prison where he looks at Lettuce. Parrot asks Lettuce why people still hate him despite all of his work, it's only the new players that are supportive, not the old ones, and asks why that may be the case. Parrot mentions before they locked Lettuce up, he said the server was unrepairable and asks if that may be related. Lettuce only answers by saying, "Who knows?" Parrot calls him pathetic and says he did everything Lettuce could never do in thirty hours, Lettuce says if he really wanted to save all the players, he could've, he then asks Parrot why he didn't choose to. Parrot says he could've done something about it, Lettuce says sometimes you have to do whatever it takes to protect the people and that he'll find out soon enough and wishes him luck as a king and that he's surprised Parrot had made it this far as king.

On the hundredth day, an influx of the player base had grown exponentially, and Parrot's kingdom has grown with it. Parrot and Theo stand up top of the castle looking down at Northern Council. Parrot asks Theo if it was strange that players used up so many resources on withers to use at spawn, and that he thought it may be trollers or griefers, but doesn't understand why people would've taken it that far. Parrot says he doesn't care about who is responsible for it and focuses on what's more important: building up his kingdom.



Trivia


A player can be seen wearing netherite armor with quartz trims, the same ones used by 
The Director
 during Fymada's speech in Capital City.

Minecraft Combat Master VS 100 Hunters
 is the 80th episode featured in

Plot


The video begins with a recap of the fight in 
SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP
 which was between 
FlameFrags
 and 
Wemmbu
 with 
Spoke
 watching invisible and from the sidelines. As Flame was about to go to the courtroom where 
Parrot
 and 
Theo
 had trapped 
Wemmbu
, the leader of 
The Law
, 
LettuceK
 showed up at his base. Lettuce calls Flame to the new Law base which is about 100 blocks from Flame's base. Lettuce says he recruited around 100 goons (from the nether) to take down Flame. Flame is impressed by how they built a new base in just one day. Lettuce introduces him to 
Deputy_Ace
; his right-hand man. Lettuce tries to persuade Flame to drop all his items in his inventory and ender chest and sit in a prison cell for a fortnight but Flame refuses. Lettuce gave Flame three more days to think and rehabilitate to become a law-abiding citizen. Flame calls his best friend 
Lomedy
 to help him gear up to fight the Law. Flame calls Lomedy to 
Merchant City
 and on the way, Flame tells him about the recent encounter with LettuceK. Flame makes a plan to disguse themselves with a law shield to learn about their battle strategies. Flame and Lomedy sneak into Law territory. Flame warns Lomedy to communicate with signs only and to not speak so their identity isn't blown. They search for Lettuce as the players are just "yapping". Flame and Lomedy listen in on LettuceK's  conversations. Lettuce makes an announcement of their gear shipment. Flame and Lomedy are stopped by Lettuce at the front gate as they try  to intercept the gear shipment. Lettuce tells them use of invisibility is prohibited in the Law Base. Flame stops Lomedy from speaking by breaking his signs. Lettuce threatens them to kick them out of Law and take action for breaking their simplest rule if they don't drink milk or speak. They run away into the nearby river. 42hunterdude is killed by LettuceK. Lomedy tries to convince Flame to turn himself in but he doesn't listen. They successfully intercept the shipment and kill the whole party plus their happy ghast. They take the shipment for themselves. Lomedy tells Flame he didn't have to kill them and Lomedy questions Flame's violent ways. Flame tells Lomedy about his motives. He explains that he is hunting Wemmbu because he is trying  to show that real skill doesn't come from power, orbital strike cannons, maces or dishonor. He explains that if people like Wemmbu prevail, people will forget about skill. Lomedy says that Flame should attack the Law right now. Flame makes another wolf machine.  Lettuce makes a speech about how Flame could stop this pointless bloodshed could stop if he turns himself in. Flame refuses. They fight and eventually, Flame comes out on top forcing Lettuce to run and killing his entire army. Flame goes back to his base. 

Parrot
 shows up and he asks Flame why he didn't show up at the 
Capital City
 courtroom. Flame says that he was fighting off the Law.

1 vs 100 Player Minecraft War
 is the 127th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.

Plot


FlameFrags
 begins the episode by explaining that he's going to fight 
Mistrul
, the leader of the 
Mist civilization
, one of the most powerful teams on the entire Unstable SMP, which would free all of the members of the civilization from his reign. The first time Flame fought Mistrul, he lost the fight and escaped via a happy ghast until his best friend 
Lomedy
 was shot off.

The episode begins with Flame looking down at where Lomedy dropped off, Mistrul then flies right into the happy ghast, maces it and kills it, leading to Flame dropping down and wind charge clutching. At the bottom are huge ice spikes, Flame looks in the general vicinity for Lomedy, unfortunately for Flame, Mistrul drops down and demands a rematch right there. Flame thinks he's cheap for wanting another fight when he is unprepared and that Mistrul had time to restock himself. Mistrul calls him a coward and blows a horn, which signaled hundreds of Mist members run in and join the fight. Flame tries to mend his armor before they catch up, Mistrul lands a mace hit instantly, and he isn't able to get any free time on the high ground, as the players all have wind charges of their own. Flame decides to run due to the sheer amount of players and his game performance started to drop. Mistrul taunts him for being a combat master running away and says Flame will never escape the Mist. The camera moves to a player sitting on top of an ice spike throwing an invis potion down for Flame, Flame notices it and goes full invis and hides inside an ice spike. Mistrul says he has won the duel and tells his players that they're going to hunt Flame. For Flame, the bigger problem is that Lomedy is missing stuck in the middle of nowhere, so he goes to find him. He runs around cluelessly yelling Lomedy's name until he sees a player glowing on top of an ice spike. He wind charges up and notices it's another player, 
NotSkrilley
. Skrilley explains that Flame needs his help and that he knows everything about the Mist that most players don't. Flame doesn't believe him at first, but gives in only under one circumstance; if he leads him away from Lomedy, he's dead.

They traverse through the Mist terrain, Flame asks why they're heading this specific way, Skrilley says if Lomedy had any sense, he would hide. Flame then asks where he's taking him if he knew where Lomedy could be, Skrilley explains that the Mist is bigger than he thinks and that it's hidden from the server. Before he got trapped, he was an explorer with his friends that thought they discovered something new and found the routes until Mistrul found them and forced them to work for the civilization. Flame asks why he hasn't escaped yet, and Skrilley says it's not as easy as he thinks and that there's an ice wall that's heavily guarded, and if Mistrul found out you even tried, he'd kill you. Shortly after, they make it to Skrilley's village with other refugees. Skrilley gathers them all up and tells them that he found Flame, who would help them escape and kill the Mist if they found Lomedy. Flame agrees to the deal as long as Lomedy is brought back to him safely. They all split off in different directions to go look, Flame and Skrilley keep together just casually talking, one of the refugees, 
Flowtives
, comes up to them and asks to join them. Flame says he's better off alone, but Skrilley insists as Flow is really good at PvP. Flow tells them they should go to the cave since Lomedy may have moved there, Flame doesn't think it makes sense to scatter all over and would rather look where Lomedy had dropped, but Skrilley says he's going with the 
flow
.

As they enter the cave, Flame has a lot of questions, wondering if Mistrul is the leader, Skrilley says there is no real leader, the strongest basically leads the civilization. Flame asks Flow how long he's been there and asks why he hasn't tried to kill his way out, Flow gets irritated by how much Flame is talking and Skrilley tells them both to calm down. They reach the insides of the cave with massive ice spikes all over, Flame calls out for Lomedy's name and complains about how it made no sense to start here rather than start in order. Right in the middle of him complaining, they hear the Mist horn, which means they found something inside of the cave, and if it was them, they'd have to do something quick. Flow has spare Mist armor sets and comes up with the plan of blending in with the army invis. Flame is skeptical at the fact that it has curse of binding in it, but puts it on as he has no other choice if he wants to survive. The three attempt to blend in, Mistrul calls them out immediately and instructs the army to kill them. No matter what they did, they got relentlessly chased, and with no way out as the door got blocked off. Flame realized that they got noticed cause of their invis, so him and Flow get tons of players stuck in a hole and splash all of them with invis, giving them enough time and distraction to run away. Mistrul kills off his own players that are invisible, Flame and the other two manage to successfully escape.

They come to the village with no good news for the rest of the refugees, Flame proceeds to ask if anyone had seen Lomedy, griffincoat6, one of the other refugees, speaks up and says they found Lomedy and spoke to him, they said they were going to bring Lomedy back until several Mist players attacked them. Griffin froze and panicked, knowing he wasn't good at PvP, so he told Lomedy to head to an old escape route, which was a dead end. Flame says they need to get there fast, but they're afraid of losing more of them if they go out again. Griffin asks to be trained in order to be good enough, Flame starts to lose his patience and threatens to kill them all, Skrilley jumps in and calms him down. Griffin says to train them fast and they'll go, Flame angrily agrees, but if Lomedy dies within that time, he'd kill them all. Skrilley gets them over to the training grounds, Flame asks why he's paying his part of the deal now, Skrilley tells him they're scared and asks to train them shortly just enough to survive. Flow says he's making a mistake by training them, if the players show any skill or power and the Mist sees they can't fight back, the players would just get killed. Flame insists on training them, Flow says he's going to head to the tunnel where Lomedy is while Flame goes and messes things up. Flame then goes to the rest of the refugees and explains combat in a very basic manner. While Flame teaches them, he spots tons of usernames at the village and they all head over. Mistrul says he's let this village live for too long and decides to end it there. Flame is unable to see who's apart of his team and who isn't, and with no other choice, he tells Skrilley he has to abandon the rest of his village if he wants to survive. The two run away, Skrilley is in disbelief that he left the rest of his group, Flame apologizes for leaving everyone else behind, he tells Skrilley after they find Lomedy, he'll take on all of Mist himself and Skrilley can leave. Skrilley doesn't want Flame to die for him, he only cared about playing on the server with his friends and having fun. They then head towards the tunnel, Flame tells Skrilley once they find Lomedy, he thinks Skrilley would get a long with him and talks about Lomedy and what he's like. Flame thanks Skrilley for helping him, Skrilley said if he stopped being kind, he wouldn't be himself anymore.

Flame and Skrilley arrive to the escape tunnel and enter in, they see a glowing player and Flame thinks it's Lomedy. As they run closer to the player, it appears to be Flow and a tomb. Flow apologizes and says it wasn't personal, Mistrul then appears right behind saying that the escape tunnel was blocked off and it was only a rumor PvPers told themselves when they were desperate. Flame says he knew there was something off with Flow, Flow tells Flame when he asked how Mistrul was so good, it's because Flow trained him and his job was to never allow anyone to leave the Mist. Mistrul says he should've never came here and thought there wouldn't be consequences. Mistrul tells Skrilley to switch sides or else he dies, Flame says they aren't going to die and keeps his promise of leaving this place. Flame then has a realization, if Flow killed him, where was Lomedy's mace, just as he has that thought, Mistrul breaks blocks beneath them and sets off TNT. Flame and Skrilley down a dropper-like area with ice spikes. Skrilley tells Flame if Mistrul says someone's dead, it really is true, he asks Flame to help him since he's the only person he has left. Flame says he promised to and would keep his word. Mistrul and Flow drop down right after and begin fighting Flame, Flame tells Skrilley to run while he deals with them two. Flow gets Mistrul to get on Skrilley so Flame can have the 1v1 with Flow. During the fight, Flow drops and pops his totem via fall damage, him and Mistrul reunite and fight Flame together. Flame goes up to Skrilley and sees he hadn't left on his own to survive. Flow and Mistrul catch up and combo Flame. In the midst of everything, Flame accidentally throws his sword out and asks himself how he even did that. Flow and Mistrul stop, Flow laughs at Flame for dropping his sword and throws it to Flame because he didn't even want a sword of a "combat master". Flow taunts Flame for losing his composure after finding out Lomedy died. They all make it out of the tunnel, Flame crafts a boat and they ice boat away, leaving Mistrul and Flow behind.

Flame and Skrilley find an abandoned tower to reside in, Skrilley apologizes, and Flame tells him to leave before they find him again. When Skrilley leaves, Flame goes on top of the tower and sits there.

Flame's monologue then plays, Lomedy's death was all of his fault, he regrets putting Lomedy in such a dangerous area such as the Mist. All because of his goal of being a combat grandmaster. It was his every decision that caused the death, and he regrets not giving Lomedy the opportunity to live his life to do everything he liked and enjoyed doing. Flame calls himself pathetic and weak that he couldn't do anything to avenge Lomedy. He knew he wasn't strong enough to fight Mistrul in a 1v1, yet alone an outnumbered battle. Flame remembered he was missing one thing; 
ItzRealMe
 taught him how to enter the zone, Itz believed Flame could reach that part of his mind. Flame couldn't be able to see it because his mind was stuck in the Mist, he hadn't been able to focus, but now that he's alone, he's able to control the zone.

Flame walks into the civilization again and sees Mistrul waiting in the fighting arena. Mistrul notices that Flame is more quiet than usual, but doesn't care and says Flame will still die in the end. The fight begins, Mistrul can already see something has changed in Flame when he starts landing more hits. Mistrul is unable to get Flame low at all, Flame then manages to land a six hit combo on Mistrul, then another eight before Mistrul flies away. Flame pearls right onto Mistrul and hits one more time, this time being the final blow and kills Mistrul. The players of the civilization come out of hiding and start attacking Flame. Flame gets a few picks off, he then goes in his ender chest to get other weapons. When a group of players are all in one place, he places a rail and blows them all up with a TNT minecart. The remaining players run away, Flow walks in and questions what just happened there. Flame gives Flow the remains of Mistrul, they then have an actual fair 1v1 that Flame asked for. During the fight, Flow still tells Flame he has a lot to learn and that he's the most worthy opponent he's had to face yet. With Flow almost dead, Flame tells him to stop and that he's not going to kill him, he wants Flow to live with the same feeling as how he felt. Flame takes Mistrul's Elytra and mace out of his ender chest and throws it to give to Flow. Before Flow could pick it up, Flame burns them both. Flow says those items were beyond any player and that it belonged to the Mist. Flame says he doesn't care and that he gets to live with that, Flow says they only did it to break him, and Flame says that it worked and leaves the civilization to Flow's hands.

Flame rides a happy ghast back to his base, Skrilley shows up and Flame says that he's glad that he was able to come back. Skrilley says he has some good news and brings out Lomedy. Lomedy explains that he ran and hid, he says it was true someone found him and ditched him, so Lomedy acted tough with his mace, which caused the Mist to run away. Flame realized he killed a bunch of Mist members and their leader over his devastation and now has beef with Flow over nothing. Skrilley adds onto it and says he lost all his friends and his village for him, Lomedy says sorry for being bad at the game and that he's just a farmer. Flame and Skrilley jokingly say they're going to kill him and chase him around the base for all of the troubles and grief they just went through.



Trivia


The video is recorded in 4K, whereas most videos are recorded in 1440p.


This video marks the first time in Unstable history where all of the protagonists uploaded twice before 
Wemmbu
.


With A/B testing, the video will either be shown as 1 VS 1000 Player Minecraft War or Finding My Best Friend Who Went Missing.


This is the first Unstable Video to have an enemy POV


The video was originally titled "1 VS 100 Player Minecraft War".

On the Unstable SMP, the world’s largest hardcore Minecraft server, the strongest players and I are about to fight an army of 2500 players all at once.”





2500 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master
 is the 115th episode featured in Unstable Universe. This marks the end of 
FlameFrags
's perspective of 
The Kings Arc
.



Plot


Flame
 does a foreshadow about the upcoming fight against 
The Law
 in 
Northern Council
. Flame recaps about the battles he had took part in against the Law until he took part against a 2v1000. The news spread like wildfire and eventually causing Flame to get exiled. Flame had trained for a month all leading up to this moment.

Flame returns to his base realizing it got griefed with banners with the Law's insignia. 
LettuceK
 comes to Flame's base trying to convince Flame to stop. Lettuce fails to convince Flame, so he goes back to the Northern Council. Just as he leaves, 
Wemmbu
 digs into Flame's base base, asking, "Have you seen an 
eggchan
?" Flame responds with no and Wemmbu says that he wants to team up with him because he needs to get a 
friend
 out of the prison. Flame says he also has a 
friend
 he needs to get out of the prison. They both agree to get their friends out. They fight the local garrison led by 
SargeLAW
. They defeat the garrison but SargeLaw retreats to get Lettuce. They notice 
PrinceZam
, 
SpokeIsHere
 and 
JumperWho
 are also killing the guards inside the prison. Flame asks Wemmbu where Lomedy is. Wemmbu asks Flame if Lomedy really  wants to leave and Wemmbu tells Flame to free all the prisoners inside and he'll stall Lettuce. Flame goes inside the prison and kills the guards one by one and destroying the doors and security. Flame meets Spoke, Zam and Jumper where the cells are. 
Th3Blurpinstein
 is seen running away as the others keep fighting. After the massacre, Flame requests Lomedy to escape but Lomedy refuses until his sentence has been fulfilled and refuses as he is not breaking the law. Lomedy also doesn't trust Flame as eh stole his mace, destroyed his farm and keeps fighting the Law and doesn't admit he's in the wrong. Lomedy says he's going to leave if the Law lets him go. Lomedy requests his mace but Flame refuses until he leaves. Flame is now only left with the option of taking down Law. Flame decides to use his mace for the army at the top of Law headquarters. They massacre the army and Flame notices Jaden MAN in the fight. Flame requests Jaden drop it but he says he can ask for it later. Wemmbu drops 
Orbital Strike Cannons
 on the headquarters until its rubble. Spoke asks them if they had seen 
ParrotX2
. Wemmbu asks them why they need Parrot but they say they need to sway the public so another group doesn't form another Law.  

Spoke leads them to his base in 
The Amplified
. Flame doesn't want to work with them due to them mostly provoking Flame in the past. Spoke led massive armies in an attempt to kill Flame; Jaden stole his friend: Lomedy's other mace and betrayed Flame; and Jumper worked with 
BAT
 in attempts to kill him. There they meet up with 
Mapicc
 and 
MinuteTech
 both enemies of Flame. Spoke tries to rally them together as they've had been involved in conflicts against each other but it barely helps. Minute supplys them with shulker boxes to fight the Law. Wemmbu notices an invisible person and warns them about it but later is informed that is a 
spy
. The spy informs them that thousands of law soldiers are converging to a single area. Spoke hypothesizes that the area must be where Parrot escaped to. They get into a debate on why they need Parrot. Spoke asks Wemmbu what he is going to do after he kills Lettuce and he replies with that he is going to ride off into the sunset. Zam and Spoke calls him stupid and then asks Flame what he is going to do after he kills Lettuce. Flame replies with that he is going to gain all the aura and that everyone is going to pat him on the head and the immortal demon is back in town and then he is going to slime out Jaden. Flame starts attacking Jaden for not giving him his mace and Wemmbu orbitals trying to stop them from fighting.   

Wemmbu elytras over to the location and Flame walks over there. Together, Flame, Parrot, 
TheobaldTheBird
 and Wemmbu kill every lawmen there. They go up top and get on a happy ghast and fly over to the base. Parrot asks them who was here during 
The Invisible Mafia Arc
 and leads them to 
District 13
.  Parrot gives a speech to rally their troops and leads them to Northern Council. They fight off  the first wave of diamond lawmen and they go into the palace to confront Lettuce and his generals. Lettuce then reveals the netherite legions. They barely fight them off and Flame, drained of resources decides to fight Jaden to try and take Lomedy's mace. Wemmbu intervenes. During the fight, Lettuce comes back and surrenders. The group leads them to the palace. They hold a vote on whether to kill Lettuce. They ultimately vote to let him live in the prison. Lettuce tells Flame that he should change so that all of the horrible actions he had done wouldn't be in vain and prove the world wrong that he was wrong. Flame goes back into the Law headquarters and free Lomedy and gives him back his mace.

title: 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters
content:
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters














Episode


106






Upload date


Jan 24, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Kings Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Wemmbu
LettuceK
TheobaldTheBird
CoinMonke
Purpled
Boosfer














On the Unstable SMP, LettuceK is currently beating every other candidate in the election by 6,000 votes.





2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Hunters
 is the 106th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Parrot
 recaps all of the events that has happened in previous episodes, ever since Lettuce got 6,000 votes at the start of the election, Parrot had a plan. Ever since 
The Law
 took over the server, 
LettuceK
 got ahold of 
Wemmbu
 and put him in custody, but Parrot knew Wemmbu had escaped and fled to the 
Great Sea
, being one of the few people that knew about it. Lettuce gathers the final four candidates to make an announcement, he says he'll host another debate a day from now, deciding who will make it to the final round, Parrot uses this chance to try and get Wemmbu to go to the debate and expose Lettuce. The plan is risky, as if Lettuce found out Parrot was doing this, he would send his lawmen to take down Wemmbu, but Parrot had no other choice.

Parrot travels sixteen hours to the Great Sea, he goes to the Pirate City base only to see it be abandoned. He stands on top of the building and sees Wemmbu and 
eggchan
 standing at another point of the base. Parrot runs to them, Wemmbu questions why he was there. Although it had been a while since Parrot last talked to Wemmbu and that they weren't on the greatest of terms, Parrot still had to try and see if Wemmbu would work with him. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he knows all about the election, Wemmbu says he's been too busy getting hunted, so Parrot explains what's been going on at spawn and asks if Wemmbu would work with him to take down Lettuce. Wemmbu says why would he ever work with Parrot, Parrot says if Lettuce ends up winning, he'd never be able to return to the main server, and before Parrot could continue, Wemmbu punches Parrot off the edge to talk to egg first. Parrot waits in the meantime, Wemmbu says he'll agree to help defeat Lettuce, leaving egg behind as it would be too dangerous for him. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he knows a faster way back to spawn since traveling by boat would take too much time before the debate started. Wemmbu says there's a dolphin tunnel that connects to 
Capital City
, but is more dangerous with all the lawmen that guards the area. 

They boat towards the island, Parrot comes up with the idea to fight them, but Wemmbu isn't geared enough to do so. The next best idea was for Parrot to run up to the island and pretend to rat Wemmbu out, all the lawmen run into the ocean except the netherite guard, who says he has to stay and protect the island. Parrot lies to the guard and says if he captured Wemmbu, he'd get a promotion in The Law, the guard believes it and leaves the island in search for Wemmbu. Parrot and Wemmbu, who was invisible the whole time, make it to the tunnel. While Parrot and Wemmbu are traveling back, Lettuce hosts a meeting at the Northern Council with all of his lawmen, he suspects that Parrot is bringing Wemmbu back to Law territory and instructs them to stop them from coming back into The Law's territory and to kill them. Back in the tunnel, Parrot and Wemmbu make good progress on their way back until lawmen start coming from the opposite direction, going unnoticed at the speed they're going, so they dig through the wall and boat up on surface the rest of the way back.

Back on land, Parrot says there's a happy ghast with loot in the cherry biome headed above, he explains that they can use the happy ghast to fly above all of Law territory and make it to the debate. Before they head to the location, Parrot checks a chest that would signal whenever somebody walked past a sculk contraption. It had went off over 105 times, which is way higher than it should be normally, which meant that The Law knew they were coming. Parrot uses his spyglass to look, and spots a bunch of lawmen hiding behind trees. Parrot says they'd have to go off path and find one of his other friends, they head to a village and Wemmbu walks out in plain sight, alerting the Law guards of their whereabouts. Wemmbu tries to start fighting, but Parrot says otherwise and to run. They run and jump into a cave, running down a mineshaft and blocks it off.

It then cuts to Lettuce having a meeting with his commanders, he tells them that the four are his strongest guards and instructs them to hunt down Parrot and Wemmbu as well. 
Deputy_Ace
 asks if this is a good idea, Lettuce wonders if Ace is trying to defend them, and Ace apologizes. 

Parrot and Wemmbu surface and loses the lawmen, Wemmbu asks where they're going and Parrot says they're going to a special river. They make the rest of the way there scott free, Parrot goes to check if the location is right. Parrot lead them to a nautilus shop owned by 
CoinMonke
, a notorious smuggler on the server. Coin sees Wemmbu and says he doesn't trust Wemmbu, but Parrot convinces Coin after telling him he's going to lose the election if they don't make it to the election. Parrot asks for the best way to get back to spawn without encountering The Law, Coin says they have to go down the Kings River and go northwest, leading to a path called The Smuggler's Pass and past The Law graveyard until they get to the professional smugglers. Parrot asks to borrow the two nautilus, and although Coin doesn't trust Wemmbu still, he lets them take it either way. They make it to a checkpoint, Parrot looks and sees a gate that may block off their way there, but he sees a player with nothing coming out the other way with a nautilus, so they sneak their way past the lawmen guarding the checkpoint. After making it past, three lawmen spot them, leading them to turn back and fend for themselves. They run up a hill, Wemmbu successfully maces a lawmen and loots it, they start running off as more lawmen come to their location. Parrot sees a pig with a saddle and grabs it with a lead, They then tower up, Parrot drops wind charges into the water and bows off the lawmen as they climb up. Wemmbu towers back up, running out of blocks in the process, Parrot towers to him and asks for his Elytra, but Wemmbu isn't willing to give it up, so Parrot gives Wemmbu the lead that held onto the pig. Parrot then jumps on the pig and tells Wemmbu to start flying and teaches him how to infinitely fly using the Elytra without having to use rockets. They make it far enough for the lawmen to stop chasing them before Wemmbu's Elytra broke.

Deeper into Law territory, they make it to the Smuggler's Pass and spots a massive mountain build. They cross the path that was built alongside the edge, Wemmbu asks to exchange armor with Parrot, as they do, Parrot sees invis particles following them. SargeLaw reveals himself and begins to chase them, tons more lawmen come from behind, Parrot lies and says he has TNT minecarts set up right under them, and they stop attacking. Wemmbu tests SargeLAW by saying he can't kill him since Lettuce instructed them to not kill Wemmbu, but rather take him captive. Wemmbu writes on a sign that he's buying time and for Parrot to come with a plan. Parrot sees eggchan amidst the crowd of lawmen, Parrot renames an arrow and shoots it to egg, asking for armor for both him and Wemmbu. Parrot gives Wemmbu the armor through a chest, and tells him to switch over to the Law shield, splashing invis on the ground right next to a bunch of lawmen, which essentially made them look like a lawmen. SargeLaw starts killing his own lawmen to make it easier, Parrot, Wemmbu, and egg all run away from the commotion. When they get out of sight, Parrot asks if egg infiltrated The Law to come help, but egg says he only infiltrated cause he wanted to. 

They make it to the end of the Smuggler's Pass, Parrot says they should keep heading back, Wemmbu says that he's going to kill him and tells egg to box him. Wemmbu asks if Parrot knows how they ended up with nothing, Parrot says it's because of Lettuce, but Wemmbu keeps backtracking to the beginning, when Parrot revealed Wemmbu's secret identity. Wemmbu says he was free to do whatever, but ever since Parrot revealed his identity, Lettuce wouldn't have ever ran for king, and says everything that has happened because of Parrot. Parrot apologizes, he says how after Wemmbu knocked into the void, that he just disappeared and the last time he say Wemmbu was when Lettuce brought him up on stage. He says how he was going to apologize to Wemmbu at Pirate City before he got knocked off. Parrot explains the reasoning behind him revealing Wemmbu's identity, how it was over a tomb with items, Parrot could give it to the players in need, but he realized that it wasn't the right thing to do. Parrot says Lettuce would do anything in his way to get rid of any person who he thinks is in the wrong and that he isn't capable of being king of the server, Parrot apologizes again for revealing Wemmbu's identity without seeing the true purpose of why he did so, he says if Wemmbu kills him right there, nothing would change about the server and he would still be hunted down endlessly. Egg agrees that Wemmbu's beef has been with Lettuce and not Parrot, and Wemmbu changes his mind on killing Parrot and sets him free. 

They make it to the Law graveyard, Parrot spots a player that's pretending to mourn a grave, Parrot asks if he's the smuggler and asks for the fastest way back. The person writes a sign telling them to follow him, but none of them trust it. Parrot sees that the smuggler flashed a Law shield for a split second, so he tests him to see if he's a real smuggler by asking for the name of the person that owns the nautilus shop. The smuggler asks why that matters and Parrot says he's a smuggler and should know this, the person then pulls out a TNT minecart and sets it off, blowing up the entire graveyard with it and himself. 
The_Oroboros
, another commander of The Law, comes to the graveyard and investigates, he looks up and sees 
TheobaldTheBird
 standing above him. It goes to Theo's perspective, Theo begins to attack Oroboros using carts, the fight slowly drains his armor and Oroboros ends up dying. Theo makes a tomb for him and writes "loser" on it.

The time for the debate has come, Parrot had not shown up for it, and Lettuce makes himself the moderator for the debate, as they don't have a new one. Lettuce starts off by asking each candidate what they've done this election, Lettuce goes first by saying he liberated the Great Sea and captured the leader of the Pirates, 
Jaden_MAN
. 
Purpled
 goes next, he says that he fought back during the purge and has the desire to save people. Next is 
Boosfer
, who doesn't say anything for his turn. Lettuce makes an announcement, he says that Wemmbu would be executed if he was elected, but says Wemmbu had died to an explosion trying to escape custody. Purpled doesn't trust his sources, just as he says that, the doors behind them opens up, Parrot and Wemmbu run towards the debate. Parrot comes up to the front and brings Wemmbu up with him, Lettuce is shocked to see Wemmbu and asks how Parrot did it. Lettuce says he can't bring a criminal up and asks if he broke Wemmbu out, Parrot says Wemmbu had always lived out in the Great Sea. Parrot starts to speak up, he says that Lettuce sent the 1,000 players to kill Wemmbu and 
Flame
 just to die. Parrot says he had a long talk with Wemmbu while going to spawn and he's not a bad person, and that Lettuce sent the entirety of Law to kill us and attempted to blow them up. Parrot asks Wemmbu for his side of the story, but Lettuce doesn't let him do so and pots up strength, trying to mace Wemmbu, but Wemmbu uses a stasis to teleport away. Parrot continues, he says Lettuce never cared about the 1,000 players and only cared about becoming king. He tells the entire server that Lettuce will lie, blackmail, and do whatever he can to get what he wants. Lettuce deems himself as the intern of the server and puts the election on hold until it is safe enough to resume. Lettuce says he got word that his commanders apprehended Theo, and if he wants Theo back, Parrot would have to endorse him and go to jail. The episode ends with Parrot saying that Lettuce should've kept that between the two of them.



Trivia


This is the shortest gap between Parrot videos, usually uploading every three weeks, this one was nine days apart from the previous.


There are a lot of references from past videos shown in this video.

Parrot uses a similar redstone contraption that checks to see if anyone walked around in 
I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
.


Parrot has another important moment set in a snowy biome, the last one being when 
Wifies
 revealed himself to be the Director in 
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
.


Parrot reuses the same technique of renaming an arrow to send a message from his previous video 
I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge
.


Wemmbu uses ice to cover ground quicker, a nod to 
Rejoicin
 and 
I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization
.


There are three new locations near spawn presented to us - Kings River, The Smugglers Pass, The Law Graveyard.


Parrot and Wemmbu survive 5 near-death situations in a single video.


The question "How does Law recruit its people" is raised. It hints at the low average age of the members in Law.

title: 2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players
content:
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players














Season


2






Episode


58






Upload date


Nov 1, 2025

Wemmbu

The Fake Identity Arc
















largest battle in all of minecraft





2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Players
 is the 85th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts off with 
Wemmbu
 and 
FlameFrags
 starting their rematch, but unexpectedly, 
LettuceK
 and 
his team of lawmen
 come and jump them. The two try to kill off the lawmen, but it would've drained too much of their resources, so they decide to leave. Wemmbu escapes and restocks, and Flame follows along to try and continue their battle. The lawmen catch up and jump them again. Wemmbu uses an 
orbital strike cannon
 to kill some of them off, but it barely did anything. He flees from the fight since there's too many of them still.

As Wemmbu is swimming away, Flame chases again and is ready to fight once more. Wemmbu gives the idea to deal with Lettuce first and then fight, but Flame says he's going to run from the fight. Wemmbu stops running and the two decide to work together to defeat Lettuce first. They go back to Flame's base to restock, and when Wemmbu goes outside to farm sugar cane for rockets, he sees lawmen coming from a distance. After deafting the army of lawmen once again, Lettuce flies away. Wemmbu and Flame pursue him, but their tridents break mid-chase.

The two then try to sneak into The Law's base and kill Lettuce there. Wemmbu makes it to the main building, and Lettuce notices him immediately. Flame and Wemmbu jump Lettuce, Flame tells Lettuce that he won't beat Flame no matter what. Lettuce tells them if they kill him, nothing would change since there's a chain of command and it would break connections between 
Capitol City
 and 
Merchant City
. Lettuce then says he won't stop hunting them until they submit or become a prisoner. Instead, Wemmbu proposes a fight with Lettuce and all his lawmen, and Lettuce accepts the deal. 

Wemmbu and Flame go back to Flame's base to collect the loot of the dead lawmen. They then head to the black market inside of Capitol City to rob players for their experience. Wemmbu tries to be intimidating, but it doesn't work. He starts killing players if they don't abide, and it starts to work. The people begin to chase them as they leave, but are unable to catch up. Wemmbu and Flame head to Merchant City next and talk to a rich civilian who lives there. He asks for netherite ingots in exchange for mending books, but Wemmbu doesn't have mending books, instead giving the civilian netherite sets with mending on them. He also trades off a few more sets of armor for shulkers full of materials. 

The two begin to minecart to their designated fighting location. In the midst of it, Wemmbu falls down 
some sort of trap, but survives since it was already set off
. They fly the rest of the way there, standing on top of a massive statue. They wait days for the lawmen to arrive, and they see thousands of players coming into view. Lettuce blows a horn to signal them to start attacking. Wemmbu activates three orbital strike cannons, which kills hundreds of players instantly. For the first half of the fight, they kill the lawmen with ease. However, later on in the fight, players with maces and Elytras start to appear. Though it being a bit challenging, Wemmbu kills one of the mace wielders that was AFK, and kill a few more soon after. He gives Flame a mace and an Elytra, Flame rejects it at first, but takes them out of pity. 



 
 
 
 
The location after the fight.
 
 


They kill the last remaining lawmen, and Wemmbu looks at the battlefield and the destruction they have caused. Behind him, Flame burns the Elytra and mace given to him and starts to attack Wemmbu. Flame uses a fishing rod to teleport his dogs to his location and Wemmbu tries to orbital strike them. Flame says he wants Wemmbu to admit that he's stronger than him. Wemmbu then has an epiphany, he tells Flame he can have the title of being the strongest player again. Flame then leaves after hearing what he wanted to hear. Wemmbu looks in his inventory, having three maces, an extra from one of the lawmen. He throws the extra away into down a hole created by the stab shot. Out of nowhere, Lettuce appears and says Wemmbu has definitely seen better days. He elytras down into the hole and picks the mace up. He comes back up and thanks Wemmbu for it. Lettuce, seeing the current state Wemmbu is in, then takes him as a prisoner or else he dies.



Trivia


This is the second longest episode after 
The Invisible Mafia Arc
.


This is one of the fastest growing episodes in terms of views as it has has an average of 1M views per day. (as of Nov 4, 2025)


This episode has the most amount of 
Unstable Events
 players.


Wemmbu accidentally kills LettuceK during the event this episode was based on but obviously, the scene was cut.


This episode has 10 Million Views on Youtube.

2 VS 1000 Player Minecraft Battle
 is the 86th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode begins with a recap of the fight they're about to take at the ending of 
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Faked His Death
. 
Flame
 makes a recap of the full episode and talking how 
Wemmbu
 had beat him "dishonourable" means in 
SOLO Player VS Hardcore Minecraft SMP
. 

Wemmbu asks Flame for where to fight the 1000 players. Together, both of them travel to a big statue in minecarts as traveling by minecarts would have more "aura". Flame is worried of a TNT minecart trap at the end of the railway. Wemmbu says he already satisfied and doesn't want to fight Flame anymore because he already had beaten him. Flame says Wemmbu faked his death to dodge a fight from him and Wemmbu was searching the entire globe for him. Wemmbu argues that he doesn't care about Flame that much so he didn't fake his death to dodge a fight. Flame and Wemmbu arrive at the statue and they see a giant horde of players all lead by a player named 
LettuceK
; the leader of 
The Law
. As the players load in a massive amount of lag sets in. Wemmbu detonates two nuke shots that kills a portion of  the players but not enough so all the lag is gone. Flame jumps down into the pit while Wemmbu circles in the skies. Flame pulls one of his wolf rods to kill some players. Flame struggles to eat golden apples due to the immense lag. Flame is swarmed by dozens of players even some in  full netherite. Flame decides to use TNT minecarts to kill a lot of players but he demands Wemmbu to give him some space so he can take some out of his shulker box. Flame manages to kill huge groups of players with his TNT minecarts. Wemmbu asks Flame to get in a corner so he can stab-shot and kill hundreds of the horde. Flame runs out of experience bottles; a vital resource to mend his armor. Flame moles his way back up to the ground. Flame restocks while Wemmbu is also running low on his experience bottle supply. Flame kills hundreds of players in a cave using TNT minecarts. In the process he pops himself. Flame runs back to the surface to meet up with Wemmbu. Flame's helmet breaks. Despite his dilapidated state, Flame goes on a killing spree killing over 20 players.  Flame runs up to the top of  the statue to get extra gear. Flame starts running as his armor his on the  verge of breaking. Some player's stole Wemmbu's armor shulkers and run. The fact of whether they got their shulkers back is unknown. Flame eventually takes a mace and an elytra from Wemmbu which he picked up from dead players of the 1000 player army. They meet up at the top of the statue to receive his mace and elytra. Flame states that he picked up the elytra and mace due to the 1000v2 situation and he'll fight unfair if the enemy is fighting unfair. The army is decimated. Flame even gets some cool kills such as TNT minecart - mace (stun slam) combo to kill a player, Mace - Mace (stun slam) combo, quick dropping a netherite player and comboes that exceed  the double digits. Eventually all that remains is 
Venthatguy
. Flame restocks while wemmbu kills the last player. While Wemmbu is restocking, Flame betrays him and starts killing him. Flame pulls his wolf rod to counter wemmbu's nukes. wemmbu misses his last stab shot as Flame dodges it. Wemmbu then pulls a nuke shot that barely kills a wolf, although it did damage the wolf armor by a notable amount. Wemmbu's armor breaks and Wemmbu falls into a hole. Flame then asks Wemmbu to accept defeat and accept that he is the strongest player on the Unstable SMP. Wemmbu reluctantly agrees and Flame leaves. The scene changes to The Law's headquarters where Lettuce's right-hand man, 
Deputy Ace
 asks why he lead a thousand players into a meat grinder. Lettuce replies with, "Which idot would play all their cards in one move?" stating that he has a plan to kill or capture both Flame and Wemmbu.  



Trivia


This video's title was originally "1000 Minecraft Hunters VS Minecraft's Deadliest Duo" but then being "SOLO Player VS 1000 Minecraft Hunters" but 
Wemmbu
 was added to the thumbnail making it 1001. It has since then been changed to "Minecraft Combat Master VS 1000 Hunters" and then "1000 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master"

Furthermore, the title differs slightly with the title of 
Wemmbu
's video of the same battle which is titled "
2 Minecraft Pros VS 1000 Minecraft Hunters
". This however signifies a very big contrast in what are their perceptions of each other are, with 
Wemmbu
 treating 
Flame
 more as an ally, while 
Flame
 still treats 
Wemmbu
 more as a foe.


The thumbnails also support this idea because 
Wemmbu
's thumbnail shows both of them together preparing for the battle instead of 
Flame
's thumbnail which shows 
Wemmbu
 on the opposing side.


As of April 28th 2026, there are 5 variations of the title:

1000 Minecraft Hunters VS Minecraft's Deadliest Duo


SOLO Player VS 1001 Minecraft Hunters


SOLO Player VS 1000 Minecraft Hunters


1000 Players VS Minecraft Combat Master


2 VS 1000 Player Minecraft Battle


The thumbnail has been changed 1 time.

 is the 113th episode featured in

Plot


Spoke foreshadows about the upcoming fight vs 
The Law
 and their armies. 

Spoke, 
PrinceZam
, 
Mapicc
 and  
JumperWho
 have prepared makeshift arrow cannons at the tunnels 
Leow0ok
 blew up. They trigger the cannons killing a chunk of the invading force but not enough to stop the invasion. They try escaping but Zam falls back in. Jumper pulls Zam's stasis to bring Zam to safety. The bunker had been overran.

They decide to recruit more people to fight 
Bounty Assassin Team
 and 
The Law
. They go to a prison to save some more people and recruit them. Jumper directs them to a prison holding her spies while Jumper splits off to go somewhere. They splash invisibility to sneak into the prison. They see the castle that reminds them of 
The Invisible Mafia's
 architecture that's not built by B.A.T or The Law. Zam suggests going in guns blazing but they realize they aren't well-equipped enough. So, Spoke suggests using a tunnel to save the spies. Spokes invisibility runs out before he could even make it in the castle. Mapicc throws invisibility on Spoke redisguising Spoke. Spoke elytras down to the base of the prison and calls Zam to come down. They mine into the prison. Spoke slowly rescues them one by one.   

Spoke tries to stop Zam and Mapicc from blowing up the prison from the bottom using carts but Spoke is unable to stop them and they explode it from the floor. They fight and the guards at the prison seem to have powerful gear almost killing Spoke. Spoke isn't geared for this as Jumper said that there wouldn't be a fight. They're fighting and almost dead but then 
MinuteTech
 and Jumper show up saving them. Jumper had recruited MinuteTech. Together, they slaughter the guards. Minute threatens to kill Spoke as Spoke griefed his base in 
the end incident
  Spoke apologizes and says he's trying to bring all his friends back. Spoke shows Jumper the spies they had rescued and gives them gear. Jumper says she's got gear for the spies and they know where to go to get invisibility and gear. Spoke asks what are the spies going to do if they aren't fighting and Jumper replies with they're going to gain intel on The Law and B.A.T. Minute gives them gear and he decides to go back into the end and take his gear stashes. Mapicc decides he's also going to follow Minute to help him in the end as Minute's wanted in the end.  

Jumper says the next person she's going to free is 
ParrotX2
. Jumper says Parrot is rumored to be in the prison Spoke broke Zam out of. The group figures the prison is going to have increased security due to Spoke's jailbreak. They decide they'll meet back up at 
The Amplified
's Castle. Zam doeesn't want to go back in the prison due to his trauma for being in there for four months. They invis and sneak into the prison. The prison also turns out to be the headquarters of the Law. They sneak past the guards. They are spotted by SilentMountain. Spoke tells them to get ready to run down the stairs when his TNT explodes.  They block their path behind them with obsidian. They equip their armor and blow up a Level 3 Access door. They go through the halls and kills some guards. They even get level access cards and milk buckets from the loot.    

Spoke blows up any clogs. They also blow up the item checker. They are attacked by a lot of guards once the door opens. They go to the solitary as they couldn't find Parrot in the main jail. But they do not find Parrot in solitary either. Spoke checks the backrooms but no luck. They go back to the main prison cells as they didn't check it all the way. They hear 
SargeLaw
 talking. They free 
Th3Blurpinstein
 and 
Lomedy
, and also meet 
FlameFrags
 killing guards. Lomedy refuses to leave his cell and Spoke locks him in a smaller cell. They watch Flame use his 
Orbital Dog Cannon
 which summons an army of wolves. SargeLaw focuses Zam due to Zam wearing 
SargeRaxby's
 shield and due to SargeRaxby being SargeLaw's brother. They still couldn't find Parrot and SargeLaw chases them. Spoke mines ender chests without a silk touch pickaxe to obtain obsidian. Spoke blocks SargeLaw outside with obsidian rendering him out of the equation. They go back to the solitary cells and figure that they The Law must be hiding something if there were six guards protecting the place, so they summon a wither and boar through the obsidian towards a nametag. They free 
Jaden MAN
, king of the 
Pirates
 who was captured by the Law in 
Unstable SMP: The Battle for The Great Sea
. Spoke thinks Jaden is a guard but Zam tells him he is Jaden from the Great Sea. They recruit Jaden, 
Wemmbu
 and FlameFrags to join the resistance against the Law. They go to their headquarters in the Amplified. They meet Minute and Mapicc. But another glaring problem was present; 
Wemmbu
 and Flame are rivals and even more of an issue, Jaden betrayed Flame and Lomedy's mace in 
I Got BETRAYED on a Hardcore Minecraft SMP
. Flame tried killing Minute in 
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Went Missing
 to get information on Wemmbu. So Flame tries to kill Jaden but is eventually stopped by the others.   

A spy shows up dropping a book and quill to Jumper stating that armies were converging to a specific point. They figure that Parrot was most likely there. Flame and Wemmbu says they want to attack 
LettuceK
 at the 
Northern Council
. They go to 19500 ~ -10200. Immediately, Wemmbu elytras over there and leaves. Minute follows behind trying to reason with him and Flame goes there by foot. Spoke thinks on how to go faster than an elytra. They decide to make an ender pearl cannon with TNT minecarts to boost the ender pearl. Spoke goes there instantaneously beating Wemmbu and flame to the location. Spoke makes cart traps and lures the guards to the traps killing groups of them. There he sees Parrot and 
TheobaldTheBird
 up in the sky. Then Wemmbu arrives but he doesn't actually start fighting until FlameFrags show up.    

After a hard-fought battle, they loot the base and load it into chest boats strapped to a happy ghast although this is pretty impractical. Wemmbu is kicked off the happy ghast and flies over to their headquarters. Parrot leads them to 
District 13
 where he had raised an army to confront LettuceK. They march to Northern Council where they see Lettuce, 
G0dOfWar
, 
Purpled
, SargeLaw and Leow0ok standing. Lettuce and Parrot walk up and talk. No peace was able to be made. Wemmbu drops 3 nukes on the players killing over a half of their forces. Their forces are able to kill the diamond players with ease. They confront Lettuce as they went up into their palace. Lettuce asks them how stupid do they think he is and reveals that the full netherite players were stationed in the walls and now encircling them. They are forced to fight or die, After a long fight, Lettuce and the Law is defeated and ran away. Flame attempts to kill Jaden, but Wemmbu intervenes. Lettuce comes back with no armor and surrenders.   

They take Lettuce to a vote. To either execute him or imprison him. The majority voted on imprisoning him. Parrot then reveals that he was going to allow Lettuce run in the election and if he wins he'll let Lettuce be king. They revolt and Lettuce says it's a lost cause. He knew Parrot was supposed to win the moment the execution against Parrot and Theo failed. Jumper interrupts Spoke to tell him Leow0ok was only a couple hundred blocks away and they beeline to Leo's exact location. They fight Leo and breaks all of his armor except for his leggings. Leo tells Spoke this will never end until he is dead and stasis away only to find out it was rigged to drop him in the void. Leo dies in the void.

This is the second longest post mafia Unstable SMP episode


This is Spoke's 100th video.

title: Alt
content:
Alt
 was the signature exploited Netherite Chestplate owned by 
Spoke
, with every incompatible protection enchantment on it. It was broken by 
Mapicc
 after he knew the truth that Spoke instead of 
Leow0ok
 was the one who tried to kill 
JamatoP
 and encountered Spoke in a maze, surviving 130 episodes all the way from the beginning of 
Unstable Universe
 series. Of all destroyed items, this one bears the most significance, and lasted for the longest time.



Origin


Alt is first seen when Spoke is shown JamatoP's base which came from an armour set with "Ctrl" (helmet), "Delete" (leggings), and "Escape" (boots). This armour set has all types of incompatible protection enchantments, which is normally impossible. Wemmbu destroyed the rest of the set, but Spoke kept Alt for months. 

Alt has pronounced symbolic significance: It can represent Spoke's pride, Spoke's facade, Spoke's personal heroism, Spoke's false friendship with 
JamatoP
, Spoke's manipulation, Spoke's crime, or Spoke's inner goal to use exploits to take over the server. 

Ironically, Alt was broken by Spoke's former best friend, 
Mapicc
, in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
.
