Debut


The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands







The 
Far Lands
 is a terrain that "replaces the world border" and generates 12 million blocks from 
Spawn
. The more you traverse into the Far Lands, the more glitches occur, and more terrain is corrupted and deleted. The glitches are said to change a lot. The end of the Far Lands is the Minecraft void. There are many directions in the Far Lands; however, the one seen the most is the direction towards the 
Far Lands Civilization
 and SerpentBound's kingdom. 
PlanetLord
 says that he thinks that the player who first discovered The Far Lands was the one to make it such a mysterious places and generated all of these Biomes, glitches and exploits.



Places and Terrain


The Far Lands have many historical places and 
echoes
 which have been seen in many Unstable SMP episodes. These are some of the mentioned places. Direction is labelled after each place.



Ashswagg's House (unknown)


Ashswagg
 lived in a house in the Far Lands. He abandoned the house and lived in an underground base since 
the Invisible Mafia
 disbanded.



The Far Lands Civilization (+Z)


Main article: 
Far Lands Civilization


The 
Far Lands Civilization
 was one of the last resistance cells fighting against the Invisible Mafia. It had 3 districts to organize themselves and used beacon signals to communicate with other resistance cells. Its remoteness meant that other resistance cells could not help it when it was overrun by the Mafia. The final battle against The Mafia lasted a few minutes before the civilization was overrun and destroyed by The Mafia. Its ruins still stand as a memory of the terror of the Mafia.



 
 
 
 
The Far lands Civilization
 
 


The Far Lands Portal (±X, ±Z)


 
 
 
 
The Underworld Portal from 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
 
 


This is a portal in the Far lands which allows people in the Far Lands to quickly travel millions of blocks. The portal first leads to 
the Underworld
, where 
the people in the Underworld
 allow others to travel using the portals. These people are allied to 
JamatoP
, whom they seem to recognize. There are many portals spanning all the directions of the Far Lands. 
Wemmbu
 and JamatoP went from −X Far Lands to +Z Far Lands in 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
.



The Spikelands (+Z)


 
 
 
 
The Spikelands from 
I Got REVENGE on the Unstable SMP
.
 
 


This is not a very important place in The Far Lands, as the Far Lands has other terrain; however, it is important to the lore as this is the place where 
The Avengers
 were defeated by 
FlameFrags
 and 
Wemmbu
, and this is where the rivalry between Flame and Jaden began. Funnily enough, somewhere in this biome, there is an 
echo
 of a player named 
Burgle5
 who starved to death. 



The Cherry Grove (+Z)


This is also another overlooked aspect of the Far Lands; however, due to its natural beauty,p> 



 
 
 
 
 
The Zam empire echo from 
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
 
 


This is one of the anomalies in The Far Lands, as a nexact copy of 
Zam Empire
 is found by 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
. There is also a real echo of FlameFrags and other higher-ranking members of 
Zam Empire
 before 
PrinceZam
 himself. There is no real explanation why this happens.



The Far Lands Temple (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
The Far Lands Temple from 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
 (Cameo)
 
 


This is a place with the statues of all the first-generation players in the Far Lands. A first-generation player is a player who is wealthy and wants to be in the Far Lands. This is also where 
Lakerek
 was killed and where we first found out about the forge.



Serpentbound's Kingdom (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
Serpentbound's Kingdom from 
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void
 
 


This article is about the golden kingdom in the void beyond Far Lands.  For 
Horace_Altman
's Civilization, see 
Far Lands Civilization
.



This is the most influential place in the Far Lands. It is owned by some of the 
First Generation Players
. After the death of 
Lakerek
, 
Serpentbound333
 became the highest authority in the kingdom, hence the kingdom's name. These players are very hostile to intruders, and they know about something called 
the Forge
 that presumably is a place to dupe weapon-related items and structures like 
maces
, bottles of enchanting and 
Orbital Strike Cannons
. During 
the Power Arc
, 
Wemmbu
 invaded the civilization for answers about the Forge. Wemmbu managed to kill some of the first-generation players, but they refused to tell anything about the Forge. Wemmbu ended up leaving without any answers and instead used the Orbital Strike Cannons near the civilization. In 
I Explored the Minecraft Farlands
 Wemmbu met some first-generation players again but avoided the kingdom. These first-generation players are very rich, so rich in fact that they had 3 double chests of maces and some of the only villagers on the server. This means that they can infinitely produce rare items such as experience bottles and mending books. They also have an unknown method of getting netherite that Serpentbound referred to as a trade secret (presumably related to the Forge). This is odd because the portals in the Far Lands don't work, and the select few that do only lead to 
the Underworld
. 
JamatoP
 also knows this kingdom and maintains good relationship with it. They may also have some kind of relationship with the underworld, as the Soul Keepers have a portal that leads near Serpentbound's Kingdom.



The Red Plain (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
The Red Plain in 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 
 


The red plain is a biome covered with netherrack and crimson nylium and trees made of unusual blocks. It is where Revenant and 
Mapicc
 built their camp after escaping 
Null Hunters
. The camp had been looted by Null Hunters before 
Spoke
 and 
Jumper
 came. It has a tunnel to a flowery plain biome. It is one of the many biomes in The Far Lands and it also has a floating mineshaft in the sky filled with Lost Players. These Lost players are players who have been trapped in The Far Lands and they could be also referred to as Farlands Zombies. 



PlanetLord's Base and The Biome (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
PlanetLord's Base from 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 
 


PlanetLord
 built his base in a biome with periodic, intertwined, and stacked sine waves of grass blocks. It had a maxed out enchanting table, tree farm, food farm and multiple other players. Its goal was to help players who get lost in Far Lands. It was later taken over by 
Null Hunters
. This base is in a weird, hard to describe biome and it was in the path to The Dark Forest.  



The Dark Forest (+Z)


 
 
 
 
 
The 
NULL
 Leader being trapped in The Dark Forest from 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
.
 
 


Is a forest that is completely dark and torches can operate only in shorter-than-usual range. Nametags are hidden even without crouching here.  Because of the darkness having reinforcements here or allies is very hard and this is one of the most dangerous biome in The Farlands.  Spoke, Jumper and 
Mapicc
 managed to isolate Null Hunters and even capture their leader using the darkness. PlanetLord even said something about people being corrupted because of the darkness. The 
NULL leader
 was forced to lead them to a staircase that leads to Null Hunters' tunnels as well as possibly Null Hunters'  true leader. He seemed scared, for his rank and his life and also refused to continue (If he was seen with Spoke, he would have probably been labeled as a traitor) and was brutally killed. The staircase he led them to seemed to go infinitely down.  



The Fabric (+Z)


This is a biome that resemble Wifies's World that Doesn't Exist ARG series' thumbnails, with lots of tunnels inside a dark open space. It is on the side of the aforementioned staircase. It is possibly in the space between the Overworld and 
the Underworld
 due to Spoke exclaiming how deep the staircase is. Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc met 
Jamato
 in a torch-lit altar here.



The Road of Null (unknown)


Anticsparty06
 managed to offset the pearl cannon to the Road of Null before being killed and landed in the Far Lands. Therefore the Road of Null must be somewhere in the Far Lands, if not further in the void.



Inhabitance


In the Far Lands, you will most likely find 3 types of individual player entities. First, there are the 
Farland Zombies
, people trapped in with no clear way out, (Some of these players are just trapped from earlier adventures though majority have been trapped by 
NULL
) 
First Generation Players
, who are more experienced and richer "zombies".  
Echoes
. Not real players, just predictions of them that repeat over and over. Almost nothing is known about them, and finally 
NULL
 who patrol The Farlands and capture escaped players. (Farlands Zombies)

The 
Null Hunters
 is known to recently starting to take over Far Lands. This created more Farland Zombies who had to survive in the resource-scarce region or refugees like in PlanetLord's base. NULL, however is not invincible. Despite their resource advantage they can be killed like how a entire squadron was destroyed in The Dark Forest. NULL hunters in The Farlands are also less experienced and thus do not have Totems Of Undying that can teleport them since they usually fight players who have like iron armour and do not usually need them



Glitches and Mechanics


The Far Lands has many glitches and mechanics that make it a truly mysterious place on the Unstable SMP. These are some of the seen glitches and mechanics of the Far Lands.

This includes infinite repeating loops of past historical events. The main echoes that the Far Lands give home to include the 
Zam Empire
 creation echo and the First Generation Players vs Elder Guardian. Echoes, or memories, are repetitions of past events. They occur in the Far Lands as well as in 
the Underworld
.

Perhaps the biggest elephant in the room is the repeating patterns of the Far Lands. These patterns take existing structures, whether man-made or not, and make them so that they infinitely repeat. A few of the infinite repeating patterns include the infinite dungeon and spawner that 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 looted, gaining over 64 enchanted golden apples. Another massive repeating pattern is the infinite array of 
Orbital Strike Cannons
. These are the very orbitals that Wemmbu uses to this day. It is unknown what creates a repeating pattern because it's not as though they only repeat naturally generated structures, but they also include the orbital cannons, which aren't natural. This implies that there are duplication glitches in the Far Lands, which would explain how the 
OG players
 got to be so rich in the first place, and are likely related to 
the Forge
. 
Sharpness
 also only went to the Far Lands to try and find a duplication glitch.

Another glitch is that of connection between 
the Underworld
 and the Far Lands, because when you use a nether portal anywhere but the Far Lands, it takes you to the nether, but when you use an existing nether portal in the Far Lands (you cannot build one), it takes you to the Underworld. This is interesting because it implies that there is a significant history that links the Underworld and the Far Lands together. 
Null Hunters
 can light portals in the Far Lands but not normal players. It is unclear whether these portals lead to the Nether or the Underworld.

A staircase was found to go infinitely down in the Far Lands. It is theorized to connect to the Underworld. It was in the Dark Forest.

Nametags are hidden even without crouching in the Dark Forest. But they do show in the staircase as well as in the fabric biome.

PlanetLord has said that the first person who discovered the Farlands generated all of these glitches. 



Trivia


The four protagonist have all been to Far Lands. The sequence of arrival is 
Parrot
, 
Wemmbu
, 
Flame
 and 
Spoke
.

title: Farland Zombies
content:
Intro


 
 
 
 
 


The Farlands is located 12 millon blocks from 
Spawn
 and is a weird terrain glitch that basically changes the world around it. But with it comes a problem. Back in the servers old days, the Farlands was not known to exist until players, trying to reach what should have ben the world border, found IT instead. The weird part about this is that the game did not get laggy as they pressed on with their exploration. They entered, explored and exited bringing the news to everyone they met. 





Getting Lost


As news spread many players went to the farlands to colonize. The great part about this was that, since the farlands was so far away, no griefers would try to bomb it. Many people went to build there to build their homes. Houses were built, towns were made, but then, players got too adventurous. They went too far and they lost track of how to get back. Since the debug menu (for seeing coordinates) was not working, as we saw in 
Wemmbu
's POV, people could not figure out how to get back, nor did they have the resources required to. They were stuck in a land with dangerous terrain and a glitchy atmosphere, thus becoming the infamous "Farland Zombies"*. 

*In order to become a Farland Zombie, our definition would be to have been in the farlands for more than 26,300 in-Minecraft Days, 7/8 of which cannot be with any social interaction. More than 1/8 social interaction is called a 
First Generation Player
.






 
 
 
 
Farlands Zombie BaguetteBattler8 (right) next to his house
 
 


The Life


Because of the size of the farlands, it is almost impossible to find another player. Most zombies only see a player once every 2 real life years, and most of the time it's just a random explorer who does not care about the zombie. Zombies usually live in cheap houses with little-to-no interior design. They survive only on farms they tend, for their sustenance. Usually, the farms are growing carrots or potatoes as they serve enough hunger points to survive. Items like netherite and 
Maces
 are one of the hardest items to obtain on the SMP, but in the farlands, a single diamond is worth more. The Farlands is a place where the 
needs
 are way more expensive and hard to find than the 
wants
. A Zombie has almost no hope of escaping unless someone helps them do so.  



Farland Zombie List (Confirmed)


BaguetteBattler8


Wemmbu found this player in "
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Farlands
" when he was trying to retrieve one of his Maces from 
Conexion
. This was when he confirmed that Farland Zombies were real. 



Burgle5


Wemmbu found this player in the video "
I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Fartherlands
". This player was found in the ice spikes mega biome, and was actually an echo, a ghost player that has past



Players who have escaped Null Hunters


Spoke
, 
Mapicc
 and 
Jumper
 found players that have escaped Null in the Far Lands. Some tried to rob Mapicc, and others stayed at refuges like 
PlanetLord's base
.

title: Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing














Episode


130






Upload date


May 8, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


NULL






Featured Creators (Description)


JamatoP
Mapicc
JumperWho
DylPickleYT
CookieBunsquat














It was always going to end like this...



Finding 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 is the 130th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.

Plot


Spoke
 recaps his previous episode where he went to the 
Farlands
, where it is rumored that thousands of players disappeared and was waiting to be found. If they wanted to bring the server back to peace, he'd have to act fast, as well as avoiding the people who've been behind all of this: 
NULL
. When Spoke, 
Mapicc
, and 
JumperWho
 found the deepest part of the Farlands, instead of finding the missing players, they found 
JamatoP
, who was behind it all.

The episode starts with Mapicc wondering how Jamato is still alive, Jamato brushs it off says that that's what 
he
 wanted them to belive but there's a bigger problem at hand, being NULL and the players. Spoke thinks to himself that Jamato returning felt off and it wasn't a coincidence. Jamato gives the three of them a shulker box with some gear, in one of the slots has a book with Spoke's name on it signed by Jamato. Spoke opens the book and it tells him that he'll never find the players and that Mapicc and Jumper will turn on him, and that if he tries anything, Jamato would reveal everything and put an end to it all. Jamato had blackmailed Spoke, he's unsure to why Jamato would do such a thing. However, the book was signed by Jamato, which would be his biggest mistake.

The four of them reach the exit, Spoke stalls and tries to get Jamato to go up first while Spoke gives them the book. Jamato "accidentally" picks up the book and gives it back to them. Mapicc reads it and says they got the same book, Spoke opens it back up and the contents of it changed, now saying to enjoy the kit and to stay safe. Spoke burns the book and heads up with them, as he goes up the steps, he picks up another book named "
Spoke_Log_Full
", in which Jamato had been keeping track of Spoke the entire time since he joined the server. Spoke knows Jamato is trying to use his past against him, and if his real intentions were to lead them away, he'd have to sabotage Jamato's plans. He burns that book too then speaks up and says they should look where they came from if they spent all that time going down, Jumper agrees and asks why they're going up, and Jamato says they're moving forward.  

When they get out of the stairway system, new terrain of terricotta spike-like terrain with bridges built across each from each other, and hundreds of villager houses cover the floor appear right before their eyes. Mapicc asks what bridge they should take, Jamato says NULL occupies most of the Nether and has thousands of players, so they can't take them all in a fight, but that they can't find the missing players without finding NULL. Jamato offers to take them to a secret back way to find the players. Spoke intervenes and says they can't take down NULL with just the four of them and that they should head towards the opposite direction to find more rebel groups to help them. Jamato says the numbers don't mean anything and that they're not going to fight, he then asks if Spoke doesn't trust him. Jumper jumps in and is on Jamato's side, believing they're getting closer. Spoke says it'll take time, but if this is their only hope, then he isn't willing to take that chance and decides to head north by himself. Mapicc is onboard, Jumper sounds unsure, and Jamato agrees to go with whatever plan Spoke has, telling him he's making a mistake under his breath. 

Spoke was curious to see what Jamato was willing to do to turn them back, but just as he has that thought, a Nether portal appears on the pillar right in front of them. They water downwards and try to keep heading north, more portals appear, which makes Spoke blow the bridges up to dodge them. The 
Null hunters
 chase after them and they're forced to fight them or knock them down. Although Jumper and Jamato thinks it's risky to keep going north, Spoke decides to keep on going and head towards the hunters and fight. They fend off the hunters and Spoke breaks their portal, Spoke starts bridging towards a new pillar as the Null hunters wait on top for them. Spoke pearls onto a bridge nearby, the hunters catch up and get him down to half a heart. The other three kill off a few more hunters, giving some time to traverse. More hunters show up, Spoke and Mapicc use knockback swords to knock the hunters off and kill them. 

Eventually, they find a new biome and they bridge towards it. As they enter Jamato tells them it's still not too late to turn back, they don't have to cross back on the bridges, but they need to head the right way. Mapicc says he recognizes this group because Revenant says a rainbow forest has a group of stacked players. Mapicc asks Jamato if he's been around here, in which he says he hasn't. Spoke is uncertain what Jamato even wants, one moment he uses his group to turn them back and the next he's okay with just following them. Little did both of them know, they were headed towards a trap. They go deeper into the biome and find a player towering up a tree, Mapicc wind charges him off and they clutch. They try to ask the player, chromesanctuary, questions, but they appear to not have a mic and they start running; they follow. A piston fall trap gets pulled, and Chrome asks what they're doing in their biome. Spoke tries to convince them they're good and that they're trying to work with them. Chrome doesn't believe him when he has full netherite and a Null shield. He then says they'll let them talk to their leader, and Spoke says he can try and explain what they're trying to do with the leader. Jamato says they'll take off their gear in order for to gain the Rainbow Forest's group's trust. The players let them out and lead them back to the surface, Spoke tries to tell them he's trying to save them, but Chrome says they love the Farlands and getting rich. They reach the leader of the group, DylPickle, who welcomes them to Pickletopia. He makes his group give them space and asks what they're here for. Jumper says they were taken by force, but asks for any gear if he has any, which he says all their gear is taken up. Chrome asks why he was willing to give them gear, and DylPickle tells him he sees they're good people by their vibes and puts Chrome in a cage. He says all the gear here is taken up, but there's a secret place with gear that he forgot where it was located, and so he gives Spoke a lodestone compass that leads to it.

They begin their adventure towards the stash, Spoke suggests getting the gear and coming back to camp to gather them all together to head into the Nether. Spoke mutes in-game and talks to himself, he questions what Jamato is trying to do and tries to figure out what his next play is. They reach a new biome, a red sand desert with fast ravagers spawning. As they go deeper in the biome, more and more ravagers spawn, their armor begins to break, so they tower up. They come up with the idea to use lava to kill the ravagers, which works wonderfully, and so they set off to find the stash. The compass starts to loop around, Spoke digs around while the other three distract the ravagers. He finds a ladder going downwards and goes down to see what it is first, he finds diamonds, golden apples, and enchanted books, and so he goes up to tell the rest of them to come down with him. As they go back down, the whole stash is cleared, no chests or ore blocks left. Spoke digs into the walls to see if there's anything else and discovers a tunnel behind one of the paintings. They follow down it and spot the Null hunters, who had just robbed them. They follow and dig to the hunters and begin attacking them. Eventually a hunter is killed, but the hunter's inventory shows no sign of taking anything from the vault. Spoke gets infuriated at the fact that NULL took it all and possibly followed them underneath all along and thinks something is fishy. He points out that Jamato hadn't fought the whole time and was watching. They mine out and say they're dead if they ever come across Dylan again, so they just don't go back to his camp without all his gear.

They dodge the rest of the ravagers and reach the edge of the biome, entering a mythical forest biome. They try to mend their armor with the little amount of sculk blocks around, but either it's not enough or they don't have mending. Jumper spots a river from afar, Spoke tries to make a boat from the nether wood out of the forest's trees, but Jamato came prepared and makes them boats. The four of them sail through the river and Spoke mutes and talks to himself again. He doesn't know what Jamato's game plan is still and no matter what he does he can't get away from Jamato. He thinks killing Jamato is the only way to stop him but doesn't have a way of how yet. Jumper spots a village nearby. Spoke suggests taking off any NULL related gear they have and to have Jumper be the one to talk to them without striking as a threat. The leader of the village, CookieBunsquat, welcomes them and mentions that if they came through the sand biome, they wouldn't have made it out alive. Spoke says that it was all Dylan's fault, Cookie says to never trust him since he just wants everyone dead. Cookie slowly walks closer to Jumper and says she used to be one of her 
spies
. Cookie looks at Spoke and says he looks familiar too and remembers that they have a file on him. Spoke brushes that aside and asks for help and for food, Cookie leads them to their wheat farm. Spoke says they were misleading a little bit and tells her their mission is to save the missing players from NULL. She's willing to help out and gives them basic necessities.  

Jamato asks if she has an anvil and she leads him into her house. Spoke watches Jamato from a distance, he makes an excuse of mining sculk to mend his armor and leaves. He goes out of distance from everybody else and gets an invis potion from his ender chest, he walks up to the window and spies on Jamato. He gets the idea of killing Jamato right then and there, he sees that Jamato isn't holding a totem out either. Spoke thinks it's now or never, so he runs back to the group and mine an ender chest for the obsidian. He creates a Nether portal and puts on the Null armor to pretend to be a hunter. He digs into the house from below and waits right behind Jamato. As soon as Jamato takes off his chestplate Spoke pots with strength and crits him out. Jamato pulls out a totem at the last second and stasises away. Jumper and Mapicc see Spoke and believes NULL is there. They attack Spoke and the rest of the village comes to kill who they believe is a Null hunter. Spoke pearls out the window and tons of Nether portals begin spawning all over the village. Jumper goes to assist Cookie, leaving Mapicc and Spoke alone to fight. 

Spoke tries to run away in order to not reveal his identity to Mapicc, but the fight leads to their armor breaking which makes it harder to survive in time. Spoke jumps into a huge cave and tries to riptide trident away using the water, but Mapicc is still able to catch up. With a minute left, he doesn't have enough time to run and hide his identity and, unfortunately for him, Mapicc pops his totem which gets rid of his invisibility. Spoke tries to tell Mapicc that there's a lot he doesn't understand, but Mapicc deflects and asks Spoke if he's insane. Mapicc says that Jumper was captured because of him. Spoke asks Mapicc if he understands that Jamato is the leader of NULL and that Jamato's been blackmailing Spoke since the very start. Mapicc says he's lost it and is ludicrous; he's the reason why they lost all their allies. Spoke says they need to make a portal and save Jumper, but Mapicc says he's not going with him and that Spoke can go take on NULL with half his armor by himself. Spoke tells him that this is exactly what Jamato wanted and that him and Jumper only follow orders and that's all they do on the server. Mapicc leaves and Spoke is defeated. He doesn't know how else to explain it to Mapicc, but he tells himself there's still a chance to win. With no food and millions of blocks out, there can't be anything worse than now. Spoke begins to reminisce about old adventures he had on the server: blowing up farms, being hunted by the 
Invisible Mafia
, his lava cast house. He didn't think it could get any worse. 

He comes across a dead end in the cave and looks up to a crack. He builds upwards and finds himself inside a maze. Spoke tells Jamato to bring his guards to take all his gear and everything. he begins to chide himself about how he could've rallied up Parrot's guards, could've then gone to Planet, to Dylan, to Cookie, and created an army of his own. He begins to realize he's going to the be the last person to know about these players. He starts to blame himself that these missing players are going to be missing forever. He goes upwards, but the top of the maze is entirely sculk. He drops back down to find food and immediately runs out of hunger. The Null hunters start showing up but they don't attack him. They only following him wherever he goes. He reaches a dead end and tries to get the hunters to back off, but they stand there. A Nether portal spawns right in front of Spoke.  

Jamato comes through and asks Spoke if he's even surprised to see him and that it was always going to end like this. Spoke asks why he did any of this. Jamato ignores the question and asks how many people are going to take the fall for him and that he keeps going and ruining everything and even killing him wouldn't be enough to save the world. Spoke asks why he took a thousand players, and that they can be real with each other now that they're alone without Mapicc or Jumper. Jamato says everyone deserves to make their own way, explore the world, make their own choices, but it always ended with Spoke; with death and destruction, and that's why NULL exists, to bring all the bad players to justice. He goes on to say everything he's done wasn't enough. It wasn't easy to capture Spoke, and not only that he survived, but he also managed to kill and to keep fighting and that he resents that. Spoke brings up the fact that he took Mapicc way before NULL started going after him. Jamato says he realized something after Spoke killed his soldiers; there was no point in capturing Spoke himself when he already had someone to do it for him. Spoke thinks that Mapicc was in on it the whole time, but Jamato says he sent a message to NULL to let Mapicc escape, and from there, he found Spoke and brought him right where he needed him. Jamato also brings up the fact that Spoke brought NULL to all the rebel camps, and that all the leaders of those groups are all in his hands. Spoke is devastated and says it was always going to end like this. Jamato asks why it will end exactly how it will, he says he owns the truth and can tell them anything he wants to, but nothing he could make up would be better than what Spoke did to himself. He'd ruined his own life better than Jamato could do. Jamato says he's done here and turns towards the portal, Spoke stops him and asks if he's going to tell them, and Jamato says the better question is how long does he think he can hide the truth. 

After he goes through the portal, Spoke breaks the portal and wanders off to try and find an exit. Eventually, he finds a white gateway, but he also notices Mapicc standing in the maze from a distance. He tells Mapicc the exit is nearby and they can leave. Mapicc says Jamato told him that 
Leo
 didn't try to kill him, it was Spoke, and that Jamato told him everything. Spoke tries to say that Jamato is trying to turn Mapicc against him. Mapicc says they could've roamed the server freely if he didn't try to kill Jamato, but Spoke wanted to have his pride moment with Leo and that he dragged them all back into this. Spoke says if he told them if he tried to kill Jamato, they would've turned against him there, but because of his decision they were able to go back to spawn and kill Leo. Spoke tries to convince Mapicc that they can explore the server still. He just wants to go back to spawn and leave. Mapicc puts on a new full set of netherite armor and says he's not going to let Spoke leave. Spoke asks Mapicc if he's insane. Mapicc says he got manipulated this entire time to be on his side. Mapicc pearls and catches Spoke in webs and crits him out. 

Alt
, the last existing piece of an exploted armor set, finally breaks after two years. Mapicc asks if he thought this was how it was going to end and what his goal was. Spoke asks if he wanted it to end like this. Mapicc says that Spoke just wanted to get away with it. Spoke wants Mapicc to kill him now that he has nothing left, but Mapicc asks where the exit is. Spoke points him towards the direction he came from. Mapicc says he's going to leave alone and suggests Spoke to live out in the Farlands or he can push NULL and die. Mapicc says something about if he ever sees Spoke at spawn again before getting interrupted by the Null hunters coming from a portal and jumping him. Mapicc thinks Spoke was behind this, he tries to fight back, but they're stronger and break all of his armor. They capture Mapicc and lead him into the Nether as Spoke apologizes softly. Jamato comes out of the portal. He says this is Spoke's legacy now, not as the hero he claims to be, but as the reason why all the rebels fell. He says if he ever wants to see Mapicc again, he'd have to drop everything on the floor. Spoke drops everything and Jamato burns it. He then forces Spoke to drop everything in his ender chest. Jamato burns that as well. Next, Jamato tells Spoke to go through the portal and says this is the end, not for the server, but it's a new era that would be better. Without 
him
.



Trivia


This is the lowest a protagonist has ever been having nothing in there inventory nothing in there echest and no friends to help them and being captured on top of that.


This marks the first time in a long time where a protagonist has nothing to their name.


The biome that the group emerged from the staircase is a direct reference to This episode referenced 
Wifies

Destroying a World That Doesn't Exist
" ARG video.


People on Twitter have caught onto the fact that the reaction roles for Spoke in the Unstable Events server have decreased significantly. This could've possibly hinted towards the fact that Jamato was erasing Spoke from the server.

Another detail to back this up is that Spoke's name hasn't been mentioned by any of the other protagonist's in their videos in a while either

, but all three other protagonists have been mentioning or seeing each other almost every video.


At around 24:41, 
JamatoP's
 name is shown as "JamatoB".


When Spoke was looking at Jamato through the window, a flower pot with a rose could also be seen, which could be said to be

content:
Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia














Season


2

60






Upload date


Nov 15, 2025






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The Treasure Arc
 (finale)






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
Marlowww
Rasplin
CoinMonke
Venpu
Willerhide
herobanenair
pro4d
TomLWSM
qCxsh
NotBlueLeaf
Kibaxmc
nezoshoki














The Unstable SMP was once ruled by a team called 
the Invisible Mafia
.





Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia
 is the 87th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Parrot
 recaps what the 
Invisible Mafia
 was, and how they took most of the resources on the server. However, rumors say how the resources were never destroyed, but stored somewhere hundreds of thousands of blocks out in a tomb in the End dimension. Parrot and 
Theo
 head out to the outer End islands, and they both nearly drop into the void after entering an end gateway. They make it to the end of the first End rings, so they use a flying machine to travel the rest of the way there. Hours pass, and they get to a huge island filled with cherry blossom trees. The two follow the path that leads to a massive door. In front of the door has two hoppers, which means a key is needed to access it. Parrot spots players coming and both of them hide. Parrot notices that one of the players was 
CoinMonke
, one of his friends is part of the group that was trying to access the tomb too. One of the other players try to break the door down, but is suddenly given the darkness effect. An invisible player in full netherite with a quartz eye trim appears right behind them once the darkness wears off. The invisible player drinks milk, revealing themselves to be 
Marlowww
, Minecraft's best PvPer. The group is confident they can take Marlowww in a fight, having an advantage with players, but they quickly drop. Parrot and Theo decide to save Coin and run off the island.

Parrot, Theo, and Coin flies away from the island, heading towards an End station. They head inside, where everybody there is playing games and gambling. Parrot looks around, everyone stares back at him intimidatingly. Two of the people that were playing games begin to argue, and a fight breaks out, causing one of them to die. Coin lets Parrot run free and makes him talk to Rasplin. Parrot asks Rasplin for any hints on the tomb, but Rasplin wants to play a game of eight-fold for it. He says he has a key to the tomb, but Theo thinks he could be scamming. They play the first round, and Parrot loses. They keep going, with wagers going higher and higher each round. On the last round, Parrot has a good hand, and Rasplin wants Parrot to wager everything, his armor, totems, and shulker boxes in exchange for the key. Parrot wagers everything in and he loses. Then, the darkness sets in again, and Rasplin instantly gets killed by Marlowww. Parrot goes through an escape tunnel, but before leaving, he looks at Marlowww, and she's staring back at him. 

Parrot and Theo come back to the island where the tomb is located, Theo gives Parrot his Elytra since he has no armor. Parrot says they stand no chance fighting against Marlowww, and they only need to get the key from her. His idea is to lock the hoppers so the key can't be put in the hoppers and have Theo take it while Parrot shoots her away with a punch bow. Marlowww comes back to the island and they wait until she's gone to set the plan in motion. Parrot locks the hoppers and hides behind a rock to wait for Marlowww to come back. As Marlowww is coming back, Parrot is prepared to shoot and Marlowww is about to put the key in until she says, "Don't you know that I can see you right there?" Parrot, thinking his cover has been blown, hides behind the rock. However, it was another player was hiding nearby and Marlowww kills them. Marlowww then drops the key and Parrot manages to get the shot off, and Theo gets the key. They meet back at a lake where Parrot said to come to if they ever split off and lose each other. The two hide inside a cave for days until Marlowww leaves the island to enter the tomb. Days go by, and Parrot thinks enough time has passed, so they go and unlock the door to the tomb. 

Once inside, a huge elevator leads them down to what appears to be a huge maze. Parrot and Theo wander around until the darkness effect hits them. Knowing that Marlowww appears whenever the darkness effect is given, Theo tells Parrot to run. Theo says he'll do his best to fend off Marlowww. Parrot hides for a bit and comes back to the fighting grounds, with no trace of Theo anywhere. Parrot had a choice to either leave empty-handed, or try and find Theo, knowing he could still be alive, so he keeps going. Parrot finds a chest with all of Theo's loot and a sign written by Marlowww saying if Parrot keeps going, he'd end up dead like Theo. Parrot decides to keep going, and eventually makes it to the end of the maze, which leads to a massive cave with two invisible diamond trim statues in front of the door leading to the stash. Parrot walks closer to the door, and the darkness effect kicks in. Parrot flies away before the darkness wears off and before he's confronted by Marlowww. He stumbles into another part of the cave and explores further down. At the end, he finds what appears to be Marlowww's secret base. Marlowww has bookshelves full of books, using them to journal what happens day by day, and Parrot reads through them. The books show that Marlowww's best friend joined the Mafia and that Marlowww joined herself to protect her friend, the stash is set to kill any remaining Mafia members if any items were taken from it, and that Marlowww was never a monster, but only appearing to be one in order to protect her friend and anybody else. The last one reveals that Marlowww didn't kill Theo because he reminded her too much of her best friend, the two would protect their friends with their life. Parrot puts the book back, and turns around to see Marlowww. He realizes Marlowww isn't even and is only doing what's best to protect other players. Marlowww pulls a hidden lever that reveals the remaining ender pearl stasis chambers, then she walks away. Parrot apologizes and walks to the front of the door where the stash is located. He enters it, going down another big cave, and another door at the end of it awaits. He walks right through and finds the stash. There are tons of rooms, each built for specific resources. Parrot looks around, only to take nothing. 

He comes back up and reunites with Theo and gives all his items back. The two begin to head back, Marlowww watches them from the island and goes back to being invisible. Theo asks if Parrot found the tomb and how much he took, and Parrot said he took nothing and that he was wrong about Marlowww and everybody else. Parrot says he's done hunting treasure and that he doesn't know what to do after. He asks if Theo would come with him once he figures it out, and Theo happily agrees.

FlameFrags
, also known as 
Flame
, is one of the four main protagonists of 
Unstable Universe
 alongside 
ParrotX2
, 
SpokeIsHere
, and 
Wemmbu
. He was formerly one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside 
PrinceZam
) during 
Season 1
, being a high-ranking guard for the 
Zam Empire
, one of the formal archenemies of Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
. He was the most recent one to be added to the protagonists, uploading his own perspective only since the beginning of 
Season 2
. He was also a diamond tier 
Mafia
 member who refused to hold a mace due to a strong code of honor he abides by. 



Personality


Flame is a highly skilled and combat-focused player whose personality has largely centered around his pride in his fighting skills and fortitude. He has demonstrated capabilities to endure long fights and shows resilience and resourcefulness even in the face of impossible odds.  Thus, he's earned himself the title of being called The Immortal Demon. 

He can be condescending towards lower-skilled players, reflecting a confident attitude towards PvP. His self-worth is deeply intertwined with his title, causing him to stubbornly defend his reputation and taking on difficult challenges and fighting strong opponents in a constant battle to prove himself.  

He has shown great care for his friend, 
Lomedy
. Going great lengths to save him and their relationship. Flame struggles to show his emotions outside of battle and will sometimes prioritize a fight over personal relationships. He seems to be afraid of letting others get too close and then losing them.  

Flame loves dogs and builds 
machines
 to unleash their combat power.  



Gear




Relationships


Lomedy


Flame met Lomedy during his Solo Players arc when he was being hunted down by a toxic Minecraft civilization. After fighting some of their men, he began looking for resources and found Lomedy’s farm. He decided to use the farm as a base for resources, despite Lomedy’s refusal. While their relationship was rocky at first, Flame defended his farm and ended up receiving Lomedy’s trust, when the farmer gifted Flame his old teammate’s mace to fight the toxic players. After defeating the civilization, Flame returned the mace and left the farm.

Over the course of the server, the two would help each other out with various missions. Flame assisted Lomedy in the Farm War, and Flame tried to help Lomedy after his mace was stolen.

When 
The Law
 was hunting down Flame, they captured Lomedy and held him in prison to use as leverage against Flame. When Flame broke into the Law prison to free Lomedy, he refused to leave. He did not like that Flame was killing players and being needlessly cruel. It wasn’t until Flame defeated the Law and apologized to Lomedy that he left with Flame.

After the Law, Flame and Lomedy created a base in the mesa to live in together.



Wemmbu


When Flame worked under 
PrinceZam
, he was ordered to pretend to betray the Empire and attack Wemmbu. He raided his kingdom multiple times.

When Flame was in the 
Invisible Mafia
, he kidnapped Wemmbu’s best friend, 
Eggchan
, and took his mace.

Wemmbu fought Flame at his base. Flame won the battle and showed Wemmbu around his base.

Flame participated in a PVP tournament that Wemmbu also competed in. They taunted each other throughout and fought each other in the finals where Flame won.

Flame frees his friend, 
Jaden
, from an underground civilization. When Jaden reveals it was Wemmbu who trapped him, he worked together with a few other players, 
The Avengers
, to hunt him down in the 
Far Lands
. Flame tricked one of the players, 
Sharpness
, to give him a mace that he had stolen from Wemmbu. Flame betrays the Avengers and returns Wemmbu’s mace.

After being ordered by 
Spoke
, Flame goes to an abandoned mafia outpost where he finds Wemmbu. Wemmbu fights him using orbital strike canons, defeating him and making him run from the fight. Flame vowed to get revenge.

Someone tells Flame that Wemmbu had died, but he did not believe it. He hunted down Wemmbu, protecting 
Boosfer
 who claimed to know where he was. He hunted down 
ClownPierce
 in the nether after being falsely told that he had killed Wemmbu, and eventually the teamed up with 
Parrot
 to unveil the Invisible Knight who they suspected to be Wemmbu. They trapped an Ender Pearl canon and revealed Wemmbu’s identity using dogs, with Flame insisting they have a rematch for the unfair fight they had previously. Wemmbu agreed, but they were interrupted by The Law.

The two put their fight on hold to hunt down the Law. They fought the Law’s army of 1000 players together. Afterwards, they fought once more, where Wemmbu gives up and tells Flame that he can be the Strongest Player.

Flame found out that Wemmbu had been imprisoned by the Law, and he was exiled from the server.

Flame and Wemmbu team up once again to fight The Law, along with Spoke and Parrot. They succeeded, but Flame attacked Wemmbu’s friend, Jaden, for stealing Lomedy’s mace. Wemmbu protected him.



ManePear


The two both worked under PrinceZam together in the 
Zam Empire
. However, ManePear betrayed the empire, which caused them to fight and seperate.

When Flame joined the 
Invis Mafia
, Mane fought against them. Wemmbu told Mane that he had fought a diamond player who did not use a mace, who Mane figured out was Flame. Mane managed to hunt down Flame and they fought, but Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
 interrupted the fight, causing Flame to flee. Mane tried to find him again, but Wemmbu didn’t tell him where he was.

When Flame was exiled from Unstable by the law, he sought out the masters of every weapon in order to become a master of Minecraft combat. For the spear, he found ManePear, who was living in a cave far away from the rest of the server. Mane trains Flame in exchange for Flame’s help at killing a group of players that had been annoying Mane.

When Flame was captured by the Law, Mane invaded the prison to rescue him, going against his former “lone wolf” persona.

title: FlameFrags/History
content:

"
This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.


"

"
This article is unfinished or outdated by new episode info. You can help Unstable Universe Wiki by 
expanding it
.
Additional Notes: Page is missing information on every video since 
SOLO Player VS Minecraft's Deadliest Faction




History


Season 1


The PrinceZam Empire Arc


FlameFrags is seen guarding a castle in the 
Zam Empire
.

ManePear
, 
Sorhin
, and Flame attack Wemmbu and 
JamatoP
 in the latter's base, asking if they know anything about SpokeIsHere. After a short clash, they agree to take Wemmbu to the Zam Empire.

Flame is sent by PrinceZam to pretend to betray the Zam Empire and kill Wemmbu. Flame fails to kill Wemmbu due to a TnT minecart trap pulled off by him and his friend eggchan.

Wemmbu sees that Flame and Merffinn are trying to invade 
Roshambo’s Civilization
. Flame nearly kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges Flame to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in Roshambo's Civilization to evacuate, and then escapes using a stasis chamber.

The Zam Empire destroys 
Wemmbu's Civilization
. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box while Flame and ManePear fight, with the former being indignant over the idea of a traitor keeping the armor of the empire after Mane betrayed them to work with Wemmbu.



The Invisible Mafia Arc


After the Zam Empire falls, Flame joins 
The Invisible Mafia
 as a diamond player. He threatens to kill eggchan unless Wemmbu gives him a 
mace
. After successfully winning their duel utilizing slow falling and his superior skill in sword PvP, he gives the mace to 
ClownPierce
.

Flame kills 
Dimofyy
 after trapping Parrot and a few members of the 
Warriors District
.



Season 2


The Toxic War Arc


After the mafia falls, he retreats to live by himself in a base he constructed, but is constantly harassed by bandits. Three players try to trap him at his base but fail. He kills all of the players. A team of players including SpokeIsHere try to kill him. Flame finds one of the bandits' base, kills them, and steals their netherite sword.

A team of players try to steal from Flame despite 
TheobaldTheBird
, their leader, telling them not to. Flame kills them. Flame travels to 
Merchant City
 to trade for gear. While he is leaving, a team of players from 
Bounty Assassin Team
 try to kill him. They fail to kill him and run away.

Wemmbu tries to kill Flame at his base at spawn. They eventually stop fighting. Spoke and a team of players try to kill Flame again but fail.

A team of players destroy Flame's base. Flame kills most of the players, but one of the members of the team escapes. The team finds him again and manage to steal his netherite sword. FlameFrags is able to kill them by splashing a strength potion and using his fist. FlameFrags finds two of the members of the team at his camp, who mention a player named 
Razor
. FlameFrags kills them both. He picks up a lodestone compass from one of the players and follows it to a base.

Flame finds the leader of the team, Razor2gud, and tries to kill him. Razor says that he'll only fight him if FlameFrags uses worse items, such as not using netherite armor, weapons, and strength potions. Flame agrees to this, only for Razor to have his team try to kill Flame. Flame is able to kill all of them except for Razor, who escapes.

Flame finds a map showing the locations of every base owned by the team. He goes to a bunker to try and get materials for destroying more bases, and kills everyone there. Flame finds a team of players in diamond armor, including Razor. Flame kills their entire team except for Razor, who runs away again. While destroying the base they fought in, Flame finds another lodestone compass in a hidden barrel that supposedly leads to Razor's base.

Flame continues destroying bases. After destroying all of them, he goes to Razor's base. Flame and Razor agree to have a fair 1v1. They set up a trap to try and kill Flame, but it fails to kill him. FlameFrags kills every player, including Razor.

Flame's dog, 
Ashen
, gets kidnapped by the same team.

Flame kills everyone in his team before fighting 
T0X1N
. T0X1N starts losing the fight and threatens to kill Ashen. He gives Flame instructions, which are intended to kill him. However, Flame smuggled a bundle with a wind charge and manages to survive using the wind charge. Right as T0X1N is about to kill Ashen, Flame kills him.

More players attempt to kill FlameFrags but fail. 

FlameFrags looks for a base to stay in and he meets 
Lomedy
. Players try to kill FlameFrags but fail. 



The Betrayal Arc


Flame joins a PvP tournament. FlameFrags is just barely able to win the tournament.

Flame learns that his friend 
Jaden_MAN
 has gone missing, and asks several players about his whereabouts, including 
Spongs
, CookieBunsquat, and LettuceK. He finds Lettuce's answer to be incredibly suspicious and vague, deciding to trail him back to his base while invisible. Once there, he sees a signboard of targets with Jaden's name listed under 'captured.' He later returns and attempts to kill them, but fails. He comes back with invisibility, and secretly listens in on their conversation.

FlameFrags goes to Leowook's base with the intent of learning his cart PvP strategies, but finds it blown up and abandoned. He sees Leo amongst the rubble, and signs a deal with Leo for an IOU and a stack of experience bottles in exchange for lessons. A few days later, he arrives at an auction held by 
the Law
. LettuceK is able to escape.

Returning to Leo, they make another deal for another stack where Leo pretends to be captured by the Law so Flame can find out where Jaden is being kept. It doesn't go to plan, with the Law pausing to inventory check Leo, so the two of them team up to fight against the Law. They escape using a pearl cannon, but he follows them to an island and chases them down to the 
Abandoned Civilization
 where Jaden was trapped by Wemmbu. He finds Jaden after searching the civilization, and they reunite.

After Jaden is free, Jaden asks Flame to kill Wemmbu, and Flame agrees to do so. Together, they recruit a team with people whom disliked Wemmbu, named 
The Avengers


They learned from 
4CVIT
 that Wemmbu was chasing after Conexion, one of their common enemies, in the Farlands. Before going, he and Jaden set up stasis chambers so they could return easily. They find Wemmbu in the farlands and attempt to kill him, but fail.

The team begins to argue again, and splits up to cover more ground. While journeying, they find Sharpness again. Flame fights Sharpness to try to obtain his mace. Sharpness hides it in his ender chest as leverage, and Jaden comes over, convincing him to join the team. FlameFrags tricks 
Conexion
 into thinking he can duplicate the mace that Conexion has, so Conexion gives Flame the mace, and Flame then leaves.

The Avengers attempt to kill Wemmbu but fail, as FlameFrags decides to betray the team, and eventually gives the mace back to Wemmbu. FlameFrags' ender pearl stasis chamber is pearled one week after, into a void trap. His quick reaction time allows him to place a block in the trap, saving his life. He is able to escape the trap. Jaden asks FlameFrags for full netherite armor, so Flame makes it his goal to get him netherite armor. Lettuce tries to kill FlameFrags again, but fails. Flame gives Jaden a netherite helmet which he got from one of the players trying to kill him.

Jaden and Flame rob a town, and Jaden gets a pair of netherite leggings. The Law attacks Flame and Jaden. Jaden doesn't help with the fight. Flame is able to escape, and meets back up with Jaden, angry that he didn't help. Flame and Jaden go to the Law's base to try and kill them. Jaden betrays Flame, leaving him to die. Flame is able to escape.

Jaden offers Flame to join the 
Pirates
, which he declines. Jaden tries to kill Flame with his pirates, but fails.Before hunting down Jaden, Flame realizes he needs a place to re-gear after battle. He asks Lomedy to help him rebuild the base, who now has two maces. They work together to fix the terrain, walls, and base itself. While they are doing this, Jaden watches them from a nearby hill and attacks Lomedy as he's leaving. Jaden steals Lomedy's mace using pots, so Flame begins to try to kill Jaden.

Flame is winning the fight until it starts to rain, allowing Jaden to trident-mace him from above. Flame hides in a shallow cave while Jaden taunts him from outside it. Jaden gives him a lodestone compass to the new pirate islands before leaving. 

FlameFrags and Jaden fight. 



Skill vs Power Arc


FlameFrags and Lomedy participate in the "farm war", in which he was not allowed to use weapons, and could only use netherite armor. Using traps, FlameFrags is able to kill some players. FlameFrags also kills players using a diamond hoe, which Lomedy dislikes. Flame and Lomedy destroy the raiders base. 

Spoke tricks Flame into doing things for him, and also tells him to go to an old Mafia stash. Once there, Flame finds Wemmbu, who tries to kill him. Flame is forced to run due to Wemmbu using maces and orbital strike cannons. Flame's signature chest plate is broken. 

Multiple players attempt to kill FlameFrags but fail. Flame creates a machine which can summon a large amount of dogs by using a fishing rod.

Flame is told that Wemmbu died. Flame begins looking for 
Luke4472
, who supposedly knows about Wemmbu. Flame and The_CodMaster421 begin trying to find Luke. They eventually find Luke4472, and they discover that Luke heard about Wemmbu dying from MinuteTech.

Flame and MinuteTech fight due to him not explaining where Wemmbu is. Minute escapes using the outer end islands.

Boosfer claims to know what happened to Wemmbu. He gives a proposition, saying that he will tell him the information if Flame works for Boosfer. He agrees. Flame finds an invisible player, known as the Invisible Knight, who is secretly Wemmbu.

Flame returns to his base to see Boosfer under attack by the invisible player leading a crew of players. The Invisible Knight advises them to run, but they don't listen and die. 

Boosfer asks Flame to retrieve him 
ParrotX2
's helmet and potion stash. He approaches Parrot, who is annoyed to see him and mocks him for being bossed around by Boosfer, calling him a henchman. Flame takes the stuff and leaves. Boosfer still refuses to give information on Wemmbu.

He and Flame create an escape tunnel in his base together under the jukebox that ends in a nether portal. After they're done, the Invisible Knight arrives at his base once again, who attacks Boosfer, until Boosfer promises to tell Flame about Wemmbu if he kills the Invisible Knight. The player leads him to a desert void trap that Flame nearly falls into, but he and Boosfer manage to survive. The remaining people of Capital City's force who created the trap fight Flame and Boosfer. Flame wins the fight, with all but the Invisible Knight and 
Salvationism
 dead.

The Invisible Knight begins speaking to Flame, saying that Boosfer has no evidence that he knows where 
Wemmbu
 is. He convinces him to begin to distrust Boosfer, and Flame attacks Boosfer. Boosfer manages to escape through the escape tunnel they made before. When they're chasing him through it, he says that ClownPierce killed Wemmbu and then goes through the nether portal. 

Flames ventures into the nether, looking for ClownPierces's Castle but encounter a hiding ParrotX2 and TheoBladTheBird, attacking them thinking they were guards, but stopped because they planned to rob Clown's vault. They worked together with parrot promising Flames that he could get his fight with Clown. They stormed Clown's Castle and looked for FerreMC, which knows where the vault is, attacked and kidnapped him with Clown and his guards unsuccessfully preventing them from kidnapping Ferre. They interrogated Ferre and Parrot give him a elytra to fly to get loots, but putting a tracker on him too, tracking where he will go (the vault) and follow after him. 

Parrot and Theobald talked about Flame being a bad person and doesn't deserve to have a chance of fighting Clown, Flame hearing all of this, mine his way through and looked for Clown's Castle, Flame demand to know where Wemmbu is but ClownPierce will only tell if Flame can offer them something, in which Flame leaked where Parrot and Theo is, leading them to finding and capturing them. 

Flames wanted to know what happen to Wemmbu but Clown said he knew nothing since he stayed in the Nether, which angers Flame and he attacked Clown's army, taking on all Clown's elite guards all while Clown looked for Parrot, Theo went missing. After killing all of Clown's guards, Flame went back to the over world. 

Flame then encounters LettuceK, in which he told Flame that they built a new base near Flame's base, Lettuce gives Flame a tour of their new base and meets Deputy_Ace, a law commander. Lettuce then decided to ask them to stay in prison, in which Flame refuses. Lettuce gives Flame alongside Wemmbu, three days to prepare and face Lettuce's new army, having over 1,000 players. 

Flame and Wemmbu encounter the 1000 players and Lettuce. Flame and Wemmbu eventually kill all 1000 players except Lettuce, but Flame fights Wemmbu to finally see who the strongest player on the server is. Flame won this fight leaving Wemmbu and Lettuce behind. 



The Kings Arc


This arc is concurrent to 
The BAT Arc
.


Flamefrags returns to his base, finding it to be griefed by the Lawmen. He enters his base just to find his walls covered in the Law's colors, he hears a goat horn and turns. Opposite of him is 
LettuceK
, the same person who exiled him, the same person who had terrorized him for months on end. Lettuce tells Flame to calm down, saying that its only him and that he wants to talk because they had a history for one last time. Flame reluctantly agrees but holds out a double totem, LettuceK questions if Flame really thinks that he's in the right, Flame hesitates before answering saying that he doubts that it matter and that he himself thinks that Lettuce isn't in the right to which Lettuce replies with that he knows, LettuceK asks Flame if he really doesn't think that Lettuce knows what type of leader he has become? 

Lettuce continues, going on a rant about how Flame, Wemmbu and others like them have always disturbed the peace, He then says that if he (lettuce) has to go down in history as a ruthless leader then so be it. As long as Flame and Wemmbu were banned from the server, he believed that his actions were justifiable. He claimed that the actions the actions he made were for the betterment of the server. He said that he wishes that Flame would take account for his actions, not just for Lettuce but for the massacre players. Lettuce blames Flamefrags for everything, if this didn't happen, if Flame could take accountibility for all of his actions of killing 1000 players. If Flame hadn’t done this, then 
Jaden Man
 wouldn't have been freed, then 
Lomedy
 wouldn't be held captive. Lettuce tells that he is giving Flame a chance to turn around and leave to let Lettuce do his job as becoming king. 

Flamefrags refuses, going for an attack on Lettuce who starts to run away. LettuceK leaves after realizing that theres no convincing Flame, Flame watches him leave before going into a secret part of his base. In the secret section, he finds his wolf army, who luckily were still alive. 

Flamefrags gets ready to storm the Law prison, wanting to save his best friend Lomedy. But right as Flame prepared his inventory, Wemmbu appears. Flame is asks why Wemmbu was there to which Wemmbu ignores him and asks if he has seen Eggchan. The two start to bicker until calming down and Wemmbu offers to work together to free their friends.  

The two attack the Law base and quickly vanquish the netherite/diamond players, teasing 
SargeLaw
 for killing his own army in the process. After killing at the players they head for the prison building, Wemmbu asks flame if lomedy actually wants to be freed, and flame replies with a no. Before going down, Wemmbu snags a few of flame’s items and Flame calls him greedy. Eventually Flamefrags goes down tells wemmbu to gaurd abovr.  

While going through the halls of the prison, Flame kills everyone in his way while going to Lomedy. He arrives in a corridor to hear 
Prince Zam
 letting everyone free alongside 
Spokeishere
 and 
Jumperwho
. Flame uses his dogs help him, while being assisted by Spoke. The battle continues with the small group of attackers banning the law employees. 

The fight ends and Flamefrags goes to Lomedy, telling him that it's time to escape. Lomedy refuses, asking if Flamefrags is crazy and actually thinks that Lomedy would break the law. The peacefull moment fleeing the second Lomedy said that. Flamefrags laughs, thinking that Lomedy is joking, asking Lomedy to come with him. Lomedy starts yelling, questioning why he should trust Flame, he starts to list reason after reason; Flamefrags stole his mace, got his farm destroyed and still continues to fight the Law as if they were in the wrong. Flamefrags starts to get desperate, asking Lomedy to reconsider and come with him but Lomedy keeps saying no, reciting that he doesn't trust Flame. 

Flamefrags wonders why Lomedy doesn't trust him because he broke into prison for him, then he asks what Lomedy's sentence is to which Lomedy replies with months. Flame still tries to convince Lomedy to leave but Lomedy doesn't listen, Lomedy keeps asking why he should trust Flame, asking Flamefrags why he would trust someone who wasn't willing to change, why he should trust someone who fighting the Law. Flamefrags questions if Lomedy is serious, Lomedy states that the only reason he would leave is if the Law lets him go. 

Lomedy asks for his mace back, the one Flame supposedly stole when running from the Law. Flamefrags lies and tells Lomedy that he still needs the mace. Flamefrags starts to leave, walking up the destroyed staircase with Lomedy's yelling chasing him, he yells at Flame that he's now friends with a thief. Flamefrags jumps back down from the small bridge and starts to walk away, leaving his friend behind. 

On the way up Flamefrags decided to not hold back anymore, if he wanted Lomedy to be free then he had to take down the Law once and for all. He arrives on the surface to find an army of the Law standing ready. Flamefrags starts to fight using the mace, a mace that isn't his. 

The fight stretches with Zam trying to order everyone around and Flamefrags laughing about it, it was like the old days in Zam's words. Flamefrags is able to spot Jaden and is surprised to see him. Flame goes to attack Jaden wanting Lomedy's mace back. Jaden disappears into the crowd and Flame continues to attack everyone, Spoke tries to stop Flame from killing his members but Flamefrags doesn't care. The battle continues with only LettuceK and SargeLaw and a few Lawmen remaining. They kill off the rest just to discover that LettuceK had fled. Wemmbu unleashes an orbital strike cannon for free and kills one of Flame's dogs resulting in Flame attacking him. Flame and Wemmbu continue to mess around until Spoke speaks. 

Spoke asks everyone if they had seen Parrot, since nobody really knew where Parrot went, they think that they need to recruit chungies to fight in the war against the Law. Spoke and everyone headed to Spoke's "secret base", in which was a castle in plain sight, after entering Spoke's castle. 

In the base they enter a small sandstone house where the rest of the team is, like 
MinuteTech
 who questions why Flamefrags was there. Flame is in high alert and very suspicious of Spoke's base in which he held out totem in case the entire place exploded even after Spoke assure him that it was very much safe, he still have a slight suspicion, this continues throughout the entire discussion. The team moves from the sandstone house and into the castle for better discussion. Spoke tries to start a speech about that they aren't on the best terms but fails with Wemmbu laughing at him. 

Minute places down some shulkers from his enderchest with loot for the team, to which Flame takes the entire shulker and Wemmbu following up and doing the same. After settling the matter of gear they continue, with Flame questioning why he's here. Spoke explains the plan of needing people to defeat the Law, the answer causes Wemmbu to ask why they needed to go 60,000 blocks out to the castle and he suggests him and Flame going to defeat Law again since it all started with them defeating the 1000 players. Spoke shuts it down quickly saying that they didn't defeat the Law completely. 

One of JumperWho's spies walked in and give her a book, which lead to a Law's stashes of items useful for the war, and its also said that a large group of Law's chungies are also heading there, hinting that Parrot might be there too. Wemmbu asks why they don't just go to Northern Council and decimate the Law. Spoke ignores him. With the discussion continuing Flame got bored and asked Wemmbu if he wanted to leave with a sign. Wemmbu doesn't respond and the team starts to argue about Parrot, asking why they need him in the first place. 

Spoke questioned Wemmbu and Flame intention on what they are gonna do after killing LettuceK, Wemmbu said that he will "Ride off into the sunset and uhh I don't know", after asking Flame the same question, Flame said that he will get all the aura to which the team falls silent, get patted on the head by everyone and then slime off Jaden.

After Flame said that he wanted to slime out Jaden, everyone gasped and Wemmbu stepped in to defend his friend. Flame get real aggressive and hitting Jaden with wind charges, Flame continues and insults Jaden. Flame continues to demand Lomedy's mace back, he starts to get very upset and attacks Jaden with the mace. Everyone else tried to stop Flame but Flame doesn't listen and pots up, Wemmbu see this as an attack and uses a stab shot. They continue to fight until MinuteTech is able to split them up.

Flamefrags tries to attack Jaden but is swiftly stopped by Minute. Wemmbu starts a rant on that 
JumperWho
 was lying about no knowing Jaden since she disappeard from his base and popped back up by the prison to which Flamefrags jumps in with that Jumper was affiliated with 
BAT
. Jumper said that she isn't affiliated with Leo or BAT anymore, Wemmbu asked for rockets again and Flame being Flame, took it and they started chasing, Flame got trapped in a dead end and Wemmbu blew a second hole into Spoke's house then Flame threw it down the house and made Wemmbu fetch it. After Jumper read the location Wemmbu set off to do it himself. 

Flamefrags leaves and uses his riptide trident to get there. When he arrives he finds Parrot and the other protagonists already fighting. The fight continues with Flame and Wemmbu arguing about kills and overall getting in each others way. After the battle ends Flamefrags moves to get back to his team and steals one of Theo's enderchests on the way, infuriating Theo with Flame laughing at him. 

Flame starts to troll the protagonists using a voice changer with Parrot getting annoyed. Wemmbu was trying to cover for him until Parrot found Flamefrags. After that they return to the castle to meet up with the rest. After talking for a bit they decide to head for the 
District 13
 where Parrot's own army is. Wemmbu flies off into the distance as first. 

They enter the base and look around before Wemmbu returns with 
EggChan
. Flame rushes to greet them then Wemmbu and him start to beat each other up, Wemmbu unleashes an orbital strike and blows a hole in the ground. They laugh about it with EggChan asking why Wemmbu would do that. Returning back to where the rest are and Parrot decides to have a speech. In the speech, Parrot names up all the things the Law had did to them, from Flame being exiled to Parrot being tricked. 

After the speech the team head for the Northern Council for a fight. The team heads out of District 13 with minor casualties like Parrot and 
Mapicc
 falling into the hole Wemmbu created. When trying to go through the door they notice more of Wemmbu's destruction like the breaking of the redstone honey and slime wall. Ignoring the casulaties they leave for the Northern Council. 

The battle starts with Wemmbu dropping 3 orbitals and the rest of the team charges, Flamefrags decided to use the mace and spear, the spear to get close to enemies and the mace for damage. The battle continues with Flame and Wemmbu fighting for kills but besides that goes smoothly, they are able to vanquish all the players. They head for the Council and finds 
LettuceK
 and the Elites on top. 

Lettuce asks them if they think he's really that stupid. The team turn around and sees netherite players climbing over the walls, hundreds of them. While the amount of players is comparable to the diamond team the armor and gear isn't. Still the team are able to kill some of them, slowly but surely the numbers of the netherite players start to dwindle. Wemmbu continues to drop orbitals with the team freaking out. Flame and Wemmbu also continue to argue about kills again. Flame leaves to restock with Zam and Wemmbu joins them, netherite players storm them and Wemmbu uses another orbital to kill them off. 

After the restock Flame and Wemmbu decide to dual mace to kill off the netherite players faster but they eventually get split up. Flame gets into a fight with 
Purpled
 and the 
G0dofWar
. When nobody shows up Flame starts to get worried that he got betrayed once again. Being able to escape the battle Flame meets up with Wemmbu and Theo to fight. Flame finds Minute for a restock. 

The battle ends with the team coming out victorious, sadly LettuceK had run away. Wemmbu returns from chasing Lettuce with the news that he escaped. Flamefrags rethinks about what happened, with Lettuce being able to escape, they weren't successfull in stopping the Law and Lomedy would still be held captive. Deciding to do something for Lomedy, Flamefrags aimed for an attack on Jaden, attempting to get his friends mace back. Inmeddiatly, Wemmbu and MinuteTech jump to stop Flame from killing Jaden. 

Flamefrags and Wemmbu start to fight with Wemmbu defending Jaden from being slaughtered, they argue about Flame wanting his mace back. They continue to fight with Eggchan encouraging them. Flamefrags stops attacking Wemmbu and goes for Jaden, asking for his mace back. Jaden laughs and mocks him questioning what use does Lomedy have with the mace. Theo tries to stop them but Flame doesn't care, shooting back asking what Theo would do if Parrot's mace was stolen? 

The fight between Flame and Wemmbu ends with Flame falling into a pit and Wemmbu laughing at him. They both listen to the rest of the team and turn to see Lettuce by the gate. They bring Lettuce inside for voting, either they kill him or they keep him alive. Flamefrags wants to kill him but isn't able to. Flamefrags starts to get upset with Wemmbu, to him it was Wemmbu who chose to save him. Flame was likely hoping that Wemmbu would choose to kill him. 

They start to move again, Flamefrags continues to ask Parrot if they can kill him with Parrot ignoring him. Right before the staircase they stop, Parrot announces that he wants to continue the election which causes an uproar in the team. Wemmbu states that most of the server likely doesn't now what happened and would pick LettuceK to win. Lettuce stops them all, saying that its too late. Lettuce says that he tried to warn Parrot, not explaining for what. Flamefrags jumps at the chance to kill him, twisting Lettuce's words into that he wants to die to which Parrot shuts him down. Wemmbu asks why they need to change the server so badly, Flame agrees and asks Parrot the same. 

Parrot replies saying that before LettuceK came to power, didn't Flame rob innocent players for gear. Flame hesitates but agrees, knowing its true. Parrot continues to interrogate Flame, asking if he asked if he wanted Flame dead, would Flame be mad? Of course Flame responds with that most of the players wanted him dead at some point in time, Parrot continues questioning why Flame would then have the right to choose if Lettuce should live or not to which Flame replies with that they had all put in effort to defeat the Law. Parrot doesn't listen and continues to throw accusations, that the situation wouldn't have escalated so badly if Flame didn't do what he did. Flame falls silent and admits that he understands Parrot's point of view. After this altercation, Flame doesn't speak again. (In the scene) 

They continue into the discussion room of the Council and lock Lettuce up in an obsidian box. Parrot and Wemmbu leave with Flamefrags standing by the cell and Theo by the doorway. 

When the other two leave, Lettuce and Flame start to talk, for one last time. Lettuce chuckles when rethinking old memories, how the entire thing started with Flame. He continues, talking about 
Deputy_Ace's
 death, how his army is scattered, how he has fallen from the power. Lettuce asks Flamefrags to prove him wrong, that Flame can change, to not let every horrible thing he has done be in vain. Flame doesn't speak, only a slight hum before leaving the room, rethinking the conversation they had in the beginning, remembering what Lomemdy had said, remembering Parrot's words. In the doorway he stops, turning back to Lettuce and promising to think about it, then he leaves. 

Flamefrags goes outside to find Parrot and they start to talk after a few moments of silence. Parrot asks Flame where he's going and Flame says that he's going to find an old friend. Before Flame leaves, Parrot wishes him goodluck. 

After walking over the highway, Flamefrags heads for the Law headquarters to save Lomedy. He spots Lomedy standing on top of the destroyed pathway, Flamefrags tries to speak but Lomedy runs away. Flame calls him back and Lomedy stops, waiting to listen to what Flame has to say. Flame explains how the Law was gone, that they were all killed. This annoys Lomedy into walking away again with Flame stopping him again. He starts to talk, saying that Lomedy was right, that Flame had heard it again and again and it started to wear him down. Flame continues, apologizing for everything, for getting Lomedy into the situation, for the destruction of the farm, for the robbing of the mace. Then he places down an enderchest and drops the mace, surprising Lomedy. Flame continues to talk, explaining that he wants to change while most of his goals include conflict, he would try to stop as much as possible. 

Flame starts to walk away, accepting Lomedy's distrust and says farewell. While walking away, he is attacked by a mace and looks up to see Lomedy holding the mace. Flame is startled and asks Lomedy what he's doing, Lomedy laughs and says that he'll forgive Flame as long as he promises to change. Flame quickly promises, happy to have his friend back. They walk out of the headquarters, laughing about the earlier attack and Lomedy clarifying he needed to get his revenge somehow. They walk over the bridge, talking about how they need to get the copper armor to break before Lomedy playfully attacks him. The camera pans away as the two playfully fight and leave the ruined LAW base together. 



Season 3


The Kingdoms Arc
