, and I'm going to break him out.





I Broke into Minecraft's Most Secure Prison
 is the 7th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts off with 
ParrotX2
 and 
rekrap2
 breaking into the first prison, a purple hurricane-shaped prison. They splash themselves with an invis potion and ender pearl in, getting through the bubble column and sign maze defense before the guards start investigating the prison. They discover the break in and find the duo in the lava defense, so Parrot and Rekrap chorus fruit out, digging away and escaping from the prison. 

In a voice over, Parrot explains that in the center of the prison is a 
chunk ban
, an area in which if you step in, you are banned off of the server. A few days ago, one of Parrot’s best friends, 
Wifies
, stepped into one. Before he could free Wifies, 
SpokeIsHere
, one of the most wanted players on this server, stepped into the chunk ban as well. The construction of a prison was ordered to keep Spoke banned forever. But even though it seemed impossible, Parrot was going to break Wifies out. 

To be able to break Wifies out, Parrot and Rekrap would have to assemble a team of players to help break him out, which was why they were going to the smaller prisons to break Spoke’s former underlings, who were also trapped in chunk bans, out. Parrot would be responsible for building a TNT cannon that would destroy the chunk ban, while Rekrap would distract the guards, 
Merffinn
, 
yungwillx
, and 
woogiex
. 

The second prison was an end prison with a network of islands connected by flying machines. Parrot and Rekrap invis and attempt to make it to the prison undercover by the flying machines, but the guards spot Rekrap, so Parrot takes the chance to elytra in. However, his attempt to build the TNT cannon catches the guards’ attention, and after multiple failed tries, he and Rekrap decide to dip and lead the guards on a big chase before finally getting away. 


Parrot and Rekrap decide to head to the 
Zam Empire
 to negotiate a deal with 
PrinceZam
, the player that ordered the construction of the prisons. Parrot asks him to lift the ban for sixty seconds, but PrinceZam declines. Parrot then tells him that he and Rekrap are going to break out out Wifies, but PrinceZam laughs and says that the new technology (atom grid, auto piglin banners, and sculk cake chunk bans) he’s implemented won’t allow it. Parrot doesn’t believe him and he and Rekrap leave the castle and reconvene at Rekrap’s base to prepare for the next prison. 

They go on a scouting mission to the next prison, a completely underwater one. They splash themselves with invis and go down to check out the prison, but realize that they can’t see anything through the water. There is one big issue to breaking into this prison, Parrot reasons. If the entire prison is underwater, then the chunk ban will also likely be encased in water. They would have to find a way to blow up the chunk ban underwater. They find a way to blow up submerged TNT using blocks of sand and spawning withers. 

Parrot and Rekrap return to the prison with all the necessary supplies needed to blow up the chunk ban. They manage to sneak into the prison’s defenses, an obsidian maze, without any guards noticing, but they quickly catch on. The guards, woogiex, 
Willsion
, and 
What_Max
 all start chasing Rekrap, and he and Parrot are separated in the chaos. Parrot finds the chunk ban, which is surrounded by a glass wall that marks the borders of the ban, but a guard finds him. They both manage to escape, regrouping a ways away from the entrance (
26:47
: gyatt). 

Heading back into the prison, they immediately are found by guards and quickly make their way to the chunk ban. Parrot then starts spawning loads of withers while Rekrap distracts the guards. Just as they predicted, after a while, one of the withers blew up the chunk ban and they make their very frantic escape. They meet back up at a nearby mountain and recruit the player freed from the chunk ban, 
Derapchu
, as the third member of their prison-breaking team.

Derapchu leads them to another prison that he knows the coords of, located in the jungle. They then head back to base to start prepping for the prison. Parrot decides that since withers were too random and that they got lucky breaking the last chunk ban, the only way to destroy the next one was with a TNT cannon. They start practicing constructing TNT cannons and eventually find a simplified design of it that the three of them combined could complete in under fifteen seconds. 

The fourth prison break begins with invis Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu sneaking into the prison. They dig into the walls and find weird redstone contraptions. The guards, Merffinn, 
Peentar
, and yungwillx, however, find evidence of the broken redstone, and realize that someone is trying to break in. Searching the floors, Parrot discovers a chunk ban at the top floor. The guards, however, find Derapchu and start chasing after him. Realizing there was no way of communicating with the rest of his team, Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to get on a phone call. Eventually, the guards start catching on to Parrot and he tells Rekrap to start blowing the chunk ban up. 

Parrot leads the guards on a big chase while Rekrap starts attempting to blow the chunk ban up. They all end up on the floor of the chunk ban and a big fight ensues (
57:17
: magical chunk ban). Parrot realizes that the only way to actually successfully build the chunk ban was to get rid of all of the guards. They attack the guards and continue fighting until all of the guards had no choice but to dip or risk getting killed. With no one to hinder the blowing up of the chunk ban, they free one of Spoke’s henchmen. However, Parrot realizes that they had freed someone who wouldn't want to join their prison-breaking team. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to head to the first prison to check what kind of defenses PrinceZam had added, but before they even came within a thousand block radius, their game immediately crashed and respawned them in a nearby taiga forest. This was one of the new technologies that Zam added to the prison holding Spoke and Wifies, a server-crashing piece of technology. Not knowing how to solve this, they leave it for now and focus on the next prison. 

The next prison is a prison situated in the nether in a volcano, so Parrot proposes a new solution to breaking the chunk bans: flying machines and TNT minecarts. They scout the prison first and instead of one or two chunk bans, there are three stacked a ways apart from each other. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu sneak into the prison, but are quickly found out. Parrot starts building a flying machine, but is caught in the act and narrowly escapes, leading the guards on a big chase and giving Rekrap and Derapchu the chance to destroy the chunk bans. Once he loses the guards, Parrot heads back to the prison and sneaks into the walls. Rekrap and Derapchu, however, are caught and engages with the guards. Parrot takes the opportunity to successfully break the middle chunk ban with a flying machine when the guards weren’t paying attention. They all get into a big fight with Merffinn, 
FlameFrags
, 
SykerMC
, 
Sorhin
, and Woogie and decide to dip and head back to base. Parrot manages to loose the guards in the wall and mines out. 

They regroup back at Rekrap’s base and decide to head to the Zam Empire to possibly swipe information about PrinceZam’s new technology. He reveals to them that that is something called a 
memory ban
, but when Parrot tries to pry more info about the memory ban, he deigns to tell them anything. Parrot also voices that many of the same guards are guarding the prisons they went to, so asks him if he cycles the guards. They meet back at base and Parrot reasons that if the guards are being cycled throughout the prisons, then there must be a way in and out that the guards take. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu head to the next prison, a snowglobe prison in the middle of a snowy taiga. They splash invis and start scouting out the snowglobe, discovering a group of drowned patrolling the top of a soul sand water elevator containing a beacon. Parrot realizes that if the chunk ban stretched all the way to the top of the snowglobe, then there was no way PrinceZam could have it covered, so the top must be safe to break in from. They dig into the wall and eventually break through into the actual prison containing the chunkban. However, the guards, Sorhin, Merffinn, and SykerMC, catch onto them, so Rekrap quickly creates a TNT distraction to occupy the guards. Parrot successfully builds and sends out a flying machine to break the chunk ban. He escapes through a ruined portal in the desert and reconvenes with everyone at the base, where another freed player is waiting for them. 

As a skilled PVPer, 
Fantst
 was a very good player to have on their side, so after a bit of convincing, Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu add Fantst to their prison-breaking team. He also knows the whereabouts of a sky prison, which they make their way to. They land on one of the surrounding islands in the sky, but don’t spot any guards. They spot the chunk ban exposed in the middle of the central castle and sneak in. However, one of the guards, Willsion, spots them and starts attacking. They exit and lure the rest of the guards, who are invis, outside. Parrot, Derapchu, and Fantst distract the guards while Rekrap destroys the chunk ban. They then engage into a big fight with 
ManePear
, Willsion, SykerMC, and SmileyyMC, but after realizing that they couldn’t win this battle, they dip. 

After meeting back up at Rekrap’s base, the prison-breaking team reflects on the previous prison and how easy it was. Fantst then says that their mission wasn’t possible, shocking everyone. He elytras over to a nearby cobblestone platform on the shore of the ocean right next to an active chunk ban. He tells Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu that what they’re doing is too risky for him, and he doesn’t want to get banned. At the last prison, he was the one tanking all the damage and carrying everyone. Leaving with that, he steps into the chunk ban without a second thought. 

Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu are downcast, as they had just gained Fantst and losing him was a big blow. Even with that loss, they have no choice but to keep breaking into prisons if they wanted to accomplish their goal. With that, they head to the next and final prison before the ultimate breakout, another end prison. 

They start sneaking into the walls, spotting the guards, 
loppezz
 and SykerMC. They eventually find the central room with the chunk ban and form a plan: Rekrap and Derapchu will distract the guards while Parrot destroys the chunk ban with TNT minecarts. The chunk ban is blown up and Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu start fighting the guards in a 3v2. Realizing that they’re outnumbered, loppezz and SykerMC dip and elytra out of the prison, leaving Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu alone there. Unfortunately, despite their easy victory, they had freed someone who had no intention of teaming with them.

While in the end, Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu decide to go to the other end prison. Upon arrival, they find one of the guards, FlameFrags, munching on pizza in real life. Seeing that he seemed to be the only guard here and was willing to let them destroy the chunk ban, they left him alone and blew up the chunk ban. However, once he was done with the pizza, he started attacking them, so after a short fight, they dip and head back to base. 

A few minutes after Parrot, Rekrap, and Derapchu return back to base, a player named 
JumperWho
 whom they had freed from the second end prison arrives. JumperWho agrees to join them, becoming the fourth member of their team. 

Parrot, Rekrap, Derapchu, and JumperWho start brainstorming ways to break out Wifies and Spoke from the final prison. The first defense they have to get past is the memory ban, which they get around by going through the nether and past the area the memory ban is placed over. After arriving at the location of the final prison, Parrot and Rekrap go ahead to scout out the prison while Derapchu and JumperWho stay back to guard the portal. Parrot and Rekrap manage to scout out a decent amount of the prison from the outside before they’re caught by the guards, so they escape and regroup with Derapchu and JumperWho to review the footage they captured (
2:39:55
: replay mode). Inside of the prison, they find many layers of chest and obsidian defenses surrounding the chunk ban, which is being held by a baby piglin, causing it to have a longer radius. On top of that, they also have to deal with the six guards patrolling the prison. 

Parrot proposes an idea to get rid of the guards: since there is a very short period of time between a player entering a chunk ban and them actually getting banned off, they could use that to their advantage to set a trap. One player would act as bait and fly into an active chunk ban, luring all six of the guards in and getting them banned. However, right before the bait flew into the chunk ban, they would message the rest of the prison-breaking team and they would pull the player’s set ender pearl stasis, which, if successful, would temporarily ban all six of the guards off of the server, giving them at least six hours before anyone logged on, as it was the middle of the night. Everyone unanimously decided on JumperWho as the bait, and surprisingly, they pulled it off, banning Merffinn, yungwillx, Peentar, SykerMC, loppezz, and ManePear off of the server. 

Parrot, Rekrap, Derapchu, and JumperWho arrive at the entrance of the prison to greet a fifth member of their prison-breaking team that Parrot invited, a professional Minecraft prison escapist called 
_Kenadian_
. They show Kenadian the footage of the prison and he devises a plan to break in. First, they build a wither borer to try and break into the obsidian. They break through the first layer of obsidian, but realize that they have to conceal their evidence, so they explode the wither borer with flying machines loaded with end crystals and TNT. After a few attempts of trial and error, Kenadian reasons that it would be very time consuming and difficult to destroy the chunk ban from the surface, so they head underground to try and break in instead. They build many TNT cannons to explode their way 144 blocks to the central piglin ban from their location. After they do that, they make a road of ancient debris and send hundreds of TNT minecarts to damage the piglin from below. After hours of testing, failure, and trying again, the ban is finally lifted. Wifies and Spoke were freed and that is how the greatest prison-breaking team broke into Minecraft’s most secure prison. 

However, the story isn’t over yet. PrinceZam placed a target and bounty over Parrot’s head for breaking into the prisons, and he is now being hunted by 
Minecraft's deadliest player
.

Far out in our server's End Dimension lies a 
city
: a safehaven for any player trying to escape. This is the story of the rise of this place, as well as the wars and corruption that caused its downfall. This is how I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization.





I Built Minecraft's Safest Civilization
 is the 16th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Parrot
 and 
Wifies
 traveled millions of blocks in the end dimension to make a civilization as they were tired of getting hunted and kidnapped by people. However they were being followed by an invisible person. Parrot and Wifies make a trap and pop the totem of the invisible person. The invisible person is revealed to be a player named 
Deanthebean9
. Dean tells them that he's going to die if anyone finds out that he isn't invisible and 
Ashswagg
 is going to kill him. Wifies tells Dean not to come back and they won't tell anyone about him being visible, however, Parrot sees this as an opportunity to recruit their first member since Dean doesn't know where to go. Parrot and Wifies lead Dean to their first hut in the civilization. Dean tells them that if you kill a high ranking player in the 
Mafia
 you can leave and Dean wanted to get out of the Mafia as fast as possible and that was why he followed them. Wifies guesses that Dean's life was in danger because he threw an ender pearl and Dean confirms his statement. Parrot and Wifies goes to the overworld to recruit more members from 
Zam Empire
 but upon arrival they notice that Zam Empire was destroyed. As they realize that Zam Empire is abandoned they decide to take all the slime blocks and other redstone materials from the balloons to build flying machines. Parrot and Wifies find a village and transport them to the end where they meet Dean again. They transport the villagers to the outer end islands where their civilization is.

While transporting the villagers, they get attacked by The Mafia again. Parrot tells Dean to go invisible so that they don't find out that Dean is against them. After escaping Parrot and Wifies find their flying machines and villagers mostly intact, one of the flying machines aren't damaged and the villager is alive while the other one is completely damaged and the villager died. Parrot heads back to the civilization paranoid that The Mafia now has an idea of where it is located so he recruits more members. He arrives to 
Wemmbu's civilization
 and finds 
Horace Altman
, Horace explains that he spent weeks building a civilization for 
Wemmbu
 and it got blown up. Parrot invites Horace to his civilization. Horace tells Parrot he will help expand the civilization along with this builders and promises it would last forever. Parrot also visits 
Kenadian
 at the chunk ban prison built by him and Zam Empire to invite him to the civilization. Parrot tells Kenadian to help transport villagers because last time they did so they were attacked by The Mafia. While Kenadian transports the villagers, Parrot finds an invisible player and distracts them by mining into the void and flying away without them realizing. After Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian transport the two villagers, they notice a huge island done by Horace. Parrot tells Horace to make the island 100 blocks lower. Parrot also makes 4 statis chambers,

Kenadian tells Parrot that stasis chambers are cross dimensional and Parrot gets worried about Dean. Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian make a plan on how to save Dean's life. Parrot goes to one of The Mafia's outposts and pops Dean's totem, Wifies distracts the invisible players and Kenadian pulls Dean's stasis chamber when Parrot tells him to do so. Dean tells Parrot his coordinates so that Parrot can fly to their outpost and he begins fighting them. He pops Dean's totem and right as Dean is about to get stasised into the void, Parrot spam messages Kenadian telling him to pull Dean's stasis. Parrot, Wifies and Kenadian celebrate Dean getting out of The Mafia. They plan on expanding the civilization however, Wifies and Kenadian log off so Parrot tells Dean to watch over his stasis chamber. Parrot goes to the overworld and breaks his bed that way he can go back to the end and arrive at spawn, however, he can't leave the end now. Parrot writes a book asking if anyone can sign up for his civilization and places it into a chest on a broken enderman farm and places a sign telling whoever reads it to go to the enderman farm. After Dean pulls Parrot's stasis chamber, Parrot tells Dean that he's about to log off but before this, Dean thanks Parrot for saving his life in the end.

The next morning, Parrot and Dean log on and fall down 100 blocks. It turns out Horace listened to his request. Parrot requests Horace to build a castle. Parrot and Dean fly to the main end island to see if anyone signed up for the civilization. They find out 
JumperWho
, 
4CVIT
 and 
Baablu
 signed up. They interview JumperWho first. Parrot invites JumperWho because he knows he can trust her because of everything they've been through, then he interviews 4CVIT. Parrot gets a bit worried because 4CVIT is wearing the Zam Empire shield however 4CVIT tells Perrot that he isn't part of Zam Empire anymore because they also chased him. 4CVIT tells Parrot that he needs more information about the civilization because he hasn't fully trusted Parrot yet and Parrot removes all of his armour and totem and tells 4C to kill him if he was sent by 
PrinceZam
 to kill him. He also makes a deal where if Parrot does invite him he will work on something else and they can ignore him. After 4C gets invited he flies away which makes Parrot a bit concerned. While Parrot interviews Baablu, Baablu tells Parrot that he can't go anywhere without it getting destroyed. Parrot invites Baablu to his civilization and tells him that there's nothing he can do to go back after he joins so he tells Baablu to get anything he still needs and asks Dean to lead him to the civilization. Parrot flies to the civilization and finds Wifies. Upon Dean and Baablu returning they warn Parrot and Wifies about invisible players 10 000 blocks away from the civilization. Parrot takes Wifies to the main end island and tells him that The Mafia tampered with spawn teleportation in the end. Wifies tests if the portal works for him and to his surprise, it does. After Parrot and Wifies return to the end civilization and the next day, Parrot and Dean find out the castle has been built along with a sign saying that they built outposts 1k-1.5k blocks away from the civilization.

Parrot and Dean fly back to the civilization and find Wifies, as they talk about the civilization they see an unexpected guest. 
Boosfer
 enters the civilization. Parrot tells Boosfer to leave but Boosfer does nothing but other Parrot about the civilization. Parrot tells Boosfer that his civilians will not be bribed by him but he tells Parrot how he found out the civilization's coordinates. Boosfer also tells Parrot he wants to become the king of the civilization. After Boosfer leaves, Parrot and Horace discuss on how they can make the civilization safer. Horace suggests that they could use chunk bans and Parrot agrees. Parrot visits Wifies in one of the outposts and Parrot writes a sign telling whoever sees the chunk ban prison to contact either him, Wifies or Dean to open the chunk ban. Upon flying back to the civilization they notice chunk bans all over the place. Horace turns off the chunk bans and Parrot and Wifies fly to the civilization. Dean returns telling them that he received a message from 
Dol9hin
 to deactivate the chunk bans. Parrot tells Dolphin to ender the island as he doesn't have much time to talk. Dolphin tells Parrot, Wifies and Dean that his friend 
What Max
 is also arriving to the civilization however Max asks Parrot if he is one of the 4 invisible guys jumping him. Parrot, Wifies and Dolphin fly to one of the towers. Parrot tells Max to follow him to an end city after they arrive to the outpost to fight the invisible players. Parrot's helmet breaks so he tells Wifies to take Dolphin and Max to the civilization while he flies away to distract the invisible players. Wifies tries to contact Parrot to help him and save him but Parrot couldn't respond since he was still getting jumped by members of The Mafia. Parrot runs out of fireworks and has to run from an invisible player. The invisible player gets distracted by endermen buying Parrot time to leave. Parrot tells WIfies his coordinates and Wifies gives Parrot rockets and invisibility. 

After going back to the civilization, Parrot tells Dolphin and Max about the election for king and both Dolphin and Max tell Parrot that they will vote for him. Parrot, Wifies, Horace and Dean work on the civilization over the course of the next few hours and Parrot works on a garden before logging off. The next day, Parrot notices the castle's interior has been finished along with a village. Wifies tells Parrot that he noticed a crater while he was at recon with Dean. He leads Parrot to where the crater was. After this, Parrot tells Wifies he still needs to find a way to get back to the overworld and goes to the main end island until they find Boosfer. They talk about the elections and Parrot tells Boosfer that he's confident in winning the election due to his loyalty to the people there while Boosfer has 2 people working for him. Boosfer tells them that loyalty is a figment of your imagination and leaves. 

Upon returning to the civilization, 4CVIT returns to the civilization impressed about how much has changed since he was last there. Parrot asks 4CVIT why he wasn't present in the civilization and 4CVIT tells Parrot that he was working on collecting resources for the civilization. 4CVIT also criticizes the civilization and said that it is going to be found and destroyed. 4CVIT tells Parrot that he needs to be in the civilization.

Parrot tells Wifies and Dean that there are new members in the civilization, 
Fantst
 and 
LettuceK
. Fantst warns Parrot about some invisible players. Parrot and Wifies find Dean and tell him about the new features and members and lead Dean to the civilization. They spot invisible players presumably building a TNT cannon along with a red line. They turn back and see a gold trimmed player riding an A1C Bomber plane. They realize that there are three A1C bomber planes. One of them wen through their obsidian wall so they mined it. After destroying all three bomber planes they have a meeting about how they can make the civilization stronger. Parrot tells Horace to build a dome with water. 4CVIT tells Parrot he has to leave to check on something so Parrot sends him out and gets 4 people to make sure that nothing fishy is going on. Parrot also made sure of him being elected and everyone agreed to vote Parrot. After this Parrot and Wifies talked about what happened in the past day and Wifies tells Parrot that he should tell everyone about the portal. Parrot opens another meeting telling everyone about The Mafia tampering with the end portal. The people didn't mind getting trapped in the end as long as nothing happens to the civilization. 

During the election day, Horace finishes building the orb so Parrot and Wifies place water all over the orb so that it can't get destroyed by TNT. Boosfer arrives with 
Kier
 and 
Dev
. What Boosfer didn't know was that Parrot had already told everyone that they were stuck in the end and they were fine with it. During the election, Kier and Dev vote for Parrot and play dumb. Kier and Dev insist that they leave and Parrot agrees however, if they want to join his civilization he will let them. After winning the election, Parrot returns to his garden and finds Dean. Parrot tells Dean that he actually feels safe in the civilization now however, Dean warns Parrot about an invisible player in the town square. Parrot gets worried and flies searching for the player. He decides to check the chunk ban. Parrot asks Dean why he didn't say anything about it and Dean tells Parrot he was scared. The civilization has another meeting where Dean tells them that there was an invisible person hiding and everyone assembled to find the invisible player.     

They notice their civilization getting attacked again as they spot A1C bombers flying again. While they try to destroy the A1C bombers, Horace tells Parrot to check the sewers which Parrot wasn't aware of. As they check the sewers they find a bunch of shulkers. Something ticks in Parrot's mind to check the chunk bans. He realizes that they were disabled and starts to panic. Before he realizes it, The Mafia attacks the civilization and there's a diamond trimmed player present in the attack. They focus on the diamond trimmed player until the diamond player starts macing them. Parrot tells them to retreat because it isn't worth dying to a diamond player like that. Parrot deactivates the chunk ban allowing the members of the civilization to flee. They head to one of the outposts. Parrot tells them that the empire isn't going to get blown up because if they wanted to blow it up they would've done it already so Parrot decides to destroy the civilization himself as he states that it shouldn't exist if he's not running it. Parrot tells 4CVIT about the civilization getting raided and 4CVIT shows Parrot what he's been working on the entire time. After Parrot tells 4C that he wants to destroy the empire, 4C gives Parrot, Wifies and Dean a bunch of TNT. As they head back to the civilization, Wifies notices that the dome is gone. As they place TNT around the entire  castle, Parrot gets caught so Wifies distracts the invisible players. After Parrot ignites the TNT, he thinks about the old memories they had during their time leading the civilization.    



Analysis


The scene where 
Parrot
, 
Wifies
, 
Dolphin
 and 
Max
 get attacked in the end and Parrot barely escaping changes the course of Parrot and Wifies' friendship as revealed in 
Hunting a Minecraft Player Who Doesn't Exist
.

This is the first Unstable video to use custom music.

Other videos which use custom music are

,

,

title: I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
content:
I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization














Season


1






Episode


8






Upload date


Jun 15, 2024






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc
The ClownPierce Arc (semi-relevant)






Featured Creators (Description)


eggchan
PrinceZam
Pangi
FlameFrags
ManePear
Sorhin
Horace_Altman
ParrotX2
Merffinn
ClownPierce

 ✝

pheeabee
 ✝

 ✝
Jaden MAN














2 week minecraft phase in 1 video





I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization
 is the 8th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.  



Plot


The episode starts off with 
PrinceZam
 summoning 
Wemmbu
 to his castle in the 
Zam Empire
 for a meeting. PrinceZam tells him that since he helped Wemmbu ban 
SpokeIsHere
, the villain of the server, off, Wemmbu still owes him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to build him a 
colony
 of the Zam Empire to guard a vault he has. He also gives Wemmbu lots of materials to build the empire, and tells him to not go into the vault. Wemmbu gives PrinceZam all of his elytras to make space in his ender chest.

Wemmbu heads to the coordinates PrinceZam sent him, located on the top of a big hill in a plains biome. The vault is under a red tulip and when he digs down, he finds a big obsidian box, but doesn’t go in it. He gets started on building a town hall for the colony, but realizes that he doesn’t have the necessary skills to make a good-looking build, so just builds a starter wooden house which he calls the shed.

Another key factor Wemmbu would need to create a colony would be people to live in it, so he invites one of his friends, 
Eggchan
, to help him establish it. He meets Egg and they head to his house near 
spawn
, but find that it’s been blown up. Having a new source of motivation to grow this colony since they’re now homeless, Wemmbu and Egg get to work on a new pumpkin farm and storage room for all of the shulkers of materials under the shed.

Wemmbu soon discovers that Egg isn’t very good at Minecraft, so he heads into the nether to gather materials for an ender pearl stasis chamber in case anything goes wrong. He sets both of their stases in the room below the shed and shows Egg how to use it. He starts farming the pumpkin farm when 
FlameFrags
, one of PrinceZam’s guards, arrives at the colony. What was weird was that Flame wasn’t wearing his Zam Empire armor or shield. He starts attacking Wemmbu, who stasises away into the shed’s underground bunker where Egg is waiting for him. 

They form a plan, where Egg will go out to lure Flame to the underground bunker, where Wemmbu will set up traps of TNT for him. He gives Egg his combat kit and a crash course on how to survive PVPing someone. Using the TNT minecarts, they escape and Flame leaves the colony. Wemmbu is dismayed when he finds out that Egg broke the entirety of his god set, leaving them broke with nothing but a blown up colony. The shulker box with all of the redstone in it was also blown up.

He shows Egg the vault PrinceZam asked him to guard, and Egg wants to look inside of it, but Wemmbu doesn’t let him. He theorizes that that’s why Flame came to the colony. They build a villager breeder, a block of campfires, and a two block high obsidian wall as a defense around the central area of the colony. Wemmbu starts a raid to obtain more totems. They also make a dripstone trap in front of the shed, a TNT minecart trap at the entrance, and start regearing their armor. Another player called C4CorvetteOwner is invited into their colony, but later leaves.

Later, a big group of rather undergeared players, 
LettuceK
, Twirps, 
Spongs
, 
youri_mc
, 
Falconu
, and 
Jaden_MAN
, which FlameFrags ordered to kill them show up. They engage in a big fight and eventually chase the players away, winning the battle thanks to Wemmbu’s elytra. However, the battle left them with an even more blown up colony. The strange thing was that no one tried to get into the obsidian vault. Their only goal seemed to be to kill Wemmbu. Since the situation seems to be suspicious, Egg suggests cutting them off from the Zam Empire, but Wemmbu tells him that it’s a bad idea and gives him a history lesson on the Zam Empire. 

Both Egg and Wemmbu suck at building, so they invite a professional builder called 
Horace_Altman
 to give feedback on their work. After a few minutes of being criticized by him, Wemmbu gives up and just hires him for twelve emeralds to build them a real colony using the materials in their shulker boxes. 

The next day, Wemmbu and Egg return to the colony to find that Horace built an entire castle as the center of the town and an entire village at the base of the hill just like the Zam Empire. They pay him twelve more emeralds to make other renovations to the colony and add another town hall. 

They start recruiting residents in their colony and their first recruit is 
TheRealSquiddo
, who was previously 
chunk banned
 by Wemmbu. He is surprised to see her and asks her how she managed to get unbanned. Squiddo tells him that she just logged on and ended up outside of a prison unbanned. When they are heading up to the castle, they see a message in chat that 
ClownPierce
 has logged on. Wemmbu notices that 
ParrotX2
 is also online and explains to Egg that ClownPierce is one of the people who are at FlameFrag’s skill level. They then recruit another two resident, Dione4K and 
Block_Facts
 to their colony. 

They return to the castle and a while later, spot two players in full netherite landing in the town square, one invis, who is Parrot, and the other, ClownPierce. He lands at the castle and asks them about Parrot’s whereabouts. He starts looking around the castle as Wemmbu receives a message from Parrot saying “help me.” Once Clown leaves to look for Parrot, he reveals himself and asks for help. Wemmbu tells him to hide in the villager breeder, but Clown returns and starts killing all of his villagers, somehow sensing that Parrot is in there. Eventually, Clown goes away. 

Parrot tells them that Clown was hired by PrinceZam to assassinate him. They go to the shed’s underground bulker to talk. Clown blew up 
Wifies's
 house and jumped Parrot and Wifies. Parrot had gotten Wifies and a bunch of Spoke’s henchmen out of the chunk bans, which was why Zam had put a bounty on his head. Wemmbu realizes that that was how Squiddo had gotten out, and that Parrot had basically undid weeks of work. Wemmbu tells him that he is with Zam, and Parrot immediately gets out of the shed. Wemmbu tells him that he trusts Zam, but Parrot questions it and Wemmbu finds out that Spoke isn’t chunk banned anymore. He decides to let Parrot go, and Parrot tells him that he could free 
Fantst
, one of Spoke’s underlings in a chunk ban, and get him to join their colony. 

Before they can go free Fantst, PrinceZam and two of his guards, 
ManePear
 and 
Merffinn
, show up and ask for an update on how things are going. Wemmbu tells him everything and asks why FlameFrags attacked them and why ClownPierce was hunting Parrot. PrinceZam says that Flame betrayed them but says nothing about Clown. He checks the vault and tells Wemmbu that he is glad that no one broke into the vault. He leaves ManePear and Merffinn at the colony to protect them. 

They successfully free Fantst from the chunk ban and recruit him as a resident of their colony. While at the chunk ban, they find 
rekrap2's
 base nearby, Parrot and the rest of his 
prison-breaking team's
 headquarters. They find two sets of god armor and lots of OP items. They take everything of use from that base and get stacked from the loot. They make another vault below the first one under the shed to store all of their stuff. Wemmbu sends Egg a railgun tutorial to build one as a defense using all of the redstone they gained, as well as terraform a hill to hide it. Egg starts building a gold farm, so Wemmbu goes to check it out. 

Horace messages Wemmbu to head back to their colony. When they arrive, they see that Horace built giant wall at least thirty blocks tall around the entire colony, as well as sprawling farms and a town hall. Later, ManePear and Merffinn ask to see all of their traps, but at night, Wemmbu catches them tampering and rigging the railgun so that it wouldn’t work. He stays undercover and doesn’t interrupt them to not raise any suspicions. In the morning, while the guards are logged off, they check the railgun and find that they weren’t very discreet in sabotaging it. 

After recruiting another resident called 
Spepticle
 to their colony, Wemmbu takes Egg to the castle and tells him about the guards’ sabotage. Egg tells him that since this happened, there was no reason not to look into the vault. The guards had moved the auto-loader and left wood blocks on the machine. Egg then asks why they wouldn’t want them to kill FlameFrags. After checking the other traps, it seems that the guards hadn’t touched anything else. Wemmbu wants to ask PrinceZam about this, but Egg convinces him not to because then PrinceZam wouldn’t tell him anything, and he would also know. Egg wants them to trust Parrot instead of PrinceZam, and most important of all, to look in the vault. Wemmbu lets Egg check the vault and says that if they get caught, they could just blame it on Dione. However, they discover the vault is empty. 

Egg says that they are virtually useless because there is nothing that they’re guarding. Either PrinceZam is an awful emperor, or that they don’t know everything. Now Wemmbu is questioning everything they’ve worked for. Egg proposes that they get information out of the guards, since they probably know what’s going on. 

Wemmbu and Egg go about minding their own business, until Parrot shows up again, this time asking for their protection. He says that he had joined another team, made up of 
Leow0ok
, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and 
WoogieX
, whose only goal was to kill ClownPierce, but they didn’t care about his safety at all, so he left them. The Wemmbu civilization was now the only team on the server that could protect him. Wemmbu agrees to take him in because if he tells ManePear and Merffinn that Parrot joined their colony, if ClownPierce and FlameFrags showed up at their doorstep right after, then that would confirm everything about Zam. 

Wemmbu also asks Parrot to build other traps, since ManePear and Merffinn already found all of the defenses they have. Parrot builds them a chunk ban trap to defend against invaders. Wemmbu tells him that they won’t risk the entire Wemmbu civilization for keeping Parrot safe, but they will try to protect him. He also explains why the Wemmbu civilization was created in the first place. Parrot goes to start building the chunk bans while Wemmbu and Egg gear up the citizens.

They grab all of the PVP kits they have and bring everyone to the town hall, as well as a new citizen called 
expchan
. Wemmbu makes amends with Fantst and Fantst tells him that Parrot is trustworthy. He gathers everyone and tells them not to trust ManePear and Merffinn, to ignore them, Parrot is building chunk ban traps called flycatchers, so don’t go near them, and that ClownPierce and FlameFrags may be showing up at any moment.

Merffinn finally log back on and Wemmbu gives them an update on the empire, making sure to tell them that Parrot is now a citizen in the Wemmbu civilization. 

A while later, Wemmbu and Egg spot Parrot frantically flying towards them. He tells them that there are people at the front gate who are planning to attack them. Jaden_MAN was chunk banned, but there were still more than they were comfortable with, so they gather all of the citizens and head to the gate, where FlameFrags, Falconu, LettuceK, Spongs, and an invis player that was most definitely ClownPierce. They build a TNT cannon to shoot at them, but don’t have a daylight sensor, so the cannon blows up. Eventually the enemies find out that they can pearl in, so a battle ensues in the city walls, where the crop fields get bombed. 

Parrot has to dip and regear mid fight because his boots broke, but eventually, they manage to chase their opponents away. Wemmbu proclaims it as a victory as no one dropped, even though they’re drained of resources and half the town is bombed. Once they restock, Parrot thanks them for their help and leaves to mind his own business, while Wemmbu and Egg start brainstorming ways to get rid of FlameFrags. 

Wemmbu and Egg start discussing what had just happened when out of nowhere, FlameFrags appears at the top of the hill, pots up, and starts attacking. He takes the fight to a nearby ocean monument to try and stall Flame, but the elder guardian, a crucial part of his plan, despawns, leaving Wemmbu helpless and without rockets. They return to the colony, where Egg distracts Flame while Wemmbu escapes with a nearly broken trident. However, when Egg got away, Flame finds Wemmbu and starts attacking once again. Just when Wemmbu is about to drop, Flame stops attacking and lets him live, leaving for some unknown reason. Wemmbu and Egg return and group up at the castle, finding PrinceZam, 
Sorhin
, Merffinn, and FlameFrags waiting for them. 

PrinceZam, as always asks for a tour, so Wemmbu shows him everything. He then exposes Zam for everything that he’s done to the Wemmbu civilization, but this time, Zam doesn’t make anything up or try lie to him. PrinceZam tells Wemmbu that Flame was working to kill him under his orders all along, and that now, he doesn’t consider Wemmbu as a big enough threat to actually do anything, so he orders his guards to blow up the empire. PrinceZam tells him that he is unbelievably weak, so much so that he should just get out of the Zam Empire’s way. Wemmbu responds that this was just PrinceZam’s way to laugh not being able to stop the weakest player on the server, Parrot, from breaking into his prisons and freeing everyone that was chunk banned, and that ClownPierce had already failed at killing Parrot. 

As Wemmbu and PrinceZam stand there watching the colony blow up, Wemmbu tells him that PrinceZam had made a big mistake in underestimating him.

title: I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army
content:
I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army














Episode


129






Upload date


May 4, 2026






POV


ParrotX2






Featured Creators (Description)


TheobaldTheBird
FlameFrags
ClownPierce














In 5 days, the army of Cindercrest is coming to invade my kingdom. As the king of this server, I'm going to do whatever it takes to stop them... creating an army of 10's of thousands of players. This is How I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army.





I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army
 is the 129th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Parrot
 begins the episode by explaining that In five days, the Cindercrest army is going to invade his kingdom. As the king of Unstable, Parrot will do everything in his power to stop them, so he has to garner an army to fight back. Luckily for him, there's always tens of thousands of players online at all time, and his goal is to create one bigger than any of the ones in the past.

As of now, it's not going to be easy to gather up that many players. His only teammates are his friends 
TheobaldTheBird
 and 
ReinaDrop
. They were drained out of all their resources after traveling back from their failed 
Skymore Civilization
. They follow a trail down to 
Merchant City
, but is stopped by a group of bandits who stop them to rob them out of their gear. Parrot begs to let them free, the leader of the bandits, RocketBandit3 says they're on his land now. Parrot threatens them by bringing Theo up and says he can 20v1 them, but they see right through them. RocketBandit hits Parrot down to half a heart, he panics, then asks them to join his army, in which they'll get far more gear and food than if they were to kill him right there. RocketBandit agrees so, as well as the others. He holds a small speech and tells all the bandits he's willing to let any bandit join his army as long as they promise not to steal or hurt anyone else. RocketBandit tells Parrot he can bring him to the bandit base.

The army goes up to the front of the bandit base, Parrot asks to see the bandit king and the guards tell him to leave. Parrot tells them he has an offer the king can't refuse, so they let him in and threatens him if he tries anything. He goes up to the king, OutlawAndrew, and tells him about Cindercrest and how they're going to try and take back their land and asks the bandits for a helping hand. Andrew laughs and says they take things by force. Parrot makes an offer; his best warrior fights their best warrior, and picks Theo to fight. Andrew tells Parrot he knows who Theo is, and since they're on his land, they play by his rules and makes Parrot choose somebody else. Parrot chooses Reina to fight, Theo yells at Parrot and tells him he sold by picking her. Andrew accepts Reina as Parrot's fighter and gets his fighter, ralamus, to come forward. They go to the fighting arena, Parrot gives Reina a trident and tells her she can beat him. As Andrew counts down for the fight to start, Reina throws the trident, which causes dripstone to fall and kill ralamus. The crowd is completely silent while Theo cheers for Reina. Parrot goes up to Andrew and welcomes him to the army.

Parrot gets to Merchant City with his army, his next plan is to hire the 
Merchant City Vanguard
. They stop at the gates, the guards tell Parrot they're not allowed to come in with the bandits. Parrot is allowed to come in alone and convinces the guards to let Theo and Reina come with him. Parrot goes to 
DanchoGold
 and requests 150,000 diamonds and 300 of his men with a 3:1 return. Dancho laughs and reminds Parrot that he's still in debt to him and knows he's uncapable of paying that back, and so, he gets his guards to surround them and arrest Parrot. Parrot gives Theo the sigh to cart them and take Dancho hostage, which was their plan all along to try and get the vanguard on their side. They get out of the building and see the entire vanguard spread across Merchant City, they have to get Dancho out safely. Parrot and Theo tell the vanguard to back up otherwise they kill Dancho. Parrot tells the guards holding the gate to open it, the guards tell him if they kill Dancho, they'll drop down and kill him. Parrot tells the vanguard that if they join his army, once the war is over, he'll let Dancho free. One of the players speaks up and says if Dancho is dead, they won't have to work for him anymore, which changed all of their minds and likes the idea of killing him. Dancho gets on a stray horse and runs away, adding 300 more playing to Parrot's army.

The next part of Parrot's plan is to head over to the Nether and talk to 
ClownPierce
. Theo is skeptical about it, but Parrot says it's the only way to get resources for his army. Before Parrot goes through, he tells Theo and Reina to set up base where the bandit base was. Parrot explains that the Nether is a dangerous dimension that's controlled by Clown and usually anyone who tries to enter the Nether is killed. Since Parrot is the king, they made an exception for him. Parrot tells Clown the reason why he's here, Cindercrest is going to invade his army and he wants to buy 40,000 TNT from Clown. Clown reminds Parrot that he raided his vault half a year ago and asks what he could possibly be doing with that much TNT. Parrot says it doesn't matter and asks how much he owes him. Clown says it's typically 20,000, but he triples the price for all the damages of his vault. Parrot knows Clown is scamming and begins to head off to buy from someone else. Clown says Cindercrest is already departing and will arrive to his kingdom in less than 24 hours and says he hopes he finds someone else fast. Parrot thinks Clown is bluffing, and Clown says he's more fitting to be a jester than a king. He goes on and says Cindercrest came to him and bought loads of items from him as well, and if he doesn't have the gear to fight back, he's not going to win. Parrot gives in and gives Clown all of the diamonds. Parrot goes to follow the guards, Clown stops him and says he wasn't originally a fan of Parrot opening up spawn, but thinks it's one of the best decisions he's ever made. Clown then tells Parrot he's always welcome to come back to buy something, but if he ever comes to the Nether for any reason besides that, he's going to kill him.

Now that he has the resources to grow his army, Parrot is unsure if there was enough time. Parrot tells his army the bad news, he tells Theo he spent all the funds to buy 40,000 TNT, which Theo is shook by, and Reina reassures him that Parrot has a plan. He doesn't know if Clown was actually telling the truth, so he tasks Theo and Reina to scout them out. Parrot has a plan for the rest of his army, he believes he can grow the army to 10,000 players with the help of the army. While that's happening, Theo and Reina headed deeper into Cindercrest territory. They go through biome after biome, until they reach a snowy biome where they hear the horn being blown. They see a massive blimp flying towards the direction of spawn and hundreds, if not thousands of players in full netherite walking the same direction. Reina looks up and sees two players standing on top of the blimp, Theo sees them and notices that it's 
FlameFrags
 and 
ShoeBilly
. Theo accidentally places water and it falls down the hill, two Cindercrest members notices it and inspects it, Theo and Reina hide right below their feet, and the players don't see anybody. Theo and Reina head back to spawn once the coast is clear. 

With Cindercrest arriving to Parrot's kingdom in less than a day, Parrot goes to the next place to recruit more players. They head to 
The Law
's base, who was once the biggest army on the server. Even after the war against The Law, they still had a thousand soldiers, which was double than Parrot's army. Getting Law wasn't about getting more players, it was more so about the gear they had to supply thousands of players. Parrot keeps his army behind while he walks up to 
SargeLAW
. Sarge tells him to leave before Parrot could explain himself. Parrot tells him what he's told everyone else, Cindercrest is coming to invade his kingdom and they're going to kill all of the new players. Sarge says he believes Parrot, but is going to join Cindercrest. Parrot asks Sarge to join them, but he's reluctant and says no, so Parrot walks past him and asks the lawmen to make a decision to either join him, or if they stay on Sarge's side, he assumes they're going to join Cindercrest and will have no other choice than to kill them. Tons of lawmen join Parrot's side, Parrot begs for anymore to come up and join him. Parrot says he doesn't want to kill everyone, Sarge says Theo isn't there with him and they don't have a chance to win the fight. Parrot asks RocketBandit if everything was setup, and RocketBandit says it's ready. Parrot readies his bow and shoots at a target, which blows up the entire front of the base and kills off a ton of the remaining lawmen who were on Cindercrest's side. A battle breaks out between Parrot's and SargeLAW's army, in the end, Parrot's army has won and they looted the entirety of the base. 

With all of the gear and players from The Law, Parrot can grow his army big enough to defeat Cindercrest. He goes back to spawn to expand the army as fast as possible. It cuts to more cinematic scenes, over at spawn, players can choose to live in 
Capitol City
 or join the army, players build up a new path that directs whoever wants to join the army to another castle where all of the gear is. Players are farming, mining a massive chunk, practice fighting, and much more. Parrot is writing in a book when Theo and Reina come back and tells him that they're cooked. Parrot doesn't say anything about that and says they came back in time since he was just about to give a speech to his army. The episode ends as Parrot tells them to follow him, Theo says if they're going to fight back, they're going to need thousands, Parrot says they're going to need tens of thousands and shows them the massive army he was able to garner up, even 
Fymada
 shows up with her own group of players to join the army.



Trivia


The video's title with A/B testing will either show it as I Created the World's Largest Minecraft Army or I Created the World's Largest Army. This may be subject to change.


ReinaDrop's pov is shown in this video.


Starting from 
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
, every protagonist uploaded 2 days apart from each other up until this video.

I Discovered a Minecraft Sky Civilization
 is the 20th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode begins with 
Wemmbu
 emulating skyblock in Spawn until he saw 3 invisible players flying to 
Skyblock Civilization
. Wemmbu begins exploring until he finds 
Pangi
. Pangi tells Wemmbu that he has to take him to 
Jaron
 since they kill outsiders. Jaron tells Wemmbu that the civilization is supposed to be private and he's heard a few things about Wemmbu and also states that if he doesn't become a citizen they have to kill him. Wemmbu attempts to escape the civilization but gets caught by 
Straight
. Straight tells him he will kill him if he leaves. He then takes Wemmbu to Jaron and tells promises that he will always watch him. 

Pangi takes Wemmbu to the farms of the civilization and teaches him how to work on those farms and store them in storage rooms. Wemmbu and Pangi work on the farms while other civilians just watch. After a while Straight returns to check up on Wemmbu and tells him that he will be watching over him. Pangi tells Straight that Wemmbu was talking trash about him and that he can beat him in a fight. Wemmbu begins complaining to Straight that he's an incredibly skilled PvPer forcing him to do these tasks. Their argument comes to an end when Straight tells Wemmbu to 1v1 him. If Wemmbu wins, he can leave but if Straight wins, Wemmbu has to stop complaining about the city.

Wemmbu enters the colosseum where he would do a sumo duel with Straight. They both get their inventories cleared up and make it to the platform where they would begin their 1v1. Wemmbu attempts to combo Straight to the edge but Straight gains the upper hand and wins the 1v1. 

Wemmbu and 
Wato
 have a conversation on how they ended up in Skyblock Civilization. Wemmbu explains that he followed 3 invisible players and didn't think he would get stuck against his will. Wato explains that he joined to hide from ClownPierce since he betrayed him by refusing to respawn the ender dragon after Wemmbu and 
PrinceZam
 solved the escape room. Wemmbu asks if Wato can leave in which he responds by saying that normal citizens like him can leave but they are in war time. 

They head to Wato's secret home and Wato gives him a tour around his home. Wemmbu goes back to grinding materials until Pangi shows up again. Pangi tells Wemmbu he has to take a break and shows him his house. He shows him around his house and then shows him around his house. Wemmbu finds Pangi's basement which was in progress. Wemmbu and Wato throw a bunch of eggs to hatch chickens where they would then make noise to cover up villagers. Pangi returns and they continue working on their basement. 

As they work on the basement, Straight returns and takes Wato to the castle to see Jaron. Wemmbu follows Wato and Straight secretly to eavesdrop in their conversation. They discuss about why Wato shouldn't do any meaningless tasks and instead do something impactful. Jaron tells Wato to go on a scouting mission to clear the airspace to prevent more people entering the civilization without any notice so they have likely left something behind. Wemmbu interrupts their conversation and states that they in fact did leave something behind and mentions what happened before he ended up in Skyblock Civilization. Wemmbu then tells them to take him to the mission with them so that he can show them the skyblock island at spawn.     

They set their stasises for Wato to pull when they are done and pearl onto spawn. Wemmbu finds an ender chest and he gears up. He shows Straight and Jaron the skyblock island where he was playing skyblock on until three 
invisible players
 show up on the island. The iron trimmed player tells them that they are "investigating" the island. Wemmbu, Straight and Jaron pot up and begin attacking the invisible players. One of them dies from fall damage. During the fight, Straight kills the iron trim while the other no trim runs away. They return to the island and destroy it. Before Wato pulls the stasis, Wemmbu asks Jaron why the civilization doesn't have villagers; Jaron tells Wemmbu that they don't need villagers because they are only obtainable outside of skyblock. Jaron believes its fun without villagers and they don't need any. Wemmbu tells them that he wants to leave Skyblock Civilization and he has the items to leave; if Straight hunts him down he can just ruin the economy. Straight tells Wemmbu that he can kill him quickly. Wemmbu, realizing he has no other choice puts all his items into his ender chest but he smuggles 6 ender chests.      

Wato pulls their stasis chambers and Wemmbu heads to Pangi's basement along with Wato to show him what he had smuggled but Straight follows them the entire time and watches them. Wato distracts Straight by telling him about the stasis chambers and the security of the Skyblock Civilization and he tells him to destroy the stasis chamber. Straight leaves to do so leaving Wemmbu and Wato alone. Wemmbu finally shows Wato the ender chests that he had smuggled on their mission; Wato is impressed and also warns Wemmbu about showcasing items that "aren't obtainable" in Skyblock Civilization.         

Pangi enters Wemmbu's house and tries to take them to a drowned farm that he had been working on. Wemmbu and Wato try to reject the offer because they were worried that Straight will get mad; they then proceed because they feel bad for Pangi. Pangi gives them cobblestone slabs to fill up the top of the farm. As they finish, they continue hanging out with Pangi. Wemmbu and Wato have a discussion about the unobtainable items. Wemmbu tells Wato that he will spy on Jaron with invisibility. After their discussion, Wemmbu goes to visit Loppezz and her snow civilization. Wemmbu tells them that he will only join if they help him distract Jaron.            

Wemmbu tries to break in to the castle only to find Straight. Straight interrogates Wemmbu about his motives for sneaking in. Wemmbu lies to him stating that he's helping Jaron integrate a new feature in the castle and Jaron doesn't want anyone else to know. Wemmbu tells Straight that he can ask Wato about it. After Straight leaves, Wemmbu warns Wato that Straight is going to interrogate him before breaking into the castle. Wemmbu uses invisibility while hiding on the ceiling of the meeting room. During meeting Jaron discusses about the invisible players and finding out where they reside by leaving one alive. Straight gets dismissed and Jaron begins placing shulkers, presumably the unobtainable items. Wemmbu leaves the castle and goes back to his house where he has another meeting with Wato.

title: I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension
content:
I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension

Bro, where even am I?





I Escaped Minecraft's Forgotten Dimension
 is the 76th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts off with 
Wemmbu
 entering the Nether and immediately getting hit into a void trap made by 
Boosfer
. Quickly thinking, he pearls up and makes it back up and starts attacking Boosfer. Wemmbu manages to knock Boosfer down the trap, but Boosfer uses a fishing rod to lure Wemmbu down with him. Rather than taking damage from the void, the two fall down to a new dimension underneath the Nether. They are not able to break or place blocks inside of this dimension. 

Wemmbu starts to explore the dimension and finds a player riding a Happy Ghast, and starts to follow them. Eventually the player and their Happy Ghast gets low enough to the ground for Wemmbu to hit, Wemmbu gets on the Happy Ghast and steals it, he uses it to explore a bit more. Wemmbu discovers a tower with brewing stands and potion materials, allowing him to brew invisibility potions and fighting potions. 

Three soul keepers come to the tower with Happy Ghasts as well, Boosfer is seen being held hostage by them. They try to imprison Wemmbu as well, but this causes a fight to start. The soul keepers run away, Wemmbu explores further and finds a giant castle with cages with players inside of them in front. Wemmbu sneaks into the castle and eavesdrops on Boosfer talking to the soul keepers. When they leave, Wemmbu tries to get Boosfer to drop his mace, Boosfer talking alerts the soul keepers and they begin to fight again. They trap Wemmbu in a corner since he isn't able to break blocks and begins to break his armor. Wemmbu surrenders and lets them imprison him. A few soul keepers then leave to find more Happy Ghasts.

Wemmbu and Boosfer talk, and Boosfer uses a pearl he smuggled and teleports out of the cage. They make a truce to help each other escape the dimension. Boosfer gives Wemmbu his mace and a pearl to get out the cage. Wemmbu jumps a soul keeper and kills one of them. Wemmbu and Boosfer explore the castle for loot. The two stumble across a gold block that makes their game lag, it is unknown if this block has a purpose.

They go back to the tower from earlier, Wemmbu convinces Boosfer that they would work together to get out, instead he attacks Boosfer trying to get the pearls from him. Boosfer says if Wemmbu doesn't kill him, he'll actually help get them both out of here. They sneak back to the big castle using invisibility potions, their plan was to steal a Happy Ghast and get out of there, but Boosfer was spotted. They still manage to get on a Happy Ghast, but the soul keepers are able to catch up to them. When they get to where the void trap was set, they find a base built by the soul keepers there. They use their pearls to glitch through the bedrock without having to use the void trap to avoid being seen. Boosfer manages to get back up, and he goes to regear while Wemmbu fights off the soul keepers. Boosfer comes back with wind charges and experience for Wemmbu, allowing him to be able to use the mace. Once Wemmbu killed their leader, the rest retreat. Wemmbu and Boosfer get back up, escaping this dimension.

Boosfer asks Wemmbu if he's going to kill him now, instead, Wemmbu gives Boosfer his mace back and tells him not to leak his identity. Boosfer agrees not to, and promises to not attack Capital City either as a truce for not banning him. The episode ends with Wemmbu splashing himself with invisibility, hiding his identity once again.



Trivia


In Wemmbu's previous video, Boosfer can be heard cheering as Wemmbu takes damage at the end. However, neither Boosfer laughing or the rapid damage ticks can be heard at the beginning of this video.

As they traverse through the gravel lands, they see a different place with spiky mountains in the distance. They explore it until they see another ghost player replaying their death to starvation. Wemmbu continues exploring until his elytra breaks, so he chooses to walk since he now has no way of flying. They reach the end of the spiky mountains biome and find a continuation of the gravel lands. This time there are more trees and life to it. In the center of the biome, they find a ginormous golden temple with five large statues standing ominously along the path to its entrance.

As they enter the temple, Wemmbu and Eggchan are met with two people. Wemmbu punches them to make sure they are real people and not ghosts, and he finds that they are in fact real people. With this knowledge, he proceeds to rob them for their food and resources. Wemmbu asks the player if he has any XP since they are being hunted. The player gives Wemmbu his boots instead, however, they're only enchanted with protection one. He also tells Wemmbu that 
Lakerek
 has some items from The Forge and he would give it if Wemmbu wins against him in a fight.  

The player then wakes up Lakerek who proceeds to attack Wemmbu. During their fight, a massive pit opens up and they begin fighting in the pit. They continue their fight as usual until Lakerek gives Wemmbu golden apples and XP bottles to mend his armour. Little did he know it was to prepare him for the next stage of his fight. Lakerek begins firing orbital strikes on Wemmbu. After surviving the orbital strikes and restocking afterwards, Wemmbu and Lakerek continue fighting. Lakerek gives up as he can no longer fire orbital strikes and he lets Wemmbu kill him. He then returns to Eggchan and 
mxsterwu
 (the player who introduced Wemmbu to The Forge) and he kills mxsterwu as well and he loots them both.

Wemmbu and Eggchan get jumped by the players who had attacked them earlier however, Spongs had weaker gear along with FlameFrags, Sharpness and Jaden MAN being absent. After a while, everyone leaves except for Fantst who is getting mercilessly attacked by Wemmbu. Fantst tells Wemmbu that he has info about his mace and he know about the mace because Sharpness is in his team. Fantst gives Wemmbu his boots and Eggchan his shield. Wemmbu and Eggchan leave the temple and go back to the mountain spikes biome. 

They get attacked by FlameFrags and Jaden MAN again, and the entire team eventually joins in and tries to kill them again. Sharpness and Wyll begin fighting each other while also fighting Wemmbu and the entire fight becomes chaotic as everyone is trying to kill each other. FlameFrags also gets jumped by the team giving Wemmbu an opportunity to team with him. As the fight endures, Eggchan gives Wemmbu and FlameFrags some shulkers that they had which had some armour. Wemmbu and FlameFrags try to kill Sharpness but he leaves. FlameFrags gives Wemmbu his mace back telling him that he doesn't need it. Eggchan tells Wemmbu that the shulkers he gave them were from their secret hideout. Wemmbu tells them that they aren't going to leave the farlands because they have to find The Forge.

I Explored Beyond the Minecraft Void
 is the 60th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.

Plot


The episode begins with 
Wemmbu
 and 
Eggchan
 find a city in the void however, they get attacked by it's citizens using TNT cannons. Wemmbu begins fighting Nitenly as he was the one firing the TNT cannons Nitenly gets confronted by a player named Serpentbound333. Serpentbound brings Wemmbu and Eggchan to a dorm while they have a meeting and their dorm is being guarded by another player named GeeGeeGamer. Eggchan notices that the whole floor is TNT and they will get blown up if they try to escape. They find out that the TNT trap was defunct and leave the dorm as GeeGeeGamer had stopped guarding it. 

They explore the city and find an arena and a potion brewer along with an armoury with a lot of rare items and some villagers which are extinct on the regular Unstable SMP. They loot the armoury and get attacked by Nitenly once again. They have a battle in the arena until Serpentbound confronts him again. Serpentbound decides to allow Wemmbu to take anything and ask him any question he wants since he's afraid of him. Wemmbu asks Serpentbound if the city was The Forge but he states that it isn't. Serpentbound asks Wemmbu and Eggchan what they like to do; Wemmbu tells him that he loves PvPing people who are skilled and Eggchan tells him that he loves building. Serpentbound tells GeeGeeGamer to tour him around his place since he loves building as well.

GeeGeeGamer shows Wemmbu and Eggchan his place. The textures get replaced by classic Minecraft textures to show the feel of old Minecraft while GeeGeeGamer tours them. Wemmbu tells GeeGeeGamer to tell him where The Forge is or else he will die because he knows that they are just trying to distract them. GeeGeeGamer responds, telling him that only the fighters know where The Forge is and that he only builds. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan head back to their dorm where Nitenly gives them both PvP kits with netherite armour enchanted with thorns. Wemmbu keeps his diamond armour because he doesn't want thorns or frost walker. They continue exploring the city until they find more villagers. They trade with the villagers to get the ideal netherite armour set. They also find chests of maces which Wemmbu burns because he doesn't want anyone matching his power. They also find every trim and loot some trims. 

Firestar2008 interrupts them and asks Wemmbu if he could teach him PvP because he wants to get good at it. They head to Firestar's room where Wemmbu tells him that he will teach him PvP as long as he tells him where The Forge is after. Wemmbu does a brief "lesson" and pops Firestar's totem and then tells Firestar to reveal where The Forge is but Firestar refuses as he wants Wemmbu to teach him more. Firestar begins bothering Wemmbu telling him to give him his mace to try to replicate what Wemmbu does and also pearl catches a few times. Wemmbu tells Eggchan to duel Firestar and Firestar begins winning the fight and Wemmbu gets impatient so he pops Firestar's totem and demands that he tells him where The Forge is. Firestar reveals that he didn't know what The Forge was and he told him he knew just so that he could teach him PvP. Wemmbu and Eggchan head out but Firestar tells them that they could look around Lakerek's room as they may find the forge there. As they look around Lakerek's room, he tells them that his room has been emptied since he died and Wemmbu begins crashing out on him for taking them to an empty room and they leave.

Wemmbu crafts invisibility potions to spy on Serpentbound's meeting with Nitenly but they don't seem to be talking about anything interesting until Serpentbound tells Nitenly that he can just wait before Wemmbu and Eggchan leave before going to The Forge. Wemmbu's invisibility starts to run out so he hides before gearing up and leaving. Eggchan explains to Wemmbu that while Firestar was bothering him in Lakerek's room, he found a puzzle and he got a lodestone compass after solving it. They gather blocks before bridging and following the lodestone compass. 

They make it back to the farlands where they find a bunch of repeating orbital strike cannons. Wemmbu realizes that this was how Lakerek was able to strike him during the fight. They decide to test it but the tickrate increases which speeds everything up for them when they tick the lever. Wemmbu makes an observation stating that this could be how Lakerek was able to bypass the delay on orbital strikes. Wemmbu decides to finally test it but he cannot load chunks as he needs to go to the nether to unload chunks, but he cannot go to the nether. Eggchan tells Wemmbu to make a stasis chamber and set his render and simulation distance to the bare minimum, activate the tickrate machine and set his fishing rod. Eggchan then teleports Wemmbu using the stasis and they test the orbital strike cannon. After a successful test, they return to the orbital strike cannons and Wemmbu notices that the time isn't getting altered anymore so they return to check up on it only to get confronted by Serpentbound, GeeGeeGamer and Nitenly. Wemmbu claims that the orbital strike cannons was The Forge. Serpentbound tells him that it isn't The Forge and that he does know where The Forge is. 

Wemmbu and Eggchan follow them and they make it to Lakerek's room in the city. They make it to the top of the staircase and find an end portal. Serpentbound tells Wemmbu that The Forge is on the other side of the portal and GeeGeeGamer aims a punch bow at Wemmbu during their conversation. Eggchan notices GeeGeeGamer pointing the bow and as he shoots, Eggchan takes the arrow and gets sent into the end portal. Wemmbu realizes that the entire thing was a trap as Nitenly attempts to hit Wemmbu in and they have a fight. During their fight, Wemmbu gets hit with slow falling and he also doesn't have strength giving him a disadvantage. They eventually run out of slow falling making the fight easier for Wemmbu. Wemmbu kills GeeGeeGamer and attempts to kill Nitenly but he escapes along with Firestar. Serpentbound tells Wemmbu that they can work something out. Wemmbu tells Serpentbound to set the orbital strike cannons and Serpentbound takes Wemmbu back to the end portal in Lakerek's room and pushes him in the portal.

wemmbu

 get stranded on deserted islands





I Explored a Deserted Minecraft Civilization
 is the 33rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode begins with 
Jaden_MAN
 demanding that 
Wemmbu
 and 
eggchan
 throw a pearl into his pearl cannon, launching their pearl towards the Pirate Islands, teleporting both of them in there. Wemmbu begins exploring until he sees a player who accuses Wemmbu of trying to steal his food and attacks him. He kills the player's friend and steals her weapons. He then fights the player and kill him. Wemmbu begins exploring and taking their food until he sees another island. He sets sail to the island and finds eggchan in a cell. One of the people who had imprisoned eggchan asks him if he has any items. Wemmbu distracts him and kills his entire group while eggchan escapes.

Wemmbu and eggchan begin mining to find ores however, during their mining trip, they have found no ores. Wemmbu begins digging straight down but he receives mining fatigue. Wemmbu and eggchan go to a random hut to store their items. Eggchan digs down and actually finds a room with 2 golden apples and a totem of undying. 

Wemmbu and eggchan continue exploring and they find an "abandoned" house. Eggchan digs down again and finds a base with an enchanting table. They also find a trial chamber however, the vaults were destroyed. They loot the chests and pots from the trial chamber. They go fishing again and sail to another island that appears to be inhabited.  

As they sail to the island, Wemmbu and eggchan two people in diamond armour fishing. Wemmbu breaks in to their house and attempts to rob them but there aren't any items to steal. They go down a ladder and find an ice circuit. They get caught by 
LettuceK
 who chases them. Soon after, they get chased by 
loppezz
. Wemmbu escapes and enters the house again where he would pull a lever which emits a glass barrier. Loppezz states that if he breaks any glass block the house blows up. Wemmbu uses this as an advantage as he demands loppezz and LettuceK to drop all their items and uses that as leverage. 

They return to the underground ice road circuit. As they explore, Wemmbu finds a room with a massive trident but he doesn't think much of it and returns to his home island with eggchan to upgrade his armour. Wemmbu and eggchan start fishing again to get enchanting books and upgrade their armour. They get attacked by 
Arcn
 and his group of pirates shortly after for loppezz and LettuceK's armour. Wemmbu surrenders and cooperates with them so that he isn't on the run while trying to defeat Jaden_MAN. They head to an underground arena and they duke it out in a 1v1. Shortly after the 1v1 begins, Wemmbu's shield breaks, giving Arcn a huge advantage in the fight.   

Wemmbu's totem pops thus losing the fight. Arcn demands that Wemmbu joins the 
Pirates
 but he denies that offer and runs away. Wemmbu spots an ender chest and takes his mace which he placed when Jaden_MAN forced him to clear his inventory and ender chest. He uses the mace to kill a few pirates. Wemmbu and eggchan retreat as Wemmbu's helmet breaks. As they retreat, eggchan gives Wemmbu his helmet which has protection 4 while Wemmbu's had protection 1. Wemmbu and eggchan then trade armour after realizing that eggchan had maxed out armour while Wemmbu's had protection 1 and a protection 3 chestplate. They return to their home island for preparations for their stealth mission to find the pearl cannon and kill all the Pirates. Eggchan also somehow finds invisibility potions and gives Wemmbu one of them.  

As they head to Jaden_MAN's castle, they hear an argument between loppezz, Arcn, and LettuceK with Jaden_MAN. Jaden pushes a lever and sends loppezz to an underground civilization. They find the pearl cannon and try to find out how it works but suddenly an invisible player places a sign telling Wemmbu to look up. Wemmbu listens and looks up and he sees Jaden attempting to mace him. Shortly after, Jaden is accompanied by Arcn and they 2v1 Wemmbu. Wemmbu finds a few golden apples. Wemmbu pops Jaden a few times and he goes into the water so tha he can still breach swap Wemmbu while he can't hit him in the water. 
TheobaldTheBird
 also enters the fight. Jaden tries to keep hold Wemmbu hostage again but that fails as their pearl cannon blows up, killing some of the guards. The pirates get distracted and Wemmbu and eggchan they retreat as they sail to their home island. Theo also arrives and he explains to Wemmbu that he was the one helping him the entire time and he was behind the invisibility potions, the golden apples, the sign, etc. He also explains that the trident room from the ice circuit actually had a trident but it was buried. After they retrieve the trident, Wemmbu and Theo 2v1 Jaden and Jaden loses the fight. Wemmbu decides to follow Jaden as he wants to end this once and for all.

one of Wemmbu's theme songs
.

Unstable SMP: The Mafia
's thumbnail but with a Pirate theme.
