Spepticle
Dione4k
Expchan
Eggchan
FlameFrags
Jaden MAN
Spongs
LettuceK
Falcuno
TheRealSquiddo
Block_Facts
Twirps














This player
 and 
his
 
team
 are arguably the deadliest players in all of Minecraft... and for some reason, they want me gone.





I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Players
 is the 9th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts with 
ClownPierce
 suddenly breaking into 
Parrot
 and 
Wifies's
 home. He almost kills Parrot before stopping and telling him to follow him to his castle. When Parrot asks Clown why he attacked but didn't kill him, he reveals that he was hired to kill Parrot, but outright killing him wouldn't be any fun. When Parrot asked what Clown means, Clown said that it means that their conversation was over before he started counting down, which makes Parrot rush to leave the castle, but is unsuccessful, opting to hide within the castle instead. While searching for Parrot, Clown offers him a fair 1 v 1 and the coordinates to his 
circus
, saying that in the end, they're not that different from each other. Needing answers regarding who hired Clown and how he was going to survive him, Parrot heads to the circus but brings Wifies with him to help fight. The two of them assume that they would get an easy victory because they had one extra player, but are soon proven wrong when Clown gains the upper hand. The two of them keep trying to escape, especially after Wifies pops his helmet, but are unable to due to mining fatigue. Eventually, 
Leow0ok
, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, 
Woogiex
,, and 
Willsion
 break into the circus and attack Clown, but he manages to get away.

When Parrot asks what's going on, Leo explains that he's been hunting Clown for ages and has been hiring bounty hunters to do so. When Parrot mentions that someone hired Clown to assassinate him, Leo asks for more information. Realizing that Leo and his hunters can protect Parrot while he helps Leo get rid of Clown once and for all, they then devise a plan to kill him using traps and ambushes before heading to their headquarters for further discussion. Parrot proposes that he'll be bait, but make it as hard as possible to kill him before asking Leo how much his budget is, to which Leo answers that it is unlimited. Parrot says that he wants a self-sealing vault to trap him in that Clown would try to break into. Leo accepts. He gives Parrot and Wifies TNT so they can blow Clown's castle up. They are unsure about the exact purpose of doing this, but assumes it is to send a message that they weren't messing around.

When Wifies and Parrot arrive at the castle, Clown spots them and starts attacking while Parrot and Wifies start exploding the castle. Clown doesn't care about the explosions, saying that he can just repair it in a few days and keeps targeting Parrot, but Parrot escapes and meets back up with Wifies. They talk about Leo not caring about thier safety and how 
PrinceZam
 may be who hired Clown.

Leo finishes constructing the vault and Parrot heads to it to lock himself inside and tells Wifies not to get involved. Leo escorts Parrot to a room in the center of the vault containing a small house, several containers, and a small jungle biome, and tells him that he can't exactly say where the escape routes are since "you never know who could be listening." He and gives him the hint "B5," saying that he'll get it when it comes down to it, then stasises out. Wifies reveals himself to Parrot, having been invisible this whole time, saying that he couldn't just leave Parrot alone in the vault, and that that two is better than one. They try to figure out how the vault works and the escape route in case of an emergency by solving the puzzles inside.

Multiple horns blare, acting as a siren signaling Clown's arrival. Parrot and Wifies stay calm, saying that since the hunters are in a 4 v 1, they'll easily kill Clown. The episode's POV switches to Jumper, showing them struggling against Clown, who is accompanied by 
FerreMC
 and 
Mugm
. The POV switches back to Parrot with Wifies, saying that they'll be fine and realistically, they just have to wait it out. He says that since there are three layers, in the worst case (Clown wins), they're screwed—Wifies highly doubts that it'll come to that, but agrees that is anything goes wrong, they should know the escape route just in case. Parrot and Wifies go back to trying to escape.

Parrot accidentally falls down a secret hole through a shulker box into layer one, and Wifies follows him. They explore for a bit and find an evacuation port that leads back to the jungle room. The POV switches to Leo, where the Clown hunters are still fighting against Clown's team. The POV switches back to Parrot, where they are still attempting to solve the puzzles in layer one. Parrot turns on hitboxes and discovers a boat in a wall that leads to a control room containing various levers to activate traps and a sign that says "NOTICE: KEEP OBSIDIAN ON HAND AT ALL TIMES TO MASK DOORWAYS." After looking around and taking the boat, they go back to the jungle room, unsure of what to do. The POV switches to Jumper, where they are still fighting against Clown's team, they are low on resources, and Leo laments that it was supposed to be a 4 v 1. He says that he has to dip and leaves the fight.

The POV switches back to Parrot, where they discuss how weird it was that it was taking them so long to give the signal. Parrot suggests trying to escape the control room. They go to the control room, and just as they were rummaging around, the sirens blare again. Unsure of what to do, Parrot and Wifies keep looking around. The sirens blare again, but there were only two horns this time, which concerns Parrot and Wifies. The sirens blare again  and the POV switches to Jumper, where they are still struggling against Clown's team. Derapchu and Jumper leave the fight as well, leaving Woogie alone to stall Clown's team.

The POV switches back to Parrot, where they are still trying to solve the puzzles in layer one, then go back to the jungle room. They express their concerns about it being too peaceful and wonder whether the Clown hunters have forgotten about them. Wifies asks Parrot if he has read "I Have No Mouth And I Must Scream," and tells Parrot about A.M., saying that he has been cited as "the most evil character in fiction," and that he absolutely despises his creators. Parrot interrupts Wifies, silencing him and looking up at the trees, swearing that he heard something and that he saw a nametag. Wifies shushes Parrot and whispers that he heard talking.

Ferre, Clown, and Mugm can be heard talking, which prompts Wifies and Parrot to escape to the control room. Wifies splashes the two of them with invisibility potions and they express concern of there being multiple people inside. Mugm talks about an elevator and Parrot has a flashback about the shulker box entrance. The three of them go down the entrance, while Wifies expresses concern that they'll soon be found. Clown's team starts rummaging around and destroying certain areas to look for anything noteworthy. Parrot and Wifies pearl into a wall and discover a hallway containing multiple exits labelled with letters and numbers. They seal themselves in with an obsidian wall and go to the one labelled "EXIT B5" just as Clown's team finds the same hallway. They find a water elevator room blocked by a ceiling of soil. They pearl above it and find another water elevator filled with wardens. Parrot finds an exit lined by lava but manages to get out onto the roof and flies away. They escape after Wifies pearls out.

They panic, wondering since when did Clown have a team while flying through the nether, Wifies says to take the weirdest route they can and leave no traces. They hide in a wall, assuring themselves that there's no way Clown's team will find them. Parrot and Wifies discuss the Clown hunters dipping, with Parrot lamenting the fact that they promised their safety and Wifies scorning the "safe billionaire budget unbreachable base." Parrot says that if B5 didn't work, they would've been doomed, and that he is shaking. Wifies worries about Parrot saying that Clown is gonna chase him until the end of time, Parrot says he doesn't know and that he's gonna have to have a stern talk with Leo.

Parrot and Wifies arrive at the headquarters and find Leo, Jumper, and Woogie there along with a bunch of villagers roaming around. After Parrot kills some of the villagers, they tell him to "chill." Parrot angrily scolds them on what happened earlier and the fact that they left with no warning. The Clown hunters argue that they promised to kill Clown—not to protect them, and questioned why they even care if they made it out alive. Parrot argues that they weren't safe at all, and Leo says that they weren't either, and should be happy that they're alive. Parrot and Wifies leave with Parrot saying to hit him up if they come up with a better plan. After they discuss the Clown hunters' actions, Parrot decides to live at spawn for the next few days.

Wifies goes to Parrot's base and tells him that he wants to show him something, to which Parrot agrees. Wifies leads Parrot to his base, where the outside perimeter has been bombed, saying that he saw it when he logged on, unsure if it was supposed to be a threat. He can only imagine that it was Clown who did it. He leads Parrot to a sign that says "This is your last warning." Wifies says that they need to do something or else more people would get caught as collateral. Parrot helps Wifies repair the holes while discussing why Clown would bomb Wifies' base since he isn't Clown's target. Parrot gets ambushed by Clown and tells Wifies to make an escape tunnel for him, since Clown would chase him if he flew away. Just as Parrot approaches the tunnel, Clown blocks it off, forcing Parrot to fly away with Wifies telling him to go to someone else, anyone else. Parrot stumbles upon the 
Wemmbu Civilization
 where he hides behind the city hall and whispers to Wemmbu for help. He goes down to the village, where he asks 
TheRealSquiddo
 and 
Block_Facts
 for help, but they're completely useless, so he runs around the village until Clown water buckets right in front of him. Once Parrot reaches the edge of town, he flies back to the city hall, where he asks Wemmbu for help and explains his situation. Wemmbu tells him to hide in the villager breeder. Clown spots him anyway and starts attacking. Parrot manages to run and hide as Clown flies away in an attempt to chase him.

Parrot explains his situation to Wemmbu and 
Eggchan
, but Wemmbu tells him to go to the shed so he can explain it properly without being outside their two-block-high wall. When they get to the shed, Parrot begs Wemmbu for help but then Wemmbu says that he's with the 
Zam Empire
, so Parrot gets out since he's sure that Zam hired Clown. Parrot begs Wemmbu to let him go, which Wemmbu agrees, since he didn't want any more enemies. He asks Parrot if there's anybody he could recruit to his civilization, and Parrot suggests 
Fantst
, who is still 
chunk banned
, then leaves.

His interaction with Wemmbu makes Parrot realize he could be a potential teammate, despite not having been on good terms in the past, as he heads to the headquarters where he overhears Leo, Jumper, and Woogie wanting to buy a yacht. He asks where Derapchu is, since he didn't show up last time, but none of them know. He apologized for getting mad and explains that Clown has gotten worse. He asks if they've seen Wifies, but they say that they haven'tand that Parrot should know where he is since they're always together. Parrot proposes a plan to chunk ban Clown, trapping him to kill him. He tells Leo to fetch the chunkban materials, then asks Jumper for PVP training.

While Jumper lists off ways Parrot can go up against someone more powerful than him, Wifies shows up out of nowhere and reveals that he's been living on the fourth floor of the headquarters. Wifies shows his hideout to them, and Parrot comments that he'd do the same thing if he ever ran away, but to a random jungle. Wifies asks what Parrot's doing and Parrot reveals that he's been training with Jumper and Woogie. He invites Wifies to join in on the training. The four of them talk about where Derapchu's been, since they haven't seen him since the fight and hope that he isn't held hostage. When Leo comes back, they start forming a plan. Parrot will lead Clown to the chunk ban. He makes it clear that he doesn't want Wifies to go with them so he goes home while the others fly to the castle.

At the castle, Parrot and Jumper scout ahead while Leo and Woogie make the chunk bans. After confirming that Clown and Ferre are inside, they head back and help build the chunk bans. Once they finish, the POV switches to Jumper. They all head into the castle to fight Clown, but only find Ferre before discovering that Clown is inside the obsidian box in the pile of obsidian on the throne. Clown targets Parrot and chases after him into a chunk ban. Ferre is left to 3 v 1 Leo, Jumper, and Parrot. Leo leaves mid-fight for unexplained reasons and Jumper and Parrot struggle against Ferre. Eventually, Jumper and Parrot are forced to retreat and reconvene with Leo, Woogie, and Wifies, where they discover the headquarters are destroyed. They discuss their failure to kill Clown, and Parrot asks if Clown has any sort of weakness, to which Leo brings up 
BranzyCraft
.

Leo leads the group to Branzy's mooshroom island factory, and after a bit of looking, they find him near a digging site. Parrot asks Branzy to tell Clown to stop since this hunt is starting to get out of hand and other people that have nothing to do with it are getting involved. Branzy asks what's in it for him and Parrot silently threatens him with his sword. Branzy reluctantly agrees. Parrot asks why Clown is the way he is, thinking back to when Clown said that the two of them were the same. Branzy lists out their similarities: having threatened to kill him, trying to hire him to do deadly things to trick people, and both being stronger and tougher than him. Parrot tells Branzy to forward the message to Clown: if he continues doing what he's doing, they're gonna kill him, to which Branzy laughs in his face about it. Branzy goes away, murmuring that he's gonna tell Clown what's going on right now, which prompts them to fly away.

Parrot realizes that the Clown hunters don't prioritize his safety and just wants to kill Clown. He lands on the edge of the island with the others following him. He questions whether they even have a safe place to stay on the server, which they say they don't. Parrot says that he gives up. The Clown hunters try to convince him otherwise, but Parrot is headstrong, stating that he needs a better team. Parrot flies to Wemmbu's Civilization and begs Wemmbu to protect him, explaining that he came here because Wemmbu extended the olive branch last time. They discuss how much the civilization has expanded, having six residents, including Fantst. Wemmbu asks why they should protect Parrot, and he tries to think of anything he can offer, but sees that Wemmbu is already set, so he requests Wemmbu's protection again. He asks who hired Clown, and Parrot says that it was Zam. Wemmbu questions how Parrot knows, and he says that Clown implied so. Wemmbu doesn't believe him but agrees to protect Parrot, saying that he wants to see what happens. He says that 
FlameFrags
 attacking his civilization and Clown trying to kill Parrot must be connected. They discuss the two events and plan to tell 
Merffinn
 and 
ManePear
 that Parrot is with them as a way to know for sure whether Zam can be trusted. Wemmbu asks Parrot to make some new traps that the Zam guards don't know about. Parrot proposes a flycatcher. He asks what the civilization's purpose is, to which Wemmbu says that he doesn't know.

Parrot then starts making the first three chunk bans and collects materials for more before he is interrupted by a group of players, including 
Jaden_MAN
, Flame, 
Falconu
, 
LettuceK
, 
Spongs
, and an invisible Clown. Parrot prompts Wemmbu to lead his people, who proceeds to give a war speech while Parrot periodically checks in on the enemies' status in breaking the chunk bans. They bow and TNT cannon the enemies while staying behind the walls. Their opponents start towering up above the civilization's walls to pearl in, and start fighting the civilization members. After a while, their enemies run out of resources and retreat. Wemmbu and Parrot go to the city hall to discuss how Zam is behind both the Flame and Clown attacks. Parrot leaves for Wifies's house while Wemmbu stays in his civilization to get rid of Flame.

Parrot finds Wifies fixing his lawn and asks if the Clown hunters are still mad at him, Wifies doesn't know, since he hasn't talked to them. Parrot explains what happened to the Wemmbu Civilization and says that he has a plan that he doesn't want Wifies getting involved in. Wifies protests, saying that he can't just abandon the Clown hunters, saying that they aren't good enough, then pull up again and say that he has a master plan, nore could he leave Wifies behind. Parrot is insistent asks for an invisibility potion. Wifies hesitates and asks what he's gonna use it for, but gives in after Parrot says he just wants to have one. Parrot says that there's something off, mentioning how Clown said that the two of them aren't so different. Wifies says he can't see how they're that similar, and that the only character flaw he can currently see in Parrot is that he keeps running away—or rather his insistence that he has to do everything on his own. Parrot leaves while Wifies tries to stop him, but he uses the invis potion and flies to the Clown hunters' headquarters while Wifies says that he'll talk to him sooner than he thinks.

Parrot finds the headquarters still blown up and tries to look for the Clown hunters, but only finds Woogie. Woogie questions him about his "safe spot" and Parrot replies that he got that in the Wemmbu Civilization and says that they've done more for him than the Clown Hunters have, but he still respects them. He says that he needs the Clown hunters for a new plan since the Wemmbu Civilization is preoccupied. Woogie wants Parrot to say that he needs their help Clown, and after a bit of stalling, Parrot relents. Woogie takes Parrot to an underground base where Leo and Jumper immediately attack him and tell him to leave. Parrot reveals his plan of wanting to kidnap Branzy, but Leo and Jumper hesitate, saying that they felt betrayed when Parrot abandoned them. Woogie and Parrot manage to convince them to team up again by their goal of killing Clown.

They fly to the mooshroom island and find Branzy inside the factory. Parrot makes Branzy take out his totem and pops it while the Clown hunters trap him in cobwebs and stone. Parrot threatens Branzy, saying that no matter how deadly Clown is, he'll always be his Achilles heel. Branzy asks if he can bring his cow, but is denied. They make Branzy give them anything that can help him escape, escort him back to the headquarters, and pop his totem. Woogie stays behind to guard Branzy, killing him if they don't message him in a period of time. They find Clown sitting on his throne with Ferre and try to negotiate a deal to put up a white flag in exchange for Branzy's freedom. Ferre goes to the nether and Clown tells them to just ignore him while they continue negotiating, Clown asks for a shulker of gold blocks in exchange for surrender, but they deny it and keep negotiating. Ferre comes back with an armorless Wifies, then traps him in cobwebs and obsidian, leaving to find Branzy. Parrot agrees to Branzy's. The POV switches to Woogie, who tells Branzy that he's lucky before letting him go. The POV switches to Parrot, who asks Clown if Branzy has confirmed that he's been let go, which he does. Parrot asks for Wifies to be freed, saying that Clown wouldn't kill Wifies for no reason, Clown confirms that he wouldn't without getting paid to do so and lets Wifies go. Parrot gives Wifies his elytra and rockets and hurriedly tells him to fly away before pearling away. Once they're near the sea, Wifies crashes next to Parrot and gives him his elytra back, then boats away.

Parrot flies away to a random jungle as he messages Wifies to stay safe, and Wifies promises to no longer be a liability. Parrot builds a new base that Wifies manages to find. Parrot questions how he managed to find him and Wifies mentions that Parrot said that if he ever ran away, he'd be in a jungle. Parrot is unhappy that Wifies found him, worried that he'll put him and other people in danger. Wifies says that he's already been through whatever and that he just wants to make sure Parrot's fine, to which Parrot says he's fine and tries to force Wifies to leave. Wifies hasn't left and tries to reason with Parrot that they're better as two people than just one. Parrot replies that he just wants to run away and never talk to anybody ever again, to which Wifies replies that that's an absolutely miserable existence and he may as well be banned. He tries to reason with Parrot to stop running and try to fight back and do something while Parrot keeps arguing that it would be safer for everybody without him. Wifies asks Parrot what he actually wants and Parrot says he wants to keep playing without the fear of Clown. Wifies says that Parrot should start doing what's in his best interest, Parrot says that he's still gonna need some convincing, but he's gonna keep brainstorming a plan to get rid of Clown. Parrot and Wifies dig down to discuss the two possible routes they can take: Parrot can keep on living in the jungle where Clown will never find him while Wifies goes back to live on the server, or they kill Clown, which Wifies finds a bit more desirable. He asks if Parrot has a plan, and he says to screw it and that he needs to fight Clown 1 v 1, but that he needs some kind of trick since he knows that he won't win. He tells Wifies to grab everything from his base.

Wifies comes back and immediately pots Parrot with invis and apologizes, saying that Clown's team were gonna kill him if he didn't give them Parrot's coordinates. Parrot dismisses it at first, saying that they don't care about him now that he was practically gone from the server, but hears Clown and sneaks away. Clown's team destroys his base and Parrot flies away after Wifies. They reconvene as Clown's team blows up the jungle in their search.

Parrot leads Wifies to the Wemmbu Civilization, saying that it's arguably the last safe place on the server, only to see that it's been blown up. Parrot and Wifies wander around the area while discussing what could have happened. Parrot digs into the fake vault, then leaves. When Wifies asks what it was, Parrot says that it was a lie. The POV switches to Wemmbu, showing various parts of his video (
"I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization"
) in flashback form. The POV switches to Parrot, who declares that he is gonna kill Clown and destroy everything that he cares for. 

Parrot goes back to the headquarters after making Wifies promise not to follow him 'cause it was gonna put the entire server in jeopardy. Parrot goes down the underground meeting room and declares his plan to 1 v 1 Clown and nuke his castle, to which the Clown hunters call him insane for, but follow him anyway. They blow up as much as they can using Leo's TNT while Clown and Ferre attack them with Parrot declaring the cycle will continue as long as Clown hunts him, threatening Branzy's life as well. Parrot proposes a 1 v 1 the next day, saying that this was going to keep on going until one of them ends it. Clown says that they aren't very different in the end. Parrot asks him what he means, but Clown doesn't elaborate.

Parrot flies to Wifies' base and finds him terraforming his lawn. Parrot tells Wifies his plan to 1 v 1 Clown and asks him to help him practice, but gives up after seeing how terrible he was. Wifies says that it wouldn't be dirty for Parrot to have a gimmick. Parrot asks Wifies to tell Leo to plant a bunch of TNT under Clown's castle, marked with two vertically stacked mycelium blocks. They go into Wifies' house and Parrot tells him that after their conversation, he was gonna kill Branzy, Wifies tries to change his mind, saying that it's pointless to do so, but Parrot argues that Clown doesn't care about his builds. Wifies keeps trying to convince Parrot that it would be wrong to kill Branzy and that even Clown wouldn't do it. Wifies realizes that he can't stop Parrot, and asks him to listen to himself. He tells Parrot that this is wrong and his past self wouldn't have approved. Parrot asks that if he did do it, would Wifies still think of him the same, Wifies replies that he'd still be on his side, but wouldn't think of him the same. Parrot reminds him to tell Leo to rig the castle and says he'll see Wifies later. Wifies tells him, "Don't die. Stay safe."

Parrot flies to the mooshroom island and observes Branzy for a bit, but Branzy spots him, which scares him. Parrot tells him to head into the factory, weapon in hand, as Branzy tells him that he's been cleaning and replacing the cow that he murdered. He asks how Parrot's day has been. He remains silent before asking if Branzy can show him around. As Branzy shows him a lily, Parrot interrupts and says that by the end of the tour, he'll have decided if he'll kill Branzy or not then tells him to continue. Branzy continues the tour, even more scared, and heavily emphasises things that could possibly lead to deescalation (ie. lily of peace, using levers to blow off steam, etc.). Parrot asks Branzy if the tour is over and Branzy shows him a torchflower and says "This is my flower of 'please don't kill me.'" Parrot tells Branzy to follow him onto one of the cranes. He asks Branzy, "If Clown were in my shoes, would he kill you?" to decide Branzy's fate. He answers that Clown would absolutely kill anyone and everyone except himself. Parrot fakes trying to kill him before clarifying that he won't, saying that they aren't the same person. He asks why Clown is the way he is. Branzy replies that he likes to think that Clown is misunderstood, that he just wants to show that he's the most powerful person on the server. Parrot tells him that he's gonna 1 v 1 Clown tomorrow, and Branzy wishes him luck. He asks if Branzy will tattle on him, and Branzy answers that for today only, he would not. He asks how weak Clown would be against 30, 000 TNT and how okay Branzy would be with Clown dying, saying that if he lost Wifies, he would be very upset, and he would imagine Branzy would be, too. Branzy answers that he would never be okay with it, but he would understand, and that he doesn't think that Clown would survive 30, 000 TNT. Parrot thanks Branzy and flies away.

Time skips to the next day as Parrot heads to Clown's ruined castle. They have some small talk before they begin the fight. As they're fighting, Parrot tells Clown about what happened with Branzy. He expresses surprise that Clown didn't bring any backup and accepted the 1 v 1 in the first place. They talk about honor and reputation, with Parrot saying that Clown got hired by the sleaziest person on the server and Clown replying that he doesn't care as long as he gets paid. Parrot asks Clown why he is the way he is. Clown replies that he has a job that he intends to finish. Parrot says that he isn't scared of Clown 'cause he doesn't care about being banned anymore, Clown says that that's a good coping mechanism. Parrot eventually finds the two mycelium and tells Clown that he disagrees about the fact that they aren't so different before taking out a lever and activating the trap. There are so many explosions that it lags the server, but Parrot manages to escape and fly to Wifies' base.

Parrot tells Wifies that Clown disappeared. Wifies asks if Parrot killed Branzy and he says no, then thanks Wifies for convincing him not to, because there would have been no going back from it. Parrot asks about the Clown hunters and Wifies says that he hasn't seen them around, but that they can go find them. They head to the headquarters, which are still destroyed. They go to the underground base which has also been destroyed, to their surprise. Just as they are about to fly away, Parrot spots a sign that says, "You're right... We aren't the same."

Parrot and Wifies head back to Parrot's base and find a framed 
book
 on two iron blocks. Wifies asks where they're headed next on their search for Clown.

title: I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Stalkers...
content:
I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Stalkers...














Season


2






Episode


61






Upload date


Nov 18, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


BAT arc






Featured Creators (Description)


JumperWho
Leow0ok
Mapicc














On the Unstable SMP, my suspicions had become reality.





I Got Hunted by Minecraft's Deadliest Stalkers...
 is the 88th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts with 
Spoke
 being followed by two invisible spies, he pretends not to see them following him and lures them to a secret base filled with traps. The spies took their armor off to go fully invis, but Spoke spots their particles. He goes into the base and flips a hidden lever, which turns the pressure plate to open the door into a TNT fall trap. He then goes into a secret part of the base to let them enter, however, the spies didn't fall for it. They come in and raid the base and Spoke places another lever and waits for the spies to climb down the ladder leading to his location. When he hears the ladders, he pulls the lever, causing pistons to retract the blocks the ladders were placed on, leading the spies to fall into an armor stand trap. Spoke demands them to unmute and have a talk, but they refuse to, so he uses an automated dispenser machine filled with harming potions to get a word out of them. He accidentally kills one of them and forces the other one to pop their totem to reveal their username. His plan was initially to track them down and handle the situation himself, but since the spy now talks, he uses the opportunity to find out if they're working for somebody else. Spoke demands to know why they're stalking him, and the spy says they can't tell him. Since Spoke didn't get anything out of it, he activates the potion machine again, killing the spy. The spy drops a book with Spoke's name on it, confirming that this is an investigation on Spoke.

Moments after discovering the book, 
JumperWho
 and four more spies find Spoke and demands for her dead spies armor back. Spoke is about to leave when Jumper realizes the book isn't in her or any of her spies' hands. They all corner Spoke and he tries to talk his way out of it, making himself all innocent. Jumper doesn't believe it, and Spoke places a lever and pulls another trap, breaking all the moss underneath their feet. The corner Spoke was standing on had a block beneath it, so he doesn't fall into it, and Jumper reacted quickly and pearled onto the same block. The two crouch with their shields up, trying not to get knocked off by the other. Spoke threatens to look in the book and asks what they have on him and Jumper tells him that she knows Spoke killed the two spies in the hidden base. Spoke acts oblivious and says she's accusing him of something he didn't do. Spoke remembers that the lever he just pulled also activated a hopper timer that would detonate hundreds of TNT in 5 minutes. Spoke tells Jumper they'll die in a few minutes if they don't deactivate it in time, although the two don't trust each other, Jumper lets Spoke jump down to deactivate it. Once Spoke makes it to the escape tunnel, he activates the TNT anyway and escapes with ease.

Spoke goes back to his fortress to find 
Leow0ok
 arguing with 
Mapicc
. He asks why Leo and his spies are there and Leo says they're there to bring him back to the B.A.T. Headquarters. Spoke gives Mapicc the book with his name on it and goes with Leo. When they arrive, Jumper is waiting for them, and they demanded the book back, which Spoke gave them a copy of. Jumper and Leo confront Spoke, although he wanted to admit what he did wrong, he couldn't do that anymore ever since spies started dying. The interrogation got cut short and Spoke returns back to the fortress, which is now monitored by spies at every angle. Each building Spoke went into had multiple spies inside of them. Mapicc writes to Spoke in the book he gave him that he has a plan to escape without them getting caught. Spoke gathers a few spies together inside of a building and splashes them all with invisibility, then is immediately teleported outside where Mapicc grabs Spoke and flies away with a Happy Ghast. While flying away, Spoke finally reads the book with his name on it, which confirms that the spies were instructed to monitor him at all times. Spoke says there's no evidence, but Mapicc says tons of people saw, but killing them wasn't the same. The netherite armor is the last piece of info on the case, and Mapicc asked where it is, and Spoke tells him it's stored in his ender chest, which was a lie to protect the real location of it. They then spot a spy, and Spoke goes invisible and follows them to see where they're headed. He finds that there's a hidden base underneath a tree and instructs Mapicc to set a trap while he infiltrates. He goes into the base and walks right past the spies. He discovers a bunch of books stored on a bookshelf with all of them having his name on them. The main book on the lectern says that it's a top secret book, and then realize he's infiltrating since Jumper only allows three spies to work together at a time to prevent anybody from infiltrating. However, being caught was part of his plan, and Spoke runs to the area where he got Mapicc to build the trap. He swims up a waterfall, avoiding the corner. When the spies swam up, they hit the corner, which aligned their hitboxes with a hundred hidden boats that was barely sticking out of the wall, causing them to fling away. A spy dies while the other survives. Spoke, knowing that B.A.T. would be alerted of another death, runs quickly and returns to Mapicc and flies off. While up in the air, he reads the book he took from the secret base, which revealed the coordinates to the vault filled with archives. With it being only a few thousand blocks away, they couldn't just walk in, so they needed a disguise. The idea of disguising as a dead spy was out of the question, so Spoke has an idea to lure a spy to be by themselves where they wouldn't be seen by any other spies. They both then spot two new players and Spoke goes to talk to them. He says he's a spy and would protect them and asks them if there's anybody to take care of. One of them says there is somebody he can get take care of, but because he was offering this for free, he asks the person that put out the hit to come to the set of coordinates listed in the book in 90 minutes.

Spoke and Mapicc go back to their fortress, Jumper is there awaiting them and asks them where they were. Spoke goes to rename the top secret book as a "list of materials", and then heads into the Nether with Mapicc. They jump into a body of lava, which has a hidden tunnel dug underneath. Spies follow them from above, and Spoke tells Mapicc to let them follow them. He tells Mapicc at the end of the tunnel splits into two paths, Mapicc is to go left through the portal, splash invisibility, count down to thirty seconds and flick the lever and run. Mapicc turns left and one spy follows him. Spoke goes right and the other two follow him, at the end of the right tunnel is a dead end, and Spoke uses this time to restock his inventory with potions. Once the thirty seconds are up, Mapicc flicks the lever, which activates a dispenser to shoot a bunch of wind charges up into the air, which set off a stasis Spoke set up all the way in the air. Spoke and Mapicc then jump the spy that went through the portal, and they end up killing the spy. 

Spoke takes up the identity of the spy they just killed, and the other two catch up to him thinking he's the other spy and asks what happened. Spoke says he got jumped by two diamond players and clears Mapicc's name, and the others say that they should report back to Jumper. They walk all the way there, and go into a cave, where the vault full of archives is located. Jumper asks them to write their usernames to identify that they are who they are, and Spoke writes Kimchandler26, the name of the dead spy, and successfully gets by. Jumper instructs them to organize a bunch of books, with a bunch of them being about Spoke. He opens up some of the books, which shows that they know that Spoke griefed the village, killed all the witnesses, and about the family he regularly visits. There's a book in a lectern that says Leo's frustrated that the spies don't have enough evidence to kill Spoke, and that he thinks the armor isn't needed to convict Spoke, and would rather send an army of spies to kill him. Spoke and Jumper get to somewhere more private and he asks Jumper why the armor is needed to convict Spoke and why don't they listen to Leo and kill Spoke now. Jumper explains how before B.A.T. moved to the amplified lands, 
one of the former members
 was wrongfully convicted of something, and 
Jumper was the only one who went behind Leo's back to actually find the truth
 before actually convicting someone, and Leo has always been the one to jump to whatever he wants. Jumper's belief is that if Spoke does have the armor pieces, then he does deserve to be killed, if not, then there's no reason for him to. 

Leo shows up and informs Jumper about another death of a spy, and they go elsewhere to have a private conversation. Spoke tries to follow along, but Jumper says not to follow, so he goes fully invis to listen in. He eavesdrops, and Leo says that one of the spies is pretending to be a spy, but Jumper is skeptical since that's hard to pull off. Jumper tells Leo that they need the evidence to convict Spoke, but Leo says everything has gone downhill ever since Spoke has joined and that's enough evidence to kill him. They then head to interrogate the spies, Leo wants them to take off their invisibility, but Jumper says the never do that, so she asks them what they were doing before heading to the vault. Jumper asks Spoke, still disguised as Kimchandler26, to go first and he says he was chasing Spoke and Mapicc until he was jumped by two random people. When Jumper asks the other spy where they were, Spoke edits their sign to say that they're Spoke. Leo thinks that the spy is actually Spoke and begins to get angry, Spoke runs out of the vault and out the cave, where the player he talked to earlier had just arrived. He quickly gives her the Netherite armor and splashes her with invisibility, and right after Leo and Jumper kill the player thinking it was Spoke. Leo knows Spoke is up to this, but Jumper says there's not enough proof to know that Spoke was connected to it, Leo had enough of it and leaves. 

This was the end of Spoke's story, he would say the two players that asked for a bounty planned to betray, their first victim being Mapicc, who would manage to escape. Spoke would then be jumped by one of the two, but would defeat them. Jumper and Leo could only assume the other one was the actual infiltrator, only to rob B.A.T., which would clear Spoke's name. Spoke knew Jumper would defend him if Leo tried to kill him unless they found where the armor actually is.

Spoke returns to Quackenstein and his family to give them more resources, and they begin to build a clock tower. In the midst of building, Spoke sees Leo watching them. He goes to Leo and tries to make small talk, but Leo stays silent. As Spoke is about to leave, Leo finally speaks. He asks how the family obtained their armor, and Spoke tells them that he gifted it to them way before he joined B.A.T., Leo then asks what they mean to Spoke, since he's seen Spoke give them a lot. Leo then says he knows that Spoke has the items, and Spoke tries to say he's already explained everything, but Leo has had enough of his lies. Leo tells Spoke if he doesn't give up the armor, he would send spies to talk to them. Spoke asks if Leo is threatening him, Leo says, "I don't know, am I?" and flies off.

My teammates
 are some of the most Elite Minecraft Bounty Hunters on the entire server. They're experts at strategy, combat and player tracking. Yet for some reason, they now want me dead. This is How I Got Hunted by Minecraft Bounty Hunters.





I Got Hunted by Minecraft Bounty Hunters
 is the 34th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Parrot enters his room to find a chest containing two stacks of pearls, an invisibility potion, and a sign reading "Run." Suddenly, he receives mining fatigue effect. The entire BAT team storms in, blasting through all the walls in search of Parrot. However, he has concealed himself on top a massive circular lamp on the ceiling. Failing to locate him, they depart, allowing Parrot to relocate to a house 10,000 blocks away from the base. Yet, within minutes, he is discovered.

It turns out that Parrot was framed as being The Director.

"You have 60 seconds to come out!" The team hesitates to enter, suspecting a trap. During this time, Parrot constructs a Nether portal and escapes to the Nether roof, with the team hot on his heels. He uses wind charges to propel himself forward with his elytra, successfully evading capture.

After hours of wandering, Parrot discovers an abandoned city. There, he encounters an invisible player—JumperWho, leader of BAT's spy team. She explains that she had saved Parrot through the chest. When he expresses doubt, she confirms the chest's contents: two stacks of pearls and an invisibility potion.

"Parrot, I care only about the truth. I know you've been framed," she asserts. "I'll take you to the base to show you why they believe you're The Director."

The plan is to introduce Parrot as a new spy with the codename "Alkaline." They proceed to the spy hall but are intercepted by Leowo0k and Derapchu. Jumper explains that she's showing the base to a new spy. In the library, they find a book stating that Any spy who hears the emergency signal—a horn with the "Call" sound —must report to the person who issued the signal. After moving on, she leads him to a secret underground room, turns the lights on, and outlines three reasons for the suspicion:



A letter from The Director to the team that matches Parrot's writing style.


Witnesses, including ItzRealMe, ashwagg, and others, claim he is The Director.


Most compellingly, the book MrCube delivered in prison on The Director's behalf mentioned the dandelion just placed in the cell. This implies that either The Director had magical knowledge of events inside, or Parrot is The Director.


In the corridor, Leowo0k confronts JumperWho and the invisible player again.

"We're conducting a spy check," announces the BAT leader.

Parrot is taken to a room where he and several other invisible players line up.

"When I give the signal, you must take up a green shield. If you don't have one, you're a mole."

Parrot lacks such a shield.

"Why didn't JumperWho tell me about this?" he wonders.

Fortunately, JumperWho distracts Leowo0k. Everyone exits the room. Parrot notices several green banners placed on the wall and crafts a green shield from one. Upon their return, the leader gives the command. However, only Parrot's shield is green.

"Parrot!" exclaims Leowo0k, realizing that only an outsider would deliberately use the banners from the wall. In the ensuing chase, Parrot escapes using the launch chambers.

Back in the abandoned city, Parrot finds a book left by The Director, stating they will meet at this location in 24 hours. He shows the book to JumperWho. The plan is to bring BAT to observe the meeting, proving Parrot isn't The Director. However, Jumper mentions an important team meeting about the current issue that Parrot must attend. He asks why she can't just tell him what happened, but she provides no clear answer.

"Do you trust me?" she asks.

Parrot hesitates but affirms. JumperWho then gives him materials to spawn multiple withers.

"She's gone too far to prove my innocence," he thinks.

They head to the meeting hall, which Parrot himself built to guard against MrCube. It features 5-block-thick obsidian walls, a 52-block cubic structure, and floor lighting activated by stepping on it. In the center are several blocks and chairs for participants. JumperWho instructs her friend to eavesdrop from a glass pane near the ceiling. All BAT team leaders enter and ascend the podium. Their speeches lack significance, raising Parrot's suspicion of a trap. Indeed, Jumper looks up along with everyone else.

"Jumper, you betrayed me!" Parrot exclaims in disbelief.

A battle ensues. Parrot must escape the massive cube with its 5-block-thick obsidian walls. He recalls the wither materials JumperWho provided earlier.

"You're incredibly stupid!" Parrot declares.

He spawns as many withers as possible to break the obsidian, but to no avail. He then approaches the entrance, likely blocked by Leowo0k with only a single layer of obsidian. This escape attempt also fails. Amid the chaos, Parrot manages to hide in the water-filled space beneath the room.

Back in the abandoned city, Jumper approaches Parrot, who refuses to speak with her. After she explains the situation, they restore their trust. She had to prove her loyalty to the team after bringing Parrot into the base. To do so, she had to set a trap for him but intentionally gave him the wither materials to facilitate his escape.

"Ah, now I understand why you're the leader of the spy team. You're a double double agent!" says Parrot.

Suddenly, an explosion is heard—someone is nearby. It's undoubtedly a spy. All seems lost; there's no way to stop him from reporting to Leowo0k. Parrot remembers the book from the BAT library, stating that every spy must respond immediately to a horn signal. The strategy works—a visible player appears right in front of the massive central structure. Parrot immediately attacks. They trap him in a small box to prevent escape. JumperWho faces a dilemma: kill the spy or let him go, risking the operation.

"We have to kill him!" Parrot insists.

JumperWho resists. "What's the alternative?" he asks rhetorically.

Parrot watches as Jumper is forced to kill one of her own. On the grave, she places a sign reading, "In truth, there's always something that keeps it from being perfect. Jumper."

She sets off to gather the team, telling Parrot, "Whether you've manipulated us or not, I care about the truth and nothing else. Whether you're The Director or not!"

Leowo0k, Derapchu, Nufuli, JumperWho, and several invisible players arrive at the location, just outside the entrance of the ruined structure. Parrot stands in the center.

Suddenly, an invisible figure appears—wearing full netherite armor with white trims.

It's The Director. His voice is masked by a voice changer.

The conversation between them is brief, but revealing:

Parrot:
 "Can you tell me why you wrote that book and why you showed up? After everything you've done? Why now?"

The Director:
 "Right now, you need me more than I need you. This is the only way to prove to your team that you're not The Director. Otherwise, I wouldn't have shown up, would I?"

Parrot:
 "Why did you kill Wifies?"

The Director:
 "Because I had to."

Parrot:
 "He was my friend!"

The Director:
 "That's why I had to kill him."

Parrot:
 "Take off the voice changer. Look at yourself, bro! You killed Wifies and then sent everyone after me! How did you know about the dandelion?!"

The Director:
 "You won’t understand, just like you won’t understand many other things, Parrot. And that’s how it should be."

Parrot:
 "Take off the voice changer."

The Director:
 "The voice changer isn't for me. It's for you. If you knew who I was, you wouldn't be angry. You’d be terrified. Maybe one day, but not today."

Parrot:
 "Who are you, man?"

The Director:
 "Who do you think I am, Parrot?"

Before Parrot can respond, the entire BAT team jumps into action, attacking the invisible figure. The Director vanishes.

As they search the area, they come across the grave of the spy JumperWho had to eliminate.

"It was him or us!" Parrot declares firmly.

"You killed one of your own?!" Leowo0k exclaims, unable to believe it. "That's unacceptable! What even happened here?!"

JumperWho explains everything.

"This is NOT how we operate! The question isn’t whether you wanted to do it—it’s whether you DID!" Leowo0k shouts in frustration. Then he asks, "Why are we working against each other?"

Parrot snaps. "Leo! Don't get me even started! Look at yourself, bro!"

"You guys were the ones who first decided that Parrot was The Director!" JumperWho states bluntly.

"Jumper, you might be right, but we can no longer trust you. You can no longer be part of our team," Leowo0k declares. Then he asks, "Jumper, do you regret what you did?"

"No. Because it was the right thing to do" JumperWho replies.

Without another word, she takes off—flying over the ocean.

content:

We were exploring an abandoned town when we were attacked by a Minecraft Hacker: a player who is able to fly, teleport, and do all sorts of other crazy unfair things. This is How I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Hacker.





I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Hacker
 is the 40th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.   



Plot


Parrot
, 
Nufuli
, and 
Leow0ok
 stumble upon an abandoned city that seems deserted by its residents. A player named 
TruOriginal
 appears. The three ask him what happened here, and he replies that he massacred the population because he was bored, and now he will kill them too. Leow0ok goes up to him for the first strike, but TruOriginal moves away quite quickly. His movements are not normal for a regular Minecraft character. TruOriginal is using hacks. To defeat him, they will need a cunning strategy. The leader of BAT pulls a fishing rod, which activates an orbital strike weapon. For a moment, the entire city is blown up by TNT, while the three stand in the completely untouched center. However, the opponent turns out to be above them, with flying hacks enabled. The battle moves into the water. The three swim, exchanging a helmet to breathe, while the hacker walks on water as if it were a solid block. Parrot spots an ocean monument. This is their ticket out of there. They go inside, blocking off the entrance and corridors, relying on the mining fatigue to slow down TruOriginal. They build a Nether portal and escape there with elytras.

Leowo0k, Nufuli, and Parrot find the massive BAT base in ruins. Derapchu and a player named 
Ciguato
 appear. They explain that some hacker came, killed everyone, and destroyed the base. Before the conversation starts, Ciguato shoots two creepers with a regular bow. But there's no way a regular bow can kill a creeper in one hit. When Parrot shares his thoughts, Ciguato's appearance changes to TruOriginal's, and his name does too. A fight begins, in which the hacker seems to retreat, and the three barricade themselves in the center of the grass field located in the middle of the base. But then TruOriginal digs up the blocks beneath them with one click – he uses cheats for breaking several blocks at once. The team ends up in a system of tunnels designed as a trap. However much they try, there is no way to escape – they can't get out via a tunnel or a pearl. The only way out seems to be a sacrifice – Leo is ready for this. Nufuli decides to join him, but the other two convince him to escape with them. Leow0ok's death message does not appear. Parrot, Nufuli, and Derapchu climb to the surface and establish themselves at a location pre-set as an emergency location. There they decide not to report the hacker to the server administrators because they suspect he has a connection to 
The Director
, and this way they can get more information about him.

Miraculously, Leow0ok arrives at the location. His armor is broken. The four build an underground base and cover it with lava so it won't be detected by x-ray. The next goal is to go to the trading 
Redstone Town
, to buy the materials needed to build a "polygon mirror receiver". 
This is an innovation in Minecraft redstone that can perform any function, provided it is activated - this happens only if the one who built it (and consequently threw a pearl inside) looks towards a specific angle set by them.


The shop owner 4CVIT asks for payment for the materials, but Parrot and Nufuli don't have diamonds. When Leo enters the shop, the owner doesn't hesitate to give him the components for the machine because the two are old friends who have built traps together in the past. On the way back to the base, they notice the hacker flying in circles above their perimeter. There is also a huge farm there. The four decide to hide there to blend in with the plants and thus confuse the opponent. On the walls, there are signs with the text "Do Not Enter". Despite this, the players enter, cover themselves among the lavenders there, but the property owners - two unarmed farmers - reveal their position by talking to them. Then TruOriginal lands and a battle begins.

Nufuli suggests trapping the opponent with cobwebs, but Leow0ok is skeptical. The battle doesn't go well, especially when TruOriginal uses cheats to clone himself. The confusion is absolute. The farmers' shouts accompany the action in annoying manner. Then the cobweb strategy turns out to be successful - the hacker's true figure is revealed. The team also uses TNT minecarts to break TruOriginal's first totem. However, the resources of the four also start to run out. TruOriginal declares he's leaving, simply flying off towards the horizon.

The team is too tired. The time is 2 AM. We learn that no one leaves the server because it wouldn't be possible to join again due to the huge number of players. At 5 AM, Parrot notices Nufuli talking in a monologue on the surface while guarding the base. The two pay attention to the only pair of twin stars in the sky.

In the morning, they go to the location where the orbital strike weapon is built. They build a polygon mirror receiver, through which it can be activated unnoticed. This task is entrusted to Nufuli. He sets the viewing angle to where the two twin stars will appear on the horizon. He must activate the system only when Leow0ok orders him to. The team goes to a location where TruOriginal will certainly notice them.

After a long wait, he appears. In the battle, the four manage to play it well, as if pretending to lose. "I am God, I am invincible" - TruOriginal behaves arrogantly. Parrot lures the hacker to the coordinates where the strike will pierce everything down to bedrock. Nufuli activates the weapon. Just before the explosion, however, the most impossible thing happens - TruOriginal swaps his position with Parrot's. Now the hero has 5 seconds to avoid certain death. Using two chorus fruit, he manages to escape. Now, however, they are unarmed against a hacker who can even slow down time. They use a trick to defeat him - they bluff that they have a second charged strike ready. TruOriginal retreats.

During the night, Parrot and Nufuli are on shift to guard the shelter. Because of Derapchu's loud snoring, they decide to guard on the surface. Without great surprise, TruOriginal finds them. The battle is relatively light. "Come, hit me, I turned off my kill aura" - the hacker tempts Parrot. The hit turns out to be a fatal mistake - Parrot's entire inventory is cleared, but for some unknown reason, TruOriginal simply flies thousands of blocks up. Then he swaps his position with Parrot. Everything seems lost. The hero is approaching the ground. In fractions of a second, a blurry figure of a flying horse appears in the air. Parrot manages to get onto the horse, which is ridden by Nufuli - he saved his friend's life. The two can't believe it. During the flight, they are not pursued. Nufuli says he wants to be like Leowo0k. Parrot gives the following lesson: 
"He became Leo because he acted like himself and made his own decisions. You spend so much time trying to be him that you forget who 
you
 are."


Parrot and Nufuli return to the base only to discover that the others are missing and there is a sign that reads "Meet me at BAT". They assume their friends are trapped. They gather TNT, make TNT minecarts, and place them under the entire base. Surprisingly, they meet Leow0ok. He doesn't answer most of their questions, which raises the suspicion that this is TruOriginal. Their suspicions are correct. The fight reaches the field at the BAT base. Parrot and Nufuli climb up with blocks and build an obsidian platform. The hacker pushes them, and they activate the trap. His arrogance knows no bounds: 
"The Director told me to keep you alive, but it has become boring now. I will kill you, I am above the Director! Anything you want to say?"
.

Nufuli immediately understands what Parrot means. He looks at the stars, more precisely at the only twin pair. The BAT base begins to disappear layer by layer. This is a strike from the orbital strike weapon. The falling TNT kills TruOriginal. The battle is won.

The two find their friends in the base's prison. They go to the front, where Nufuli declares that he wants to leave the team. 
"I cannot be my own version of myself. Don't get me wrong. We are friends, but sometimes I feel like I don't even know who I am."
 Leowo0k, tearfully, shows understanding. Nufuli says goodbye to the team and leaves.

At that same moment, however, a row of arrows pierce him fatally. This is a railgun. Behind them appears an invisible figure in netherite armor, colored in white trims - The Director. Leow0ok is angry: "You killed my best friend!". Parrot's fate had now befallen him.

"Here we meet again. I killed Nufuli because he stopped serving his purpose. Soon you and Derapchu will not be needed either," the Director states firmly.

"What do you want from us?" - the question is rhetorical.

"You know what I want from you, Parrot. You've known it from the start, but you are simply terrified of the truth. Now the story is coming to a close."

"Who are you?" - asks Leowo0k.

"You will find out who I am very, very soon. And when you do, all this will end!" - these are the Director's last words for the video, and they start to go after The Director to try and kill him.



Analysis


The moral of the story conflicts with the Season 2's motive - teamwork. Another philosophic problem regarding the series.


It is not clear whether The Director has intentions of killing Parrot - he says "this will end", which could refer just to the "game of cat and mouse". We learn from TruOriginal's words that The Director has told him to keep Parrot alive - another support for the upper statement.


Near the end of this video, TruOriginal states that he didn’t care that The Director said not to kill Parrot, and says that he will. Nufuli activates the orbital strike cannon, killing Tru before he got the chance to, essentially saving Parrot.

MrCube6
 is widely known as a Minecraft Redstone Genius, being able to build anything he wants using Redstone. And for some reason, he wants me dead. This is How I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius.





I Got Hunted by a Minecraft Redstone Genius
 is the 31st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Parrot
 receives an emergency signal in his room. He checks all over the BAT base and find 
MrCube6
. MrCube traps him into a void trap disguised as a lava trap. MrCube taunts Parrot. Parrot tries to escape the void trap using pearls but fails to do so. 
Derapchu
 saves Parrot by mining into the obsidian. The rest of BAT enter the room and 
Leowook
 wasn't happy with Derapchu despite being unaware of the void trap. The entire team discuss about MrCube until they see an invisible player. Parrot suspects the invisible player to be MrCube, or someone working with him. Parrot had thought about interrogating them about The Director. Parrot decided to switch the topic and talk about practicing redstone in the courtyard, with the intention of catching MrCube in the act. 

Parrot sends a message to everyone in BAT to meet him at 10 AM in the courtyard but he intended for them to come earlier to catch MrCube in the act. However since Derapchu was missing they decided to try to catch him anyways until they find Derapchu. Derapchu explains it's a "Wire Trap", that if he steps off the pressure plate he is standing on the entirety of the base will blow up including him. MrCube gives them 20 minutes to try to defuse the bomb and also tells them that he built a bomber tank to blow up his base. Parrot defuses the bomb while the rest of BAT destroys the bomber tank. 

After the meeting it turned out that MrCube was tampering with the messaging system as Parrot tested the messaging and entered Leowook and Derapchu's rooms however they didn't receive any messages. Parrot made a meeting room and showed everyone the room. Parrot had also explained the entire message tampering and the book that Parrot had sent to Derapchu and had also explained how to catch someone trying to sneak into the meeting room. Parrot messaged one of the spies to try to sneak in to their conversation and he tells the spy to drink milk. Parrot knew it wasn't a spy and it was MrCube. MrCube drinks milk to remove his invisibility and the rest of BAT imprison him. Derapchu watches over MrCube while the rest of BAT have a conversation where Parrot explains that MrCube was probably hired by The Director. They return to the prison to question Cube about his ties with The Director. However, MrCube escaped while Derapchu was trapped and he told them that he had to go to the bathroom for 30 minutes, the cell then gets blown up by a trap from MrCube.  

BAT finds out that the armoury had been robbed by MrCube. Leowook blames it on Derapchu for not watching MrCube. Leowook sends Parrot and Derapchu to get the items back and Derapchu saw this as an opportunity to prove himself since he had been getting blamed for everything. Parrot and Derapchu find MrCube transporting the stolen items and they follow the rails to a town called 
Redstone Town
. They see 4CVIT helping MrCube secure the stolen items so they question 4CVIT regarding the stolen items. 4CVIT tells them that they were in the underground section of his base in a vault. He told them that if someone stepped on the wrong pressure plate, the vault will blow up killing everyone. Parrot and Derapchu safely make it through the vault however, 4CVIT told them that they had been wasting their time that there were no explosives. Parrot and Derapchu try to return the items to the base until a team of bandits, run by Mixiku steal some of their items. Parrot and Derapchu and kill all of the Bandits, excluding Mixiku, who runs away. On their way back to BAT headquarters Derapchu asks Parrot to let him take all of the credit for saving the items, and when Parrot refuses, Derapchu confesses that he wishes his teammates saw him differently. Parrot tells Derapchu that if he doesn't want Leowook to see him as a bad teammate he has to stop looking at himself that way.   

After heading back to BAT headquarters Leowook is impressed that Derapchu and Parrot had managed to bring back the items. After heading back to his room, Parrot receives a book from MrCube telling him that he wants to meet him and take no one with him. Parrot meets with MrCube at the location he wanted to meet him with the items MrCube wanted him to take with him. MrCube is impressed on how Parrot managed to survive all of his traps. The void trap, the Derapchu trap, etc. and also makes fun of Derapchu. MrCube explained to Parrot that he had to enter one of the 12 hallways and if he entered the wrong one, he would blow up. However, Parrot stands still and notices that all of the hallways had blown up. Derapchu appears out of nowhere and tells MrCube that he had been detained. After they imprison MrCube again, they interrogate MrCube and ask him questions regarding The Director. MrCube doesn't tell them any useful information so they leave him there to die. Jumper gives him a dandelion and MrCube gives Parrot a book from The Director. While Parrot reads the book, MrCube teleports away from the cell randomly and there's a page that says "I don't think he's a big fan of dandelions anyway". The Director also tells Parrot that he is going to meet up with him. Parrot tells BAT that he doesn't care about what he has to do and that he's going to kill The Director.

ItzRealMe
 is undisputedly the #1 ranked Minecraft player in the entire world. And he wants me dead... This is How I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player.





I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
 is the 29th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


Upon exit of his house, 
Parrot
 finds a player named 
ItzRealMe
, the #1 best Minecraft Player in the world at PVP, who immediately attacks him. Parrot attempts to flee to an escape route, but finds it has been blocked up. However, the bounty hunters 
Leowook
, 
JumperWho
, 
Nufuli
, and 
Derapchu
 arrive with intent to kill Itz, though manage to escape by throwing a turtle master potion on him. The five flee to the nether, but when Parrot attempts to part ways, Leo tells him to come along back to their base, 
BAT Headquarters
—shaped like an infinity symbol and housing over thirty members—where they tell him it’s best to stay with them for now because if Itz is trying to kill Parrot, it’s likely he’ll chase him down, and BAT can kill Itz when he comes. Using automated chicken blasters, Parrot and Leo return to the former’s base to collect his remaining belongings. However, after finding that a chest beneath a tree now has one more dirt block than it did before, Parrot gets paranoid and leads Leo to the back of the house, explaining in voiceover that the pressure plate which opens his main door is connected to said chest, dropping another block in every time someone enters. If the infiltrant were to enter and exit, two blocks would be dropped, but since there is only one, it means someone is still inside. Looking through the back window, they do in fact find Itz stalking the front door. No longer caring about the items, Parrot and Leo leave. Since Itz is patient and likely won’t move, they devise a plan to build an enclosure around the house. 

In the meantime, Nufuli shows Parrot to his room "A5", a two story master sweet. He also explains that each of Leo’s close friends run their own team inside of BAT Headquarters. Jumper leads a spy team that keeps tabs on everything on the server. Derapchu’s team is “not worth explaining.” Nufuli himself is Leo’s right hand man, responsible for combat and base-related tasks.

After ensuring that Nufuli won’t tell Leo about this question, Parrot asks for the room number of the lead builder who will be overseeing the enclosure—C1. After Nufuli leaves, Parrot immediately gets to work on sending a private message to the builder, asking for suspended wall height to accommodate sand walls. Upon arrival at the trap, Parrot is pleased at the changes that have been made, and thus the group—Leo’s team as well as five additional invisible players—enter. They taunt Itz, and begin fighting. The sand walls then activate, and Parrot explains that he understood ten players would still not be enough to kill Itz, so he decided to shrink the playing field so that Itz cannot isolate any player or get away for long enough to restock. However, after Itz manages to mace five players, killing them, Parrot realizes that the tables have turned. No matter how many times they break his armor, he seems to replace them without needing a shulker. After returning to BAT Headquarters, Leo gets mad at Parrot for interfering with his plans, and that he should’ve said something because they are a team. Right before Parrot leaves to his room, Leo places him on house arrest, and under no circumstance will he do anything without first alerting someone, but Parrot disagrees by saying that he works alone.

He then leaves the base in the middle of the night with intent to do recon on Itz, only to be stopped by Leo who catches him in the chicken blaster room, and sternly says he shouldn’t be doing it alone, and the only reason he enforced communication is because they’re meant to be a team. After failing to convince Parrot to stay, Leo ends up coming with him. When asked what he’s going to do, Leo says he won’t intervene, but he will keep Parrot safe and help if help is required. Parrot coldly dismisses the latter, to which Leo mutters that “this isn’t how a team should work.” Upon being asked more questions, Parrot gets annoyed, and explains that during the prison building process, Parrot got one of Jumper’s lackeys to leave a fake postage box in the prison in hopes of Itz finding and picking it up, as it contains a fake set of coordinates and a map that Parrot can use to track him. However, as they near Itz’ location, his icon disappears, which means that he must know they’re here. After going fully invisible, Parrot and Leo spot an unfamiliar player named 
DylPickleYT
 on the shore and begin following them, discovering that he knows Itz and insists on being trained by him. Though Itz declines over and over, Dyl then says he has valuable information in exchange, thus pointing out Parrot and Leo who are spying on them. Parrot decides to fight and tells Leo not to get involved, not even taking the potions offered, but Leo begins helping anyway, knowing that Parrot will die otherwise. They begin using TNT minecarts to deal damage on Itz, popping two of his totems and forcing him to switch to mace attacks. At that, Parrot and Leo leave.

Upon a moment of reflection, Leo asks Parrot why he always wants to be alone, and Parrot, who asks if it seems like he’s trying to be, explains that after the war, two of his best friends were killed, and that he doesn’t want to put himself through that again. Leo understands, but he says having a team is better because when you’re part of one, you always have someone to watch your back and will help no matter what. He apologizes for getting mad about the sand trip, and extends Parrot an invitation to permanently stay at BAT Headquarters and work with the people there. However, Parrot grows hostile and says that the only reason they’re working together is for the common goal of killing Itz. Leo concedes and says that the offer will always stand. They return to headquarters where Parrot, once in his room, mutters about them thinking he’s stupid, and blames them for getting caught in the first place. However, his mailbox begins ringing. Instead of taking the message, he breaks the note block.

The next day, he receives mining fatigue, and discovers further that everybody is gone and Itz has arrived. With no way out, Parrot blocks the door to his suite and hides under the stairs, begging for help. Then he begins mining through the suite wall, hoping to reach the one beside it. Each suite is connected, so if he is able to break through enough of them, he will reach the airlock and be able to escape. He eventually reach the airlock, but just as he begins to mine out, Itz catches him. Knowing that his diamond pickaxe wouldn’t be able to mine faster than Itz’ netherite one, Parrot resigns, only to be saved by Leo and his team, who fly back and explode the airlock. Itz leaves. Leo then explains that they found Parrot through Jumper’s intelligence team. Overwhelmed by gratitude, Parrot apologizes for going behind their backs, and genuinely thanks everyone at BAT. Leo then welcomes him into the team.

While in his room, Parrot hears someone cough, and finds Itz standing above him. He quickly pulls the emergency button, but Itz tells him to relax by saying that since Parrot has a team now, it’s too much trouble to try and kill him. Parrot asks why he’s here and Itz explains that the reason he tried to kill him was because 
The Director
 told him to. He won’t try to kill Parrot anymore, but he does alert him that more people will be coming with the same intent, and tells him to run while he still can. Nufuli arrives right after Itz leaves, asking what happened, but Parrot lies and says he just accidentally clicked it, not fully trusting the team yet.



Trivia


This video has the first reference to 'the zone' as mentioned in Flame's 
I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
. When the prison was built around Itz, Itz says that he was meditating, which is one of the steps to enter the zone.
