After our heist went wrong, we were trapped inside the walls of a massive mining city. Forced to collect diamond blocks until the end of time, we have one goal: escape. This is the story of how I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City.





I Survived Minecraft's Most Corrupt City
 is the 18th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The video begins with 
Parrot
, 
Wifies
 and 
Dean
 attempting to rob one of 
Reddoons
' vaults in 
Capital City
. They get caught by Reddoons and 
5 invisible guards
. Reddoons tells them to clear all their inventories or else they will all die so they proceed in clearing their inventories. Reddoons leads them to the top of his tower and makes them prove they don't have any items smuggled with them by using boats and tells them that if they want to get out, they would need to complete a quota of 10 000 diamond blocks. Reddoons leads them to the mining section of the city. Parrot uses his spyglass in front of Reddoons and he tells him to give him the spyglass or else he will double his quota. Parrot doesn't care about his quota being doubled as long as he keeps his spyglass. Reddoons says he will double the quota of everyone instead and because of Parrot's selflessness, he gives Reddoons the spyglass.  

After the guards leave, Parrot, Wifies, and Dean try to escape by using boats but they get caught by the guards. Reddoons tells Parrot, Wifies and Dean that he will increase the quota to 10 000 diamond blocks per person because of them attempting to escape. Reddoons shows them a vault with tons of diamond blocks with a diamond trimmed Mafia member guarding the room. After getting dismissed, Parrot tries to leave again but Wifies tells him not to because he has to get his spyglass back. 

Wifies gives Parrot a spare spyglass and they explore the mining city. They meet their fellow miners such as 
Ratrick
, 
Pika
 and 
LuigiToan
. They also meet their warden 
CoinMonke
. Parrot goes mining with Luigi. While they were mining, Parrot finds an emerald and gives it to Luigi as a gift for teaching him about what life in Capital City is like. 

During night time, CoinMonke orders everyone to pay him everything they mined. The best payment for the day was 
dizzyu
 as he mined 32 diamonds (3 diamond blocks and 5 diamonds). Parrot tells Luigi not to give away the emerald. After Parrot and Luigi show CoinMonke their payments and he gets disappointed especially at Luigi. The next day, as Luigi tries to guide Parrot more, they get interrupted by CoinMonke telling them to start mining. Without a choice they proceed in doing so. Luigi finds diamonds however he chooses to split the diamonds with Parrot and Dean. They show the diamonds to CoinMonke and CoinMonke is impressed but tells them to keep going. Parrot, Dean and Luigi consider entering CoinMonke's house. Luigi warns them not to but they do it anyways. They get caught by CoinMonke. Wifies gets concerned about what Parrot, Dean and Luigi had been up to and Parrot lies to him saying that he was "just mining".

During their conversation Parrot has an idea to break in to one of the vaults. Parrot asks his fellow miners how badly they want to escape Mining City until they get interrupted by Ratrick saying that he found something crazy in his house. Parrot, Wifies, Dean and Luigi get interested in what he was talking about however CoinMonke tells everyone to start mining again.

Parrot, Wifies, Dean meet Luigi and tell him that they are going to Capital City to break into their vault. Parrot asks Luigi if he can cover for them while breaking into one of their vaults. Luigi agrees as long as they tell him what's in the city. While exploring Capital City, they notice most of the buildings are empty. They enter an art museum but they exit because they don't find it interesting. Upon exiting, Dean points out how the building they had just entered is one of the only furnished buildings which makes Parrot realize that the furnished buildings may have vaults in them. They enter another furnished building which appears to be a library. Parrot notices that most of the walls are chiseled bookshelves while one of them are just regular bookshelves. Wifies also notices a chiseled bookshelf on the wall with normal bookshelves and as they pick up a book, a door opens. At first it doesn't appear to be a vault but after some digging they chests with diamond blocks in them. They steal all the diamonds that they can get and return to Mining City however, during their trip they see Invis Mafia members roaming around. After returning to Mining City, Luigi gets concerned about why they were late and he also splits the diamonds he got to pay the warden. After entering a mine, Parrot gives Luigi all the diamonds he stole and tells them to give them to Coin so that he can leave. Luigi refuses and tells them to give them anyone who has been in Mining City for longer than he has. Parrot gives PikaTM all the diamonds he stole and tells him to give them all to CoinMonke. During payment time, Pika gives CoinMonke all the diamond blocks Parrot, Wifies and Dean gives them. CoinMonke lets Pika out of Mining City.

The next day, Parrot asks Luigi to cover for them again as they would be robbing the vault again. As they enter the vault they steal as much diamonds they can get again. During the heist Dean gets stuck in pistons. As Parrot mines the pistons they realize that they have to fix the door before Reddoons finds out about the door. When they return to mining city it is night time. Parrot, Wifies and Dean notice Luigi is missing. After he finds Luigi they continue paying Coin what they got from mining. The next day Parrot asks the miners about their quotas and they give 
LettuceK
, 
novagriddy
, and 
Cristalit
 all the diamonds they stole. At night, they remunerate the diamonds and are free. CoinMonke gets baffled about how much people have been freed and confronts Parrot, Wifies and Dean. 

The next day, LettuceK submits his diamonds to Coin. Coin gets confused again and Lettuce starts crafting diamond armour and he is freed from Mining City. The next day, everything is normal until Wifies notices a player flying and Coin getting nervous, they all eavesdrop in Reddoons and Coin's conversation. Reddoons points out the library vault was broken into. Coin tells Reddoons that four people have left because they met their quota. Reddoons gets furious and yells at Coin stating that people don't meet quota. Coin shows Reddoons the diamonds that they gave him and Reddoons tells him to investigate. Since Parrot stashed diamonds in a house he realizes that he has to check the houses for a stash of diamond blocks. Coin tells everyone that he is going to check all the houses for anything suspicious like contraband. Parrot finds the barrel where they stashed the diamonds and takes all the diamonds. Coin tells Parrot to tell him where Luigi's house is but Parrot refuses to do so. Coin checks a random house and finds an emerald which happens to be Luigi's emerald. He gives the emerald to Reddoons but Reddoons declines because he doesn't care about the emerald and starts yelling at Coin. Reddoons tells Coin that 
Ash
 is going to kill both of them and tells everyone including Coin to line up.

Reddoons confronts everyone about the stolen diamonds and tells them that if they come clean they get to leave. 
Lezy
 starts taunting Coin. Luigi captures Reddoons' interest only to ask for his emerald back. Reddoons tells everyone that he will double quota and will decrease Coin's payment. He later decides to triple the quota and increase the security. The next day, Parrot, Wifies and Dean decide to rob another vault however they find string which will trigger an alarm. They return to Mining City because they are unprepared. Since it was night, they decide to go to Coin to give them their diamonds but they notice that he is missing. They decide to look inside his house and look at all the chests there until Coin finds them in his house. He also notices a stack of diamonds missing which Dean stole. 

The next morning, Parrot, Wifies and Dean break in to the vault again. They need wool so that they don't trigger the sculk sensors. They ask Luigi if he has wool but Luigi doesn't have any but he tells them that Ratrick, Puki and Finiahn can smuggle some. They pay them to smuggle some wool and some TNT minecarts. After they obtained the wool and TNT minecarts, Parrot decides to distract everyone by blowing up one of the towers in mining city and while everyone is investigating they rob the vault. Wifies sends Parrot and Dean the red string texture pack making it easier to locate the string. They successfully steal all the shulkers with diamonds alongside some of the diamonds in the chests. 

Upon returning to Mining City, they talk about the diamonds they looted and although they were unaware, Reddoons was listening to their conversation. He confronts them about their plan and the diamonds and Parrot asks Reddoons where Coin is. Reddoons says that they will be dealing with him now because of how easy it is to take advantage of Coin. Reddoons reveals that he knew about the tripwire in the vaults and they actually activated one. They keep acting oblivious and because of this, Reddoons decides to fill their inventory with boats again. Parrot tells Dean to distract Reddoons while they put all their shulkers in pots. After the inventory checks, Reddoons finds out that they don't have anything suspicious in their inventory but Reddoons is still suspicious about them hiding the diamonds. 

Parrot tells Ratrick and Finiahn to give him clay for 16 diamond blocks. and he tells everyone to turn the clay into bricks so that they can make replacement pots after they get shulkers from the pots and Parrot also admits that he stole from Reddoons' vaults. Parrot tells everyone to bury their shulkers because he can use it as leverage against Reddoons to free some people. The next morning, Parrot sees Reddoons and he immediately tells them to go to the tower. He once again confronts them about the diamonds they stole and brings up the pots but Parrot continues to act dumb. He tells them that if he doesn't return the diamonds, things are going to get much worse for them.

After Parrot, Wifies, Dean and Luigi return to Mining City they see a new structure. They check it out and it appears to be a roulette table. They try the roulette table and tell everyone else about it. CoinMonke returns however he tells them that there is now a maximum quota of 9 diamonds per day and he also explains how the roulette table works. Whoever has the lowest quota for the week has to gamble for their life. If it doesn't land on the colour they picked, they get executed. Coin also gives Luigi his emerald back because Reddoons said so. 

After the end of the week Coin assembles everyone for the roulette game. Parrot and Dean had the lowest quota so they had to play the roulette game. Parrot loses therefore he has to get executed by Coin, Parrot tells Coin to kill him however, Coin says he can't kill him. Parrot talks to Coin about what happened. Coin said that he doesn't like killing. Parrot uses Coin defying Reddoons as leverage and get him to tell him how the vaults work. Coin tells him that one of the vaults have 3 codes.  

Parrot, Wifies and Dean break in to that vault and find the codes in question. One had a lever where you have to click on the lever on the right, the other one had crafters where you had to figure out how much slots are required to open the door, and at last there were buttons. They had to get shulkers because they had none. 

They returned to Mining City to get Coin to give them shulkers. Coin tells him that he has one last chance to do this because Reddoons is going to completely lock down his vaults. Parrot goes mining with Luigi and Parrot tells Luigi that he will do an attack on Capital City. Parrot asks Luigi what he would do after he leaves Mining City. Luigi said that he will go to a city in the 
Far Lands
. The next day they find Reddoons flying into Mining City again to have another talk with Coin. Reddoons talks about how Coin is always a pushover and how he needs to actually kill someone. Coin goes to the roulette table and Reddoons tells 
Naparizel
 to go first. He wins therefore Reddoons doesn't get Coin kill him. Lezy interferes with Naparizel's turn so he's next. Parrot tries to stop Reddoons but he decides to pick Luigi instead. Luigi picks a colour but Reddoons denies both of his picks and tell him that he's choosing green despite there being no green on the roulette table. After this, Reddoons gets excited and tells Coin to kill Luigi and even encourages him to do it but Coin refuses. Reddoons gets fed up and kills Luigi himself and fires Coin.

Everyone stands there in shock of what just happened. Wifies tells Parrot that now everyone knows they can't just stand there and they have to try to leave. During Luigi's funeral, they plan on starting a revolution and attacking Capital City. Parrot and Wifies made a speech about how they can use the diamonds as leverage to get Reddoons to free everyone so they have to steal all of them and also fight off the Mafia members there. As they all gear up Parrot gives a final speech declaring war on Capital City. Parrot, Wifies and Dean set a stasis chamber that Coin should pull. They break in to the vault in the tower. 

After breaking into the vault they see a bunch of empty chest minecarts. They kept cycling them until the minecarts had the diamonds inside them. However, they get caught by Reddoons. Reddoons tells them about the rest of Mining City being captured again. Parrot tells Reddoons that if anyone dies, the diamonds are gone. Reddoons takes them back to Mining City where Parrot finds everyone sitting there with no armour or tools in the roulette dome. Reddoons tries to convince Parrot to give him the diamonds and if he wins, he gets all his diamonds back and everyone stays in Mining City, but if he loses, he still gets the diamonds but everyone can leave. Reddoons choses to pick green instead of red or black and tells Parrot that if it lands on red or black he wins. After the roulette game, everyone gets freed, Reddoons gets his diamonds back and Parrot gives one final speech before everyone leaves. Reddoons shows Parrot that he actually won the roulette game and he let everyone out because that's what he wanted to do. 

Reddoons tells Parrot, Wifies, and Dean to take off all their armour and he also gives Parrot his spyglass back before he takes them to Ash. Dean tries to walk away because he doesn't want to be around Ash anymore after he 
got freed from The Mafia
 however, Wifies tells Dean to stay because if they wanted to kill them, they would've done it already. Ash points out that Dean is afraid of him and uses this as an opportunity to invite them to The Mafia. He also lets them know that the roulette table was his idea. He then states that you can control someone if they fear something and starts making fun of Luigi's death alongside Reddoons before telling them that if they joined the Mafia they would be gold or even diamond players. He realizes that they won't join so he tries to force them and gives them invisibility pots and Parrot throws them. They tell Ash that they still wont join so he gets the invisible players standing behind him to kill him if they don't join in 10 seconds. Ash tells them that The Mafia is going to take over the server before CoinMonke pulls their stasis chambers. Coin tells them to get everything they could before The Mafia finds them. Parrot finds Luigi's emerald inside a chest in his house. He grabs the emerald before telling Wifies that he has to get out of Mining City.

title: I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...
content:
I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...














Season


2






Episode


56






Upload date


Oct 27, 2025






POV


SpokeIsHere






Featured Creators (Description)


Mapicc
Leow0ok
JumperWho














On the Unstable SMP, I made a mistake that could cost me my LIFE, so to make sure NO ONE finds out, I tracked down every witness to rig their secret bases with as many traps as possible...





I Trapped Secret Bases on the Unstable SMP...
 is the 83rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


The episode starts off with 
Spoke
 spying on a group of players heading to their secret base. He plans on trapping them inside of their own base, since an hour before they all saw him griefing their village and could snitch on him. For the first group of players, Spoke rigs the staircase and a few more areas of the base. When the players come back, 
Leow0ok
 happens to be with them, doing a trade with them. Once the trade is done, Leo leaves the base. Spoke uses this opportunity to set off a chest trap and killing one of the bystanders. He sets off the staircase trap, but the person manages to clutch. He activates one last trap and kills another player. The last person finds Spoke's hidden redstone area and confronts him. They then try to run away, but Spoke kills them. Spoke cleans up the evidence and sets up more traps for the next group of players who also lived in the base. Spoke sets off a few traps, killing the rest of the group. As he's leaving, he spots spies coming to investigate the base. He tries to trap the spies, but inevitably fails, he then manages to escape without being caught.

Spoke returns to the 
B.A.T. headquarters
 and goes to the library to find the coordinates of the next hidden base. Leo comes up to him and questions Spoke about what he's up to. He brings Spoke to the village that was griefed and asks Spoke what he was doing before. Spoke lies and says he was building with 
Mapicc
. Spoke then begins heading towards the next base, until he notices people following him from behind. He anticipated this, so he goes through the Nether and heads back the fortress that Mapicc was building. As the spies watch over them, Spoke sneaks out of the fortress and heads to the base.

When he gets to the base, three players are spotted, and they soon leave to collect seagrass for their turtle. Spoke sets up his trap once again while they're gone. When they arrive back at their base, Spoke manages to trap two of the three players, and the last one spots him. Spoke then uses a knockback sword to knock them down into a corner, where a backup trap is waiting, killing them. He overheard the players talking about more people coming back, and so he rigs the base with more traps. The players come back, and Spoke floods their base with lava and blowing it up in the process. Spoke looks at the damage he's done, he then sees the spies looking right at him. Spoke then comes up with a plan to kill the spies, since the spies had to neutralize their threats before heading back to base. He lures the spies into a small tunnel and sets off TNT minecarts, one dies to them, and Spoke kills off the other one himself. He then frames somebody else for the crimes he just did. He returns back to the fortress, where Leo is talking to Mapicc. Spoke wonders why Leo is back, and Leo says it's because two spies just died. Spoke acts clueless, but Leo says he knows Spoke was at the secret bases. Mapicc defends Spoke, pretending to be his alibi and saying that Spoke was there with him. Spoke says that the spies were watching them all along, but Leo says the spies only showed up to the secret bases. Leo hints that it could've been 
JumperWho
, the same person who gave Leo the spies he has now.

Spoke then heads to the borders of the amplified lands, revealing that all of the items he's been collecting has been used to pay off his debts for 
Quackenstein123
 and his family. The episode ends with JumperWho and one of her spies watching Spoke from afar.



Trivia


The video's original title was "Trapping Secret Bases on a Hardcore SMP...".

title: I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
content:
I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret














Season


1






Episode


5






Upload date


May 17, 2024






POV


ParrotX2






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc






Featured Creators (Description)


Wifies
‬
SpokeIsHere
PrinceZam
Wemmbu
FlameFrags
ManePear
Peentar
Merffinn
LuigiToan
‪














This Minecraft player
 knows a secret... a secret so powerful that it could change Minecraft forever. So, why does he want me to find it?





I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
 is the 5th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot








The episode begins with 
ParrotX2
 describing a mysterious music disk that he received from a player named 
SpokeIsHere
. Upon inserting it into a jukebox with a texture pack Spoke sent him, Parrot receives a message telling him that there is a huge secret in the server and that he should bring a friend to the set of coordinates described in the disk.  

Parrot invites a player called 
Wifies
 to accompany him in this journey and arrives at the first destination, a twin set of medieval towers facing a large stone gate in the side of a hill. Standing on both pressure plates on the towers, the gate on the hill blows up, revealing a large abandoned city complex. The two find a chest containing a music disk telling them to "follow the light,” but right after they open the chest and take the disk out, they hear TNT exploding, so quickly elytra out. Parrot realizes that they must go to the lighthouse in 
Zam Empire
 to find the next clue. Being concerned about how Spoke knew exactly when they had gotten their hands on the disk, Parrot hands 
Wifies
 his prized 
spyglass
 as a token of trust. 

After heading toward the Zam Empire, Parrot and Wifies don't find anything significant and instead encounter 
Wemmbu
 and 
PrinceZam
, who ask that they hand over the disks and let them take care of the secret instead. Parrot declines and 
Wifies
 splashes himself and Parrot with a potion of invisibility, escaping the clutches of the Zam Empire leader after a tense battle. Parrot and Wifies return to the lighthouse, noticing that it is blinking and decode it as a Morse code message which translates to "minus 64,” or the y level of -64 (in the void). 

After searching under the lighthouse, Parrot and Wifies discover a staircase leading to the void. They find another music disk telling them to fly in the void for two thousand blocks north, but after flying to the destination, they find a group of shulkers and a hole in the bedrock that was blocked off with obsidian. Parrot and Wives return to the hole they entered, but find that that hole has been blocked off as well. They return to the shulkers, running low on fireworks, and decide to fly to the void base of 
JumperWho
, but with Wifies too low on fireworks to make it, they come up with the solution of using fishing rods to conserve. 

Barely surviving the void, Parrot and Wifies play the new disk, which gives them the code of 9783, the password to PrinceZam's vault. Parrot and Wifies splash themselves with a potion of invisibility, and after sneaking past 
FlameFrags
 and 
ManePear
, they enter the vault where they grab the next disk and a lodestone compass just before 
Merffinn
 comes out of AFK. The two head to their destination, where a lodestone floats in the air in an ice spikes biome. Confused about where the next clue is, Parrot replays the message over and over again until they figure out that the "riddle" in the message is hidden in the phrase "it's pretty straightforward, it gets pretty straight to the point." After following a straight line between the point of a nearby ice spike and the lodestone, they find a chest beneath the ice containing another lodestone compass. 

Parrot and Wifies yet again follow the directions until they find a giant ice mountain with its insides carved out. An invisible player waits for them at the bottom in front of two large chests beside a parkour course that leads all the way to the top. He motions for them to put all their items in the chest before starting the parkour. They manage to make their way to the top with lots of close calls and retrieve their gear from two double chests as well as a third one that holds a lodestone compass and the next disk. They listen to the disk, which was just Spoke telling them good job and to continue finding the secret. Parrot then brings up the question of why he would want him to bring a friend, but they ignore that and head to the next location. 

Parrot and Wifies arrive at a giant obsidian dome and are greeted by the same invisible player that was waiting for them at the parkour. He places down two double chests and they put their stuff in it, but Parrot secretly keeps two invis potions and golden carrots. They head into the next challenge, a maze, but soon realize that they need to find the disk and get out as soon as possible because they hear the voices of Wemmbu and PrinceZam, who are likely here to hunt them down. They splash themselves with invis and eventually find their way to the exit, which is blocked, and since they have mining fatigue, they can’t get out. However, Wemmbu finds them and they strike a deal. If Wemmbu lets them go, then he can have the disk and turtle egg in the chest at the center. 

After their encounter with Wemmbu and PrinceZam, Parrot and Wifies decide to set an auto stasis chamber and sneak into PrinceZam’s vault to steal the disk, which will most likely be stored there. They splash themselves with invis, head into the vault, and steal the disk and turtle egg. The guards, ManePear and 
Peentar
, and PrinceZam and Wemmbu attack them. They escape into the nether, but Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them. Parrot tells them that they can work together to find Spoke and after they give him the turtle egg and disk and return to the overworld, he breaks the portal. They escape again and listen to the disk.

Once the turtle egg hatched, Parrot and Wifies follow it all the way to the ocean, where they see a giant shipwreck in the water. On shore, the invisible player is waiting for them again with three double chests. They put their stuff in the first two chests and are supplied with two turtle shell helmets and eight water breathing potions. In the water, they find a shipwreck in the middle and ruins surrounding it. There are four towers surrounding the ship, each containing an item frame that they quickly deduct would have to be containing an item for a big hatch in the corner of the ruins to open. They find all of the items and open the hatch, which leads to an underwater graveyard, where they figure out where the chest is and take the disk and another lodestone compass. 

It leads Parrot and Wifies to a jungle. They split up to search and Parrot finds a jungle temple containing the disk. When played, Spoke tells them to fly to 5000, 5000 in the nether. The invisible player is waiting for them at the coordinates and they put their stuff in the chests again. 

On the other side of the portal is an escape room. Parrot and Wifies successfully complete all of the rooms and drop into a house in the middle of a mesa biome. Upon closer observation, however, the mesa is just a custom escape room inside a 100 by 100 obsidian box. They manage to escape that as well and collect the last disk. Spoke says that they are one step away from learning the secret and that it will change their life. Parrot then brings up the notion that Spoke had him bring a partner to do the scavenger hunt with, as well as the sheer amount of obsidian and manpower needed to complete that escape room. They head back to Parrot’s base and find the invisible player waiting for them there.

The invisible player drinks a bucket of milk and reveals himself to be Spoke all along. He takes Parrot and Wifies to the final obstacle, which is a series of tasks they will complete to determine the player who learns the secret. But here’s the catch: only one player can make it out alive. The other will get chunk banned. Parrot and Wifies debate whether to take the risk or not, but knowing everything they went through, they agree that they’ll figure something out. As they progress through the challenges (a puzzle, redstone parkour, maze, potion obstacle course, another parkour, and a mini escape room), when they reach the end, Parrot and Wifies are tied. However, Spoke has a tiebreaker, which is a game of chess. Parrot takes Wifies aside and they decide to end in a stalemate so Spoke can't ban either of them. 

The plan works, but Spoke refuses to let both of them go. After a long moment between Parrot and Wifies, Wifies asks him if this secret is really worth it. Parrot tells Wifies that he knows what he's going to say, so Wifies gives Parrot his spyglass and steps into the chunk ban.

Once Parrot and Spoke arrive at the surface, Spoke reveals that there is no secret. He just wanted to get revenge on him for something he did in the past. But the problem was that Parrot didn’t have anything of true value that Spoke could take away from him, so he made this scavenger hunt and had Parrot invite another player to join him. The sole purpose of all of these challenges were to bring Parrot and Wifies as close together as possible so Spoke could chunk ban one of them off of the server. He told Parrot that right before Wifies was banned, he could tell that Wifies was doing it for someone he cared about, and from Parrot’s silence, he had lost someone he deeply cared about. 

Parrot is speechless, but then, Wemmbu, PrinceZam, Merffinn, and 
LuigiToan
. arrive. He realizes that they were tracking Spoke the whole time and this was why they wanted to hijack the scavenger hunt so badly. They chase him around the sky and eventually make their way all the way to the chunk ban. 

They are about to kill Spoke when he says, “Parrot, I’m sorry man, but—” and steps into the chunk ban.



Trivia


This is the first 
Unstable Universe
 video to be over 3 hours long.


This episode is where 
Wifies
 has his first debut.

This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.




Important Items
 in 
Unstable Universe
 are items that hold sentimental meaning to their players or are heavily lore relevant.



Parrot's Spyglass


Main article: 
Parrot's Spyglass


 
 
 
 
 


Parrot's Spyglass
 is a recurring item in Unstable. It was originally given to 
Wifies
 by 
Parrot
 in 
I Uncovered Minecraft's Greatest Secret
, mentioning that it has "sentimental value" to him. Eventually, 
Wifies
 gave it back to Parrot before chunkbanning himself. It appeared in most of Parrot's videos up until the finale of 
The Director Arc
. In 
Escaping Paragon: The Perfect Minecraft Prison
, Parrot was forced to drop the spyglass by Wifies onto the platform below, which he picked up before it despawned. Later on, Wifies forced Parrot to stand with him on pressure plates which would detonate hundreds of TNTs and blow them up if one of them stepped off. However, Parrot kept the spyglass and dropped it on the pressure plate, allowing him to walk off of the trap. Wifies stepped off his pressure plate to run towards the spyglass so he can pick it up one last time, setting off the TNT and killing him as well as destroying the spyglass in the process. Parrot still has a spyglass, albeit being a different one.



deanthebean9's Goat Horn


Main article: 
Deanthebean9's Goat Horn


 
 
 
 
 


Dean’s Goat Horn was a goat horn (Yearn) given to 
deanthebean9
 in 
The Search for Minecraft's Far Lands
 by 
Wifies
 after 
Parrot
 told him to do so. The horn was meant to be used if 
Dean
 was ever in danger, since Parrot assumed that Dean was not smart enough to use messages. Later, Dean admits that he was leaking their coordinates to 
The Mafia
, a faction that have been hunting them down, hence how they kept finding them every time, which led to Dean leaving the team after blowing the horn. Parrot later finds him in 
Unstable SMP: The First War
 in the jungle where they had their last argument, but refused to let him rejoin because of Dean's earlier betrayal. Wanting to help, Dean secretly rejoins the Mafia to help Parrot by sabotaging his mafia teammates during the war. Parrot, noticing this, tries to kill him, thinking he's a free kill, not knowing it was Dean because of invisibility. They both knock each other off a really high bomber plane, causing both of them to pop their totems when they land, which clears Dean's invisibility. Dean blew the horn one last time before the Mafia pulled his stasis, teleporting him into the void — the punishment for losing invisibility — and ultimately dies.



George Junior (Fish bucket)


Main article: 
George Junior (fish bucket)


 
 
 
 
 
 
George Junior
 is a salmon fish in a bucket that 
Spoke
 always keeps in his hotbar. Spoke has a full shulker of these and usually replaces him every time he dies. He is the oldest important item in the entire series dating all the way back to 
Episode 1
.

It also served as Spoke's secret identity (Fish bucket) while he was infiltrating 
The Invisible Mafia
.

The shulker box full of George Juniors was presumably destroyed when 
JamatoP
 burned all Spoke's inventory and ender chest in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
.



Gambit (Mace)


Main article: 
Maces § Gambit


Gambit
 is a mace owned by 
Wemmbu
. This was first given to 
Wemmbu
 by 
Yeah Jaron
. 
Yeah Jaron
 provided the weapon so 
Wemmbu
 could help defend the 
Skyblock Civilization
 from a raid by the 
The Invisible Mafia
. 
Wemmbu
 once lost it to 
FlameFrags
during a fight to save his friend, 
Eggchan
. The mace passed through several hands—from 
FlameFrags
 to 
ClownPierce
 and then to 
FerreMC
—before 
Wemmbu
 recovered it by defeating 
FerreMC
 in combat and taking him hostage.

Enchants:
 Density V, Mending, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II, Wind Burst I.



Crucible (Mace)


Main article: 
Maces § Crucible


Crucible
 is a mace originally belonged to a "Diamond Player" of 
The Invisible Mafia
 named 
Iqcniq
. After 
Eggchan
 Civilization collapsed, it was briefly stolen by 
Jaden MAN
, but 
Wemmbu
 eventually forced 
Jaden MAN

Conexion
, also known as Sharpness, forcing 
Wemmbu

Far Lands

 because he felt he did not need it.

Enchants:
 Breach IV, Mending, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II.



Rejoicin's Sunflower

 is 
Rejoicin
's favorite flower, possibly due to his Minecraft skin being based off one. He had multiple stacks of them in a double chest. He gave 
Wemmbu
 one in 
I Explored an Abandoned Minecraft Civilization
. Following Rejoicin's death, Wemmbu has always kept the flower in his Ender Chest, signifying his grief for him.

Alt (Netherite Chestplate)


Main article: 
Alt


 
 
 
 
 
Spoke
 wearing Alt in the thumbnail for 
I Almost Got BANNED from the Unstable SMP...
 
 


Alt
 is an exploited Netherite Chestplate that 
Spoke
 always wears. It was given to Spoke by 
JamatoP
 when they were testing out the exploits. It has every possible enchant that a chestplate can have, except for Thorns. It has a Snout armor trim with redstone material. Spoke also used to have other illegal exploited armor pieces but they were all broken (except for Alt) while fighting 
Wemmbu
 in 
How to Destroy the Unstable SMP

Mapicc
 in 
Finding 1000 Missing Minecraft Players
.

This, alongside George Junior, is the oldest important item in the entire series.

 Protection IV, Blast Protection IV, Fire Protection IV, Projectile Protection IV, Mending, Unbreaking III.

It was later broken by

 in

 after 
JamatoP
 told him that Spoke was lying to him and that 
Leo

. This is one of the only things

 cared about on the sever as much as his love for combat. He was given it when he was a diamond player in 
The Mafia

 with an 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 during their rematch.

's Book (Book and Quill)
 
 


Eggchan's Book (Book and Quill) contains server information, and history; dating back to the Zam Empire Arc as it is the arc where Eggchan first joined. This book was written with information over the course of Eggchan, and Wemmbu's adventures on the Unstable SMP.

Eggchan

It's Impossible to Catch this Player
 is the 6th episode featured in

. 



Plot


The episode starts off after 
Wemmbu's
 fight with 
SpokeIsHere
, in which Spoke escaped using an ender pearl stasis chamber. Wemmbu, of course, makes it his goal to kill Spoke. Spoke’s base was, of course, empty, so he heads towards 
ParrotX2's
 base to ask him if he knows Spoke’s whereabouts, but Parrot doesn’t tell him anything. The only other player on the server that could know where Spoke was was 
JamatoP
, but after interviewing him at his base, Wemmbu finds out that he doesn’t know anything. He is about to leave when he spots other players in the base and quickly hides. The other players turn out to be 
ManePear
, 
Sorhin
, and 
FlameFrags
, three of 
PrinceZam's
 guards who are also looking for Spoke. 

Wemmbu decides to follow the guards back to the 
Zam Empire
 to see if PrinceZam wanted to form an alliance with him in their search for Spoke. However, in the middle of their conversation, 
Mapicc
 jumps them and they see a plane launching TNT onto the Zam Empire in the distance. PrinceZam’s castle is blown up and a fight ensues between Wemmbu, PrinceZam, and his guards, ManePear, FlameFrags, Sorhin, 
LuigiToan
, 
ECorridor
, zzye, 
loppezz
, 
yungwillx
, and 
Peentar
, and Spoke’s cronies, Mapicc, 
JumperWho
, 
SykerMC
, 
TeamKalal
, 
Chiffoi
, Elemental_Man, 
RealReeon
, 
Only_A_Squid
, 
Derapchu
, 
What_Max
, 
Arcn
, ItsRyanStuff, and 
Sharooh
. They manage to blow up TeamKalal before Spoke’s goons stasis away.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam check with 
TheRealSquiddo
 first for the whereabouts of Spoke due to her previous affiliations with him. Squiddo agrees to DM them the coordinates of where Spoke last was. They find contraband items, stacked totems, and a spawn egg in her chests, so they 
chunk ban
 her.  

Wemmbu and PrinceZam spot Parrot and 
Wifies
 at the lighthouse on the outskirts of the Zam Empire. After a bit of prodding, Parrot reveals that Spoke sent them on a scavenger hunt for a secret that could change the server. Wemmbu demands the disk (when played with a texture pack reveals the next clue) they were talking about, but they refuse. Wemmbu and PrinceZam catch them breaking into the castle and chase them around the empire grounds, eventually losing them. 

They start heading to Squiddo’s coordinates, which are in the end. At the stronghold, they are attacked by Mapicc, 
Sharkilz_
, and RealReeon, three of Spoke’s henchmen who are guarding the portal. Mapicc and Sharkilz_ are able to escape while they manage to chunk ban RealReeon. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam find a massive end base at the coordinates and sneak up on Spoke, JumperWho, and Derapchu. They chunk ban Derapchu and JumperWho, but Spoke escapes into the void. 

Seeing that chunk banning Spoke wasn’t as easy as they thought it would be, Wemmbu and PrinceZam come up with a plan to get him without a totem, then one-shot him with a 
mace
. They trade for a trial chamber map and mess around for a while before finding the chambers, where they get the ingredients for the mace. However, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, 
Fantst
, Sharooh, and Mapicc jump them in the trial chambers, so Wemmbu heads to the surface to get wood craft the mace while PrinceZam leads them to him. They then engage into a big fight and Arcn is chunk banned. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam change plans and decide to go after Spoke’s henchmen, assuming that they will lead them to Spoke himself. They use an arrow tracker to track down Only_A_Squid and chunk ban him. They leave the underground base and after a bit of flying, spot a nether portal. They land to check it out and are attacked by Fantst and Sharooh, chunk banning Sharooh. 

The next location is a giant obsidian box. They break inside and see Mapicc, engaging in a fight. They are about to drop him when a group of invisible players that are later revealed to be Spoke, Sharkilz_, and Fantst  jump them. They take PrinceZam hostage and use him as a bargaining chip for the mace. Wemmbu burns the mace, so they start attacking again. Wemmbu and PrinceZam are about to die when they suddenly stasis away, leaving them broke. 

Once Wemmbu and PrinceZam regear themselves, they head to another obsidian box which, upon entering, isn’t infested with Spoke or his minions. Inside the obsidian box is a maze, and after wandering around, they find themselves back at the entrance. They assume that this is a trap set up by Mapicc until they hear Parrot and Wifies’s voice somewhere else in the maze. Wemmbu tells PrinceZam to barricade and guard the entrance while he starts searching for Parrot and Wifies. He is about to give up when he sees a name tag and mines in through the roof with a bucket of milk to counter the mining fatigue. He finds Parrot and Wifies without armour and makes a deal with them: if they show him where the disk is, then he’ll let them go alive. Wemmbu obtains the disk and turtle egg that was inside the chest at the center, but realizes that they need the texture pack Spoke sent Parrot to listen to the disk after Parrot and Wifies already left. 

Regardless, Wemmbu and PrinceZam head back to the Zam Empire to set a trap for Parrot and Wifies, knowing that they would likely try to steal the disk. Since the arrow tracker pointed them to Parrot and Wifies, they must be related to Spoke in some way. They put the disk in PrinceZam’s castle’s vault and set their ender pearl stasis chambers in a pile of gold and emerald blocks. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam arrive at a manmade hole dug into the floor of an ocean decorated with custom coral, ruins, and many elder guardians. They come across a giant underwater castle and enter it, finding Sharkilz_ and chunk banning him after a short fight. However, not ten seconds after they ban him, the entire castle blows up, including the chunk ban, allowing Sharkilz_ to log back on and start attacking, as well as Fantst, who was hiding in the castle to jump them. In the end, they manage to chunk ban both Sharkilz_ and Fantst. 

Seeing that they only had one more location to go to, PrinceZam and Wemmbu split up so PrinceZam could go back to his empire to fetch more people and chunk bans and Wemmbu could stall Spoke. 

Wemmbu flies away until he eventually finds two twin towers guarding a blown up entrance into a mountain. He goes in and spots an invisible player, assuming that it was Mapicc. He communicates using signs and tells Wemmbu that he doesn’t care if he bans him off and that he would take Wemmbu to Spoke under a few conditions. 

The invisible player leads Wemmbu to a giant ice mountain that was hollowed out to create a parkour course inside. The player tells Wemmbu that he needs to complete the course without cheating and with no armour. After a few close calls with death, he completes the parkour, where he learns that this is part of the scavenger hunt Parrot and Wifies were doing. 

The player then leads Wemmbu to the next location, the same obsidian box he and PrinceZam previously found Parrot and Wifies in. The player tells Wemmbu that Spoke told him that he didn’t properly complete the maze. He forces Wemmbu to put all of his stuff in a chest and gives him two minutes to solve the maze. Wemmbu easily finds his way to the center and the player tells him that phase two is complete. He takes back all of his gear and the player leads him to the third location.

The invisible player puts down a sign that says “Squiddo’s castle.” Wemmbu, realizing that this wasn’t Mapicc, but instead, Spoke, starts critting him out, but he pulls his ender pearl stasis and disappears after a quick fight. 

Wemmbu elytras to Squiddo’s castle, assuming that Spoke is there. The castle is almost completely burned down with fire spreading everywhere. He quickly finds Spoke and lands in front of him. They quickly engage in battle while Spoke tries to overpower Wemmbu’s moral with his taunts. Spoke tells him that at the end of the day, no matter how many people Wemmbu chunk bans, he will still be on the losing side of this war. Wemmbu says that PrinceZam is bringing people right now to help him, but Spoke retorts that no matter how many materials or manpower he brings, the amount of gear Spoke possesses is unimaginable. After a long, long, fight, Wemmbu manages to steal Spoke’s shulker full of all his materials and finally drain him of his resources, forcing him to yet again stasis away. However, before he left, Spoke shot a few arrows that Wemmbu could use to track his location, which he must’ve intended for him to find. 

Before Wemmbu could process any of the information, he was teleported to PrinceZam’s vault by the ender pearl stasis chamber they had set earlier. He sees PrinceZam, ManePear, and Peentar battling two invisible players that had stolen the disk and turtle egg and realizes that Parrot and Wifies had come to rob them. They chase them all the way to their underground nether portal and head inside, where they quickly find Parrot and Wifies behind a cluster of magma blocks. Wemmbu and PrinceZam strike a deal with them that they would hand Parrot and Wifies the disk to decode and then they would work together to find Spoke. Once Wemmbu and PrinceZam return to the overworld, though, Parrot and Wifies break the portal and escape. Wemmbu and PrinceZam return to the nether to search for them, but it was already too late. 

They gather 
Merffinn
 and LuigiToan, two of PrinceZam’s guards and head in the direction Spoke’s arrows pointed towards. However, when they reach the location, they see something interesting, finding Parrot chasing Spoke around in the sky. They follow parrot and start attacking Spoke. He leads them into two obsidian surrounded staircases and into what must’ve been the final challenge in Parrot and Wifies’s scavenger hunt, which included a puzzle, a redstone parkour course, a maze, a potion obstacle course, another parkour, a mini escape room, and a life-sized chess set. 

A fight ensues in the last room with the chessboard, which Merffinn discovers contains an active chunk ban. Spoke, on the other hand, says a few last words to Parrot and steps into the chunk ban. Everyone is shocked and confused, but Wemmbu realizes that he would rather be chunk banned than die at the hands of the Zam Empire, which meant that prisons would have to be constructed to keep the chunk bans from being broken. Now, all that was left to do was rebuild the Zam Empire.



Errors


In various sections of the video, the health bar switches from hardcore hearts to regular hearts.


Trivia


This video was recorded with a pre-1.21 snapshot with the mace due to it's cooldown being similar to the sword's cooldown.

content:
It's Impossible to Find this Player














Season


1






Episode


12

Jul 22, 2024

A few days ago, 
5
 
of
 
my
 
best
 
friends
 as well as 
ClownPierce
 all vanished. All that was left of them was a book with a set of coordinates. I have no idea where they went, but I'm going to find them.





It's Impossible to Find this Player
 is the 12th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


After five of 
ParrotX2's
 friends, 
rekrap2
, 
JumperWho
, 
Kenadian_
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Leow0ok
, disappear, along with 
ClownPierce
, the server's deadliest player, Parrot and 
Wifies
 head to the location that Clown left them. Upon arrival, they stumble across a massive sky island. Parrot and Wifies find two players, 
Jaden_MAN
 and 
Spongs
, who refer to themselves as the game masters. They tell Parrot and Wifies that if they want to find the missing players, they had to complete quests.  


Parrot and Wifies’s first quest is for a Heart of the Sea. They clean their inventories and the game masters give them a kit to complete the quest with. They destroy an underwater gold box in a lake and find a barrel with a lodestone compass. They are interrupted by two players named 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev
. They say that they have been ordered by a player named 
Boosfer
 to assist them in their quest, but Parrot and Wifies get suspicious, so they pot invis and run away. They come across Clown-themed ships and Parrot finds a book that says "Dig where the winds meet.” Wifies tells him that they have to go in the direction of the sails. After obtaining the Heart of the Sea, Parrot realises that it’s Derapchu's prized possession. They put the item into the corresponding quest temple and a blue beacon lights up.
 
 
 
 
the sky island 
Clown
 lead 
Parrot
 and 
Wifies
.
 
 
The game masters give Parrot and Wifies another kit and send them on another quest for a pair of netherite boots, Jumper’s prized possession. Parrot and Wifies find a town in the sky, but Kier and Dev show up again for "assistance.” They have to catch thirty-two fish, light all of the hot air balloons, replace all of the lanterns, repair all of the damaged crops, and fill all of the empty cauldrons. Parrot and Wifies place the lanterns. They find some flying machines and glowstone beneath carpets throughout the island. Parrot distract Kier and Dev by telling them that the hot air balloons are in the shape of an arrow, and they fly off. They follow a trail of glowstone to a sea lantern, where Wifies uses it to activate the flying machines. They look below a sea lantern flying machine and find the boots, which they place into a quest temple and activate a white beacon.
 
 
 
 
Town that Parrot and Wifies explored during the quest
 
 
 
 
 
 
The glowing flying machines Parrot and Wifies activate
 
 
Parrot and Wifies don’t find the game masters, but they see their ender chests and kits for the next quest. They decide to go talk to Boosfer about why he wants the items so much. They head to his headquarters, an office building in a jungle. Boosfer says that he steals people’s prized possessions and sells them for lots of money. Parrot asks him to stop bothering them, but he declines and says he doesn’t care. Parrot tells him that the items were meant to help them find their missing friends and that if Boosfer interferes, they may be gone forever.  

 
 
 
 
 
Flower field with a hidden poppy
 
 


 
 
 
 
 
Rekrap's base (the large tree Parrot and Wifies find)
 
 


Parrot and Wifies go on another quest to look for a poppy, which they have no idea who it belongs to. They find a massive flower field in which they have to locate a poppy within. While searching for the poppy, Parrot gets irritated by how many red tulips are in the fields since they look like poppies. After a long time of searching and going insane over flowers, they finally find the poppy. They dig under the poppy and find a cave with lots of poppies as well. They realize that the poppies lead to something so they follow the path of the poppies and eventually reach a valley.  

Parrot and Wifies explore the valley until they see more moss and grass, which leads to a large tree. They walk around it until Parrot gets mining fatigue. They decide to check the inside of the tree and find an escape room. It goes wells until they hear the tree burning down and fireworks being shot by none other than Kier, Dev and Boosfer. Parrot and Wifies hide from them, but after they find them, they ask for the item. Wifies offers to distract them while Parrot continues looking for the item, but he declines and keeps them busy instead. He begins bluffing and deletes everything from the book, writing, "Through the valley's last edge, under the boulder below" on the first page and "deez nuts" on the second page before giving it to them. 

After a while of meandering around, they uncover Parrot’s bluff. He leads them to where they were actually supposed to go and mines down, but realises that the tree is Rekrap's base. Since Wifies stashed the item in his ender chest, Kier, Dev and Boosfer threaten to kill them and blow up the base. Parrot doesn’t want them to, giving them leverage over him and Wifies. They tell them to bring the item to their headquarters in thirty minutes or else the base gets destroyed.

Once they leave, Parrot and Wifies start evacuating all of the animals in Rekrap’s base. They hear withers and find bomber planes. They bridge up to them and find 
Wemmbu
. He tells them that he was paid by someone anonymous to grief Rekrap's base. Parrot realizes it's Boosfer, Kier and Dev, and Wemmbu admits that they were the ones who hired him. He needs money to build another empire of his own and get revenge on 
PrinceZam
 and the 
Zam Empire
 by declaring war on them. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he doesn't need to stoop down Zam’s level to get revenge, and that they can rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev, which Wemmbu agrees to. 

Parrot and Wifies place the flower in its quest temple’s item frame and activate the beacon. They retrieve their netherite gear to tell Boosfer that his plan to bomb the valley failed. He taunts them, and, realising that there is no point in staying, they head back to the quest temples.

Upon return, Parrot interrogates Jaden and Spongs about why they’re always absent. They play dumb and give them a cave quest. They are looking for a diamond, which Parrot assumes belongs to Leo. After entering the cave, they are met with another escape room. They complete it and find a cave maze. On the other side is an ancient city where they have to kill a warden to obtain a skulk catalyst needed to open a vault door. The warden is defeated and they find Leo’s diamond behind the vault door. 

Parrot and Wifies go back to the quest temples and activate the beacon for the diamond. However, Kier and Dev jump them and steal all of the items that they found. They just played dumb the entire time and waited for a chance to steal all of the items at once. There is nothing they can do without the game masters. When they finally arrive, Parrot lectures them about their irresponsibility and tell them that they need to deal with something else.

They head to the Wemmbu Civilization and form a plan to rob Boosfer, Kier, and Dev. Parrot tells Wemmbu that he will help destroy their base using an 
orbital cannon
 as long as Wemmbu only uses it on them and the Zam Empire. They launch the orbital cannon and grief Boosfer, Kier, and Dev’s base. After a successful heist in which they steal most of the Treasure Hunters’ riches, Parrot and Wifies head back to the quest temples.

Parrot tells the game masters to send them on the nether quest. They receive a book with six sets of coordinates. The first set has oddly placed nether quartz. They realise that it is morse code and they translate it to "Rurple," which is supposed to mean "Purple.” They go to the second set of coordinates but only find a lava ocean. They go to the third set of coordinates and are met with a bastion, along with a sign that says "840 32 cyan.” They head to the next set of coords and find a chest in a nether fortress with a magenta candle, a spruce button, an oak plank, and brown wool. The decode the blocks with their block IDs to find the message “670.5 brown.” They arrive above a lava lake and splash each other with fire resistance before jumping in and finding a sign that says “960.18 pink.” They go to the nether roof of the second set of coords and find two signs that say "390.43 blue” and "390.43 blue.” 

The last set of coordinates houses a library constructed over a lava ocean. Parrot and Wifies tame striders to ride and use the 
Dewey Decimal System
 to find specific books, which they use to unlock a vault at the back. They find a wither rose and Parrot realises that it belongs to Kenadian. They head back to the quest temples to activate their fifth beacon.

Parrot and Wifies go to the end quest. They do a parkour course/escape room to reach the portal to the outer end islands. They find a chest containing fireworks, elytras, and a book. They search the islands and find an end city with a cartography table and Wifies’s prized dragon head. Upon returning to the main end island, they run into Kier and Dev. They respawn the ender dragon and threaten to kill them. Parrot and Wifies obtain their gear through an ender chest in the end city and chase them away. They place Wifies’s dragon head in the sixth quest temple and activate the beacon. 

Parrot and Wifies head to their usual meeting place with Jaden and Spongs, but instead see Clown. Parrot asks him why there are seven quest temples since they completed all of the quests and only six beacons were lit. Clown tells Parrot that he is the last key. Parrot places down the final item to return the missing players, his precious 
spyglass
. Clown empties all of their inventories before leading them to what they worked to achieve all along.

Welcome to 
Proton
, Minecraft’s most secure prison.

ItzRealMe
, also known as 
Itz
, is a character featured in 
Unstable Universe
, serving as the main antagonist of episode called 
I Got Hunted by the World's Best Minecraft Player
. Later he serves as the deuteragonist in 
I Got Trained By the World's Best Minecraft Player
.



Personality


ItzRealMe is incredibly stoic and cold, even coming off as rude to people who seem to idolize him, such as DylPickle. He is focused on his job and tends to streamline his thoughts and focus completely on his mission, blocking out things he deems as distractions, which can be a double-edged sword. He is self assured and very intelligent, as well as being a man of few words, believing that his actions speak louder than his words ever will. 



History


ItzRealMe tries to assassinate 
ParrotX2
. A team of people called 
Bounty Assassin Team
 save him from Itz. They escape from Itz by going to the nether. Their leader, 
Leow0ok
 invites Parrot to BAT. Parrot and Leow0ok see Itz inside of Parrot’s house. They start constructing a massive obsidian prison around Parrots house because they knew Itz would sit there patiently and wait for the prey.

BAT tries to kill ItzRealMe, but are forced to run away as it reveals that he has a 
mace
. Itz later finds Parrot in the 
BAT headquarters
. The BAT team saves Parrot. 

After this incident ItzRealMe comes to Parrot's room and tells him that 
The Director
 is the one who hired him to assassinate Parrot.  

Seeking to become a "Combat Master," 
FlameFrags
 tracked down the legend to his remote hideout to request training.

Initially reluctant to return to combat, ItzRealMe was persuaded when Flame pointed out that they shared a common enemy: 
the Law
, a faction hunting down elite players like them. Itz agreed to train Flame the mace techniques so that the student could eventually dismantle The Law, allowing both of them to live in peace.

The most vital lesson ItzRealMe imparted was the concept of "The Zone"—a state of absolute focus. He taught that a master must silence all distractions (including "yapping" or trash talk: "bro", "like", "dude", etc.) to observe the opponent’s habits and patterns. He emphasized that "the quieter you become, the more you can hear," using meditation as a tool to sharpen the senses.

Every player no matter how long they've played, no matter what gamemode, no matter what weapons they use, everyone has their strengths and everyone has their weaknesses.

Eggchan
 find a villager trading hall and enchant their gear. Wemmbu and Eggchan lead wardens over to Jaden to try and kill him, but see he escaped from his trap.

Wemmbu finds Jaden_MAN killing elder guardians and tries to kill him. Jaden almost kills Wemmbu, but Rejoicin stops the fight and tries to convince them to be friends. Jaden starts attacking Rejoicin. They try to kill Jaden, but he escapes.

Wemmbu and Eggchan learn that the civilization was going to have a vote to decide if they were going to go to the surface in a book, but the next page after that is blank. The team finds Jaden_MAN at a trap near a warden factory. Rejoicin is killed by a warden.

The team finds an elytra. Using the elytra and a mace, Wemmbu uses all of Jaden’s totems. Wemmbu makes him throw out all of his items, removes all of the chorus fruit in the civilization, and traps him underground in the civilization.

FlameFrags searches for Jaden until he encounters The LAW. 

After a long fight with The Law in the abandoned civilization, FlameFrags finds Jaden, who tells FlameFrags that Wemmbu was responsible for locking him inside the abandoned civilization before he breaks him out.

Jaden_MAN and FlameFrags form a team of Wemmbu's past enemies to kill him in the Farlands. After failing to kill Wemmbu, they fight Sharpness to get a mace to make killing Wemmbu easier. FlameFrags convinces Sharpness to give him his mace by telling him that he can duplicate it and then gives it to Jaden_MAN.

After acquiring a mace, Jaden, along with FlameFrags and the rest of the team, tries to kill Wemmbu in the mountain spike biome in the Farlands. The fight erupts into chaos as Sharpness and WyLL begin fighting and the rest of the team attack each other. Jaden fights FlameFrags until he lets him go. 

His new civilization is destroyed by Wemmbu. 

With the help of the 
Invisible Knight
, Jaden manages to capture the Marine Ranger base, laying the foundation for the new Pirate Empire. 

Jaden saves Wemmbu and Eggchan by killing Law members.  

Jaden houses both Wemmbu and Eggchan.  

Jaden leads a group of pirates with Wemmbu and Eggchan to destroy the orbital cannon set up by the law to take over The Great Sea. Jaden is captured by the Law.  

After Jaden is captured by The Law, he is imprisoned and LettuceK has a plan to use him as leverage over Wemmbu. This forces Wemmbu to think twice before attacking LettuceK.   

He is freed from prison by Spoke and his team with the accidental help of Flame and by extension, Wemmbu. When the teams regroup, Flame begins to fight Jaden, demanding Jaden hand over Lomedy's mace. In the six-day war in The Northern Council against Lettice and The LAW, Jaden uses his mace to help eliminate the 2500 player army alongside the protagonists and allies. 

Post-battle, Flame starts attacking Jaden again which causes a brief scuffle that is interrupted by Wemmbu. Wemmbu protects Jaden and challenges Flame instead, Jaden remains quiet during this exchange in the background.    

In 
I Explored the World's Largest Minecraft Server
, Wemmbu orders Egg to head to the Pirate Civilization to recruit Jaden for a 4v4. However, Egg fails to grasp what the situation was and relays the wrong request to Jaden but Jaden comes to help anyway. When he sees Wemmbu and realizes the true events Jaden is very confused but is still on-board to help. He stays by Wemmbu's side in what essentially became a 2v4 because the fourth random bailed and Eggchan was useless in combat. Jaden helps Wemmbu win the fight and is dismissed following the battle. 

In 
Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
, Jaden protects Old Man 
Lynn
 and sees Wemmbu at his island. He is some what confused but agrees to help Wemmbu find Eggchan. FlameFrags is also present but Jaden and Flame struggle to cooperate together. Jaden arrives at the island and helps Wemmbu at the auction of 
Eggchan.
 Wemmbu loses his patience and starts to attack everyone at the auction with Jaden being his ally. Jaden fights Arachn1d, Yungyx, and the Invisible Player in the battle. Jaden continues fighting them until the Invisible Player says that he will kill Eggchan if they continue to fight. Jaden stops fighting for Wemmbu's sake and tells Wemmbu about the threat.

JamatoP
, also known as 
Jamato
, is a supporting character—turned antagonist, featured in the 
Unstable Universe
. He was 
Spoke
's first ally on the server and now serves as his arch-nemesis as the leader of the 
Null Hunters
. He serves as the main antagonist of 
The NULL Arc
.



Personality


JamatoP was a kind individual as seen when he helped Spoke with figuring out how all the protections got on the same piece of armor and when he saves Mapicc from dying. He is bent on protecting the server even when that means losing his closest friends and allies, namely Spoke. He appears to be rather curious, willing to experiment with the exploits until he decided they were going too far at which he abandons Spoke and disappears. Even then, it seems that he deeply cared about Spoke's wellbeing until the latter attacked him after he revealed his plan to protect Mapicc from Spoke.  

After a period of hiding, Jamato seems to have developed a large amount of disdain for Spoke, as shown in the book he had written specifically for him to find in the gear set he gave him, stating that Jamato will make Jumper and Mapicc turn on Spoke if he ever tells them anything. By this time, Jamato had created the 
Null Hunters
 and seemed to go to extreme lengths to accomplish his goal of capturing Spoke and other players he deemed evil to make the server better and give everyone a chance to explore. Despite this seemingly self-righteous belief however, Jamato ordered Null to capture innocent players like 
PlanetLord
, 
CookieBunsquat
 and 
JumperWho
; infiltrated Spoke's team and broke Spoke's heart and his bond with Mapicc; and killed every player they met on sight, essentially defying his own purpose and integrity, showing that he was not above doing evil himself if it meant that he met his goals which he believed were for the betterment of the server. He even imprisons his friend 
Mapicc
 all to get revenge on the one he sees as the most dangerous person on the server.  



History


SpokeIsHere
 shows JamatoP a glitch which allowed him to get a full set of diamond armor with every protection enchantment, which is normally not possible. Jamato then guides Spoke through his base, where he shows him a lot of glitched features.

Jamato helps Spoke create glitched features in 
The Wonders
, such as a chunk suppressor. 

Spoke tells him that he wants to destroy all the end portals so that he can duplicate mobs without interference by other players, but Jamato disagrees. He says that Spoke just wants to play god. He says he doesn’t want to be part of this anymore. Despite this, Spoke still tries to convince him otherwise and shows him that he obtained a barrier block, and a command block.

Jamato later finds Spoke and sees that he’s going to use a machine to destroy The Wonders. He tells him this is not a good solution.

JamatoP vanishes.

Wemmbu
 finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players from the 
Zam Empire
 come into the base, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Eventually Wemmbu and Zam Empire leave.

JamatoP's base gets blown up by 
The Mafia
 after 
Ashswagg
 finds out that the exploits he taught Spoke were patched. Spoke and 
PlanetLord
 find a revamped version made out of wood and finds a book alongside a book and quill saying that he’s either captured by the mafia or dead, and a lodestone compass that leads to the Mafia outpost.

JamatoP explores multiple locations in the server, including the 
Far Lands
 and 
The Underworld
. He settled near the 
Far Lands
 and built a house on a flowery mountain as his base.

JamatoP saves Mapicc from an attack by 
BAT
 using weapons that the BAT spies have never seen. The two escape to the 
Far Lands
 using an ender pearl cannon where Spoke (alongside PrinceZam) finds JamatoP's base that resides on the outskirts of the Far Lands. JamatoP is followed to a lighthouse by Spoke, where the two have an argument and JamatoP tells Spoke that he leeches off of the people he calls friends. JamatoP takes off all his armor and taunts Spoke, assuming that Spoke won't kill him. When Spoke tries to kill him, he swaps to his totem, which popped and triggered an exploit that instantly teleported him away. At the end of the video he is seen watching Spoke and his friends.

Soon after Spoke left his far land base, 
Wemmbu
 took 
4CVIT
's pearl cannon to the destroyed lighthouse and found JamatoP's flowery mountain base. He realized he arrived near the wrong direction of 
Far Lands
. Jamato appeared outside the house. Wemmbu tricked him to believe that he was trustworthy as 
Serpentbound
 was inviting him to his kingdom. Jamato took Wemmbu to a giant portal after navigating through wither traps. The portal led them to a lobby in 
the Underworld
, where Jamato asked 
soul keepers
 to guide them to portal to 
Far Lands
 near Serpentbound's Kingdom. They went through the portal, and Wemmbu revealed they would part ways and he was not 
Serpentbound
's friend. Jamato fought Wemmbu but he was quickly defeated due to being bad at PvP. He popped a totem and disappeared instantly using the same exploit.

In 
Minecraft Trapper VS Elite Bounty Hunters
, Spoke is hunted down by 
a group of players
 which seem immortal. They use the same exploit as JamatoP uses as when they pop their totem of undying they are instantly teleported via a stasis chamber. Later Spoke asks 
SirPig
 about who is doing all of this.  In their brief conversation, SirPig mentions that Spoke's chestplate was given to him as a gift by Jamato, and that the person who hired the hunters demanded said chestplate as proof of Spoke's death.

JamatoP appeared after Spoke, JumperWho and Mapicc found the fabric / fiber next to the infinite downward staircase, stating that he came to help them from 
Null Hunters
. Spoke discovered after a lot of theorizing that Jamato is indeed the leader of NULL that hunted him down. He fails to convince Mapicc about it, and instead, Mapicc treats it as a betrayal, believing that Jamato was actually helping them and Spoke worked with NULL to trap him. He broke Spoke's infamous 
Alt
 Chestplate inside a maze. After Mapicc does the job of breaking his armor, both Mapicc and Spoke are weakened and captured by NULL and are ordered to enter into a nether portal. Jamato burnt all of Spoke's belongings, including items in his ender chest, effectively removing Spoke's ability to do anything on the server making him as weak as a new player on the server. 

JamatoP's ruthlessness in his revenge against Spoke is clear as he tore Spoke's team apart and captured innocent players all to be part of his grand plan. It is likely he still has good intentions however he is shown to be ruthless in destroying the rebels and commands NULL.



Quot




"That was never the plan. Look, Minecraft exists in layers, we're here on the surface, and with exploits, you can go down, deep into the rock, grab your riches. But this-this is the foundations of Minecraft-the foundation of computers, if you're changing the ones and zeros, you're breaking the bedrock, that holds this all together. And there's nothing waiting for you, but the void.

It is likely shadow items, i.e. two "quantum entangled" reference to the same instance of totem, with one in the exploit user's hand and the other in a chest connected to comparator that triggers stasis machine. When the user's totem pops, the other reference in the chest also "pops", leading to the stasis being pulled.

JumperWho
, more commonly known as 
Jumper
, is a character in 
Unstable Universe
. Jumper is in charge of spies in 
Bounty Assassin Team
. She is shown to care a lot about morals and treats her spies very fairly. She sometimes however is forced to make difficult choices like allying with her enemies just for her morals. Her thinking is similar to 
Parrot
 in many ways.



History


Season 1


JumperWho is seen as a guard for one of 
The Wonders
.

JumperWho is seen as a guard for 
SpokeIsHere
 in an end base.

ParrotX2
 and his friends free JumperWho from a chunk ban. She agrees to help them break people out of prisons.

JumperWho is seen as part of early BAT when they are focused on killing 
ClownPierce
.

Spoke and 
Mapicc
 find JumperWho, who is AFK. They move her onto the nether roof. She comes back and they run away to the overworld. Spoke and Mapicc destroy the guardian farm.

Parrot and 
Wifies
 go on a quest to obtain certain specific items. They obtain a pair of netherite boots which is one of JumperWho's most prized possessions.

JumperWho is trapped in a prison called 
Proton
. She is put in solitary confinement. With the help of Parrot and the other prisoners, they are able to escape from prison.

JumperWho is seen as a member of 
The End Civilization
.

JumperWho joins 
District 13
.  She later leaves District 13 to join 
The Invisible Mafia
 after being unhappy with how things were going.



Season 2


JumperWho joins Bounty Assassin Team.

JumperWho puts a chest and a sign saying to run in Parrot's room with two stacks of pearls, and an invisibility potion. BAT comes into Parrot's room and tries to kill him as they think he is 
The Director
.

JumperWho finds Parrot in an abandoned city. She tells Parrot that she was the one who put the chest and sign in his room. Parrot becomes a JumperWho spy to figure out how he had been framed for being The Director.

JumperWho gives Parrot the pieces of evidence that BAT thought showed he was The Director. 
Leow0ok
 does a "mole check" to see if any of JumperWho’s spies were moles by having them hold a green shield. Parrot takes a green banner off of the wall and combines it with his shield. Parrot is the only spy who holds a green shield, showing that he is a mole. Parrot manages to escape.

Parrot finds a book asking Parrot to meet up with him. Parrot spies on BAT's meeting. JumperWho betrays him, telling them that Parrot is spying on them. Parrot manages to escape during the chaos. JumperWho tells Parrot that she was actually just pretending to betray Parrot because BAT didn’t trust her. Parrot discovers that someone was spying on them. JumperWho uses a goat horn to call back her spy, and kill the spy. 

BAT watches Parrot and The Director have a conversation, which convinces BAT that Parrot is not The Director. The Director teleports away. Leow0ok discovers that JumperWho killed a spy, and kicks her off the team.

JumperWho rejoins BAT after saving Parrot from death to help hunt down the Director. JumperWho leads them to a secret base that she and her spies created.

JumperWho sends spies to secretly spy on suspects for the Director while the Director visits Parrot. The Director holds a chest plate with a red trim on it, causing Parrot to believe the Director is Spoke, as Spoke wears that netherite chest plate. Parrot convinces Leow0ok and Derapchu to pretend to be spies so Parrot can threaten to kill the spies so that JumperWho confesses to lying about none of the suspects being the Director. Parrot fails to do so.

JumperWho and 
Derapchu
 are trapped by the Director in an obsidian room. Leow0ok later saves them using a happy ghast.

JumperWho works as a guard in 
Paragon
. Wifies reveals that he knows her spies identities and make Jumper work for him. This shows how much she cares about her spies.

JumperWho continues as a member of BAT. After 
SpokeIsHere
 kills several spies, she ends up conflicting with 
Leow0ok
. 
Leow0ok
 wants to kill 
Spoke
, but JumperWho requires finding the armor pieces of the dead spies as proof that Spoke was the one. 

JumperWho is one of the 16 candidates that get over 100 votes. She is pressured by Leow0ok to become a candidate. 

JumperWho drops out of the elections for unknown reasons but probably because she just did not want to and was forced by Leow0ok. 

JumperWho stalks 
Spoke
 and her spies attack him. After Leow0ok orders more of her spies to their death she finally loses it and helps Spoke fight  
Leow0ok
. 

JumperWho helps 
Spoke
, 
Mapicc
 and 
PrinceZam
 attempt to kill 
Leow0ok
.  She helps Spoke kill hundreds of Law men commanded by Leow0ok  using a rail gun. Later she faces Leow0ok and saves PrinceZam from dying. 

JumperWho fights alongside 
District 13
 at the the Battle of The Northern Council. 

After the battle, JumperWho gets a book from one of her spies revealing Leow0ok's location. She and 
Spoke
 attack Leow0ok and break his armour completely. Leow0ok eyes both of them with contempt and says his last words before teleporting away, only to realise that his enderpearl statis was rigged by Spoke. Leow0ok is killed in the void and Spoke probably informs Jumper about this. 

Spoke hires jumper and pulled JumperWho and her spies stasis when 
Null hunters
 attacked his base, and they has since been both hunted by these hunters. the two of them help each other fight the Null hunters but most, if not all, JumperWho's spies were killed by 
Null hunters
