About


PrinceZam
, also known simply as 
Zam
, is a supporting character in 
Unstable Universe
. She was one of the two secondary antagonists (alongside 
FlameFrags
) in Season 1. He serves as the tritagonist of Spoke's 
BAT Arc
.   

He was the former ruler of the 
Zam Empire
, a faction that once thrived on influence and control. Early in the server, Prince Zam and 
Wemmbu
 had a very strong alliance, however Zam's paranoia and need for control ultimately led to him betraying Wemmbu. The Wemmbu Arc spanned several episodes, with Zam constantly obsessing over chasing Wemmbu down, then letting him escape and forcing Wemmbu to live in fear. This conflict comes to a head after Wemmbu detonates an Orbital Strike Cannon against Zam, when ClownPierce imprisons them together for entertainment. Zam and Wemmbu are forced to work together, and they become close again, although they are never truly allies again.  

Despite its earlier prominence, the Zam Empire ultimately fell, leading to its dissolution following internal and external conflicts, including opposition from notable figures like 
Wemmbu
, 
ClownPierce
 and 
Reddoons
. This collapse marked a significant turning point in Zam's arc within the server's story.



Personality


PrinceZam is known for her ambitious and tenacious nature, aiming to consolidate power and secure dominance through strategic planning and fortifications, such as the infamous wall that led to discord among other factions and various prisons where he chunkbanned many of his enemies. Zam's leadership showcased both determination and an ability to command respect, even amidst controversy. Zam is also characterized by an intense need for control of both her citizens and the full server, as well as extreme paranoia and concern over people who potentially pose a threat to the Empire. 



History


SpokeIsHere
 helps 
Mapicc
 steal from 
Zam Empire
. PrinceZam now wants to ban Spoke.

Wemmbu agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. A war between people against and with PrinceZam starts as they are talking.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate 
TheRealSquiddo
 and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. PrinceZam chunk bans TheRealSquiddo.

Parrot and Wifies go to PrinceZam’s base as a clue in a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke. Parrot and Wifies see Wemmbu, who questions them about a "disc" that they were talking about. Parrot says that Spoke left something at his base and that Spoke claims there’s a server secret, and they’re trying to find the next clue. PrinceZam comes over to them. PrinceZam says that they should give them all the information they found, however they don’t oblige. Parrot and Wifies fly away over to the castle and start exploring it while Wemmbu tries to kill them. Eventually they escape by flying out, and Wemmbu loses them.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the stronghold to get to the end base that TheRealSquiddo was talking about. Once they were there, they see there are three Spoke guards at the stronghold, 
RealReeon
, 
Sharkilz_
,  and Mapicc. They dig down to the stronghold, and make their way to the portal room. They find the guards and start fighting them. They flee to the end, except for RealReeon. They chunk ban RealReeon. They go into the end and start flying to the coordinates that the end base is at. They break into the base and start killing Spoke and his guards. Spoke is able to escape before being chunk banned.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam leave to the overworld to get some materials. This includes getting a mace. After going to the trial chambers and getting a heavy core, other people go into the trial chamber and see it’s already looted. Wemmbu and PrinceZam hide. The people who break into the trail chamber are Mapicc, Fantst, Arcn, Only_A_Squid, and Sharooh, all enemies of the Zam empire. Mapicc finds them and they start fighting.

Wemmbu escapes the fight and crafts a mace. PrinceZam escapes to the surface, and Wemmbu uses the mace to try and kill some of the players. All of the people flee the fight by running or using stasis chambers. Arcn is chunk banned by PrinceZam. They use the arrows that they left on the ground and a strategy with TNT to try and find the location of Spoke. They find a base that 
Only_A_Squid
 is at. They chunk ban Only_A_Squid.

They use the second arrow to find 
Fantst
 and 
Sharooh
. Fantst runs away and they chunk ban Sharooh. They find an obsidian box, and inside is the player Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. PrinceZam’s armor all breaks, and he almost dies. Spoke and his team run away because PrinceZam holds a chunk ban.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use an arrow to find an obsidian maze. They find two chests with peoples stuff inside of them. They hear Parrot in the maze. This is because Parrot and 
Wifies
 followed a clue left by Spoke which lead them to the maze. A guard who was there signaled for them to put all of their items in chests for no advantages in the maze. He eventually finds Parrot and Wifies who have no items. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the clue, however, because Wemmbu and PrinceZam don’t have the texture pack that goes along with the hunt, they would not be able to get any use out of it. Wemmbu gets a turtle egg and music disc from the chest. Wifies and Parrot get their stuff and leave the maze. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam realize that they need a texture pack and begin chasing Wifies and Parrot, however they’ve already escaped. Wemmbu and PrinceZam store the disc and turtle egg in a vault.

They follow an arrow to an underwater base. They find Sharkilz_ and chunk ban him. The base explodes which gets rid of the chunk ban, meaning that Sharkilz_ is unbanned because the chunk ban is exploded. Fantst now comes to help Sharkilz_ kill Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are teleported to the vault, where Parrot and Wifies are stealing the music disc and turtle egg. Wemmbu starts killing them, and they manage to fly away and escape. Parrot and Wifies dig down and go into the nether, however Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them in the nether, since they unluckily spawned in a nether cave. Parrot gives Wemmbu and PrinceZam the disc. Parrot says that to find Spoke they need a turtle egg, as baby turtles always go back to their home beach. They agree to team up, however after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld to team up, Parrot and Wifies mine away and escape.

The Zam Empire finds and tries to kill Spoke. Parrot is also trying to kill Spoke with them, as Spoke had just chunk banned Wifies. Spoke goes into the puzzle area that Parrot and Wifies were in, and start chasing him. Before they can kill Spoke, he chunk bans himself, with Wifies also stuck in the chunk ban.

Parrot and Rekrap try to convince PrinceZam to disable the chunk ban for one minute so that they can let Wifies out. PrinceZam says no. Parrot breaks into all of his prisons.

PrinceZam hires ClownPierce to kill Parrot as he broke all of his prisons.

PrinceZam gives Wemmbu the task making 
a civilization
 to guard a vault. It turns out this is just a plan by PrinceZam to get rid of Wemmbu. The vault contains nothing.

Wemmbu goes to his 
Orbital Strike Cannon
 to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and 
eggchan
 go back to spawn and see that the Zam empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over the spawn. Once Wemmbu and eggchan are far enough from the Zam empire, 
ManePear
 tells them that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use an orbital strike cannon to destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam. Wemmbu is able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam Empire.

ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, 
Merffinn
, and 
Peentar
 on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, so Wemmbu and ManePear take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. 

While they are taking 
Sorhin
 hostage, the Zam Empire breaks out yungwillx and Peentar. The entire Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu's civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that the Zam Empire took eggchan.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam Empire. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. Wemmbu picks up 36 cakes, which normally shows he has no items in his inventory, but uses the crafting menu to store extra items to smuggle in four items. He uses the orbital cannon which lags the server, giving him enough time to give eggchan full netherite armor from his ender chest to escape. They break out of the prison. Wemmbu destroys the Zam Empire. ClownPierce comes and takes PrinceZam and Wemmbu to a prison.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu are trapped in a miniature version of the normal world with only three totems. PrinceZam tries to kill Wemmbu, but he’s able to escape, though PrinceZam uses three of Wemmbu’s totems.

Wemmbu and eggchan find PrinceZam to ask him if he found any lava, but PrinceZam starts attacking them. They run away.

PrinceZam and Pangi find Wemmbu and eggchan. They start fighting, but because they have better armor, Wemmbu and eggchan run away. They escape by digging underground. They find a slime chunk under PrinceZam’s base. They’re able to get enchantments by fishing.

ClownPierce sends his guard into the prison to try and kill them, and says that if you pop the guards totem, they’re teleported out. The guard teleported in is 
FerreMC
. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to co-exist to kill Ferre. Wemmbu and eggchan sees that they somehow got obsidian. Pangi goes to the nether, but gets chunk banned.

Wemmbu and eggchan build a creeper farm, but it doesn’t work. They go over to PrinceZam to ask why the creeper farm isn’t working, and see he has villagers. They ask how PrinceZam got obsidian, and he says that completing a raid can give obsidian. PrinceZam helps them diagnose the problem with their creeper farm. ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam’s base because of Pangi going to the nether to escape. PrinceZam thinks this is Wemmbu’s fault, so he tries to kill him. PrinceZam stops trying to kill him realizing that Wemmbu is better at PvP than him. He convinces PrinceZam to give Wemmbu his looting sword. Wemmbu and eggchan leave. Wemmbu comes back to his base and sees it is destroyed by the orbital cannon.

PrinceZam goes over to Wemmbu’s base and tries to kill him. PrinceZam now has maxed enchanted diamond armor. Wemmbu shows PrinceZam that if he gets close to killing him, ClownPierce will interrupt it. He proves this by taking off all his armor, and ClownPierce plays a sound saying that the next round of juggernaut is going to happen. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to team again to escape the prison. They use a TNT minecart to activate Ferre’s totem of undying, so he gets teleported out. ClownPierce says that he now knows about a potential escape plan.

Nothing is certain here except for one thing— once you're inside, there's no escape. But I promise that someday, somehow, I'm gonna break out.



ParrotX2
, 
Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison


Proton
 was a prison built in 
Unstable Universe
 designed to hold many players at once. This prison was made for 
ClownPierce
’s entertainment, as he wanted to see what players would do when faced with it.



History


Escaping Proton: Minecraft's Most Secure Prison


Kenadian designs the prison. The prison is built and 
Eggchan
, 
ParrotX2
, 
Kenadian
, 
Wifies
, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Rekrap2
 are trapped in it.

They managed to escape the prison with help from 
Leow0ok
 and 
Wemmbu
. 

Kenadian
 is still trapped in the prison but they teleport him out using an ender pearl stasis chamber hidden in Kenadian’s base. 



Design


The prison is made of three main rings. Each ring is circle shaped and large, about the size of a biome. The cell is basically normal Minecraft terrain, except there was no sand or lava. On the borders of each cell are chunk-banned walls. There were only a few spots that sometimes had an inactive chunk ban, and they are hallways connecting the three cells. In the middle of the three rings is the control tower, and outside of all of it, are chunk-banned crying obsidian walls so thick that it goes outside render distance.

The hallways connecting the three cells are usually chunk-banned at the entrance, and the chunk bans are only temporary turned off when the prisoners are getting moved. There middle of these hallways are not chunk banned because there are solitary confinement cells located in between.

Around every hour, the players are moved to another cell through the hallways connecting the three cells by invisible armed guards. The guards are armed with things like splash potions of poison to control misbehaving prisoners. Each cell is usually designed to hold two prisoners. Each prisoner would usually see the same person every six hours.

When prisoners misbehave, the guards take the prisoner into a small solitary confinement cell for hours and even days depending on what the prisoner did. The cell is located underneath each hallway connecting the three cells. There are two per hallway. The cell has a calibrated skulk sensor connected to an inactive chunk ban. If the player were to place or break any blocks, it would activate the chunk ban.

Purpled
 is a minor antagonist featured in 
Unstable Universe
. He was the leader of the 
Far Lands
 Warrior Council before 
Parrot
's election.



Personality


Purpled is known to be a powerful, paranoid, and tyrannical player. Not only does he heavily dislike the Farmers and goes out of his way to tell the other Warriors about how pathetic the Farmers district is, he prioritizes hierarchy and power over peace and progress. 



History


Purpled is seen as the leader of the 
Warriors District
 in 
Far Lands
.

He made the choice to leave the Farmers alone in their time of need, yet he continues to be upset at the Farmers for not doing their jobs of providing for the Warriors, highlighting his hypocrisy. He is paranoid about Parrot, and betrays him and the Warrior Council by pretending to be Mafia members to attempt to maintain his position of power, but Parrot escapes. Parrot becomes the new leader because Purpled is outvoted by the council members.

In 
I Survived the Unstable SMP Purge
, Purpled is one of the remaining candidates in the “dining hall”. Everything was going well until 
LettuceK
 announces the second round, whilst a group of assassins try and kill the candidates. Purpled tries to fight, but he is outnumbered. Purpled escapes but at the cost of Naparizel’s life.

Lettuce calls the emergency meaning and tells the Unstable Members that Napa died, and he gives each candidate 120 votes to be split among the remaining candidates. After the votes are split, Lettuce announces the purge. All the candidates either run or fight and Purpled wants to fight. Purpled demands that Parrot give him his book and has 2 unknown affiliated players. Until Theo arrives at the Northern Council and decides to fight Purpled. Parrot then escapes and the fight between Theo and Purpled begins. Theo, using his TNT minecart combat style is able to wear down Purpled’s armor and in the end Purpled runs away and Theo calls it quits there to find Parrot. 

After the event of Parrot, Horace, and Fymada escaping a trap, the three are now on their way back to the Northern Council until Horace falls into a sand trap made by Purpled, he demands someone to give him the votes, in which Parrot says that Boosfer stole them. Purpled is angered by this response and gives Parrot and Fymada four hours to get the votes back. Parrot then sneaks into the Viking village Purpled owns and successfully helps Horace escape a trap that if he was to die, he would fall in lava. Purpled then goes after Parrot. Parrot manages to lose Purpled by hiding behind a tree.  

Purpled is one of the 4 remaining candidates in the election alongside 
Boosfer
, 
ParrotX2
, and 
LettuceK
.

He later renounced from the election and supported LettuceK. He then joined the Law at the Battle of The Northern Council.

Unstable Universe
, briefly serving as a minor antagonist. He was recently seen in 
ParrotX2
's video, 
Finding the Tomb of the Minecraft Mafia
, where he served as a gambler in a floating house far out in the End. 



History


Rasplin was seen as a member in 
Roshambogames Civilization
 which was attacked by the 
PrinceZam Empire
.

He challenged Parrot to a game of eight-fold, and if Parrot won he would give him the key he needed to open the door to the Tomb of the Mafia. He places increasingly large bets and wins every game, taking a shulker box full of diamonds and Parrot's armor. 

Shortly after their last game, he was killed by 
Marlowww
 in an attempt to retrieve the key.



Trivia


Rasplin likely rigged the game of eight-fold, evidenced by the fact he won every game he played with Parrot. Assuming this is true, he used the rather ingenious strategy of getting his dealer 
HerobaneNair
 to give Parrot a high-value card, making him bet confidently, then following the strong card with a weak one.


He owns a Roblox rant channel with over 800k subscribers.


He has returned to Minecraft after a long period of retirement.

, the guard, says he can’t kill him, as he doesn’t want to kill him. Parrot threatens to tell Reddoons that he didn’t do his job unless he helps them steal from Reddoons.

LuigiToan

Parrot pulls a trap that makes Flame pummel down a chute but Flame block-clutches and saves himself. Flame enderpearls out to catch Parrot running away to a tunnel. Parrot digs the roof dropping lava on Flame but Flame pearls past. Parrot jumps down a hole and breaks a block to make Flame drop down another hole but Flame block-clutches to  prevent himself from dying. Flame then chases Parrot as Parrot runs to 
Theo
. Theo splashes invisibilty on both of them but Flame manages to catch Parrot and pop his  totem. Parrot then bluffs saying he has a TNT minecart trap that would kill all three of them. Parrot says Flame to go back to his job of working for clown but Flame says he isn't working for clown but instead trying to kill him. Flame and Parrot decide to make an alliance as both of them had  the same objective.  

Together, all three of them make  their way to the 
Nether Civilization
 to assassinate Clown or 
FerreMC
. Flame goes to the nether festival and Theo pressures him to fight a player named "GeneralChungus". Flame kills GeneralChungus. Flame and Theo make their way to the central building where they jump Ferre. Although Clown and his guards eventually make their way up to save Theo, they were unsuccessful and Ferre is taken hostage. Parrot denies Flame his fight against Clown purposefully by taking Ferre to a remote bunker. Parrot drops Ferre some maps and other junk making it seemlike the maps were useless. Parrot then lets Ferre free. Flame, furious starts attacking Parrot for letting Ferre out. Parrot tracks the general direction of Ferre and decides to hold a stakeout to see any guards of Clown passing by.  

Flame pretends to go AFK and Parrot says he is just using Flame to get to Clown's nether vault. Flame hears them and runs away to Clown's castle with the goal to betray Parrot. Flame recruits Clown and gives him Parrot's location in exchange for information about 
Wemmbu
. Together the group, makes their way to Parrot and jumps Parrot and Theo. Parrot is able to run away but Theo is captured. Parrot jumps down attempting to make negotiations so Theo is spared but instead, Parrot is captured too. Clown says he knows nothing about 
Wemmbu
. Before Parrot is executed, he apologizes to Flame for using him and Flame accepts it and tells Clown that they'd have to get through him first, betraying Clown. This gives Parrot and Theo time to find the vault. Clown runs away to catch Parrot so his vault isn't ransacked leaving his army behind. Clown's army is eventually defeated and Flame comes out on top. Afterwards, Flame decides to go to 
Capital City
 to offer Parrot a deal to find 
Wemmbu
. Flame offers Parrot the tomb of 
The Invisible Mafia
. Parrot accepts his deal.

SOLO Player VS Minecraft Bounty Hunters

Plot


Flame's
 best friend, 
Jaden_MAN
, has mysteriously disappeared off the server, and he goes around asking players if they know where Jaden went. One player in specific, 
LettuceK
, tells Flame that Jaden is not someone he should be looking for, which makes Flame suspicious, so he follows Lettuce with invisibility. Flame makes it to the base of Lettuce's team of bounty hunters, he questions what it meant by Jaden is captured, and Lettuce says he worked to get things done and have Jaden captured, and so Flame attacks them. Flame quickly pops some of their totems, but is then shot with weakness arrows and is drained of resources. Lettuce proposes that Flame not look for Jaden and that they stop fighting, and Flame agrees just to get them to stop. Flame goes and spies on 
The Law's
 meeting invisible to get any intel on where Jaden could be. The first meeting had nothing important, but a few hours later they held another and Flame overhears them talking about 
Leow0ok
 taking on a 1v5 and ended up beating The Law, they also mentioned holding an auction a few days from then, so Flame plans on attending it to get a lead on Jaden's location. 

Flame goes to the destroyed 
B.A.T. Headquarters
 to look for Leo. Leo thinks he's there to kill him, but Flame says he's there to learn Leo's PvP techniques, which costed Flame an IOU to learn Leo's strategies. Leo shows Flame to use a crossbow and flint and steel to explode the TNT minecarts instantly, and they begin practicing together. With crossbow carting understood, Flame heads to the auction and uses his newfound knowledge and wipes out a good amount of players. Lettuce wants to talk it out and knows Flame won't get the information out of killing him, and he says the reason why he can't tell Flame where Jaden was is because he couldn't let others go through what he had to, so Flame lets him go.

Flame has an idea goes back to the B.A.T. Headquarters and asks Leo for a favor, Leo doesn't want to work with Flame, but Flame gives him an offer of a stack of experience bottles and Leo accepts. He tells Leo to turn himself in to see where The Law takes him and hope that they take the bait. They make it to The Law's base and Leo turns himself in, they take him outside of the base and head towards an ender pearl cannon, where Leo stops pretending and starts to fight The Law. Leo breaks the scaffolding leading up to the cannon, Lettuce and his lawmen begin to stack up. Leo says he's done his job, so Flame gives him the other half of the stack of experience and tries to stop The Law from escaping, but was too late. Flame uses the cannon and is teleported to the Pirate Islands. Flame chases them from island to island, until they reach the last island, which had to have Jaden. Flame carts the lawmen and they're forced to run into the castle. They all jump down the hole that leads to the 
Abandoned Civilization
, Flame asks again where Jaden is, but Lettuce says he needs to stay locked up for the good of everyone. After killing one more lawmen, Lettuce and the remaining lawmen flee and says Flame wins this time. Flame looks around the civilization and finds Jaden inside of a house and gives Jaden food before he starved to death. Flame said he dealt with The Law for Jaden, but Jaden doesn't know who Flame is talking about. Flame asks who put Jaden down there then, and Jaden replies, "It was 
Wemmbu
."

FlameFrags

Lomedy's
 base to reside in for the time being. The toxic clan finds Flame before he could even devise a plan on how to find the leader of the clan, they're all wiped out once again. One of the bodies dropped a lodestone compass, which gave him a clue to find the leader. After regearing, Flame travels towards the location, which is a castle on an island in the middle of the ocean. The toxic clan sees him and try to intimidate him to leave when he says he's looking for their leader. The leader, VEN0M, appears out of nowhere with a mace and revealed that he was a diamond trim Mafia member like Flame was. Flame however doesn't think VEN0M is intimidating despite having a mace and being as skilled as he is, so he takes on the fight against all of them at once. The army dies and it's only Flame and VEN0M left, Flame switches to a different sword and begins to beat VEN0M, causing him to run and call it a stalemate. Flame knew going into the toxic civilization base would take more resources, so he mends his armor and heads back to Lomedy's base where Lomedy was being pressed by more toxic players, and Flame takes of all of them and spares one when they give him a map. Flame trains Lomedy in PvP so he doesn't make Flame look bad later on, he teaches Lomedy how to use cobwebs to slow players down and heads off to the location on the map afterwards.

The map shows a location of one of the toxic clan's vault, Flame forces Lomedy to come with him to the vault. The location is inside of one of the clan's bases and Flame jumps all the guards outside, once inside the clan's territory kills the guards there, and goes into the vaults and kills the guards there too. Flame and Lomedy loot the vault and get a lot of good gear, more guards come in and Flame uses the TNT minecarts and flame bow he just looted to get rid of them. VEN0M makes fun of Flame about how he thinks he's the immortal demon and Flame tells him to show him that he's not, and they begin fighting. Flame uses slow falling arrows to prevent VEN0M from using his mace, Lomedy returns to his base and gives his former teammate's mace to Flame to help. Flame easily kills off the toxic clan, leaving VEN0M alone again, who runs away again. Flame asks Lomedy why he gave him the mace, and Lomedy says that he's been alone ever since his teammate died and it was nice to hang around with someone again and wants to follow Flame along in his journey, but Flame says he works better alone.

Flame pearls into the base and jumps the guards, the TNT dupers come in and blow up the base at the same time, which helps kill some of them off. Flame goes back to Lomedy and returns his maces and get 
Ashen
 back before heading off.

.  

FlameFrags follows the toxic players and attacks the first few people he sees in the base. SOLO Player VS Toxic Minecraft Team
 is the 41st episode featured in

. 



Plot


FlameFrags
 was exploring the server until his wolf teleports to him and began growling, which only happens when a wolf gets attacked. FlameFrags decides to check on his base and he finds out his base was griefed by a toxic team. The team of toxic players had blown his entire base up and killed all his wolves and the wolf that teleported to him was the only survivor. 

FlameFrags heads out to set a temporary camp until he gets attacked by a band of players from the toxic team. They use pots to steal FlameFrags's weapon but FlameFrags proves that he can win a fight against these players with his fists. The toxic players loot FlameFrags's camp and destroy it and he has an argument with the remaining players. They reveal that their leader is 
Razor2gud
. FlameFrags's wolf kills one of the remaining players and one of them drops a lodestone compass. 

FlameFrags goes to where the lodestone compass leads to and finds Razor2gud. FlameFrags tries to confront Razor2gud but he taunts him and runs away. FlameFrags tries to have a fight with Razor2gud but he says that if he wants to fight him, he has to downgrade his gear. After switching to iron armour and weapons, Razor2gudbrings his army to try to kill FlameFrags. The fight goes well, they start using strength potions but FlameFrags is still able to kill all of them. FlameFrags finds a map in one of the houses and realizes that the base he raided wasn't the only base the players own. If he wanted to find all of their bases and destroy them as well as getting revenge on Razor, he had to find the bases. 

FlameFrags sets up another temporary camp inside a cave where he gives his dog new armour and a name, Ashen. FlameFrags uses his map to find a bunker since he knew that they could have TNT after what happened to his base. On his way to the bunker, FlameFrags finds another group of members from the same team. He goes into the bunker and is met with more people trying to defend it. FlameFrags defeats a wave of players there. He begins looting the base until another wave of players jump him.  He uses the fireworks and the crossboy he looted to kill them all. FlameFrags then blows up the entire bunker.

FlameFrags heads to another town and he kills the players living there in case one of them drops a lodestone compass. While he was looting a potion stash, he finds a bunch of strength potions and protects his dog until he gets confronted by Razor2gud and his team. FlameFrags crafts a bunch of TNT minecarts and he also enchants his iron leggings with blast protection to take less damage as well as gathering a few turtle master potions in case he's about to die. FlameFrags kills the army with the minecarts. FlameFrags has a fight with Razor2gud but he runs away again after his armour breaks. FlameFrags destroys the entire town until he finds another lodestone compass. 

FlameFrags arrives to other towns owned by the city and kills everyone there as well as blow up the houses. FlameFrags arrives at Razor2gud's base and he's not playing around anymore. As soon as he confronts them they continue to complai about FlameFrags having netherite armour while they have diamond armour. FlameFrags refuses at first but he downgrades his armour before having a fair fight in the colosseum. FlameFrags begins fighting Razor2gud and it goes well until Razor2gud activates a trap of TNT which was under the colosseum the entire time. As the team leave the colosseum, the TNT explodes and would've killed FlameFrags but he survived using turtle master. FlameFrags begins killing the remaining members of the team and blows up some houses in front of Razor2gud. Razor2gud begs for FlameFrags not to kill him as there are worse people out there but FlameFrags tells him that he will kill them all before killing Razor2gud.

SOLO Player VS Unstable SMP
 is the 64th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


FlameFrags
 is running out of resources, and if he wants to stay alive on Unstable, he's going to have to get rich fast. Flame gets a chance of doing so when he comes across a mysterious invisible player offers Flame riches if he completes their quests. The player instructs Flame to take bring back stolen potions from a dangerous player named MisterLegend101, and so Flame heads to 
Capital City
 in search for him. When he gets to Capital City, nobody is around and it appeared to have been destroyed. He spots a random person and asks where everyone is and they explain that 
Wemmbu
 came by earlier and was looking for Flame, but Flame doesn't care about that as of now and continues looking for MisterLegend101. He finds MisterLegend101 right after and presses him for the potions, but MisterLegend101 says he doesn't have any and will give it back in two weeks, Flame pops his totems until he gives them up. He heads back to the invisible player and hands over the shulker full of potions. His reward is an enchanted golden apple, the invisible player tells him he can receive more if Flame gets a Happy Ghast. However, the Nether is a dangerous dimension as it's guarded by ClownPierce and his army, so he has to go deep into the Nether. He stumbles across Nether scavengers that offer to help him traverse the Nether if he protects them. While exploring, the scavengers explain how they supply groups such as 
B.A.T.
 and 
The Law
. They get to a part of the Nether that has been unlooted and finds a dried Ghast.

Headed back to spawn, Flame meets back with the invisible player, the player says they appreciate Flame's work and gives Flame a beacon, Flame doesn't think the beacon isn't a powerful item and demands for better items. The invisible player asks if Flame wants to know who they are, and they reveal themselves to be 
Spoke
, a person who's manipulated many people in the past, and Flame knows to not trust him because of that. Flame attacks Spoke because he knows that Spoke was scamming him, Spoke drops a book and goes into an escape tunnel. Flame reads the book that tasks him to kill a group of bandits called the Skullhounds and that this could be his final moments on the server. Unsure of how to find them, Flame visits The Law's base to get any intel on them. The Law's base has also seem to be blown up, Flame asks 
LettuceK
 if he knows anything about the Skullhounds, Lettuce says that they're located about 15,000 blocks out from spawn. Flame thinks that Lettuce could be lying, but Lettuce says he has no reason to as of now, seeing the current state that he's in and that he's been trying to kill them himself, but if Flame wants to do it himself, The Law wouldn't interfere. Lettuce also tells Flame to talk to Wemmbu to stop blowing stuff up, but Flame doesn't care about that right now.

Flame is out in the wild and finds a random player and asks if they know the leader of the Skullhounds, they point Flame towards a direction, he finds griefed villages and lava casts, as well as player's loot that has yet to despawn, meaning that they were nearby. He finds the Skullhounds and confronts them, they tell him not to care about what they're doing if he's not apart of Law or B.A.T., two of the bandits stall them while the other builds a small railgun behind him, however Flame notices due to not being able to hear his game, so he quickly places blocks and covers himself to prevent himself from being shot to death. The bandits jump him and puts up a tough fight, almost breaking Flame's armor and resorting to diamond armor, but Flame manages to kill them all off in the end. He picks up their shields and the main bandit's chestplate with trims as proof that he completed the mission. Back at spawn, Spoke is seen high up in the air, trying to avoid being attacked again. He drops down and Flame gives him the shield and armor and asks for his rewards, Spoke says he deserves to be rewarded and that he's trying to build any type of alliance because of his mistakes in the past and is trying to make up for it. Spoke gives Flame a book that leads to a Mafia stash that would lead him to a lifetime full of stashes. Spoke explains how there's so much loot that nobody knows about and that Flame would be rich forever and that the only reason why he hasn't gone there himself is because he's afraid of the people near there, how he doesn't need the loot and Flame needs it more than him. He mentions how he had Flame go through trials to prove that he's ready for this final mission and says they should work closely more in the future.

Flame makes it to the Mafia stash built inside of the mountains of a Bandlands biome that appears to be blown up and looted, each area he goes to has rooms full of chests that are all empty. Flame finds some diamond armor and experience bottles, allowing him to mend his Netherite, he walks out of a dining area and outside onto the bridges that link to other parts of the stash, he's then greeted with Wemmbu standing right above where he just came out of. Wemmbu asks for a rematch, Flame thinks it's pointless since he's beaten Wemmbu every other time, but Wemmbu says he thinks he's the strongest now, Flame laughs at him and Wemmbu sends down a stab shot right at Flame. Flame is shocked and confused at the powers Wemmbu has, he manages to get a few hits in, but is unable to for the most part due to Wemmbu flying in and out. Wemmbu uses an orbital strike cannon as well, making Flame even more confused than before, Flame still has confidence that he can beat Wemmbu even with his TNT powers. The stab shots blow through the entire mountain and reveals an ancient city underneath, Flame grabs a hoe and breaks the sculk for experience in order to mend his armor. Wemmbu stab shots out and Flame chases him, and Wemmbu spams orbitals to try and kill Flame. An invisible person drops Flame more potions to help him out. Now out of totems, Flame starts to use turtle master potions to stay alive, the invisible player drops a couple more totems for Flame. Wemmbu drops another stab shot on Flame, popping a totem, but more importantly breaking Flame's chestplate, his most prized possession. Flame tries to regear with his shulkers, but Wemmbu blows them up before he has the chance to. Without any more totems this time, Flame drops all the way down to bedrock and digs a tunnel to hide. Wemmbu talks knowing Flame probably hears him, he says he doesn't want to kill Flame and wants him to know he'll never be the strongest ever again and flies off.

Flame goes back to spawn where Spoke said he would be, instead of finding Spoke, a sign is placed saying, "Thank you my friend" with a wither rose right in front of it. Flame is upset that he lost to Wemmbu and destroys everything inside of his ender chest and inventory. He says to himself that it's over for Wemmbu, implying he's going to get stronger and get revenge on Wemmbu.

It has since then been changed to SOLO Player VS World's Largest Minecraft Server.

title: Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
content:
Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing














Episode


126






Upload date


Apr 28, 2026






POV


SpokeIsHere






Arcs


NULL






Featured Creators (Description)


JumperWho
PlanetLord
JamatoP
Mapicc
DevMCchamp
ItsAli
bluecube132
















The Unstable SMP is the largest Hardcore Minecraft server, with thousands of players joining every day. However, over the course of the past few weeks, at least a thousand of these players have gone missing....





Searching For 1000 Players Who Went Missing
 is the 126th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


Spoke
 recaps what he's gone through for the past month; looking for a thousand players, trying to find his 
best friend
, finding clues that players left behind, all to find out there are anonymous players take players to places that nobody else has seen before on the server.

The episode starts right where it left off previously, Mapicc unveils his identity and tells Spoke and 
Jumper
 that he doesn't have a lot of time and to pack everything they have and to meet him at a set of coordinates in a signed book by a player named Revenant44. This leaves the both of them speechless, but they had no other choice other than to listen to his instructions. 

They reach the coordinates and spot a tree getting broken and replaced, hinting that's where the hidden bunker is and so they go down the ladder. As they do, one of the 
Null Hunters
 watch them from a distance. At the bottom of the bunker, there are four eerie identical tunnels lit with redstone torches, Mapicc tells them to follow him down one. Spoke asks Mapicc what's happened to him and asks for an explanation about everything. Mapicc explains that he was captured by NULL , but was able to escape and has a chance to save the rest of the players. He then goes on to say that they're heading towards a pearl cannon that leads to a camp and they'll be able to gear up and meet up with Revenant, the same player who wrote the book, saved Mapicc. Just as they think they're safe, the Null Hunters hide in the walls of the tunnel and dig out and start chasing. Mapicc insists going to the pearl cannon is the only way out of this, so they keep running to the cannon. Spoke and Jumper hold them off easily and they make it to the cannon and pearl into it. 

As the three all teleport, Mapicc says the cannon had failed to teleport them to the right location and the hunters may have tampered with it. Spoke opens up his F3 menu and sees that they're 12 million blocks out and thinks it's going to take forever to go back to spawn, but Mapicc says being out that much is a good thing and begins walking towards the 
Far Lands
. Mapicc says to be careful of Null Hunters that could potentially be out in the Farlands since the camp is deep inside. The three of them go inside of the Farlands rather than the top to not show themselves, Mapicc says they'll keep going until they reach a biome he recognizes. When they reach the end of the tunnel, it's a biome that's all flowers, which isn't the one Mapicc recognizes. Mapicc then spots a Null Hunter so they sneak and watch him. They overhear 
their squad leader
 telling the rest of the hunters instructing them on what to do before they used their traveling methods to leave. They come out of hiding and start walking forward again, Mapicc tells Spoke and Jumper that there are other people that have escaped NULL and that NULL isn't the only things they should be worried about in the Farlands. Mapicc makes a point that with NULL capturing bad players, they're bound to do bad things even in the Farlands, so he suggests for Spoke and Jumper to blend in with them and not use their netherite armor. Spoke then suggests that they use the shortcuts that the hunters since there's a good chance they'd get lost in the Farlands, and so they do. As they run back the opposite direction, they spot a cave entrance and go inside. They splash invis for safety measures and spot Null Hunters running right past them. After all of them have passed, they come out of hiding and turn left and reach the red plains biome of the Farlands, which is the biome the camp is located at. Spoke asks why they don't go through the Nether, Mapicc tells him that nether portals are a bad omen and whoever has gone through the Nether that isn't NULL have never returned. He theorizes that the hunters may have taken these players into the Nether. 

Eventually, they find the campsite, but with no signs of Revenant anywhere. Spoke spots a hole caused by an explosion with cobwebs, signaling that the hunters had found the camp and took all of the gear. With no other leads, they have no other ideas and need to come up with something new. Mapicc has the idea of killing the other missing players, Spoke doesn't think that seems ideal. Just as they say that, a group of the missing players run their direction and they start running the opposite direction and towering up to the mineshaft up in the air with the players towering up as well. Spoke and Jumper put on their netherite armor and start attacking them, but they hear one of them say that they were the players that raided the camp. Spoke is confused and asks them to repeat themselves, they think that Spoke is a part of NULL because of his shield pattern and demands to know why he attacked the camp. Spoke explains to them that him and Jumper are the only players who know about NULL and what they've been doing, and that convinces them to team up. The Null Hunters start towering up, the missing players tell them to take their horses at the bottom and to head north while they fight off the hunters. Mapicc couldn't believe that they convinced the missing players to work with them, Spoke says although they are all bad people, they'd have to work with each other. It cuts back to the missing players being confronted by the Null Hunters, they make all the missing players take off all their armor and go through a nether portal. Spoke finally uses the time to ask Mapicc why he gave him the NULL shield. Mapicc goes to say when him and 
MinuteTech
 went to the end right before the final fight against 
the Law
, they split off and Mapicc encountered the Null Hunters for the first time. He says that they helped him by giving the shield and invited him to join NULL. Since he was about to fight a war, he couldn't join quite yet, but in the middle of the fight, they pulled his stasis due to him being way too trusting.

The three of them make it near the end of the biome, where chunks of the biome start appearing on top. Jumper spots Null Hunters coming from the distance, but Spoke says they can outrun them with their horses. Shortly after, they make it out of the red plains biome and enter the Farlands Rings biome. They go upwards and see names, and so they go to investigate. They find a house and a group of players surrounding a campfire playing a game. Spoke holds up the NULL shield and asks if they know anything about the group, the player speaking tells him that he should talk to their leader and brings them over to their leader, who is 
PlanetLord
. He invites them into a house with an enchantment table and allows them to gear up. After they get all new gear, Spoke asks Planet what he's been up to, Planet says he's been in the Farlands for a while and he used to explore a lot of the biomes before NULL started patrolling it and that him and the village believes the biomes weren't created naturally, but rather that whoever discovered the Farlands first on Unstable made them. The three go to the farm and collect wheat and carrots and begin fishing, when all of a sudden the same player that they talked to earlier gets killed by a Null Hunter. They go back invis and spy on the leader talking to Planet asking where Spoke had went, but Planet says he doesn't know in order to protect them, and so the hunters force Planet to go through a nether portal. Spoke sees the house they were just in and realizes he left all of his shulkers in the house, so he goes down to the house to collect them. The Null Hunters see that Jumper and Mapicc are above and start attacking them, causing them to run. 

They make it to the end of the Farlands Rings and enter a big plains biome with no trees or water. They run through that whole biome and enter a biome that's entirely dark and filled with black. They realize that the armor's enchantment glints is the only way to see in this darkness, so they take off their armor and place a torch to see each other. They come up with a plan to use this to their advantage, as the hunters don't know how to track them through this biome. They sneak up on a few of the hunters and kill them off one by one. One of the hunters drops chainmail armor, which meant Planet could have possibly died. The leader comes up to them and asks what they did to his team, and they start jumping the leader. Before they kill him off, he asks what they want. Spoke says he knows it's not easy to become a leader and wants him to answer a few questions. Firstly, he asks why they take players from spawn to the Farlands, but the leader says he's just the middleman and knows nothing and was sent by someone. The next question Spoke asks is who sent these hunters, but he isn't able to share that information, however, he can show the place where they come from. Spoke forces the leader to drop his netherite armor for precautionary reasons and make him take him to the place. When they reach the place where the Null Hunters travel through, he's too scared to go down the trapdoor and says he can't be seen with Spoke. The leader tries to run away, and Jumper kills him. They then drop down the trapdoor, which seems to be an infinite stone brick staircase that keeps going down and down. They finally reach the end, which has fibers that may lead to the different biomes like the leader said. Spoke says they should go to the bottom and starts lighting the place up with redstone torches to be able to see. They see a light in the distance and walks towards it to discover a village looking area. Jumper sees someone coming from the darkness, Spoke is taken aback and shocked when he sees 
JamatoP
 come into view. The episode ends as Jamato tells them that he's there to help.



Trivia


Unlike 
Wemmbu
, Spoke's ender chest did not get cleared when he entered in the Farlands.


Null Hunters
 can light nether portal in the Farlands.


The red plain biome, the fabric biome, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" are reference to Wifies' world that doesn't exist ARG series.


The endless downward ladder, and Mapicc saying "soul corrupted to darkness" may be a reference to 
the Underworld
.


The word "Revenant" means "a person who returns after a long absence or, in folklore, a visible ghost or animated corpse that returns from the dead to haunt the living" which suggests that Revenant might return.

eggchan is gone





Searching For My Friend Who Went Missing
 is the 131st episode featured in 
Unstable Universe




Plot


Wemmbu
 begins the episode by telling the viewers that he doesn't have a lot of friends, except his friend 
Eggchan
. Wemmbu then recaps his previous video, that a mysterious player wanted Egg dead, however during an encounter he and Egg split off and he hasn't found Egg every since. However, while he was split off from Egg he managed to kill the mysterious player who was revealed to be a player named 
Cytharam
. He believed that he managed to kill the mysterious player until he saw the mysterious player next to him. The player told him to meet him at his base and stasises away. Wemmbu asks the mysterious player where Egg is. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu that he doesn't know where Egg is. The player tells Wemmbu that Egg is valuable and that he needs to kill Egg or he will get captured and it will end badly for everyone .  Wemmbu eventually agrees to work with this player to find Egg. The mysterious player asks Wemmbu if he has any idea where Egg could be. Wemmbu tells the player that he has an idea. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu that he needs to restock his orbitals as he anticipates they will get into a lot of fights. Both of them head to a town to get information about Egg, they begin to look for a player who is selling armor. A player named Wheatgust rings a bell bringing them to his shop. Wemmbu then asks wheatgust if he has any armor that he doesn't need. Wheatgust shakes his head yes and gives armor to Wemmbu and the mysterious player. The mysterious player gives Wheatgust diamond blocks and Wemmbu and him began walking all over town. Then, 
Yungyx
 and 3 guards appear in the town and start interrogating people about the whereabouts of Egg. Yungyx tells the players that 
Arachn1d
 really wants Egg, Wemmbu asks the mysterious player why he wants Egg and the mysterious player tells Wemmbu again that Egg is too valuable. Wemmbu heads to the pond where Yungyx and begins fishing, secretly listening to Yungyx's conversation with the other players.

After a few seconds of listening to Yungy's conversation, Wemmbu maces Yungy catching him by surprise. Wemmbu begins fighting Yungy and his guards when the town guards starting fighting Wemmbu. Wemmbu manages to kill Yungy's guards and makes Yungy'x flee. The town guards continue to fight Wemmbu while Yungy continues to flee. Wemmbu jumps off a bridge with his elyta and flies to Yungy, however the town guards continue to fight Wemmbu. Eventually ,Yungy flees leaving Wemmbu and the town guards alone. The town guards continue to fight Wemmbu, they eventually stop and Wemmbu leaves the town guards. Wemmbu comes back to the mysterious player who tells Wemmbu that he should have kept a low profile as everyone from the town left leaving them with no information. Wemmbu and the mysterious player head to Egg's fishing spot to find any clues about where Egg could be. They don't find anything and Wemmbu asks the player why Egg is so valuable in the first place. The mysterious player ignores Wemmbu and Wemmbu begins to leave when the player tells Wemmbu fine. The player tells Wemmbu that Arachn1d isn't the only one hunting Egg down and that the only reason why Arachn1d is hunting Egg is to control him. Wemmbu then asks the player why he knows that information about Arachn1d's plans. The player tells Wemmbu that Arachn1d payed him to capture Wemmbu alive and that many of his enemies will pay big to keep him alive. Wemmbu believes that the planted wheat seed is a clue and the mysterious player says "The Wheat Village". The player then tells Wemmbu that they is where Egg is, they head to the Wheat Kingdom in hope of finding Egg. They discover that the Wheat Kingdom has been destroyed and find a group of players in the destruction. 

A player writes on a sign saying "This invis guy kidnapped Egg", Wemmbu then tells the invisible player that he has Egg all this time. The mysterious player tells Wemmbu why would he be working with Wemmbu if he had already gotten Egg. Wemmbu then believes that the mace that he has is the one that he gave to 
FieldsOfElysium
. Wemmbu then tells the player that the deal is off and attacks the player with a stab shot, killing a player from the group in the process. Wemmbu then unleases an orbital strike on the wheat farms blowing up a big chunk of it. Wemmbu continues to fight the player for a long time, using another orbital strike on him. The mysterious player stasises away and Wemmbu meets up to the group of players. The group of players reveal that someone was with the invisble player, that someone was 
FlameFrags
. Wemmbu comes to FlameFrag's base to find two players guarding the entrance. Wemmbu orbitals them instantly killing them and heads into Flame's base. He finds Flame, Lomedy, and the invisible player and knows that they have Egg. Flame tells Wemmbu that he is forced as he is in 
Cindercrest
. Wemmbu asks Flame why he is working with the invisble player. Flame tells Wemmbu that if he cooperates Egg won't die. Wemmbu then unleashes an orbital strike on Flame's base and starts fighting Flame. Wemmbu and Flame continue to fight, with Wemmbu continuing to stab shot Flame. Flame tells 
Lomedy
 to kill Egg and Wemmbu rushes after Lomedy trying to stop him. Wemmbu discovers an obsidian box and realizes that the invisible player took Egg. Flame tells Wemmbu that it is Wemmbu's fault, Wemmbu asks Flame why was he working with the invisible guy. Flame tells Wemmbu that he was working with him because he is in Cindercrest. Flame tells Wemmbu that he was asking Egg questions and when he refused to answer any questions, he put him in an obsidian box.

Wemmbu and Flame begin sailing to 
Linnwyrm's
 base, and find that Linnwyrm is afk because he is getting doordash. Lynnworm returns and is greeted by Wemmbu and Flame, Wemmbu asks Linnworm if he has see Egg. Linnworm tells Wemmbu that he hasn't see Egg, Wemmbu asks Linn how did he know that he needed the armor that he is wearing. Linn tells Wemmbu that ever since the Law had came out of power that there have been many players stirring in the world. He wanted Wemmbu to be at full strength if anything came up. Wemmbu asks Linnwyrm if he knew about the mysterious trimmed player,Linn tells Wemmbu that he knows the mysterious player. Wemmbu and Flame gives the recap of his story with the mysterious player. Lynn reveals that he knows where the mysterious player's base is and tells Wemmbu that it's time to get looking. 
Jaden_MAN
 then appears to help and Linn tells Wemmbu and Flame that they need all the help they can get. Flame and Jaden start arguing with each other, they eventually agree to work with each other. Wemmbu, Flame, and Jaden begin looting up to prepare for the journey to the mysterious player's base. Wemmbu begins disenchanting a bunch of fishing rods and bows to get xp for his armor. Wemmbu asks Flame for totems, hesistant Flame eventually places a shulker box full of totems which Wemmbu quickly snatches. Wemmbu, Jaden, and Flame begin to head out of Linn's base just before Linn gives them a warning about how dangerous the player. They begin to head off when they realize they've never asked the coords to the base. Once they have the coords. they sail to find an enormous island which they presume is the player's base. They approach the island and find Yungyx and Arachn1d with three guards who tell them that they want Egg. They all head up the mysterious player's to see Egg, they find Egg and the mysterious player. 

Egg greets Wemmbu and Wemmbu aks Egg how he got in this situation. The mysterious player tells everyone that he has a proposition, he tells them that who ever pays him the most will be given Egg. Wemmbu asks the player what happened to him, killing Egg of the server. The mysterious player then puts Egg in a remote stasis chamber for his safety. Everyone starts arguing about their riches until Flame tells everyone he is on the behalf of Cindercrest. Wemmbu being surprised asks Flame why. Flame tells everyone that Cindercrest needs Egg's knowledge. Getting impatient, Wemmbu tells everyone that he will kill everyone there, he then unleashes an orbital strike bringing in a huge fight. Everyone starts fighting each other, Jaden and Wemmbu manage to kill two of Arachn1d's guards before unleashing another orbital strike. The huge fight continues wth Wemmbu only focusing Flame. Flame then brings a bunch of armored wolf's to the fight, Wemmbu then starts fighting Yungy. Wemmbu eventually goes back into the fight with everyone. Wemmbu and Yungy fly into a cave and start dueling when the invisible player and and Flame enter as well. Wemmbu and Flame continue to fight for a long time, Wemmbu then goes after Yungy, he then notices an intresting building in the cave. Wemmbu then goes invis to hide from everyone. He goes into the mysterious cave building and finds a maze, Wemmbu begins to go through it until he digs down. He finds nothing and continues to got though the maze almost going into a trap. He finds a dripstone trap and realizes he could use the dripstone. 

He manages to pop the invisible player's totem with the dripstone revealing his name which is Flbthp. He chases after Flbthp and finds Arachn1d, Jaden, and an invis guy (possibly still Flbthp) in a big room. The invis guy tells them to wait for the representative for Cindercrest, Flame and Yungy both arrive and the mysterious player tells everyone he is willing to negotiate. Arachn1d tells the mysterious player that he will give him, the entire treasure of the caverns. The mysterious player accepts his offer and expects the offer to be true. Wemmbu asks Yungy and Arachn1d, why they want Egg so badly, Yungy tells Wemmbu that with Egg, they have him and with him they have a bunch of power which will allow for Arachn1d to be the rightful king. Yungy then tells Wemmbu that with him on their side they will win a lot of battles in the future.  The episode ends off with Yungy giving Wemmbu an ultimatum, join him in the caves or they will kill Egg.

Thousands of players have joined the Unstable SMP, but a small portion of those players have mysteriously disappeared, including my 
best friend.
 After finding out no one else was willing to solve this, I along with my teammate, JumperWho, made it our mission to find the missing players and hopefully reunite with my long lost friend...





Searching for 100 Players Who Went Missing
 is the 123rd episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
.



Plot


On the Unstable SMP, thousands of players are online concurrently, but a small percent of these players have disappeared within the past month. Most players don't seem to notice the disappearances, as death bans are super common, but 
Spoke
 thinks it may be something much more sinister going on. A case of this happening was his best friend 
Mapicc
, who went missing a month ago after spending years on Unstable. Spoke went on a search for him, which turned into a mission that unraveled one of the biggest mysteries on the server. Spoke goes on to recap what happened in the 
previous episode
 and the episode begins where it left off.

Spoke picks up the 
mission: null
 book and goes through the pages, which have usernames and coordinates linked to that player. He gives it to 
JumperWho
, neither of them know what it means. Jumper goes through the hundred pages to see if she recognizes a name, Spoke sees the bounty hunters coming from a distance and tells Jumper to invis up and run into the house. Both of them hide on top of lanterns just as the hunters barge inside the house and begin destroying it. A nether portal spawns nearby, another leader of 
the bounty hunters
 named 
_x_6_00
 comes through and gives the hunters extra resources. The leader builds a grave and goes back through the portal, the hunters then spread out and walk away. Once the coast is clear, Spoke and Jumper jump down from their hiding spot and go over to the grave and break the block underneath the wither rose. A chest appears under and there's a book signed by the leader, Spoke takes the book and reads it. It reads as following:

"
I know you stole it.


It doesn't belong to you.


Surrender and return what is ours.


Now, rebuild the portal.
"

Spoke gets scared at the fact that the leader knew he was going to break the portal, so they run towards a direction he knew the hunters didn't go. He mentions that some of the coordinates were close by and suggests that they should investigate in case this could have any leads on Mapicc's whereabouts. The first set of coordinates leads them to a house built out of cherry blossom wood, Jumper finds a dog left abandoned inside of the house, which confirms their theory that these players have gone missing. They begin heading over to another set of coordinates, they spot a nether portals in their path, signifying that the hunters are traveling through the nether to watch them. Spoke makes an escape tunnel in the nearby area because of this. Once Spoke builds the hole, they walk to the next set of coordinates and spots a player named Cornflakecapt4in living there. Spoke asks Cornflake if they've seen someone named Calvin6 and they say that Calvin was their teammate that went missing after he went out to get an enchantment table. Jumper goes through the book again and sees that Cornflake's name is also in the book at the exact same coordinates of Calvin, Spoke suggests that Cornflake should escape quickly. Cornflakes immediately starts digging into the ground. They see a nether portal spawn on a mountain close by, the hunters start attacking Spoke and Jumper, who barely have any resources to survive. Spoke has no more food or blocks, Jumper tells him that they need to run right then and now to one of their escape tunnels. Spoke doesn't have enough resources to get there, so he gets up on a mountain and gets invisibility from his ender chest. He goes back over to the base and rescues Jumper. 

A chase breaks out, Spoke spots another base in the distance and hides full invis in it. He hides on the outsides of the base and sees a boat placed on the ice. He doesn't know where Jumper is, so he has no way of contacting her and telling her to meet him over at the boat, but Jumper is already in the boat and spins around in it, showing Spoke that she was there first. The leader chases them, who drifts into a tree, giving them a bigger lead. When they get in water, the hunters are already all on boats and continue to chase. The hunters attempt to sink Spoke and Jumper's boat, Spoke tries to shoot and break their boats, but fails to. With no other option, they head back on land and continue heading towards the direction of Spoke's escape tunnel. Spoke towers upwards, but gets knocked off. He sees Jumper as soon as he falls and they start running again, the escape tunnel is right in front of them, Spoke breaks a melon and exposes the hole. He looks down and sees that there's not water down to bedrock and realizes the hunters broke the bedrock and turned it into a void trap. Spoke uses his Elytra and flies down slowly, he asks Jumper to drop rockets for him. The hunters have blocked off the entrance, Jumper makes up a plan real quick, she realizes the people are in the book for a reason and they're all trappers, so the coordinates in the book could have a void trap as well. The first set of coordinates have nothing, so they quickly go over to the next. As they continue to fly, Spoke's Elyta's durability wears down and is close to breaking until they spot something in the void. It's a happy ghast floating in the void with five players stuck on it. Jumper flies up and breaks the obsidian, she places water, but it doesn't flow down as blocks don't go beneath bedrock. Spoke steps up and pearls up, going through the obsidian entirely and breaks it. After Spoke gets up, he gets Jumper to get a saddle so they can all ride the happy ghast upwards, but because there's more than four of them, he asks if any of them were willing to jump and one of them jumps into the void. Spoke gives one of the players a pearl and they pearl up, Jumper then puts the saddle on the happy ghast and flies it upwards so the rest of them can swim up. As soon as they all make it up safely, Jumper gives them signs and asks what happened. One of them writes that they were trapped by someone named MisterMinion, who was the name in the book and were stuck down there for over three months. Spoke and Jumper leave them to be and lets them keep the base and leaves.

Jumper says she was right about NULL targeting bad players. Spoke says what they know about NULL is that they're ruthless and that they kill people, random people, friends, griefers, and it's more about their actions that affects players all around the server. Spoke says they need more help finding out what's going on. Spoke thinks that there's one player that could help them rally up players together, Jumper asks who he has in mind and Spoke says they need to go to spawn to visit the 
king
. They head to the front of the 
Northern Council
, Spoke nicely asks the guards to let them see the king, but they nod their heads no. One of them blows a horn, Spoke thinks they should start going full invis and sneaking in, just as he says that, Jumper sees 
TheobaldTheBird
 walking out of the Northern Council to see what they want. Spoke says they need to see the king, Theo doesn't allow to let them through without any reason, Spoke places down his ender chest and says he has goodies, which piques Theo's interest. Theo makes them pay two totems as down payment to walk foot inside the Northern Council and two pieces of netherite when they're at the front of the castle. Spoke says he does have netherite to give Theo and gives him directions to where it is, Theo writes it down in a book and quill, Spoke and Jumper run past him while he's distracted. Theo catches up to them and asks for his tip, Spoke gives him a stack of TNT. The three of them walk up to where Parrot is, Theo tells Parrot that Spoke and Jumper were there to visit and forces them to bow. Parrot stops Theo since they're his friends and asks how they've been. Spoke cuts to the chase, he asks Parrot if he knows anything about NULL. He explains Parrot what NULL has been doing and that players have gone missing inside of the book they got their hands on. Parrot says he has gotten zero reports about any player disappearances and that most of the coordinates inside of the book were inside of his kingdom. Parrot goes on to say this is the first time he's heard of this and he would've known if players were actually going missing. Jumper begins to explain how everybody in the book is theorized to be players who are trappers, griefers, scammers, bad people overall. Parrot says all of the people that have disappeared are bad and NULL is doing more good for his kingdom than bad. He doesn't believe NULL is a real thing, but rather that they're using him to find Mapicc and is willing to give them resources to find him and that NULL isn't a top priority for him. Spoke crashes out and says he's the king and that he should be worried about a mysterious group of players terrorizing his kingdom. In the end, Parrot tells them he doesn't have a lot of resources and gives them as much as he can. 

Spoke, Jumper, and five guards walk down the obsidian highway. Spoke asks Jumper if she has anybody they can ask for help, as Jumper answers, Spoke sees a nether portal on top of a lava cast and senses that something is wrong. The bounty hunters break out of the walls and instantly kill Parrot's guards. Another chase breaks out, Spoke and Jumper desperately try to boat away, but the bounty hunters are constantly on their tail. Spoke tries the tree strat again by hiding in a tree, but the hunters spot him. Spoke then wind charges up a lava cast and towers up, Jumper follows shortly after. Jumper accidentally misclicks and that causes them both to get knocked down. They make it back on ice, Spoke boats away, but gets stuck in a pothole. The hunters catch up, Spoke swims down into the water and digs into a cave and wind charges out, successfully juking out most of the hunters. He reaches the top of the tower again, he pearls away and pretends to get knocked off to distract the hunters. He spots Jumper in the distance and goes full invis in a boat to go save her. Spoke fails to boat away and sees another cave in the distance. He gets Jumper to follow him into the cave, the hunters come following and Spoke hides right below a waterfall and jukes the hunters again. He then uses this opportunity to make an escape tunnel. He climbs out of the tunnel and signals Jumper to pearl to him, they both jump down the tunnel, Spoke drains the water and places a dripstone where the water was, popping four of the hunter's totems and making them teleport. They go into crawl mode and begin to dig away, the hunters catch up, but end up losing their trail. 

As they surface, Spoke says they're back at square one and without the regear Parrot gave them, they would've died. He mentions how there's so much going on in the server for players to care and that just the two of them aren't enough to stop it all. Spoke says they only have one more option, and that's to use 
Jumper's spies
. Jumper dislikes the idea of using her spies and reminds him of the spies' actual purpose and that if they do go through with this plan, they would essentially be declaring war on NULL. They then decide to go to the last remaining set of coordinates to find any clues on Mapicc. The last house appears to be another regular house, Spoke looks around on the outside and sees there's a part of the house hidden somewhere and stumbles across a hidden passageway inside of the chimney hiding behind a painting. Inside of the secret room is random loot and a book hidden in an item frame named "
road to null
" signed by anticsparty06, a different player who isn't shown in the mission: null book. Spoke begins reading the book, it reveals that Antics hasn't left their base in weeks because 
they
 would find him and this time he doesn't think he would escape. Antics joined Unstable with the intent of building farm with friends and creating a factory to give new players gear in order to survive and wanted to be remembered as a good player. Antics starts to talk about NULL, they came rummaging the base and forced him to march for tens of thousands of blocks to a mountain, where a pearl cannon was built and was said to teleport them to the Road of Null. Antics never got to see where it lead, he attempted to offset the cannon and send his pearl elsewhere. Right before he was killed, his pearl landed in the middle of the 
Far Lands
. He was able to reach the border to find food and resources to build a pearl cannon of his own. He says NULL has been relentlessly hunting and watching him and asks for whoever found the book to come save them and gives them a set of coordinates; 50,000 in each direction. Spoke thinks this may lead to the coordinates of the pearl cannon and this is their only chance of saving the missing players as well as Mapicc. Spoke says they have to go into this world and makes a plan to gather up the spies while NULL is distracted. Spoke goes in one direction and Jumper goes towards another, before they set off, Jumper tells Spoke to give them a choice to come join them.

They get ahold of fourteen more spies and they all fly towards the pearl cannon using happy ghasts. Just as they reach the pearl cannon, another set of happy ghasts come flying from the other side of the mountain. NULL had gotten there at the same time and begin shooting arrows at the spies. Spoke comes up with a plan, goes full invis and jumps down. He walks to the pearl cannon and throws a pearl into it. The leader sees it being activated and blows the cannon up, and the hunters kill off Jumper's spies, causing Spoke and Jumper to retreat. Jumper sounds defeated at the fact that she brought her spies into war when she promised to keep them safe from any kind of conflict. They had lost the last players that could help them and with no pearl cannon to get to where they need to go. They head back to Spoke's hidden base from the previous episode, a lamp goes off signaling that someone is at the entrance and Jumper goes to see who it is. She comes back and tells Spoke someone is at the door and doesn't know who it is. Spoke comes up to the entrance and sees an invisible player with a copper helmet, diamond chestplate, copper leggings, and iron boots. The invisible player drinks milk and it is revealed to be Mapicc.



Trivia


The coordinates 50k, 50k is the exact same coordinates that Wemmbu used for his griefing services back in Season 1 in the episode, 
Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP
.


At 1:00:07 you can see "Kill Spoke" on the frozen river.
