I Created Minecraft's Greatest Civilization










 
 
 
 
 


Wemmbu’s Civilization
, or 
The Grand Empire
, was a Minecraft civilization established by 
Wemmbu
 within 
Unstable Universe
. The civilization was marked by large-scale constructions, a well-structured society, and strategic planning, though it did not dominate the server. It focused more on creative experimentation with empire-building, establishing territories and resource management. Despite its efforts, the empire never gained widespread control over the server but was still a notable feature due to its ambitious designs and infrastructure.



History


PrinceZam
 tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a civilization to guard a vault. PrinceZam tells him not to go inside. Wemmbu gets his friend 
Eggchan
 to help him build his empire. 
FlameFrags
 comes over to Wemmbu. FlameFrags acts like he is not a guard of PrinceZam, and he’s not wearing his PrinceZam gear. FlameFrags starts attacking Wemmbu. Eggchan pulls Wemmbu’s stasis chamber, which means that Wemmbu escapes. Wemmbu gives eggchan all of his armor.

Wemmbu sends Eggchan to distract FlameFrags. Wemmbu uses TNT minecarts to try to kill FlameFrags. It pops his totem and they mine down to try and escape. Eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

The civilization recruits a new player, 
C4CorvetteOwner
. A team of people including 
Jaden_MAN
 come over and try to kill the Wemmbu empire. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps.

Wemmbu has a professional builder, 
Horace_Altman
 help him build the empire. After a day has passed, they come back to the base and see Horace has built a village. They invite a couple of new residents. 
ClownPierce
 is seen chasing an invisible player in the civilization. ClownPierce eventually leaves. ClownPierce comes back and hears Wemmbu talking with Parrot. He starts killing villagers to try and get information, but Wemmbu tells him he has no information. Parrot leaves.

ManePear
, 
Merffinn
, and PrinceZam come over. PrinceZam comes over to check up on the colony. He says that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu asks if he put a bounty on Parrot and hired ClownPierce to kill him, but PrinceZam says that he is not affiliated with ClownPierce. PrinceZam leaves his two guards at the vault to help the citizens not die.

Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base where they experimented on how to break into prisons. He takes a bunch of useful items there, including full netherite armor, golden apples, etc. They destroy the chunk ban that 
Fantst
 is in, and ask him if he wants to join their civilization. He agrees to join it. Horace adds giant obsidian walls around the empire.

Wemmbu hears Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that they broke their railgun. They decide to see what the vault is. They dig down and discover it is an obsidian box with nothing in it.

Parrot comes back to the empire and asks if they can protect him from ClownPierce. Wemmbu agrees to help him. Parrot has the idea to put chunk bans around the empire to protect it from invaders.

A team of people including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN invade. The civilization manages to get them to run away, but the entrance part of their colony is destroyed. Parrot parts ways with the empire. Wemmbu and eggchan try to figure out how they could kill FlameFrags. While planning, FlameFrags comes over and tries to kill them. Wemmbu almost dies, but PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags says "I guess you have to live now." PrinceZam comes over to the civilization to check on Wemmbu. Wemmbu tells him that he found out that there was nothing in the obsidian vault they had been guarding.

PrinceZam destroys all of his civilization and tells him to pretend like none of this ever happened. He says that his original plan was to chunk ban Wemmbu, but he changes his mind and says that Wemmbu is too weak to even be a threat anymore.

Wemmbu goes to his orbital cannon to try and destroy the 
Zam Empire
, but sees the orbital cannon has been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam Empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn. They blow it up.

Wemmbu and some of the members of his civilization try to use a new orbital cannon to destroy the base, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray Zam Empire.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade the 
Roshambogames Civilization
. FlameFrags almost kills 
Roshambogames
 with a wooden sword, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges FlameFrags to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in the Roshambo empire to evacuate, and he escapes using a stasis chamber.

Horace_Altman expands Wemmbu's new civilization greatly, and makes it fire-proof.

ManePear distracts 
yungwillx
 by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and 
Peentar
 on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage, forcing Zam and his guards to leave. Wemmbu and ManePear take yungwillx to the dungeon. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage and put him in the dungeon. ManePear and Wemmbu think about killing the hostages, but are dissuaded by eggchan. While they are taking 
Sorhin
 hostage, players from Zam Empire break out yungwillx and Peentar before regearing them with Zam Empire ear. 

The Zam Empire destroys Wemmbu’s civilization. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, and Zam imprison eggchan.

This article contains major spoilers from recently released episodes. Please proceed with caution.




History


Season 1


Wemmbu secretly spies on 
SpokeIsHere
 having a conversation with 
JamatoP
, and hears them talking about an exploit. Jamato gives Spoke an armor set, to which 
Spoke
 reacts to the armor set surprised. Wemmbu leaves into a nearby cave. In the end dimension, Wemmbu asks Spoke what his armor is. Spoke lies to him and says that he grinded for the armor himself. Wemmbu is interviewed to guard one of The Wonders. He shows that using a fishing rod he can activate an 
orbital strike cannon
. This gets him the job to guard one of 
The Wonders
. Wemmbu gets more suspicious of Spoke when he meets him in the end, where Wemmbu is not guarding The Wonders. Wemmbu respawns the dragon, suffocating Spoke in obsidian in an end pillar he hollowed out. Spoke is able to get out, and Wemmbu questions Spoke. Spoke starts trying to kill him, but Wemmbu is stronger than him. Wemmbu is unable to kill Spoke as he escapes using the outer end islands. Spoke checks one of The Wonders and exclaims that "it" is still here, referring to the glitched items that he stores in the wonders. Wemmbu hears this and says "what’s still here, Spoke?". He attacks Spoke, almost killing him. Spoke escapes by mining out of the wonder. Wemmbu and ParrotX2 discover that The Wonders were being destroyed. Wemmbu uses Parrot to give him the coordinates of Spoke. At those coordinates, he finds a massive vault of duped items, and attempts to break in. 
Tyrad
 finds him, a guard of the vault. Tyrad fails in to stop him from breaking in. He also spots 2 other guards, 
Sharkilz
 and 
RealReeon
. He kills Tyrad, and escapes from them. He finds the guards again, but this time 
Only_A_Squid
 is also there. Wemmbu escapes again. Wemmbu breaks into the main area, where he’s trapped in an area full of chest minecarts with a warden.  

Spoke says that Wemmbu’s stuck in his prison. Wemmbu manages to escape by going to a corner, destroying a couple of chest minecarts, and mining out. He tries to kill Spoke, but Spoke escapes. He finally escapes the vault by mining out. He finds Spoke and attempts to kill him, but he escapes again using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu asks Parrot if he knows where Spoke is, to which he says no. He then finds JamatoP in his base after he’s vanished. Jamato says that he doesn’t know where Spoke is because he parted ways with him and hasn’t seen him since. Other players come into the base, 
ManePear
 and FlameFrags, and start attacking Wemmbu and Jamato and asking if they know anything about Spoke. Wemmbu explains that he’s also trying to find Spoke. They explain that they’re part of the Zam empire. They go over to the Zam Empire, where PrinceZam is with his two guards 
Peentar
and 
yungwillx
. He agrees to team with PrinceZam to kill Spoke. 
Mapicc
 comes into the room and starts attacking PrinceZam. Part of the room they are in explodes. They chase after Mapicc to try and kill him. A war breaks out between people against PrinceZam, and the Zam empire. The only person who died was 
TeamKalal
, since everybody against PrinceZam got away using stasis chambers. PrinceZam and Wemmbu interrogate 
TheRealSquiddo
 and threaten to chunk ban her if she doesn’t give information on Spoke. They check her barrels and find out that she has glitched items. She says that she did make a build in the end dimension, and DMs Wemmbu the coordinates. PrinceZam chunk bans TheRealSquiddo.

Parrot and 
Wifies
 go to the Zam Empire as a clue in a scavenger hunt set up by Spoke. Parrot and Wifies see Wemmbu, who questions them about a "disc" that they were talking about. Parrot says that Spoke left something at his base and that Spoke claims there’s a server secret, and they’re trying to find the next clue. PrinceZam comes over to them. He says that they should give them all the information they found, however they don’t oblige. Parrot and Wifies fly away over to the castle and start exploring it while Wemmbu tries to kill them. Eventually they escape by flying out, and Wemmbu loses them. Wemmbu and PrinceZam decide to go to the stronghold to get to the end base that TheRealSquiddo was talking about. Once they were there, they see there are three Spoke guards at the stronghold, RealReeon, Sharkilz_,  and Mapicc. They dig down to the stronghold, and make their way to the portal room. They find the guards and start fighting them. The guards flee to the end, except for RealReeon. They chunk ban RealReeon. They go into the end and start flying to the coordinates that the end base is at.

They break into the base and start killing Spoke and his guards. Spoke is able to escape before being chunk banned. They leave to the overworld to get some materials. This includes getting a 
mace
. After going to the trial chambers and getting a mace, people go into the trial chamber and see it’s already looted. Wemmbu and PrinceZam hide. The people who break into the trail chamber are Mapicc, 
Fantst
, 
Arcn
, Only_A_Squid, and 
Sharooh
, all enemies of the Zam empire. Mapicc finds them and they start fighting. Wemmbu escapes the fight and crafts a mace. PrinceZam escapes to the surface, and Wemmbu uses the mace to try and kill some of the players. All of the people flee the fight by running or using stasis chambers. Arcn is chunk banned by PrinceZam. They use an exploit that has to do with arrows and TNT to try and find Spoke. They find Only_A_Squid at a base and chunk ban him.

They use the second arrow to find Fantst and Sharooh. Fantst runs away and they chunk ban Sharooh. Wemmbu and PrinceZam find an obsidian box, and inside is Mapicc. Spoke and his teammates come in and start to fight Wemmbu and PrinceZam. PrinceZam’s armor all breaks, and he almost dies. PrinceZam holds a chunk ban which scares them away. 

Wemmbu and PrinceZam use the arrow to find an obsidian maze. They find two chests with peoples stuff inside of them. They hear Parrot in the maze. This is because Parrot and Wifies followed a clue left by Spoke which lead them to the maze. A guard who was there signaled for them to put all of their items in chests for no advantages in the maze. He eventually finds Parrot and Wifies who have no items. They agree to lead Wemmbu to the clue, however, because they don’t have the texture pack that goes along with the hunt, they would not be able to get any use out of it. Wemmbu gets a turtle egg and music disc from the chest. Wifies and Parrot get their stuff and leave the maze. Wemmbu and PrinceZam realize that they need a texture pack and begin chasing Wifies and Parrot, however they’ve already escaped. Wemmbu and PrinceZam store the disc and turtle egg in the vault.

They follow the arrow to an underwater base. They find Sharkilz_ and chunk ban him. The base explodes which gets rid of the chunk ban, meaning that Sharkilz_ is unbanned because the chunk ban is exploded. Fantst now comes to help Sharkilz_ kill Wemmbu and PrinceZam. They chunk ban Fantst and Sharkilz_. Wemmbu finds a destroyed castle from the first clue that Parrot and Wifies found. He finds an invisible player, who is later revealed to be Spoke. The invisible player says he will take Wemmbu to Spoke. He brings him to an ice parkour mountain, which is the second clue that Parrot and Wifies found. He tells him to do the parkour, however Wemmbu cheats his way through it. The invisible player leads him to the maze he was in earlier. He puts all his items in the chest, except for some enchanted golden apples, two pearls, and a totem of undying.

He completes the maze. The guard tries to trap him using obsidian, but Wemmbu uses his ender pearl to escape. The invisible player leads him to a shipwreck, also a puzzle that Parrot and Wifies had to solve. The player writes on a sign that Squiddo’s castle is the location of Spoke, to which Wemmbu reacts by trying to kill him. The player escapes by using a stasis chamber. Wemmbu finds Spoke at Squiddo’s castle, which is being burned. He starts killing Spoke. Spoke escapes by using a stasis chamber. 

Wemmbu is teleported to the vault, where Parrot and Wifies are stealing the disc and turtle egg. Wemmbu starts killing them, and they manage to fly away. Parrot and Wifies dig down and go into the nether, however Wemmbu and PrinceZam find them in the nether, since they unluckily spawned in a nether cave. Parrot gives Wemmbu and PrinceZam the disc. Parrot says that to find Spoke they need a turtle egg, as baby turtles always go back to their home beach. They agree to team up, however after Wemmbu and PrinceZam go into the overworld to team up, Parrot and Wifies mine away and escape. The Zam Empire finds Spoke and try to kill him. Parrot is also trying to kill Spoke with them, as Spoke had just chunk banned Wifies. Spoke goes into the puzzle area that Parrot and Wifies were in, and start chasing him. Before they can kill Spoke, he chunk bans himself, with Wifies also stuck in the chunk ban.

PrinceZam tells Wemmbu to do him a favor. He wants Wemmbu to make a colony to guard a vault he has. PrinceZam tells him not to go inside the vault. Wemmbu gets his friend 
eggchan
 to help him build his empire. FlameFrags comes over to Wemmbu. FlameFrags acts like he is not a guard of PrinceZam, and he’s not wearing his PrinceZam gear. FlameFrags starts attacking Wemmbu. eggchan pulls Wemmbu’s stasis chamber, meaning that he escapes. He gives eggchan all his netherite armor. He sends eggchan to distract FlameFrags. Wemmbu uses TNT minecarts to try to kill Flame. One of thmempops his totem and they mine down to try and escape. eggchan accidentally breaks all of Wemmbu’s armor.

They build a villager breeder to automatically produce villagers. They make a pumpkin farm and build an obsidian wall around the base. They start a raid to get totems of undying. They recruit a new player, C4CorvetteOwner. A team of people including Jaden_MAN come over and try to kill Wemmbu. Wemmbu is able to win the war against them with traps. Wemmbu has a professional builder, 
Horace_Altman
, help him build the empire. After a day has passed, they come back to the base and see Horace has built a village. They invite a couple of residents, including TheRealSquiddo, Dione4k, and Block_Facts. 
ClownPierce
 is seen chasing an invisible player. He eventually leaves. ClownPierce comes back and hears Wemmbu talking with Parrot, who was the invisible player. ClownPierce starts killing villagers to try and get information, but Wemmbu tells him he has no information. Parrot leaves.

ManePear, 
Merffinn
, and PrinceZam come over. PrinceZam comes over to check up on the colony. He says that FlameFrags betrayed him. Wemmbu asks if he put a bounty on Parrot and hired ClownPierce to kill him, but PrinceZam says that he is not affiliated with ClownPierce. PrinceZam leaves two guards at the vault to help the citizens not die. Wemmbu and eggchan go over to Parrot’s testing base where they experimented on how to break into prisons. He takes a bunch of useful items there, including full netherite armor, golden apples, etc. They destroy the chunk ban that Fantst is in, and ask him if he wants to join their civilization. He agrees to join it. Horace adds giant obsidian walls around the empire.

Wemmbu hears Merffinn and ManePear messing with their rail gun. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that they broke their railgun. They decide to check inside of the vault. They dig down and discover it is an obsidian box with nothing in it. Parrot comes back to the empire and asks if they can protect him from ClownPierce. Wemmbu agrees to help him. Parrot has the idea to put chunk bans around the empire to protect it from invaders.

A team of people including FlameFrags and Jaden_MAN invade the colony. The empire manages to get them to run away, but the entrance part of their colony is destroyed. Parrot parts ways with the empire. Wemmbu and eggchan try to figure out how they could kill FlameFrags. While planning, FlameFrags comes over and tries to kill them. Wemmbu almost dies, but PrinceZam logs on and FlameFrags says "I guess you have to live now." PrinceZam comes over to the empire to check on Wemmbu. Wemmbu tells him that there is nothing in the vault. PrinceZam destroys all of his empire and tells him to pretend like none of this ever happened. He says that his plan was to chunk ban Wemmbu, but he is too weak to even be a threat to the Zam empire. 

Wemmbu goes to his orbital cannon to try and destroy PrinceZam’s empire, but sees the orbital cannon been blown up. Wemmbu and eggchan go back to spawn and see that the Zam empire has built a giant PrinceZam statue at spawn. Wemmbu and eggchan set up a job where people can hire them to blow up things. 
Roshambogames
 hires Wemmbu and eggchan to blow up Spoke’s end base. They are successful in doing so. 
Woogiex
 hires them to blow up 
FerreMC
’s base. They find that Ferre has a secret tunnel system in his tower, so they go to investigate. Ferre catches him and Wemmbu tries to escape. He goes underground, and eventually Ferre leaves. Wemmbu and Eggchan come back to destroy the base.

They send three TNT missiles to destroy the base. They are able to destroy the base using TNT, and are able to escape by going underground. Woogiex gives Wemmbu and eggchan their payment of a shulker box of netherite ingots. Woogiex says that all of the members of the team against ClownPierce have disappeared. Wemmbu and eggchan discover that PrinceZam has started taking over spawn. Once far enough from the Zam empire, ManePear says that he’s not a big fan of being a guard of PrinceZam, and that if they need help, he can help him. ManePear tells Wemmbu and eggchan to go over to the treasure hunters base and give them coordinates to go to. Once there, they see 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
. It turns out that Kier and Dev are working for 
Boosfer
. They say they’re not the treasure hunters, but this is a lie. Boosfer pays Wemmbu and eggchan to destroy "the valley". Wemmbu creates TNT bomber planes to destroy the valley. He also discovers there is a giant tree in the valley. While destroying the valley, he finds Parrot and Wifies.

Parrot and Wifies explain that this is 
Rekrap2
’s base which they are trying to protect from Its_Dev_, Kierrrr, and Boosfer. Wemmbu ignores this and continues blowing up the base. Parrot also says that a bunch of players on the server somehow just disappeared. Wemmbu agrees to team with Parrot and Wifies to steal from Boosfer and his team, and go on his quest. Parrot and Wifies say that Wemmbu is allowed to blow up specific parts of the build.

Parrot and Wifies help Wemmbu build an orbital cannon to destroy Boosfer's base. Wemmbu agrees to only use one shot on Boosfer and one shot on PrinceZam. They use the orbital cannon, withers, and TNT to destroy their headquarters. Wemmbu finds their vault of items. Wemmbu steals thousands of netherite blocks and thousands of diamond blocks.

Wemmbu and eggchan blow up the PrinceZam statue at spawn.

Wemmbu and his civilization try to use the orbital cannon to try and destroy the Zam Empire, but see that they’ve put a sheet of obsidian above the entire empire meaning that they can’t use the orbital cannon. They decide to try and break into the empire and kill PrinceZam. They are unable to kill PrinceZam. Wemmbu is able to escape.

Wemmbu convinces ManePear to betray the Zam empire.

Wemmbu sees that FlameFrags and Merffinn are trying to invade Roshambo’s empire. FlameFrags almost kills Roshambo, but Wemmbu stops him. Wemmbu challenges FlameFrags to a 1v1. He manages to get everyone in the Roshambo empire to evacuate, and he escapes using a stasis chamber.

Wemmbu decides to rebuild his empire. Horace_Altman expands Wemmbu's empire greatly.

Wemmbu plans to take a member of the Zam Empire hostage. ManePear distracts yungwillx by talking to him while Wemmbu sets up a trap at his base. Wemmbu comes into the base invisible and pretends to be ManePear. He sets off the trap, but it fails to kill him. Yungwillx gets PrinceZam, Merffinn, and Peentar on to help him survive. All of yungwillx’s armor breaks, and they take him hostage. They leave a message at Peentar’s house with instructions for him. They take Peentar hostage. 

While they are taking Sorhin hostage, the Zam empire breaks out 
yungwillx
 and Peentar. The entire Zam empire destroys Wemmbu’s colony. They trap Wemmbu in an obsidian box and they watch ManePear and FlameFrags fight. ManePear’s armor breaks, so he stops fighting. They both run away, but then realize that they took eggchan hostage.

PrinceZam takes down the obsidian sheet protecting the Zam empire from an orbital strike cannon. Wemmbu goes over to PrinceZam, with no armor, and they imprison Wemmbu. He fills his inventory with cakes to prove he has not smuggled in any items, but uses the crafting menu to store the extra items to smuggle in four items. He uses the orbital cannon which lags the server, giving him enough time to give eggchan full netherite armor from his ender chest to escape. They break out of the prison. Wemmbu destroys the Zam empire, and ClownPierce comes and takes PrinceZam and Wemmbu to a prison.

PrinceZam and Wemmbu are trapped in a miniature version of the normal world with only three totems. PrinceZam tries to kill Wemmbu, but he’s able to escape, though PrinceZam uses three of Wemmbu's totems. eggchan is also put into the prison. eggchan and Wemmbu wait for 
Pangi
 to be put into the prison to steal his totem. They get the totem and leave. They gear up underground and get full iron armor. They build a skybase in the corner of the map.

Wemmbu and eggchan find PrinceZam to ask him if he found any lava, but PrinceZam starts attacking them. They run away.

PrinceZam and Pangi find Wemmbu and eggchan. They start fighting, but because they have better armor, Wemmbu and eggchan run away. They escape by digging underground. They find a slime chunk under PrinceZam’s base. They’re able to get enchantments by fishing.

ClownPierce sends his guard into the prison to try and kill them, and says that if they pop the guards totem, the guard is teleported out. The guard teleported in is FerreMC. They are able to pop his totem. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to co-exist. They see that PrinceZam somehow got obsidian. Pangi goes to the nether, but gets chunk banned.

Wemmbu and Eggchan build a creeper farm, but it doesn’t work. They go over to PrinceZam to ask why the creeper farm isn’t working, and see he has villagers. PrinceZam says that completing a raid can give obsidian. PrinceZam helps them diagnose the problem with their creeper farm. ClownPierce uses an orbital strike cannon to destroy PrinceZam’s base because of Pangi going to the nether to escape. PrinceZam thinks this is Wemmbu’s fault, so he tries to kill him. PrinceZam stops trying to kill him realizing that Wemmbu is better at PvP than him. 

He convinces PrinceZam to give Wemmbu his looting sword. Wemmbu and eggchan leave. Wemmbu comes back to his base and sees it is destroyed by the orbital cannon.

PrinceZam goes over to Wemmbu’s base and tries to kill him. PrinceZam now has maxed enchanted diamond armor. He shows PrinceZam that if he gets close to killing him, ClownPierce will interrupt it. He proves this by taking off all his armor, and ClownPierce plays a sound saying that the next round of juggernaut is going to happen. PrinceZam and Wemmbu agree to team again to escape the prison. They use a TNT minecart to pop Ferre's totem of undying, and he is teleported out. ClownPierce says that he now knows about a potential escape plan.

A bunch of new members are put into the prison and PrinceZam tries to recruit them. These players include 
_Kenadian_
, 
SykerMC
, 
Loppezz
, 
LuckyMixx
, 
Dol9hin
, and 
Spepticle
. They both leave.

PrinceZam and his teammates comes over to Wemmbu and try to kill them. Eventually they leave. Wemmbu and his team set up a stasis chamber using honey. Wemmbu puts his pearl in the stasis chamber. ClownPierce starts activating people’s stasis chambers to trap them in the prison. Wemmbu is the only one who is able to escape using an ender pearl cannon.

Wemmbu breaks out the people in the Proton prison by giving them contraband items.

Wemmbu and PrinceZam are trapped by ClownPierce in an escape room made by 
Wato1876
. While solving the escape room, they obtain the servers last mace. After escaping, they make it to the end where ClownPierce is there to get their mace. Wemmbu gives ClownPierce the last mace.

Wemmbu sees a couple of players flying up. He decides to follow them and finds the 
Skyblock Civilization
. He finds a player named Pangi who brings him to 
Yeah_Jaron
, their leader. He says that he has to be a citizen or die. Wemmbu tries to escape, but is caught by 
Straight
. Wemmbu is forced to do tasks.

Wemmbu and Straight fight in a sumo duel which decides if Wemmbu is let free or not. Wemmbu loses the sumo fight. Wemmbu does more tasks for the civilization. Wemmbu spies on the members talking about himself in the castle. Wemmbu says that he just saw people flying up. They go down to see what Wemmbu was talking about. Once down, 
The Invisible Mafia
 finds and begins attacking them. 

They are able to kill two of the members, but the third member escapes. They go back to skyblock civilization, and Wemmbu smuggles in an ender chest. While helping Pangi with building a drowned farm, Wemmbu messages Loppezz to come over and distract him. A player named LordSirWeasly the Third. SirWeasly refuses to tell Wemmbu how to find the mace unless he duels him in a fair 4v4. Wemmbu recrutes Eggchan, Jaden_MAN, and a random person from the fair. The random person runs away right before the duel starts and Wemmbu is forced to let an 
invisible netherite guy with a voice changer
 to join his team. Wemmbu wins and SirWeasly tells him that to find the mace you have to follow a path, or absence of trees, behind the castle at the Wheat Kingdom until you come across a blue cornflower. Wemmbu lets the invis guy and Jaden go back to whatever they were doing before the duel and he and Egg follow SirWeasly's instructions. They eventually come across a house with a book inside which Egg reads outloud. It talks about how the constant fighting and battles of the server get repetitive and boring and how the player who wrote the book was going to leave the server. As Egg reads, a group of players attempt to sneak up on them, but Wemmbu hears them and promptly blows them up. The duo continue on until they find the blue cornflower SirWeasly was talking about. Wemmbu breaks it and a door opens up to reveal a large cavern. They accidentally activate several traps as they explore including zombies with prop 4 armor and some wardens. but eventually find the mace. The invisible person from earlier suddenly steals the mace before Wemmbu can get it and tries to escape. Wemmbu chases them and the two fight until he breaks all their armor. They equip an entire new set of trimmed netherite armor and return the mace before leaving. Wemmbu takes the mace back to the Wheat Kingdom and gives it to their leader. Egg and Wemmbu are rewarded with free building resources and horses. Wemmbu maces and kills his horse on the way back to the base. 

A massive army attacks Wemmbu and Eggchan at their base. Wemmbu manages to escape, but Egg purposely allows himself to be captured. Wemmbu secretly follows part of the army to a castle that leads to an underground kingdom build around an ancient city. Wemmbu attempts to talk to the guards at the entrance, but they only shoot arrows at him. Wemmbu eventually negotiates a 1v1 with the player who seemed to be in charge. He kills the player causing the remaining guards to release some warden as well as attack him. In the chaos, Wemmbu manages to sneak into the castle and makes his way down into the kingdom. He enters another castle to see if Egg was being held captive there. Egg is shown to be being interrogated and is forced to give up his 
journal of cords
 before being put in a cage in the middle of a lava lake. Wemmbu finds Egg there and frantically tries to get his friend's attention. It takes several tries, but Egg eventually pearls across the lava to him. Wemmbu attempts to escape with Egg, stab shoting the cave to make a quick way out and killing two guards to get armor for his friend. Wemmbu stab shots Eggchan out of the cave and is chased around but the now alerted army. Eggchan comes back and helps Wemmbu regear before alerting him that the massive army from earlier was coming. Wemmbu begins to fight again and targets 
Yungyx
, one of the leaders of the army. This time he easily wins the battle and retrieves Egg from the same cage as earlier, seemingly recaptured. The 
invis guy
 kills and steals Egg's book of coords from two guards. 

The invis guy shows up at Wemmbu and Eggchan's base claiming that he's going to kill Egg. The two are confused at this statement and Wemmbu reminds the invisible player what happened last time they saw him. The invis guy warns Wemmbu about standing in their way and tells him that if he goes outside the base, he dies. The invis player uses a stasis to leave. Wemmbu exits the base and his totem is immediately popped by a railgun. The invis player maces him and pops his second totem. Wemmbu chases the player until they stasis away for the second time. The invis player suddenly explodes a tnt minecart underneath Wemmbu and stasises away for the third time after saying that they'll be back. Wemmbu destroys the railgun and regroups with Egg inside the base. The pair wonder who the player might be and Wemmbu gives Egg his Crucible mace for protection. They decide to visit 
Parrot
 to see if he could help as he is the king. They find Parrot inside the 
Northern Council
, but he refuses to help because he is busy with other issues. The pair leave and lay low at an outdoor restaurant. As they review what they know about the invisible player they order some enchanted golden apples and water. Suddenly, a band of assassin attack them. Eventually, Wemmbu with the help of Egg and the nearby civilians kill at the assassins. The duo speculate that the invisible player was responsible and decide to find a place with a better view so they can at least know when they're being attacked. Egg thinks as hard as he can until he concludes that the players who attacked them were just normal bandits who'll do anything for money. They decide to visit these assassins, and Egg convinces Wemmbu to enter the base with nothing on him. Wemmbu confronts the assasin's leader, 
Dizzyu
, and attempts to get information about the invis guy out of him. When this does not work and Dizzyu instructs his guards to put Wemmbu in the prison until the invisible player could get there to prove his death, Wemmbu gets some of his stuff from Egg who had been hiding underground and fights them. Wemmbu successfully kills everyone except Dizzyu who finally explains that he knows just as much as Wemmbu. The invisible guy shows up and begins to fight Wemmbu, saying that he has to get rid of Wemmbu to get to Egg. Wemmbu and Eggchan split up with the invis guy following Wemmbu. Eventually, Wemmbu escapes and manages to heal his armor with a grindstone. He comes across a town but finds no one there but the invisible player. The invisible player traps Wemmbu in a flying machine with trapdoors and mining fatigue and explains that he's more valuable alive then dead. The machine stops suddenly midflight and Parrot reveals himself. Wemmbu and Parrot escape to the ground and the invisble player chases them. After they lose the player, Parrot explains that Egg convinced him to help in exchange for a favor from Wemmbu (despite him already owing Wemmbu a favor for not 
killing
 
him
). He then tries to have Wemmbu come back with him to his kingdom for protection, but Wemmbu politely refuses. Wemmbu explains that he wants to end this once and for all. Parrot gives him some fighting supplies and Wemmbu finds the invisible player again. The two fight and Wemmbu kills them, revealing their name to be 
Cytharam
. 

A second invisible player appears behind Wemmbu and tells him to meet them at his base before stasising. Wemmbu finds them at his base and demands to know where Eggchan is, because he lost him earlier. The invis guy says that he does not know where Egg is, but that Egg is valuable and he needs to kill him. The two eventually agree to work together until they find Eggchan. They start searching at 
Highwater City
 as it is where Egg likes to fish. They disguise themselves with iron and leather armor and Wemmbu puts on invisibility to not draw too much attention to themselves. Yungyx shows up with some guards and begins to terrorize the townsfolk about Eggchan's whereabouts. Wemmbu suddenly maces Yungyx and queastions him about why he wants Egg. Yungyx manages to escape Wemmbu's attack and Wemmbu and the invis guy go back to searching for Egg in the town. They go to Egg's fishing spot and find some wheat seeds growing in the corner. Wemmbu questions the invisible player about why he needs Egg. The invis guy doesn't answer at first, but when Wemmbu begins to leave they say that Egg is valuable because whoever has Egg can control Wemmbu. The pair determine that the wheat seeds are a clue to the Wheat Kingdom. When they get there, they find the kingdom raided and mostly destroyed. Wemmbu asks if Egg was there to the few remaining players. They tell him yes, but that the invisible guy took him. Wemmbu believes them and attacks the invisible player who run out into the wheat fields. They invis guy stasises away and Wemmbu returns to the town. The towsfolk tell him that the invis guy wasn't the only one who took Egg. 
Flamefrags
 also helped. Wemmbu goes to Flame's base to confront him. Flame, 
Lomedy
, and the invisible player there and Flame admits to taking Egg. He says that he only needs to ask Egg a few questions for 
Cindercrest
. Wemmbu refuses to compromise and begins to attack Flame and Lomedy and subsequently destroy the base. Eventually, Flame gets fed up and orders Lomedy to kill Egg. Wemmbu chases Lomedy and the three players discover that Egg has been stolen by the invisible player. Wemmbu and Flame compromise to work together until they get Egg and go to visit 
Lynnwyrm
. Lynn happily helps them and gives them 
Jaden_MAN
 for extra help. Flame is not happy about this because of his current rivalry with Jaden, but all three head out to the invis guy's base. They find Yungyx, Arachn1d, and three guards there and they all make a temporary truce. They find Eggchan with the invisible player. The invisible player says that he will give Egg to the highest bidder. Everyone begins putting down offers until Flame abandons Wemmbu because he is there on the behalf of Cindercrest. Wemmbu threatens to blow everyone up unless he gets Egg. He does so and a fight ensues. The fight leads down below the island into a crystal cave. Wemmbu eventually sees an interesting building and goes invisible to see where it goes. It turns out to be a maze with traps in it. The invis guy begins to fly about the maze, possibly to keep an eye out for any of the players. Wemmbu gets his hands on some dripstone from one of the traps and tricks the invisible player into dropping onto it. The dripstone pops their totem showing their name as 
Flbthp
. Flbthp quickly stasises away and Wemmbu follows their name up some stairs. He finds Jaden, Arachn1d, Egg, and the invisible player there. Jaden explains that the invisible player will kill Egg unless another truce in evoked. Eventually Flame and Yungyx show up and Flame doesn't stop attacking Yungyx until Wemmbu warns him that Egg will die if he doesn't. Arachn1d tells the player that he will give them the entire treasure of the caverns for Egg. The invis guy immediately accepts and Flame leaves. Yungyx give Wemmbu an ultimatum. Join the Spider Web Faction and help Arachn1d become king or Egg dies.  

Wemmbu if forced to put all his items in his ender chest and joins the Spider Web Faction. Yungyx tells him that he's a bottom feeder right now and brings him to that section of the city. Wemmbu runs into Jaden, who had joined to help Wemmbu out and then they run into one of Jaden's old friends, 
The_Codmaster14
. They catch up  Codmaster shows them his house. Yungyx shows up and brings all three of them to the mines. He leaves them there and Codmaster shows Wemmbu and Jaden what to do. Codmaster says that he hates the mines and that it's really dangrous, but refuses to explain why. Wemmbu and Jaden quickly find out that it's because there are patches of deep dark everywhere. Wemmbu destroys two shriekers and then accidentally spawns a warden with a third one he didn't see. They run away from the warden and end up in the corridor again where they see a second warden for some reason. Eventually, Yungy and some other royalty status people show up and kill the wardens. Yungy inquires who spawned the warden and the remaining bottom feeders rat Wemmbu out. Wemmbu, Jaden, and Codmaster all get sent to jail. Eventually, Yungy shows up again and escorts them to an interrogation room. Wemmbu begins lying that another player did it and they only get blamed for it, but Codmaster fesses up and blames Wemmbu. Yungy lets Codmaster go and forces Wemmbu and Jaden to fight in a duel to the death in an arena. The two are reluctant and Wemmbu almost kills Jaden before 
Arachn1d
 shows up and stops Yungy. Arachn1d says that he'll make it up to Wemmbu and Jaden. If they complete a mission they will become normal citizens. Wemmbu attempts to bargain for Eggchan, cause his friend is the only reason he's here, but Arachn1d threatens to kill Egg if Wemmbu keeps asking.    

Wemmbu and Jaden agree and they go to find Codmaster again so they can gear up properly. Codmaster tells them that they're dead, but he wishes them luck. Wemmbu asks why he thinks they're dead. Codmaster explains that most people have really good gear when they go on missions. Wemmbu and Jaden decide to spend time enchanting their gear. Codmaster brings them to the richest bottom dweller who has an enchanting table they can use. The_BanditKing allows Jaden and Wemmbu to enchant because they're normally powerful players and he doesn't want to get on their bad side. Wemmbu steals the enchanting table on the wat out. Wemmbu and Jaden finish gearing up with the table and meet up with Yungy who takes them to the surface.    

(WIP - my brain is tired from watching the entirety of Wemmbu's newest video in one sitting. I'll either finish this later or someone else can for me. - WonderfulJaguar)

title: Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP
content:
Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP














Season


1






Episode


10






Upload date


Jul 8, 2024






POV


Wemmbu






Arcs


The PrinceZam Empire Arc
The ClownPierce Arc (semi-relevant)






Featured Creators (Description)


ParrotX2‬
SpokeIsHere
 ‪
Mapicc
 ‪
Wifies‬
 ‪✝
PrinceZam‬
 ‪
FlameFrags
Peentar
ManePear
FerreMC
Boosfer
Kierrrr
Its_Dev_
Woogiex
Roshambogames














crashout of the century





Why I Destroyed the Unstable SMP
 is the 10th episode featured in 
Unstable Universe
. 



Plot


The episode starts with 
Wemmbu
 looking over the ruins of his civilization. 
Eggchan
 then joins shortly after to help him make a secret hideout under it. Wemmbu reveals to eggchan that he has an 
orbital cannon
 millions of blocks away, but he used it to show off to 
SpokeIsHere
 during the guard interview and would need to reset it. After a bit of disbelief over how many enemies they have, Egg agrees and they travel to it through the nether. Wemmbu discovers that his orbital cannon has been destroyed. With no resources to build another one, Wemmbu and Egg set out to make money. They fly to 
spawn
, where they find a giant 
PrinceZam
 statue, and build a message board advertising their griefing services with signs saying, "Do YOU need a build griefed?? Yes, you do.," "Meet at x: 50k z: 50k," and "I WILL BLOW UP WHATEVER YOU NEED." They hide in a hole while waiting for customers. At nightfall, they hear 
Roshambogames
. After revealing themselves, Ro says he wants Spoke's end base griefed and will pay them well. Before going, Wemmbu asks if he can give them stuff because they're broke. Ro gives them supplies as part of their payment.

Egg and Wemmbu fly to Spoke's base, which is filled with people. They decide between making missiles or just going in and blowing everything up by hand—Egg decides that they splash invis, go in, and TNT everything by hand. They manage to fill almost the entire first floor with TNT and blow it up before running away and restocking. Wemmbu distracts 
Mapicc
 and Spoke by summoning ten withers (two failed to deploy and three were incomplete) while Egg drops more TNT in the center. Spoke and Mapicc eventually find Wemmbu and immediately identify him despite being invisible because the four of them are the only ones online and fight him while he spams TNT and withers. While in pursuit, Wemmbu and Mapicc note the water's strange behavior. Once they blow up the second floor, Egg and Wemmbu escape. They go back to spawn and are paid a stack of netherite ingots each by Ro, who has been making a 
civilization
 of his own. Wemmbu reveals he's been making his own 
civilization
 and asks Ro how much PVPers cost. Ro says he pays a shulker of netherite each, since it takes a lot to risk their only life.

Wemmbu and Egg fly back to their business hole, but Wemmbu spots an obsidian pillar at exactly 50,000, 50,000 with a sign at the top that says "X: 19241 Z: 9930." They talk to the client invisibly and use signs to protect their identities. They pass by a crater in a spruce forest and end up in the now ruined headquarters of the Clown hunters (
Leow0ok
, 
JumperWho
, 
Derapchu
, and 
Woogiex
) where they meet Woogie. Wemmbu asks what happened to the base and Woogie reveals that 
ClownPierce
 destroyed it in the five minutes they were away. Wemmbu asks if Woogie wants anything blown up, and Woogie keeps expositioning, but points out 
FerreMC
. Wemmbu says Ferre is scary and it will cost a lot to blow his base up. Woogie says he'll pay a shulker of netherite blocks, which Wemmbu gladly accepts. They talk about locations, and Woogie mentions Ferre's tower, which he said he could show them, but Wemmbu asks for coordinates instead since he didn't want him to die before they got paid. Wemmbu asks Woogie what his goals were right as their invisibility runs out, prompting him and Egg to go underground and repot while he isn't looking. They finish the deal and Wemmbu asks for the coordinates in a DM. Wemmbu asks Egg for some rockets, and Woogie says they really need the job if they need to share rockets. Wemmbu punches him repeatedly, and they fly away and reconvene. Egg and Wemmbu plan what they need to do for the job, and Egg asks who Ferre is. Wemmbu explains that Ferre is Clown's coach, and Egg is shocked that Minecraft coaches are an actual thing that exists.

They pot invis, fly to Ferre's tower, and enter through the top window into his bedroom and sneak around the lower floors while avoiding Ferre before heading back to the bedroom to report. They sneak back downstairs to see what's on the ground floor, where Wemmbu sees Ferre go inside a secret room. Wemmbu is hesitant in going in despite his curiosity, because he doesn't want to make noise, but he sees Egg's particles waiting by the door and decides to join. They are caught off guard while waiting, but Wemmbu hears footsteps right as Egg repots, but luckily, nothing came of it. Eventually, Ferre comes out and flies away. Wemmbu and Egg go inside and unmute, rushing down the hallway and barely missing two traps before figuring out it's caused by sculk and sneaking the rest of the way to a room filled with basic items and refill shulkers. As finish stealing the shulkers and escape, Ferre catches and starts attacking them. They both escape, but Ferre targets Wemmbu. Wemmbu lies to Ferre, saying that 
ClownPierce
 sent him to see if he was up to par and that he didn't steal anything. Ferre doesn't believe him and just keeps chasing him. Wemmbu eventually to loses Ferre and hides underground. He whispers to Egg that he'll AFK for a bit to ensure that Ferre goes away and tells him to meet at the civilization ruins. Ferre manages to find Wemmbu's hiding place while Wemmbu stays hidden in the walls. After a bit of searching by sight, Ferre starts using TNT to excavate the area. Wemmbu starts using the explosion noises to mask his mining and block placement as he tunnels downward. Eventually, Ferre says, "There's no point," and after a bit of waiting and hearing no noise, Wemmbu mines up and flies back to his civilization's underground base.

Wemmbu and Egg discuss how to blow up Ferre's tower, but concludes that using world eaters or going underground won't work. Egg says that they just have to go in and blow things up, but Wemmbu denies that, saying they should come up with something smarter. He asks to see the resources they stole to check if they have enough to build an orbital cannon, which they have except for a few activator rails, which would be easy to craft. Wemmbu says that despite having practically everything, it would still take them a whole day, which is time they don't have, especially since Ferre knows they are there. Wemmbu proposes building missile planes that would be faster but riskier, which Egg approves of. He asks for an explanation on what a missile plane is because he has no idea what technobabble that Wemmbu uses is, saying that he came to the server to build a colony and has had to adapt to the various conflicts like an insect that digs underground every time it sees predators.

The two of them then fly back to Ferre's tower, and after a bit of surveying, they start building the missile planes somewhat far away (possibly outside his render distance) while Ferre is patrolling the perimeter of his tower. Two of the six missiles pick up blocks they weren't meant to, and Wemmbu fixes them as they fly. Once Ferre notices the missiles, Wemmbu messages Egg to come in as bait while Wemmbu spams TNT, but Ferre targets Wemmbu instead and pops one of his totems. They regroup on the roof and decide to do what they did in Spoke's end base. Wemmbu asks Egg for more rockets, but Ferre interrupts them, so Wemmbu dives underwater when he runs out. Wemmbu once again asks Egg for rockets and tells him to drop them in front of the tower. He tells Egg to distract Ferre, but it takes him a long while to do so since he can't see Wemmbu and Ferre fighting in the river. He eventually surfaces, and Egg drops Wemmbu sixteen rockets. Ferre pops another of Wemmbu's totems as he flies away, telling Egg to finish the job without him. Wemmbu asks Ferre if he's going to turn around and prevent his tower from getting griefed, but Ferre says that he is abandoning the base and that it was between the two of them now. Wemmbu uses pearl misdirects when his rockets run out and hides underground when he loses Ferre and tells Egg to leave. Egg asks for Wemmbu's coordinates and they regroup. Wemmbu asks for more rockets, and Egg gives him ten rockets.

Wemmbu and Egg fly back to Leo's headquarters to talk to Woogie, who reveals he did, in fact, see when Wemmbu and Egg's invis ran out. Woogie also reveals that he doesn't actually have a shulker of netherite blocks and that he can't get more resources from Leo because he disappeared. Wemmbu asks who else Woogie was working with, and he tells Wemmbu that 
Willsion
 disappeared before the self-sealing base, then Derapchu disappeared shortly after, and that it was just him, Leo, and Jumper until Leo disappeared, as well as Clown. Woogie gives Wemmbu a shulker of netherite ingots, then threatens to report Wemmbu to Zam if he didn't destroy Ferre's base. Wemmbu retorts that they did, so there's no need to do it. Woogie questions how the water is flowing mid-air as though it were on the ground. Wemmbu asks Woogie if he has any more jobs because they could use the money, but Woogie says he already gave Wemmbu most of what he has, but mentions the Treasure Hunters, who rival Leo in wealth, their source of money a mystery. Wemmbu says the information makes up for Woogie not paying in full and asks Egg if they should chop off his toes. Egg says it isn't necessary, so they bid each other good luck.

Wemmbu and Egg fly away to find the Treasure Hunters, saying that the price of undying loyalty is a shulker of netherite blocks and that the only thing that can be trusted is money. They head to spawn as a start and find that it's changed a lot. They see 
Peentar
 and 
ManePear
, who take them to Zam, who says that life is full of gifts and surprises. They take him to one of the new houses at spawn as Wemmbu took off his boots. Zam greets him with a "My sweet, sweet Wemmbu," while Wemmbu steals a brown shulker, which Zam forces him to return by attacking him. Mane asks where his boots are, and Wemmbu lies, saying 
FlameFrags
 broke them. Wemmbu asks if Zam is here to yap at him, and Zam confirms, saying it's his favorite thing to do while punching Wemmbu, which Wemmbu comments feels like abuse. Wemmbu's totem eventually pops, and Zam stops, saying that things haven't been going well for Wemmbu and that he's like a bug he can crush under his finger, that he's just a little Wemmbu guy. Zam gives Wemmbu a tour around the latest 
Zam Empire
 expansion, which is filled with houses that come with security he plans on renting off in exchange for gear. Zam hits Wemmbu with flaming arrows, and Wemmbu gives him a harming arrow. Zam comments on his ability to keep calm, which he thinks is interesting, and Wemmbu replies that he knows if Zam wanted him dead, he would be by now. Zam retorts he could change his mind at the drop of a hat, and Wemmbu calls him a mad and insane PrinceZam. Wemmbu asks why Mane is just sitting in the corner naked, and Zam tells him to stop it because they're making him look less threatening. Mane asks why they can't have fun, but apologizes when Zam orders Peentar to pull down Mane's pants. Zam tells Mane to escort Wemmbu out and that he's not allowed at spawn. Wemmbu retorts that he can't just ban people from spawn, but Zam says that he can and he will.

As Mane escorts Wemmbu and Egg all the way out into the forest, he asks Wemmbu if he needs help, saying that he doesn't like being under Zam because of how strict he is. After Wemmbu checks the vicinity for Zam, Mane asks if there was a trust exercise he could do. Wemmbu throws away an instant damage arrow and a white tulip, which Mane picks up, but Wemmbu denies that it's for him. Mane says he sees how it is. Wemmbu asks Egg if Mane can do anything to prove himself, but comes to the conclusion that they just have to trust him since they aren't in a position not to. Wemmbu reveals he was lying about being broke and says that his trust test would be to not tell Zam. Wemmbu asks Mane about the Treasure Hunters, and he explains that they used to go to the Zam Empire to steal materials until it eventually sizzled down, and that he knows where their headquarters are. Mane gives him the coordinates, and Wemmbu asks Egg if they should trust him. Egg says no because he feels like every time Zam does something to them, it's in the most elaborate, complex, unnecessary way possible in order to humiliate Wemmbu. This feels like one of those schemes and that he associates anything elaborate with Zam, because why don't they do it efficiently? Wemmbu says that it's the only lead they have ,and if Zam is keeping people out of spawn, that means nobody would see their ad. Egg asks Wemmbu about 
ParrotX2
, but Wemmbu says that they haven't talked to each other in a while. Egg proposes that they should grief more bases and claim that he and Wemmbu did it. Wemmbu retorts that that would be a bad idea and that Zam would kill them. Their only saving grace is that Zam thought they are poor. Egg proposes double agenting, but Wemmbu retorts that Zam would just take him hostage. They end up deciding to just go to the coordinates and that if it is a trap, they would avoid it.

Wemmbu and Egg fly to the coordinates and find an office building with 
Kierrrr
 and 
Its_Dev_
 inside. Kier is missing his helmet while Dev is missing his boots. Wemmbu asks them about it, and they reply that it's a fashion statement. Wemmbu and Egg talk outside while Kier and Dev stay inside to discuss with each other too. Egg calls them simple-minded and they head back inside. Kier and Dev ask what they want, and Wemmbu asks if they're the Treasure Hunters, but they have no idea what they are. Kier and Dev ask again, since they didn't answer their question, and Wemmbu replies they are looking for the Treasure Hunters so they can be hired to grief people, to which they answer that they can point them to some people who would do that. Wemmbu asks that if they aren't the Treasure Hunters, then who are they? Kier and Dev ask if they can trust them before discussing with each other. Dev asks them to follow him, where they lead them to one of the Treasure Hunters. Egg whispers that he doesn't want to work with Kier and Dev, even if they are telling the truth, but Wemmbu whispers that they can take them if they need to.

Egg and Wemmbu follow Kier and Dev to a meeting room on the top floor where 
Boosfer
, Kier, and Dev are sitting at a table. Dev asks what they want, and Wemmbu explains that they are looking for the Treasure Hunters so they could be hired to grief things because they needed money for "personal things," and that they may have been misled to believe that Kier, Boosfer, and Dev are the Treasure Hunters. Boosfer asks what Wemmbu and Egg would want from them if they were hypothetically the Treasure Hunters. Wemmbu replies that they would blow stuff up for payment. Boosfer replies that they love explosions and asks that if, hypothetically, they had the resources, how much would the payment be? Wemmbu replies that it depends on the job. Boosfer tosses a stack of netherite ingots to them and asks how much it would buy. Wemmbu replies, "A moderately-sized building." Boosfer then tosses a stack of netherite blocks to them, and Wemmbu comments on how Boosfer is just tossing them around. Boosfer says they can give them more if needed and asks how big the explosion would be, then tosses them another stack of netherite ingots. Wemmbu replies that it depends on the job, and that they could definitely make things work. Wemmbu asks what they need them to do, and Boosfer just replies, "Big explosion," which leaves Wemmbu confused. Dev whispers to Boosfer that they can explode "the valley," and Boosfer tells Wemmbu that they want to explode a valley the size of a biome on July 1st, 1:00 PM. Wemmbu asks why the date is so specific, and Boosfer fumbles for a bit before saying that it's for Kier's birthday. Boosfer asks if they have a deal, and tosses them a stack of diamond blocks. Dev and Boosfer say that they are sure they have a deal. Wemmbu asks if they were actually the Treasure Hunters, and Boosfer says that what he's about to say is confidential, and if it leaves the room, they are dead. He reveals that he built the office just for show and that his helpers were also for show. They stole treasure for fun, but if things got stolen and they didn't have a base, it would be suspicious, so they needed a front. Boosfer says he was surprised that they found their base and that they needed to take care of the leaks. Egg says it was Mane, then pretends that he thought they were in Mane's base when Wemmbu whispers to him, "YO." They run through the job one more time, and Egg asks to be escorted out, which Wembbu questions why. Kier and Dev lead them to the window and punch them out.

Wemmbu and Egg fly away and Wemmbu comments on how suspicious the whole affair was, especially with how Kier and Dev suddenly locked in. He asks how much they got from Boosfer, which is two stacks of diamond blocks, a stack of netherite blocks, and two stacks of netherite ingots. Wemmbu scolds Egg for almost leaking Mane, but Egg retorts, saying it would be a whole Zam guard gone. Wemmbu realizes that he's right. Egg says their birthday excuse was nonsense, which Wemmbu agrees. Egg says that them wanting a whole biome gone is suspicious and that there's something going on. Wemmbu agrees but says they should just get the job done. They head to the coordinates to scout the biome out and find a giant tree with Egg joking that they found 
Yggdrasil
 and destroying it might crash the server. They scout the tree while invisible to see how big it actually is. Egg whispers that they don't have the firepower to bomb the whole thing, but Wemmbu whispers that there has to be something here. Egg whispers that he can check the tree, but Wemmbu replies that it's not a good idea with Boosfer specifying the valley and not the tree. Egg replies it's because that's what he's hiding, which Wemmbu agrees. Egg whispers that he found an elder guardian and that it's wide enough to have stuff inside. Wemmbu whispers to back away from it and that there might be people inside. He asks why he would destroy the valley and not the tree itself before repotting. Egg retorts that they didn't check the Wemmbu Civilization vault until it was too late and that they didn't want to make the same mistake twice. Wemmbu says not to do it because Boosfer won't pay them. Egg relents, but tells him not to blame him when it turns out to be a fatal mistake. He continues checking the tree and reports what he sees to Wemmbu. Neither see anyone and conclude it's safe to elytra. Wemmbu digs down and tells Egg there's nothing under the tree. They meet back up and discuss how they're going to blow everything up. Wemmbu proposes a bomber plane that can rain TNT down from one end to the other. Egg comments that everything they do is so morally questionable that he doesn't feel good being on the server anymore. Wemmbu replies that they have to make the money. They discuss how sketchy the tree is, and fly back to their underground base.

Wemmbu checks if they have enough resources for bomber planes, which they do, and puts them in his ender chest. Egg says his girlfriend is coming over and that Wemmbu might be on his own. He says that he doesn't think he's cut out to be a fighter, and just a little man in a cruel world, then logs out. Wemmbu laughs and says, "Okay, I guess I'm doing this on my own," before leaving the meeting room to stare at the ruins of his civilization. He does an inventory check and leaves to make bomber planes in the valley. After he finishes them, he murmurs to himself how he needs to monologue on his video instead of having Egg do it. He gives some explanations while activating the planes. He needs to manually blow up the ravine because the planes can't reach down there. He had to build three planes because the path is stupid and it winds. He flies around, showing off the plane and carpet-bombing the valley, which is barely making a dent in the ground, so he resolves to doing it manually. He commentates that the best way to blow something up is to do it yourself and with the wither skulls from 
ParrotX2's
 old base. Wemmbu spawns three withers, one of which fails to deploy, and sees that the bomber planes are working properly. He spawns five more withers and flies up to see a watermelon pillar with a bridge near the tree that wasn't there before. He finds out two of the planes broke for some reason, while the third plane is moving too fast, then concludes that it's because he unloaded the chunks that broke the planes.

He flies to the bridge and finds Parrot and 
Wifies
 there with Wifies greeting him and Parrot panickedly telling him to get out. He asks if Wemmbu built the planes. Wemmbu confirms that. Parrot incredulously asks why, and Wemmbu replies that he was paid to blow up the valley. Wifies asks, confused, why. Wemmbu replies that he doesn't know. Wifies asks by who, and Wemmbu hesitates, saying he doesn't know if he's allowed to tell them, but Parrot interrupts, guessing it was Boosfer, Kier, and Dev. Wemmbu says he can't confirm nor deny it for fear of legal repercussions. He spleefs Parrot and cuts down a bit of the melon bridge just as a wither breaks the last plane before Parrot calls him over. They mess up the planes further, but Wemmbu isn't really that mad about it because it is already broken. Wemmbu asks what they're doing, and Parrot asks what it looks like they're doing. Wemmbu replies that he doesn't know because Parrot is always doing the oddest things. Parrot says that Wemmbu is blowing up 
rekrap2's
 base, which Parrot and Wifies were trying to protect. Wemmbu just replies that they paid him to blow it up, so… Parrot sighs and asks if he was just going to blow it up. Wemmbu replies, "Yeah," then flies away as Parrot calls for him. Wemmbu spawns three more withers before Parrot whispers to Wemmbu to come back for an offer. He asks if he's just doing it to get paid, and Wemmbu replies, "Yes." Parrot asks why, and Wemmbu tells him he needs money. Parrot asks Wemmbu if he can make an exception for Rekrap's base. Wemmbu retorts, asking when the last time they saw Rekrap was, and Parrot replies that Rekrap's gone and that they're searching for him. Wemmbu replies that he won't care about his base and that it's a win-win. Parrot explains a bunch of players disappeared, but that Wemmbu wouldn't care about them and that they're on a scavenger hunt again. He asks Wemmbu if he knows what the Treasure Hunters' actual jobs are, and when Wemmbu says not really, he explains that what they actually do is steal people's most prized possessions and sell them, to which Wemmbu replies that it makes sense. Parrot explains that they were doing a quest and that the Treasure Hunters pulled up, threatening them that if they didn't give them what they wanted, they would blow Rekrap's base up, which Wemmbu is doing. Parrot tries to reason with Wemmbu to not go against the people who have the server's best interests in mind, and instead go against the people who have way more riches than what they have given. Wemmbu retorts that he doesn't really care about the server and that he's not intentionally targeting Parrot, and that he was just in Wemmbu's way. Parrot asks what happened to Wemmbu's empire, and Wemmbu explains that Zam blew it up. Parrot asks if he was going to stoop to Zam's level, if he was just going to blow up an innocent player's base for his own benefit. Wemmbu asks what else he can do. Parrot says he can not do it, and Wemmbu replies, baffled, "What else am I going to do, not get revenge and just get bullied by Zam forever?" He starts fidgeting with the items around him and asks Parrot what their plans are, to just steal from the Treasure Hunters? Parrot asks Wemmbu if he really was planning to beat Zam with Zam's game or with his own. He welcomes Wemmbu to the team after a moment of silence, which Wifies and Wemmbu both comment is bold of him to do. Wemmbu asks Parrot if they have the Treasure Hunters' location and what their plan is supposed to be, considering Parrot is naked and Wifies is in leather armour. Wemmbu compromises, saying he'll blow up the parts they don't care about and still claim the payment. Then he can help them find the Treasure Hunters' vault. He asks them why they aren't wearing netherite, and Parrot explains that it's part of the rules of the quest. Wemmbu asks what parts he can blow up, and Parrot replies that he can only blow up the top of the tree, but Wemmbu explains that it's already been blown up. He asks if there's a way to make it seem like he blew up the whole area without actually doing so, and Parrot replies he can do so by not blowing up the underground base, to which Wemmbu happily takes his TNT shulker and heads to the ground to blow it up.

Wemmbu asks them if they can help place TNT, and they agree. He asks Parrot who's watching them, and they can't provide an answer, but Wifies says they'd rather not take any chances. Wemmbu asks Wifies how he's doing, and Wifies replies he's better than the times he's been kidnapped and mentions that it's happened quite a few times. Wemmbu says he won't not not not not not not not kidnap Wifies. He replies that he likes the sound of that. Wemmbu assumes that the Treasure Hunters didn't know the base was there and that they were following them to find it, but Parrot mentions that they were jumped in the actual base. Parrot asks Wemmbu why he's doing this, and Wemmbu replies he's doing it for money and that he's good at it, and has to make ends meet. He mentions that Boosfer was being vague and he didn't trust him either. Wemmbu asks if it is okay if the top portion is blown up since he didn't want to stoop to Zam's level. Parrot replies that the best-case scenario was that it wasn't, but that it was okay in order to convince the Treasure Hunters. Wemmbu flies up and surveys the area, concluding that it's pretty destroyed. The three of them head to the underground base and start planning. Parrot and Wifies conclude that while on a quest, they shouldn't wear armour, but between quests should be fine. Wemmbu tells the other two to tell him when they've completed their quest so that they can rob the Treasure Hunters. Parrot and Wifies go to complete their current quest while Wemmbu collects his payment.

Wemmbu goes to Kier and Dev, who escort him to Boosfer. Kier and Dev confirm to Boosfer that Wemmbu did a good job blowing up Rekrap's base, and Boosfer gives Wemmbu a black shulker filled with netherite blocks as payment. Boosfer asks if Wemmbu wants more jobs, but Wemmbu asks what was it that he blew up, and that Parrot and Wifies were upset. Boosfer asks if he was up to the task. Wemmbu confirms that he is, just that he wants more information. Boosfer asks if he and Parrot are friends, and Wemmbu replies that they kinda are. He asks if Wemmbu is still fit to do the job, or if they should pass it on to the next candidate. Wemmbu says that he'll think about it, and Boosfer agrees to give him a couple of days, but Dev makes him reduce it to just one day. Boosfer has him leave because he's tired of looking at his face, and Kier and Dev escort Wemmbu out.

Wemmbu heads back to the Wemmbu Civilization ruins and paces around the inner obsidian wall. Parrot and Wifies arrive, and Parrot asks if there was a reason Wemmbu wanted to meet them there. Wemmbu replies that he's been thinking. Parrot and Wifies reply that they've been thinking too. Wemmbu leads them into the underground base and explains that it's his and Egg's hidey hole, but that Egg's been busy. He asks if they finished their quest, and they reply that they need him for something. He says that he needs them for something too, both of which is to blow up the Treasure Hunters' headquarters. Wemmbu explains his first meeting with Boosfer and Boosfer's monologue about being in plain sight. He says that there might be a base in their headquarters, but that he'd still want to blow up the headquarters regardless because they threatened his life. Parrot says that they don't care about the Treasure Hunters' items and that they just don't want them to interfere in their quest. Wemmbu says that he has the materials that he's sure they were familiar with. Parrot guesses that it's an orbital strike cannon, to which Wemmbu asks if they'll be down to help him build it. Parrot agrees, but asks if it'll only be used on the Treasure Hunters. Wemmbu says it'll also be used on Zam, but they didn't care about that. He relays the lesson he's learned throughout his career in griefing: that it's best to manually blow things up, not use complicated redstone machines. Parrot concludes that there's no need to build a cannon and makes Wemmbu promise to use it only for one shot on Boosfer and one shot on Zam for them to agree to help him since any more than that would cause a domino effect of destruction. Wemmbu says that he's built orbital cannons alone before, but agrees. They fly to a remote location to build the cannon.

Wemmbu asks if they want to help him wage war against Zam, and Parrot denies, saying that they just want to find the missing players. Wemmbu then mentions that Zam is a menace to the server as motivation for Parrot, and that they're basically fighting a war together by going against Boosfer. Parrot relents, saying that if it were Wemmbu five weeks ago, he would've denied, but this time, he accepts. They head to the Treasure Hunters' base, where they pass by a lone tree dubbed "Waypoint Tree." Parrot misses all of the pots, and Wembbu says it's okay because he wasn't gonna use them anyway. They head in and strike it just as it renders in. As the cannon blows the building up, Wemmbu goes in and withers the first floor, where Dev finds him and exclaims that he can't believe he betrayed them, to which Wemmbu replies that he didn't betray them. He was never on their side in the first place. Once six withers are spawned, Wemmbu goes to the top floor to spawn more, only to see that it's already been blown up by the orbital cannon. Wemmbu spams TNT, but the Treasure Hunters interrupt him. They start a 3 v 3 while Parrot and Wifies try to spam TNT. Dev's helmet and boots pop, and he goes to the vault before escaping, which leads Wemmbu to them. Kier follows inside and attempts to prevent Wemmbu from getting anything, but his helmet and boots break, forcing him to retreat and let Wemmbu take everything. He tells Parrot and Wifies to come into the vault and e-chest everything they can before escaping.

Parrot asks for an e-chest and tries to give it to Wemmbu, but Wemmbu tells him to keep it because his e-chest is full and he can get it from him later. Parrot tries to bury it in a normal chest, but Wemmbu tells him that that's a bad idea and reiterates that he'll get it from Parrot later. Parrot finally relents and e-chests the diamonds while exclaiming that the Treasure Hunters are hoarders. Parrot and Wifies continue to hunt for Clown and Wemmbu prepares for his war against Zam.

Wemmbu goes back to the civilization ruins to stand on the inner wall and observe the sunrise, saying that everything is ready. Egg logs on and Wemmbu greets him. Egg says that his girlfriend is finally gone, and Wemmbu celebrates, but his mic cuts off. Egg says that she gave him the strength to come back and be a mole. Wemmbu asks what he's talking about, and Egg says that he's low on the food chain. He proceeds to tell Egg that they're rich now and leads him to the Zam statue at spawn to blow it up as a declaration of war. Wemmbu asks Egg if they should blow up the village as well, but Egg says that they have to leave the people alone. 

Wemmbu places a sign that says "- wemmbu" at the foot of the blown-up statue to alert them that they have declared war on the PrinceZam Empire.



Trivia


This episode was originally titled "Why I Destroyed Our Minecraft Server".
